	public class SnapCompatibilitySettings : CompatibilitySettings

		protected internal override void ResetCore()

		}

	}

	public class DocumentDataSources
	{
		[Description("")]
		public DataSourceInfoCollection DataSources { get; set; }

		[Description("")]
		public DataSourceInfo DefaultDataSourceInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return DataSources.DefaultDataSourceInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				DataSources.SetDefaultDataSource(value);
			}
		}

		protected internal DocumentDataSources()
		{
			DataSources = new DataSourceInfoCollection();
		}

		protected internal DocumentDataSources(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DataSources = documentModel.DataSources;
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public delegate void SnapMailMergeStartedEventHandler(object sender, SnapMailMergeStartedEventArgs e);
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class SnapMailMergeStartedEventArgs : CancelEventArgs
	{
		private readonly SnapDocumentModel targetDocumentModel;

		private InternalSnapDocumentServer targetServer;

		private string operationDescription = string.Empty;

		public string OperationDescription
		{
			get
			{
				return operationDescription;
			}
			set
			{
				operationDescription = value;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocument Document
		{
			get
			{
				if (targetDocumentModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (targetServer == null)
				{
					targetServer = CreateDocumentServerForExistingDocumentModel(targetDocumentModel);
				}
				return targetServer.Document;
			}
		}

		internal SnapMailMergeStartedEventArgs(SnapDocumentModel targetDocumentModel)
		{
			this.targetDocumentModel = targetDocumentModel;
		}

		internal static InternalSnapDocumentServer CreateDocumentServerForExistingDocumentModel(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return new InternalSnapDocumentServer(documentModel);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)targetServer).Dispose();
			targetServer = null;
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public delegate void SnapMailMergeRecordStartedEventHandler(object sender, SnapMailMergeRecordStartedEventArgs e);
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class SnapMailMergeRecordStartedEventArgs : CancelEventArgs
	{
		private readonly SnapDocumentModel targetDocumentModel;

		private readonly SnapDocumentModel recordDocumentModel;

		private InternalSnapDocumentServer targetServer;

		private InternalSnapDocumentServer recordServer;

		private int recordIndex;

		public int RecordIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return recordIndex;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				recordIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocument Document
		{
			get
			{
				if (targetDocumentModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (targetServer == null)
				{
					targetServer = SnapMailMergeStartedEventArgs.CreateDocumentServerForExistingDocumentModel(targetDocumentModel);
				}
				return targetServer.Document;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocument RecordDocument
		{
			get
			{
				if (recordDocumentModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (recordServer == null)
				{
					recordServer = SnapMailMergeStartedEventArgs.CreateDocumentServerForExistingDocumentModel(recordDocumentModel);
				}
				return recordServer.Document;
			}
		}

		internal SnapMailMergeRecordStartedEventArgs(SnapDocumentModel targetDocumentModel, SnapDocumentModel recordDocumentModel)
		{
			this.targetDocumentModel = targetDocumentModel;
			this.recordDocumentModel = recordDocumentModel;
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)targetServer).Dispose();
			((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)recordServer).Dispose();
			targetServer = null;
			recordServer = null;
		}
	}

	public class ValidateSqlEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public bool Valid { get; set; }

		public string Message { get; set; }

		public string Sql { get; private set; }

		public DataConnectionParametersBase ConnectionParameters { get; private set; }

		public ValidateSqlEventArgs(DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters, string sql)
		{
			ConnectionParameters = connectionParameters;
			Sql = sql;
		}

		public ValidateSqlEventArgs(CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery)
		{
			ConnectionParameters = customSqlQuery.DataSource.Connection.ConnectionParameters;
			Sql = customSqlQuery.Sql;
		}
	}
	public class DataSourceRemovedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private readonly DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo;

		private readonly bool isDataSourceInternal;

		public DataSourceInfo DataSourceInfo => dataSourceInfo;

		public bool IsDataSourceInternal => isDataSourceInternal;

		public DataSourceRemovedEventArgs(DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo, bool isDataSourceInternal)
		{
			this.dataSourceInfo = dataSourceInfo;
			this.isDataSourceInternal = isDataSourceInternal;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Snap.Services
{
	public class DataAccessService : DataAccessServiceBase
	{
		protected internal DataAccessService(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
		}

		public Type GetColumnType(object dataSource, string dataMember, string columnName)
		{
			if (dataSource == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] nestedFields = ((!columnName.Contains(".")) ? null : new string[1] { columnName });
			SnapDataContext snapDataContext = new SnapDataContext(base.DataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields(dataSource), base.DocumentModel.Parameters, null, nestedFields);
			try
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowserForParentDataMember = GetDataBrowserForParentDataMember(snapDataContext, dataSource, dataMember);
				ListBrowser val = (ListBrowser)(object)((dataBrowserForParentDataMember is ListBrowser) ? dataBrowserForParentDataMember : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((SnapListController)(object)val.ListController).GetColumnType(columnName);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDataContext)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IObjectDataSourceValidationService
	{
		void Validate(IEnumerable<ObjectDataSource> dataSources);
	}
	internal class SnapCustomQueryValidator : CustomQueryValidator
	{
		private Action<ValidateSqlEventArgs> callback;

		public SnapCustomQueryValidator(Action<ValidateSqlEventArgs> callback)
		{
			this.callback = callback;
		}

		public override bool Validate(DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters, string sql, ref string message)
		{
			ValidateSqlEventArgs e = new ValidateSqlEventArgs(connectionParameters, sql);
			e.Valid = base.Validate(connectionParameters, sql, ref message);
			e.Message = message;
			callback(e);
			message = e.Message;
			return e.Valid;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Snap.Native
{
	public interface IParameterChangeManager
	{
		void BeginUpdate();

		void EndUpdate();

		void SetProperty<T>(Action<T> setter, T oldValue, T newValue);
	}
	public class ModelParameterCollection : ParameterCollection, IParameterChangeManager
	{
		private readonly SnapDocumentModel model;

		public ModelParameterCollection(SnapDocumentModel model)
		{
			this.model = model;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter item)
		{
			InsertParameterHistoryItem insertParameterHistoryItem = new InsertParameterHistoryItem(model, this);
			insertParameterHistoryItem.Index = index;
			insertParameterHistoryItem.Item = item;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)model).History.Add(insertParameterHistoryItem);
			insertParameterHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		internal void InsertItemCore(int index, DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			SetChangeManager(item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			RemoveParameterHistoryItem removeParameterHistoryItem = new RemoveParameterHistoryItem(model, this);
			removeParameterHistoryItem.Index = index;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)model).History.Add(removeParameterHistoryItem);
			removeParameterHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		internal void RemoveItemCore(int index)
		{
			ResetChangeManager(index);
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter item)
		{
			SetParameterHistoryItem setParameterHistoryItem = new SetParameterHistoryItem(model, this);
			setParameterHistoryItem.Index = index;
			setParameterHistoryItem.Item = item;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)model).History.Add(setParameterHistoryItem);
			setParameterHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		internal void SetItemCore(int index, DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter item)
		{
			ResetChangeManager(index);
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			SetChangeManager(item);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			ClearParametersHistoryItem clearParametersHistoryItem = new ClearParametersHistoryItem(model, this);
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)model).History.Add(clearParametersHistoryItem);
			clearParametersHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		internal void ClearItemsCore()
		{
			using (IEnumerator<DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter current = enumerator.Current;
					current.ChangeManager = null;
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		private void SetChangeManager(DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.ChangeManager = this;
			}
		}

		private void ResetChangeManager(int index)
		{
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter parameter = base[index];
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				parameter.ChangeManager = null;
			}
		}

		void IParameterChangeManager.BeginUpdate()
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)model).BeginUpdate();
		}

		void IParameterChangeManager.EndUpdate()
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)model).EndUpdate();
		}

		void IParameterChangeManager.SetProperty<T>(Action<T> setter, T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			HistoryHelper.SetPropertyCore<T>((PieceTable)(object)model.MainPieceTable, setter, oldValue, newValue);
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Snap.Native.Services
{
	public class CompositeDataConnectionParametersService : IDataConnectionParametersService
	{
		private readonly HashSet<IDataConnectionParametersService> innerList = new HashSet<IDataConnectionParametersService>();

		public void AddService(IDataConnectionParametersService srv)
		{
			innerList.Add(srv);
		}

		public DataConnectionParametersBase RaiseConfigureDataConnection(string connectionName, DataConnectionParametersBase parameters)
		{
			foreach (IDataConnectionParametersService inner in innerList)
			{
				parameters = inner.RaiseConfigureDataConnection(connectionName, parameters);
			}
			return parameters;
		}

		public DataConnectionParametersBase RaiseHandleConnectionError(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionErrorEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			foreach (IDataConnectionParametersService inner in innerList)
			{
				inner.RaiseHandleConnectionError(eventArgs);
				if (eventArgs.Handled)
				{
					return eventArgs.Cancel ? null : eventArgs.ConnectionParameters;
				}
			}
			return eventArgs.ConnectionParameters;
		}
	}
	public class DataConnectionParametersService : IDataConnectionParametersService
	{
		private readonly SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel;

		public DataConnectionParametersService(SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel)
		{
			this.snapDocumentModel = snapDocumentModel;
		}

		DataConnectionParametersBase IDataConnectionParametersService.RaiseConfigureDataConnection(string connectionName, DataConnectionParametersBase parameters)
		{
			return snapDocumentModel.RaiseConfigureDataConnection(connectionName, parameters);
		}

		DataConnectionParametersBase IDataConnectionParametersService.RaiseHandleConnectionError(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionErrorEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			return snapDocumentModel.RaiseHandleConnectionError(eventArgs);
		}
	}
}

	public class NativeSnapChart : NativeSnapEntityBase, SnapChart, SnapEntity, IDisposable
	{
		private ISNChartContainer chartContainer;

		private bool useExplicitSize;

		private bool autoLayout;

		private int width;

		private int height;

		private int paletteBaseColorNumber;

		private string appearanceName;

		private string seriesDataMember;

		private string dataMember;

		private string dataSourceName;

		private string indicatorsPaletteName;

		private string paletteName;

		private Color backColor;

		private PrintImageFormat imageType;

		private SortingMode seriesSorting;

		private SnapPieceTable PieceTable => (SnapPieceTable)(object)base.RawField.PieceTable;

		private DataContainer DataContainer => chartContainer.Chart.DataContainer;

		private IDataSourceDispatcher DataSourceDispatcher => PieceTable.DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher;

		public bool UseExplicitSize
		{
			get
			{
				return useExplicitSize;
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureUpdateBegan();
				if (useExplicitSize != value)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						base.Controller.SetSwitch(SNChartField.UseExplicitSizeSwitch);
					}
					else
					{
						base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNChartField.UseExplicitSizeSwitch);
					}
					useExplicitSize = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string DataSourceName
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSourceName;
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureUpdateBegan();
				if (!string.Equals(dataSourceName, value, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					base.Controller.SetSwitch(SNChartField.ChartDataSourceSwitch, value);
					dataSourceName = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string DataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureUpdateBegan();
				if (!string.Equals(dataMember, value, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					chartContainer.Chart.DataContainer.DataMember = value;
					dataMember = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return DataSourceDispatcher.GetDataSourceOrDefault(dataSourceName);
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureUpdateBegan();
				if (DataSource != value)
				{
					DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(value, allowNullDataSource: true);
					if (dataSourceInfo == null)
					{
						dataSourceInfo = PieceTable.DocumentModel.RegisterDataSource(value);
					}
					DataSourceName = dataSourceInfo.DataSourceName;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Width
		{
			get
			{
				return width;
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureUpdateBegan();
				if (width != value)
				{
					if (value == 0)
					{
						base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNChartField.ChartWidthSwitch);
					}
					else
					{
						base.Controller.SetSwitch(SNChartField.ChartWidthSwitch, Convert.ToString(value));
					}
					width = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Height
		{
			get
			{
				return height;
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureUpdateBegan();
				if (height != value)
				{
					if (value == 0)
					{
						base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNChartField.ChartHeightSwitch);
					}
					else
					{
						base.Controller.SetSwitch(SNChartField.ChartHeightSwitch, Convert.ToString(value));
					}
					height = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				return new Size(Width, Height);
			}
			set
			{
				Width = value.Width;
				Height = value.Height;
			}
		}

		public SeriesCollection Series
		{
			get

		public NativeSnapChart(SnapNativeDocument document, Field field)
			: base(document, field)
		{
		}

		public NativeSnapChart(SnapSubDocument subDocument, SnapNativeDocument document, Field field)
			: base(subDocument, document, field)
		{
		}

		protected override void Init()
		{
			base.Init();
			SNChartField sNChartField = GetParsedField<SNChartField>();
			Size savedSize = sNChartField.GetSavedSize();
			width = savedSize.Width;
			height = savedSize.Height;
			useExplicitSize = sNChartField.UseExplicitSize;
			dataSourceName = sNChartField.ChartDataSourceName;
			EnsureChartContainerCreated();
			SNChart chart = chartContainer.Chart;
			autoLayout = chart.AutoLayout;
			appearanceName = chart.AppearanceName;
			backColor = chart.BackColor;
			dataMember = chart.DataContainer.DataMember;
			indicatorsPaletteName = chart.IndicatorsPaletteName;
			imageType = chart.OptionsPrint.ImageFormat;
			paletteBaseColorNumber = chart.PaletteBaseColorNumber;
			paletteName = chart.PaletteName;
			seriesDataMember = chart.DataContainer.SeriesDataMember;
			seriesSorting = chart.DataContainer.BoundSeriesSorting;
			chartContainer.Dispose();
			chartContainer = null;
		}

		private void EnsureChartContainerCreated()
		{
			if (chartContainer == null)
			{
				SNChartField sNChartField = GetParsedField<SNChartField>();
				chartContainer = sNChartField.GetChartContainer(base.RawField);
			}
		}

		public override void BeginUpdate()
		{
			base.BeginUpdate();
			EnsureChartContainerCreated();
		}

		public override void EndUpdate()
		{
			SNChart chart = chartContainer.Chart;
			RegisterSeriesDataSources(chart.Series);
			SNChartHelper.SaveChartLayout(chart, base.Controller);
			SNChartHelper.SaveChartSeriesBindings(chart, base.Controller);
			base.EndUpdate();
		}

		private void RegisterSeriesDataSources(SeriesCollection series)
		{
			int count = series.Count;
			SnapDocumentModel documentModel = PieceTable.DocumentModel;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				object dataSource = series[i].DataSource;
				if (dataSource != null)
				{
					DataSourceInfo info = DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(dataSource);
					if (info == null)
					{
						documentModel.RegisterDataSource(dataSource);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{

			base.Controller.SetSwitch(SNBarCodeField.BarCodeGeneratorSwitch, SNBarCodeHelper.GetGeneratorBase64String(generator));
		}

		private static BarCodeGeneratorBase CloneGenerator(BarCodeGeneratorBase generator)
		{
			object obj = ((ICloneable)generator).Clone();
			return (BarCodeGeneratorBase)((obj is BarCodeGeneratorBase) ? obj : null);
		}

		public SnapNativeFieldOwner(NativeSubDocument subDocument, SnapNativeDocument document)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)subDocument, "subDocument");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)document, "document");
			this.subDocument = subDocument;
			this.document = document;
			lists = new Dictionary<string, NativeSnapList>();
		}

		internal void SetActiveEntity(SnapEntity value)
		{
			if (activeEntity == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (activeEntity == null)
			{
				activeEntity = value;
				return;
			}
			if (activeEntity.Active)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (activeEntity is NativeSnapList nativeSnapList)
			{
				lists.Remove(nativeSnapList.Name);
			}
			activeEntity = value;
		}

		public SnapList FindListByName(string name)
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (lists.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return lists[name];
			}
			Field listField = GetListField(name);
			if (listField == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			NativeSnapList nativeSnapList = new NativeSnapList(SnapSubDocument, Document, (Field)new NativeField(NativeSubDocument, listField));
			lists.Add(name, nativeSnapList);
			return nativeSnapList;
		}

		public SnapList CreateSnList(DocumentPosition position, string name)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Expected O, but got Unknown
			name = name ?? string.Empty;
			string fieldCode = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) ? $"SnList \\name {name}" : "SnList");
			Field val = CreateField(position, fieldCode, "SnapList");
			NativeSnapList nativeSnapList = new NativeSnapList(SnapSubDocument, Document, (Field)new NativeField(NativeSubDocument, val));
			if (!lists.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				lists.Add(name, nativeSnapList);
			}
			else
			{
				lists[name] = nativeSnapList;
			}
			return nativeSnapList;
		}

		public void RemoveSnList(string name)
		{
			if (activeEntity != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.SnapEntityRemoveLock));
			}
			Field listField = GetListField(name);
			if (listField == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (lists.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				lists.Remove(name);
			}
			NativeSubDocument.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				PieceTable.DeleteFieldWithResult(listField);
			}
			finally
			{
				NativeSubDocument.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private Field CreateField(DocumentPosition position, string fieldCode, string fieldType)
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (activeEntity != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.SnapEntityAddLock), fieldType));

			{

			}
		}

		}

	{
		private readonly SnapNativeDocument document;

		private readonly SnapSubDocument subDocument;

		private InstructionController controller;

		private Field apiField;

		private Field rawField;

		private CalculatedFieldBase parsedField;

		public static readonly string TextBeforeIfFieldNotBlankSwitch = "b";

		public static readonly string TextAfterIfFieldNotBlankSwitch = "f";

		protected virtual string LockExceptionText => SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.SnapListLockException);

		public InstructionController Controller
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Active)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(LockExceptionText);
				}
				return controller;
			}
		}

		protected Field RawField => rawField;

		public bool Active => controller != null;

		public SnapNativeDocument Document => document;

		SnapDocument SnapEntity.Document => Document;

		public SnapSubDocument SubDocument => subDocument;

		public Field Field => apiField;

		protected NativeSnapEntityBase(SnapNativeDocument document, Field field)
			: this(document, document, field)
		{
		}

		protected NativeSnapEntityBase(SnapSubDocument subDocument, SnapNativeDocument document, Field field)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.subDocument = subDocument;
			this.document = document;
			apiField = field;
			rawField = ((NativeField)field).Field;
			Init();
		}

		protected virtual void Init()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			parsedField = ((FieldCalculatorService)new SnapFieldCalculatorService()).ParseField(((NativeSubDocument)subDocument).PieceTable, RawField);
		}

		public void EnsureUpdateBegan()
		{
			if (!Active)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(LockExceptionText);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Reset()
		{
			Init();
		}

		protected T GetParsedField<T>() where T : CalculatedFieldBase
		{
			CalculatedFieldBase obj = parsedField;
			return (T)(object)((obj is T) ? obj : null);
		}

		public virtual void BeginUpdate()
		{
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Active)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.SnapListSecondBeginUpdateException));
			}
			if (document == subDocument)
			{
				document.SetActiveEntity(this);
			}
			else
			{
				((SnapNativeSubDocument)subDocument).SetActiveEntity(this);
			}
			controller = new InstructionController(rawField, parsedField)
			{
				SuppressFieldsUpdateAfterUpdateInstruction = true
			};
		}

		public virtual void EndUpdate()
		{
			controller.Dispose();
			controller = null;
			if (document == subDocument)
			{
				document.SetActiveEntity(null);
			}
			else
			{
				((SnapNativeSubDocument)subDocument).SetActiveEntity(null);
			}
			Reset();
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			EndUpdate();
		}
	}

				}
			}

				}
			}
		}

		{

		public float ScaleX
		{
			get

				return 0.01f * (float)scaleX;
			}
			set

				EnsureUpdateBegan();
				scaleX = (int)(100f * value);
				if (scaleX == 100 && scaleY == 100)
				{
					base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNImageField.ScaleXSwitch);
					base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNImageField.ScaleYSwitch);
				}
				else

				}

					base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNImageField.ScaleXSwitch);
					base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNImageField.ScaleYSwitch);
				}
				else
				{

					base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(SNImageField.HeightSwitch);

			SNImageField sNImageField = GetParsedField<SNImageField>();
			imageSizeMode = sNImageField.Sizing;
			updateMode = sNImageField.UpdateMode;
			scaleX = GetScale(sNImageField, SNImageField.ScaleXSwitch);
			scaleY = GetScale(sNImageField, SNImageField.ScaleYSwitch);
			width = ((CalculatedFieldBase)sNImageField).Switches.GetInt(SNImageField.WidthSwitch);
			height = ((CalculatedFieldBase)sNImageField).Switches.GetInt(SNImageField.HeightSwitch);
			showPlaceholder = sNImageField.ShowPlaceholder;
		}

		private int GetScale(SNImageField parsedField, string key)
		{
			if (!((CalculatedFieldBase)parsedField).Switches.Switches.ContainsKey("\\" + key))
			{
				return 100;
			}
			return ((CalculatedFieldBase)parsedField).Switches.GetInt(key);
		}

		public NativeSnapList(SnapNativeDocument document, Field field)
			: this(document, document, field)

		}

		public NativeSnapList(SnapSubDocument subDocument, SnapNativeDocument document, Field field)
			: base(subDocument, document, field)
		{
			SNListField sNListField = GetParsedField<SNListField>();
			if (sNListField.Name == null)
			{
				name = string.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				name = sNListField.Name;
			}
			dataAccessService = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)document.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			if (dataAccessService == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = dataAccessService.FieldPathService.FromString(sNListField.DataSourceName);
			dataSourceName = FieldDataSourceInfoToString(fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo);
			dataMember = fieldPathInfo.GetFullPath();
			filters = new NativeSnapListFilters(this, (fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem != null && fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem.FilterProperties != null) ? fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem.FilterProperties.Filters : new List<string>());
		}

		public DocumentRange GetSwitchValue(string key)
		{
			if (switches == null)
			{
				UpdateSwitches();
			}
			if (switches.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void UpdateSwitches()
		{
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switches = new Dictionary<string, DocumentRange>();
			SNListField sNListField = GetParsedField<SNListField>();
			foreach (string allSwitchKey in ((CalculatedFieldBase)sNListField).Switches.GetAllSwitchKeys())
			{
				if (((CalculatedFieldBase)sNListField).IsSwitchWithArgument("\\" + allSwitchKey))
				{
					DocumentLogInterval switchArgumentDocumentInterval = ((CalculatedFieldBase)sNListField).Switches.GetSwitchArgumentDocumentInterval(allSwitchKey);
					switches.Add(allSwitchKey, (DocumentRange)(object)base.Document.CreateRange(switchArgumentDocumentInterval.Start, switchArgumentDocumentInterval.Length));
				}
			}
			erl = 20;
			if (switches.ContainsKey(SNListField.EditorRowLimitSwitch))
			{
				int.TryParse(((CalculatedFieldBase)sNListField).Switches.GetString(SNListField.EditorRowLimitSwitch), out erl);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRowTemplate()
		{
			InternalSnapDocumentServer template = GetTemplate(TemplatedFieldBase.TemplateSwitch);
			rowTemplate = (SnapNativeDocument)template.Document;
			((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)template).ModifiedChanged += RowTemplateDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateListHeader()
		{
			InternalSnapDocumentServer template = GetTemplate(SNListField.ListHeaderTemplateSwitch);
			listHeader = (SnapNativeDocument)template.Document;
			((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)template).ModifiedChanged += ListHeaderDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateListFooter()
		{
			InternalSnapDocumentServer template = GetTemplate(SNListField.ListFooterTemplateSwitch);
			listFooter = (SnapNativeDocument)template.Document;
			((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)template).ModifiedChanged += ListFooterDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateSeparator()
		{
			InternalSnapDocumentServer template = GetTemplate(SNListField.SeparatorTemplateSwitch);
			separator = (SnapNativeDocument)template.Document;
			((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)template).ModifiedChanged += SeparatorDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
		}

		private InternalSnapDocumentServer GetTemplate(string switchKey)
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (switches == null)
			{
				UpdateSwitches();
			}
			SnapDocumentModel documentModel = base.Document.DocumentModel;
			DocumentModel val = ((DocumentModel)documentModel).CreateNew();
			DocumentModelCopyCommand.ReplaceDefaultProperties(val, (DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
			DocumentModelCopyCommand.CopyStyles(val, (DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
			val.FieldOptions.CopyFrom((FieldOptions)(object)documentModel.FieldOptions);
			if (switches.TryGetValue(switchKey, out var value))
			{
				CopyHelper.CopyCore(base.RawField.PieceTable, val.MainPieceTable, new DocumentLogInterval(value.Start.LogPosition, value.Length), DocumentLogPosition.Zero);
			}
			InternalSnapDocumentServer internalSnapDocumentServer = new InternalSnapDocumentServer((SnapDocumentModel)(object)val);
			((DocumentModel)internalSnapDocumentServer.DocumentModel).Modified = false;
			return internalSnapDocumentServer;
		}

		private void RowTemplateDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EnsureUpdateBegan();
			rowTemplateModified = true;
		}

		private void ListHeaderDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EnsureUpdateBegan();
			listHeaderModified = true;
		}

		private void ListFooterDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EnsureUpdateBegan();
			listFooterModified = true;
		}

		private void SeparatorDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EnsureUpdateBegan();
			separatorModified = true;
		}

		private void ApplyGroupsAndSorting()
		{
			if (groups == null && sorting == null)
			{
				if (!filters.Modified && !dataSourceModified)
				{
					return;
				}
				InitGroupsAndSorting();
			}
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = new FieldPathInfo
			{
				DataSourceInfo = FieldDataSourceInfoFromString(dataSourceName),
				DataMemberInfo = new FieldPathDataMemberInfo()
			};
			fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.Items.Add(new FieldDataMemberInfoItem(dataMember));
			foreach (SnapListGroupParam item in sorting)
			{
				groups.Add(groups.CreateSnapListGroupInfo(item));
			}
			foreach (SnapListGroupInfo group in groups)
			{
				fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem.AddGroup(((NativeSnapListGroupInfo)group).Group);
				((NativeSnapListGroupInfo)group).EndUpdate();
			}
			foreach (string filter in filters)
			{
				fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem.AddFilter(filter);
			}
			base.Controller.SetArgument(0, dataAccessService.FieldPathService.GetStringPath(fieldPathInfo));
			groups.SetObsolete();
			sorting.SetObsolete();
			groups = null;
			sorting = null;
			filters.Modified = false;
			dataSourceModified = false;
		}

		private void InitGroupsAndSorting()
		{
			FieldDataMemberInfoItem lastItem = dataAccessService.FieldPathService.FromString(GetParsedField<SNListField>().DataSourceName).DataMemberInfo.LastItem;
			groups = new NativeSnapListGroups(this, lastItem);
			sorting = new NativeSnapListSorting(this, lastItem);
		}

		public DocumentModel CreateSwitch(out string key)
		{
			EnsureUpdateBegan();
			key = base.Controller.GetNonUsedSwitch();
			base.Controller.SetSwitch(key, string.Empty);
			return ((DocumentModel)base.Document.DocumentModel).CreateNew();
		}

		protected override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			groups = null;
			sorting = null;
			switches = null;
		}

		private void ApplyTableStylesCore(SnapNativeDocument template, ElementStyle baseStyle, int listLevel)
		{
			ApplyTableStylesCore(template, baseStyle, listLevel, 0);
		}

		private void ApplyTableStylesCore(SnapNativeDocument template, ElementStyle baseStyle, int listLevel, int groupLevel)
		{
			((NativeSubDocument)template).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)template.DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					SnapDocumentModel documentModel = base.Document.DocumentModel;
					SnapDocumentModel documentModel2 = template.DocumentModel;
					string styleName = StyleHelper.GetStyleName(ElementStyleNames[0], listLevel, (DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
					TableStyle styleByName = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableStyle>)(object)((DocumentModel)documentModel).TableStyles).GetStyleByName(styleName);
					if (styleByName != null)
					{
						TableStyle val = styleByName.CopyTo((DocumentModel)(object)documentModel2);
						foreach (Table table in ((PieceTable)documentModel2.MainPieceTable).Tables)
						{
							table.TableProperties.AvoidDoubleBorders = !BottomBorderVisibleWhenNested;
							if (table.NestedLevel == 0)
							{
								table.StyleIndex = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableStyle>)(object)table.DocumentModel.TableStyles).GetStyleIndexByName(((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)val).StyleName);
							}
						}
					}
					switch (baseStyle)
					{
					default:
						return;
					case ElementStyle.Header:
					case ElementStyle.Footer:
						styleName = StyleHelper.GetCellStyleName(ElementStyleNames[(int)baseStyle], listLevel, (DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
						break;
					case ElementStyle.GroupHeader:
					case ElementStyle.GroupFooter:
						styleName = StyleHelper.GetGroupStyleName(ElementStyleNames[(int)baseStyle], listLevel, groupLevel, (DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
						break;
					case ElementStyle.None:
						return;
					}
					TableCellStyle styleByName2 = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)((DocumentModel)documentModel).TableCellStyles).GetStyleByName(styleName);
					if (styleByName2 == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					TableCellStyle newStyle = styleByName2.CopyTo((DocumentModel)(object)documentModel2);
					foreach (Table table2 in ((PieceTable)documentModel2.MainPieceTable).Tables)
					{
						((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table2.Rows).ForEach((Action<TableRow>)delegate(TableRow row)
						{
							((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).ForEach((Action<TableCell>)delegate(TableCell cell)
							{
								StyleHelper.ApplyTableCellStyleCore(((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)newStyle).StyleName, cell);
							});
						});
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)template.DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((NativeSubDocument)template).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private bool GetBooleanSwitch(string fieldSwitch)
		{
			if (base.Active)
			{
				if (base.Controller.ContainsSwitch(fieldSwitch))
				{
					return !base.Controller.IsSwitchRemoving(fieldSwitch);
				}
				return false;
			}
			SNListField sNListField = GetParsedField<SNListField>();
			return ((CalculatedFieldBase)sNListField).Switches.GetBool(fieldSwitch);
		}

		private void SetBooleanSwitch(string fieldSwitch, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				base.Controller.SetSwitch(fieldSwitch);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(fieldSwitch);
			}
		}

		public void ApplyTableStyles()
		{
			ApplyTableStyles(1);
		}

		public void ApplyTableStyles(int level)
		{
			ApplyTableStylesCore((SnapNativeDocument)RowTemplate, ElementStyle.None, level);
			ApplyTableStylesCore((SnapNativeDocument)ListHeader, ElementStyle.Header, level);
			ApplyTableStylesCore((SnapNativeDocument)ListFooter, ElementStyle.Footer, level);
			int num = 1;
			foreach (SnapListGroupInfo group in Groups)
			{
				if (group.Header != null)
				{
					ApplyTableStylesCore((SnapNativeDocument)group.Header, ElementStyle.GroupHeader, level, num);
				}
				if (group.Footer != null)
				{
					ApplyTableStylesCore((SnapNativeDocument)group.Footer, ElementStyle.GroupFooter, level, num);
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		public override void EndUpdate()
		{
			if (base.Active)
			{
				UnsubscribeFromEvents();
				ApplyGroupsAndSorting();
				if (rowTemplateModified)
				{
					UpdateSwitch(TemplatedFieldBase.TemplateSwitch, rowTemplate.DocumentModel);
					rowTemplate = null;
					rowTemplateModified = false;
				}
				if (listHeaderModified)
				{
					UpdateSwitch(SNListField.ListHeaderTemplateSwitch, listHeader.DocumentModel);
					listHeader = null;
					listHeaderModified = false;
				}
				if (listFooterModified)
				{
					UpdateSwitch(SNListField.ListFooterTemplateSwitch, listFooter.DocumentModel);
					listFooter = null;
					listFooterModified = false;
				}
				if (separatorModified)
				{
					UpdateSwitch(SNListField.SeparatorTemplateSwitch, separator.DocumentModel);
					separator = null;
					separatorModified = false;
				}
				base.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFromEvents()
		{
			if (rowTemplate != null)
			{
				((NativeDocument)rowTemplate).ModifiedChanged -= RowTemplateDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
			}
			if (listHeader != null)
			{
				((NativeDocument)listHeader).ModifiedChanged -= ListHeaderDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
			}
			if (listFooter != null)
			{
				((NativeDocument)listFooter).ModifiedChanged -= ListFooterDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
			}
			if (separator != null)
			{
				((NativeDocument)separator).ModifiedChanged -= SeparatorDocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSwitch(string fieldSwitch, SnapDocumentModel model)
		{
			if (((DocumentModel)model).IsEmpty)
			{
				base.Controller.RemoveSwitch(fieldSwitch);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Controller.SetSwitch(fieldSwitch, (DocumentModel)(object)model);
			}
		}

		internal static FieldDataSourceInfo FieldDataSourceInfoFromString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return new RelativeFieldDataSourceInfo(0);
			}
			return new RootFieldDataSourceInfo(value);
		}

		internal static string FieldDataSourceInfoToString(FieldDataSourceInfo value)
		{
			if (!(value is RootFieldDataSourceInfo rootFieldDataSourceInfo))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return rootFieldDataSourceInfo.Name;
		}
	}

	public class NativeSnapListGroupInfo : SnapListGroupInfo, IList<SnapListGroupParam>, ICollection<SnapListGroupParam>, IEnumerable<SnapListGroupParam>, IEnumerable
	{
		private GroupProperties group;

		private SnapDocument header;

		private SnapDocument footer;

		private SnapDocument separator;

		private bool headerReady;

		private bool footerReady;

		private bool separatorReady;

		private NativeSnapList list;

		private Dictionary<string, InternalSnapDocumentServer> servers;

		private bool obsolete;

		internal GroupProperties Group
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				return group;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocument Header
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				if (!headerReady)
				{
					PrepareHeader();
				}
				return header;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocument Footer
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				if (!footerReady)
				{
					PrepareFooter();
				}
				return footer;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocument Separator
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				if (!separatorReady)
				{
					PrepareSeparator();
				}
				return separator;
			}
		}

		public SnapListGroupParam this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				return GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(group.GroupFieldInfos[index]);
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureValid();
				list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
				group.GroupFieldInfos[index] = SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(value);
			}
		}

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				return group.GroupFieldInfos.Count;
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public NativeSnapListGroupInfo(NativeSnapList list, GroupProperties group)
		{
			this.list = list;
			this.group = group;
			servers = new Dictionary<string, InternalSnapDocumentServer>();
			headerReady = !group.HasTemplateHeader;
			footerReady = !group.HasTemplateFooter;
			separatorReady = !group.HasTemplateSeparator;
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, InternalSnapDocumentServer> server in servers)
			{
				list.Controller.SetSwitch(server.Key, (DocumentModel)(object)server.Value.DocumentModel, true);
			}
			servers.Clear();
			if (header != null)
			{
				header = null;
				headerReady = false;
			}
			if (footer != null)
			{
				footer = null;
				footerReady = false;
			}
			if (separator != null)
			{
				separator = null;
				separatorReady = false;
			}
			SetObsolete();
		}

		private void PrepareHeader()
		{
			header = (group.HasTemplateHeader ? GetTemplate(group.TemplateHeaderSwitch) : null);
			headerReady = true;
		}

		private void PrepareFooter()
		{
			footer = (group.HasTemplateFooter ? GetTemplate(group.TemplateFooterSwitch) : null);
			footerReady = true;
		}

		private void PrepareSeparator()
		{
			separator = (group.HasTemplateSeparator ? GetTemplate(group.TemplateSeparatorSwitch) : null);
			separatorReady = true;
		}

		private SnapNativeDocument GetTemplate(string switchName)
		{
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (servers.ContainsKey(switchName))
			{
				return (SnapNativeDocument)servers[switchName].Document;
			}
			DocumentRange switchValue = list.GetSwitchValue(switchName);
			SnapNativeDocument document = list.Document;
			InternalSnapDocumentServer internalSnapDocumentServer = new InternalSnapDocumentServer(((DocumentModel)document.DocumentModel).DocumentFormatsDependencies);
			CopyHelper.CopyCore((PieceTable)(object)document.PieceTable, (PieceTable)(object)internalSnapDocumentServer.DocumentModel.MainPieceTable, new DocumentLogInterval(switchValue.Start.LogPosition, switchValue.Length), DocumentLogPosition.Zero, true, true, (UpdateFieldOperationType)4);
			((DocumentModel)internalSnapDocumentServer.DocumentModel).Modified = false;
			((DocumentModel)internalSnapDocumentServer.DocumentModel).ModifiedChanged += DocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
			servers.Add(switchName, internalSnapDocumentServer);
			return (SnapNativeDocument)internalSnapDocumentServer.Document;
		}

		private static GroupFieldInfo SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(SnapListGroupParam value)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new GroupFieldInfo(value.FieldName)
			{
				SortOrder = value.SortOrder,
				GroupInterval = value.Interval
			};
		}

		private static SnapListGroupParam GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(GroupFieldInfo value)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new SnapListGroupParam(value.FieldName, value.SortOrder, value.GroupInterval);
		}

		private void DocumentModel_ModifiedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel && ((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).Modified)
			{
				list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
				((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).ModifiedChanged -= DocumentModel_ModifiedChanged;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureValid()
		{
			if (obsolete)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.SnapListPropertyOutOfDataException));
			}
		}

		internal void SetObsolete()
		{
			obsolete = true;
		}

		public SnapDocument CreateHeader()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			RemoveHeader();
			string key;
			DocumentModel val = list.CreateSwitch(out key);
			InternalSnapDocumentServer internalSnapDocumentServer = new InternalSnapDocumentServer((SnapDocumentModel)(object)val);
			servers.Add(key, internalSnapDocumentServer);
			group.TemplateHeaderSwitch = key;
			header = internalSnapDocumentServer.Document;
			return header;
		}

		public SnapDocument CreateFooter()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			RemoveFooter();
			string key;
			DocumentModel val = list.CreateSwitch(out key);
			InternalSnapDocumentServer internalSnapDocumentServer = new InternalSnapDocumentServer((SnapDocumentModel)(object)val);
			servers.Add(key, internalSnapDocumentServer);
			group.TemplateFooterSwitch = key;
			footer = internalSnapDocumentServer.Document;
			return footer;
		}

		public SnapDocument CreateSeparator()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			RemoveSeparator();
			string key;
			DocumentModel val = list.CreateSwitch(out key);
			InternalSnapDocumentServer internalSnapDocumentServer = new InternalSnapDocumentServer((SnapDocumentModel)(object)val);
			servers.Add(key, internalSnapDocumentServer);
			group.TemplateSeparatorSwitch = key;
			separator = internalSnapDocumentServer.Document;
			return separator;
		}

		public void RemoveHeader()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			if (group.HasTemplateHeader)
			{
				list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
				string templateHeaderSwitch = group.TemplateHeaderSwitch;
				if (servers.ContainsKey(templateHeaderSwitch))
				{
					servers.Remove(templateHeaderSwitch);
				}
				header = null;
				headerReady = true;
				list.Controller.RemoveSwitch(templateHeaderSwitch);
				group.TemplateHeaderSwitch = null;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveFooter()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			if (group.HasTemplateFooter)
			{
				list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
				string templateFooterSwitch = group.TemplateFooterSwitch;
				if (servers.ContainsKey(templateFooterSwitch))
				{
					servers.Remove(templateFooterSwitch);
				}
				footer = null;
				footerReady = true;
				list.Controller.RemoveSwitch(templateFooterSwitch);
				group.TemplateFooterSwitch = null;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveSeparator()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			if (group.HasTemplateSeparator)
			{
				list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
				string templateSeparatorSwitch = group.TemplateSeparatorSwitch;
				if (servers.ContainsKey(templateSeparatorSwitch))
				{
					servers.Remove(templateSeparatorSwitch);
				}
				separator = null;
				separatorReady = true;
				list.Controller.RemoveSwitch(templateSeparatorSwitch);
				group.TemplateSeparatorSwitch = null;
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			EnsureValid();
			return group.GroupFieldInfos.IndexOf(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			EnsureValid();
			list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
			group.GroupFieldInfos.Insert(index, SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			EnsureValid();
			list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
			group.GroupFieldInfos.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Add(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			EnsureValid();
			list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
			group.GroupFieldInfos.Add(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
			group.GroupFieldInfos.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			EnsureValid();
			return group.GroupFieldInfos.Contains(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void CopyTo(SnapListGroupParam[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			EnsureValid();
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (arrayIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			if (array.Length < group.GroupFieldInfos.Count + arrayIndex)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in group.GroupFieldInfos)
			{
				array[arrayIndex++] = GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(groupFieldInfo);
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			EnsureValid();
			list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
			return group.GroupFieldInfos.Remove(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public IEnumerator<SnapListGroupParam> GetEnumerator()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in group.GroupFieldInfos)
			{
				yield return GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(groupFieldInfo);
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			EnsureValid();
			foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in group.GroupFieldInfos)
			{
				yield return new SnapListGroupParam(groupFieldInfo.FieldName, groupFieldInfo.SortOrder, groupFieldInfo.GroupInterval);
			}
		}
	}

	public class NativeSnapListSorting : SnapListSorting, IList<SnapListGroupParam>, ICollection<SnapListGroupParam>, IEnumerable<SnapListGroupParam>, IEnumerable
	{
		private NativeSnapList list;

		private List<SnapListGroupParam> data;

		private bool obsolete;

		public SnapListGroupParam this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				return data[index];
			}
			set
			{
				EnsureValid();
				list.EnsureUpdateBegan();
				data[index] = value;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				EnsureValid();
				return data.Count;
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public NativeSnapListSorting(NativeSnapList parent, FieldDataMemberInfoItem info)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			list = parent;
			data = new List<SnapListGroupParam>();
			if (info == null || !info.HasGroups)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GroupProperties group in info.Groups)
			{
				if (group.HasGroupTemplates)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in group.GroupFieldInfos)
				{
					data.Add(new SnapListGroupParam(groupFieldInfo.FieldName, groupFieldInfo.SortOrder, groupFieldInfo.GroupInterval));
				}
			}
		}

		{
			if (obsolete)

				throw new InvalidOperationException(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.SnapListPropertyOutOfDataException));
			}
		}

		{
			obsolete = true;
		}

		private int GetScale(SNSparklineField parsedField, string key)
		{
			if (!((CalculatedFieldBase)parsedField).Switches.Switches.ContainsKey("\\" + key))

			}
			return ((CalculatedFieldBase)parsedField).Switches.GetInt(key);

			if (themeByName == null)
			{

		}

		{
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme modelTheme = GetModelTheme(theme);
			DocumentModel.AddTheme(modelTheme);
		}

		public void Delete(DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Theme theme)
		{
			if (theme.IsDefault)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.Msg_CannotDeleteDefaultTheme));
			}
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme modelTheme = GetModelTheme(theme);
			DocumentModel.RemoveTheme(modelTheme);
		}

			return ((NativeTheme)theme).ModelTheme;

	public class SnapInternalAPI : InternalAPI
	{
		private byte[] cachedSnxContent;

		public SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((InternalAPI)this).DocumentModel;

		public byte[] SnxBytes
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedSnxContent == null)
				{
					cachedSnxContent = GetDocumentSnxContent();
				}
				return cachedSnxContent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (cachedSnxContent == null || cachedSnxContent != value)
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						((InternalAPI)this).Text = string.Empty;
					}
					else
					{
						((InternalAPI)this).SetDocumentContent<byte[]>(value, (Action<byte[]>)SetDocumentSnxContent);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public SnapInternalAPI(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, IDocumentExportersFactory exportersFactory, IDocumentImportersFactory importersFactory)
			: base((DocumentModel)(object)documentModel, exportersFactory, importersFactory)
		{
		}

		public virtual void LoadDocumentSnxContent(Stream stream, SnapDocumentImporterOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseBeforeImport(SnapDocumentFormat.Snap, (IImporterOptions)options);
			try
			{
				SnapImporter snapImporter = new SnapImporter(DocumentModel, options);
				((OpenXmlImporter)snapImporter).Import(stream);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseInvalidFormatException(ex);
			}
		}

		public virtual void SaveDocumentSnxContent(Stream stream, SnapDocumentExporterOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			NativeCustomProperties val = ((InternalAPI)this).CreateNativeCustomProperties((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
			((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseBeforeExport(SnapDocumentFormat.Snap, (IExporterOptions)options, (DocumentCustomProperties)(object)val);
			if (((DocumentExporterOptions)options).Format == SnapDocumentFormat.Snap)
			{
				DocumentModel.ActivePieceTable.UpdateTemplate(clearUnusedSwitches: false);
			}
			SnapExporter snapExporter = new SnapExporter(DocumentModel, options, val.CustomProperties);
			((OpenXmlExporter)snapExporter).Export(stream);
			((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseAfterExport();
		}

		public byte[] GetDocumentSnxContent()
		{
			return GetDocumentSnxContent(null);
		}

		protected internal byte[] GetDocumentSnxContent(SnapDocumentExporterOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			NativeCustomProperties val = ((InternalAPI)this).CreateNativeCustomProperties((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
			bool flag = options == null;
			if (flag)
			{
				options = new SnapDocumentExporterOptions();
				((InternalAPI)this).ApplyDefaultOptions((DocumentExporterOptions)(object)options);
				((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseBeforeExport(SnapDocumentFormat.Snap, (IExporterOptions)options, (DocumentCustomProperties)(object)val);
			}
			SnapExporter snapExporter = new SnapExporter(DocumentModel, options, val.CustomProperties);
			try
			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				((OpenXmlExporter)snapExporter).Export((Stream)memoryStream);
				return memoryStream.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseAfterExport();
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetDocumentSnxContent(byte[] content)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapDocumentImporterOptions snapDocumentImporterOptions = new SnapDocumentImporterOptions();
			((InternalAPI)this).ApplyDefaultOptions((DocumentImporterOptions)(object)snapDocumentImporterOptions);
			((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseBeforeImport(SnapDocumentFormat.Snap, (IImporterOptions)snapDocumentImporterOptions);
			SetDocumentSnxContent(content, snapDocumentImporterOptions);
			((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).RaiseAfterImport();
		}

		public void SetDocumentSnxContent(byte[] content, SnapDocumentImporterOptions options)
		{
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(content);
			LoadDocumentSnxContent(stream, options);
		}

		protected internal override void ResetCachedContent()
		{
			((InternalAPI)this).ResetCachedContent();
			cachedSnxContent = null;
		}
	}

		{

			}
		}

		private void AddTablesToJoin(List<Table> tablesToJoin, Table table)
		{

			}
		}

		private void JoinTablesIfNeeded(PieceTable pieceTable, List<Table> tablesToJoin)

		}

			Rectangle rectangle = StartBoundary.GetPhysicalBoundsAsStartBoundary(converter);
			Rectangle rectangle2 = EndBoundary.GetPhysicalBoundsAsEndBoundary(converter);
			rectangle.Inflate(1, 0);
			rectangle2.Inflate(1, 0);
			Point[] graphicsPathSingleRow = GetGraphicsPathSingleRow(rectangle, rectangle2);
			if (graphicsPathSingleRow == null)
			{
				if (StartBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemTableRowBoundary && EndBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary)
				{
					rectangle2 = Rectangle.FromLTRB(Math.Min(rectangle2.Left, rectangle.Left), rectangle2.Top, Math.Max(rectangle2.Right, rectangle.Right), rectangle2.Bottom);
				}
				if (StartBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary && EndBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemTableRowBoundary)
				{
					rectangle = Rectangle.FromLTRB(Math.Min(rectangle2.Left, rectangle.Left), rectangle.Top, Math.Max(rectangle2.Right, rectangle.Right), rectangle.Bottom);
				}
				if (StartBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary && EndBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary)
				{
					TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary templateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary = StartBoundary as TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary;
					Rectangle pixelPhysicalBounds = converter.GetPixelPhysicalBounds(GetColumnContentBounds(templateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary.Column));
					rectangle = new Rectangle(pixelPhysicalBounds.X, pixelPhysicalBounds.Y, pixelPhysicalBounds.Width, 0);
					rectangle2 = new Rectangle(pixelPhysicalBounds.X, pixelPhysicalBounds.Bottom, pixelPhysicalBounds.Width, 0);
				}
				int bottom = rectangle.Bottom;
				int top = rectangle2.Top;
				Point[] rectanglePoints = GetRectanglePoints(rectangle);
				Point[] rectanglePoints2 = GetRectanglePoints(rectangle2);
				if (rectangle.Left >= rectangle2.Right && top - bottom < 2)
				{
					return new Point[2][] { rectanglePoints, rectanglePoints2 };
				}
				Point[] array = new Point[8]
				{
					rectanglePoints[0],
					rectanglePoints[1],
					new Point(rectanglePoints[2].X, top),
					new Point(rectanglePoints2[1].X, top),
					rectanglePoints2[2],
					rectanglePoints2[3],
					new Point(rectanglePoints2[0].X, bottom),
					new Point(rectanglePoints[3].X, bottom)
				};
				return new Point[1][] { array };
			}
			return new Point[1][] { graphicsPathSingleRow };
		}

		private Rectangle GetColumnContentBounds(Column column)
		{
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = int.MaxValue;
			int num3 = int.MinValue;
			int num4 = int.MinValue;
			RowCollection rows = column.Rows;
			int count = ((List<Row>)(object)rows).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Rectangle actualSizeBounds = ((LayoutItem)((List<Row>)(object)rows)[i]).ActualSizeBounds;
				num = Math.Min(actualSizeBounds.X, num);
				num2 = Math.Min(actualSizeBounds.Y, num2);
				num3 = Math.Max(actualSizeBounds.Right, num3);
				num4 = Math.Max(actualSizeBounds.Bottom, num4);
			}
			TableViewInfoCollection innerTables = column.InnerTables;
			if (innerTables != null)
			{
				int left = ((LayoutItem)column).Bounds.Left;
				int count2 = ((List<TableViewInfo>)(object)innerTables).Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					TableViewInfo val = ((List<TableViewInfo>)(object)innerTables)[j];
					if (val.Table.NestedLevel <= 0)
					{
						SortedList<int> alignmentedPosition = (SortedList<int>)(object)val.VerticalBorderPositions.AlignmentedPosition;
						int count3 = alignmentedPosition.Count;
						if (count3 > 1)
						{
							num = Math.Min(alignmentedPosition[0] + left, num);
							num3 = Math.Max(alignmentedPosition[count3 - 1] + left, num3);
						}
						num2 = Math.Min(val.TopAnchor.VerticalPosition, num2);
						num4 = Math.Min(val.BottomAnchor.VerticalPosition, num4);
					}
				}
			}
			return Rectangle.FromLTRB(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}

		protected virtual Point[] GetGraphicsPathSingleRow(Rectangle startBounds, Rectangle endBounds)
		{
			if (!(StartBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemParagraphBoundary templateDecoratorItemParagraphBoundary))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(EndBoundary is TemplateDecoratorItemParagraphBoundary templateDecoratorItemParagraphBoundary2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (templateDecoratorItemParagraphBoundary.Row != templateDecoratorItemParagraphBoundary2.Row)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle rect = Rectangle.FromLTRB(startBounds.Left, Math.Min(startBounds.Top, endBounds.Top), endBounds.Right, Math.Min(startBounds.Bottom, endBounds.Bottom));
			return GetRectanglePoints(rect);
		}

		protected Point[] GetRectanglePoints(Rectangle rect)
		{
			return new Point[4]
			{
				new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top),
				new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top),
				new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom),
				new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom)
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class TemplateDecoratorItemBoundaryBase
	{

		}

	}
	public class TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary : TemplateDecoratorItemBoundaryBase
	{
		public TemplateDecoratorItemColumnBoundary(Column column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		public override Rectangle GetPhysicalBoundsAsStartBoundary(ILayoutToPhysicalBoundsConverter converter)
		{
			Rectangle pixelPhysicalBounds = converter.GetPixelPhysicalBounds(((LayoutItem)base.Column).Bounds);
			pixelPhysicalBounds.Height = 0;
			return pixelPhysicalBounds;
		}

		public override Rectangle GetPhysicalBoundsAsEndBoundary(ILayoutToPhysicalBoundsConverter converter)
		{
			Rectangle pixelPhysicalBounds = converter.GetPixelPhysicalBounds(((LayoutItem)base.Column).Bounds);
			pixelPhysicalBounds.Y += pixelPhysicalBounds.Height;
			pixelPhysicalBounds.Height = 0;
			return pixelPhysicalBounds;
		}
	}

		{

		}

	public enum TemplateDecoratorType
	{

		GroupHeader = 2,
		GroupFooter = 3,

	public interface ITemplateDecoratorInfo
	{
		SnapPieceTable PieceTable { get; }

		RunInfo Interval { get; }

		TemplateDecoratorType DecoratorType { get; }
	}
	public abstract class TemplateDecoratorInfoBase : ITemplateDecoratorInfo
	{
		public SnapPieceTable PieceTable { get; private set; }

		public RunInfo Interval { get; private set; }

		public abstract TemplateDecoratorType DecoratorType { get; }

		protected TemplateDecoratorInfoBase(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, RunInfo contentInterval)
		{
			PieceTable = pieceTable;
			Interval = contentInterval;
		}
	}
	public abstract class TemplateDecoratorInfoSingleItem : TemplateDecoratorInfoBase
	{
		public static TemplateDecoratorInfoSingleItem Create(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, RunInfo contentInterval, TemplateDecoratorType decoratorType)
		{
			switch (decoratorType)
			{
			case TemplateDecoratorType.DataRow:
				return new TemplateDecoratorInfoDataRow(pieceTable, contentInterval);
			case TemplateDecoratorType.GroupFooter:
				return new TemplateDecoratorInfoGroupFooter(pieceTable, contentInterval);
			case TemplateDecoratorType.GroupHeader:
				return new TemplateDecoratorInfoGroupHeader(pieceTable, contentInterval);
			case TemplateDecoratorType.ListHeader:
				return new TemplateDecoratorInfoListHeader(pieceTable, contentInterval);
			case TemplateDecoratorType.ListFooter:
				return new TemplateDecoratorInfoListFooter(pieceTable, contentInterval);
			case TemplateDecoratorType.Separator:
				return new TemplateDecoratorInfoSeparator(pieceTable, contentInterval);
			case TemplateDecoratorType.GroupSeparator:
				return new TemplateDecoratorInfoGroupSeparator(pieceTable, contentInterval);
			default:
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected TemplateDecoratorInfoSingleItem(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, RunInfo contentInterval)
			: base(pieceTable, contentInterval)
		{
		}
	}

	public class IntervalCalculatorBase
	{
		protected static RunInfo GetFieldSelectionInterval(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, SnapBookmark contentBookmark)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DocumentLogPosition start = ((DocumentInterval)contentBookmark.TemplateInterval).Start;
			DocumentModelPosition val = PositionConverter.ToDocumentModelPosition((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable, start);
			Field val2 = pieceTable.FindNonTemplateFieldByRunIndex(val.RunIndex);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((PieceTable)pieceTable).GetFieldRunInfo(val2);
		}

		protected static RunInfo GetContentInterval(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, SnapBookmark from, SnapBookmark to)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)from, "from");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)to, "to");
			DocumentLogPosition logPosition = ((DocumentInterval)from).Interval.Start.LogPosition;
			DocumentLogPosition val = ((DocumentInterval)to).Interval.End.LogPosition - 1;
			if (val < logPosition)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return pieceTable.GetRunInfo(logPosition, val);
		}
	}
	public class TemplateDecoratorInfoCalculator : IntervalCalculatorBase
	{
		public virtual ITemplateDecoratorInfo[] GetDecorators(SnapSelectionInfo selectionInfo)
		{
			return GetDecorators(selectionInfo.EnteredBookmarks.ToArray());
		}

		public virtual ITemplateDecoratorInfo[] GetDecorators(EnteredBookmarkInfo[] enteredBookmarks)
		{
			List<EnteredBookmarkInfo> existingBookmark = GetExistingBookmark(enteredBookmarks);
			return GetDecorators(existingBookmark);
		}

		private List<EnteredBookmarkInfo> GetExistingBookmark(EnteredBookmarkInfo[] enteredBookmarks)
		{
			List<EnteredBookmarkInfo> list = new List<EnteredBookmarkInfo>();
			if (enteredBookmarks == null || enteredBookmarks.Length == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (EnteredBookmarkInfo enteredBookmarkInfo in enteredBookmarks)
			{
				if (!enteredBookmarkInfo.Bookmark.Deleted)
				{
					list.Add(enteredBookmarkInfo);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private ITemplateDecoratorInfo[] GetDecorators(List<EnteredBookmarkInfo> enteredBookmarks)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)enteredBookmarks, "enteredBookmarks");
			if (enteredBookmarks.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ITemplateDecoratorInfo[1] { CreateSingleItemDecorator(enteredBookmarks[0]) };
		}

		private ITemplateDecoratorInfo CreateSingleItemDecorator(EnteredBookmarkInfo enteredBookmarkInfo)
		{
			SnapBookmark bookmark = enteredBookmarkInfo.Bookmark;
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable = bookmark.PieceTable;
			return CreateTemplateDecoratorCore(pieceTable, bookmark, bookmark, (TemplateDecoratorType)bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType);
		}

		private ITemplateDecoratorInfo CreateInnermostDecorator(List<EnteredBookmarkInfo> enteredBookmarks)
		{
			EnteredBookmarkInfo enteredBookmarkInfo = enteredBookmarks[0];
			SnapBookmark bookmark = enteredBookmarkInfo.Bookmark;
			return CreateTemplateDecoratorCore(bookmark.PieceTable, bookmark, bookmark, (TemplateDecoratorType)bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType);
		}

		private ITemplateDecoratorInfo CreateTemplateDecoratorCore(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, SnapBookmark from, SnapBookmark to, TemplateDecoratorType decoratorType)
		{
			if (from == null || to == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RunInfo contentInterval = IntervalCalculatorBase.GetContentInterval(pieceTable, from, to);
			return TemplateDecoratorInfoSingleItem.Create(pieceTable, contentInterval, decoratorType);
		}
	}

		private class DataSourceInfoComparer : IComparer<IDataSourceExportInfo>
		{
			public int Compare(IDataSourceExportInfo x, IDataSourceExportInfo y)
			{
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				SnapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor = new SnapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor();
				x.Accept(snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor);
				SnapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor2 = new SnapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor();
				y.Accept(snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor2);
				if (snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor.Dependencies.Contains(snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor2.DataSource))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor2.Dependencies.Contains(snapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor.DataSource))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		{
			Dictionary<Type, Action<CustomRun>> dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, Action<CustomRun>>();
			dictionary.Add(typeof(BarCodeRunObject), ExportBarCodeRun);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(CheckBoxRunObject), ExportCheckBoxRun);
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected internal override void InitializeExport()

		}

		{
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).GenerateDocumentRelations(writer);

			GenerateDataRelations(writer);

			GenerateMailMergeRelations(writer);
		}

		{

		}

		private void GenerateDataRelations(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).GenerateFileRelationsCore(writer, dataSettingsRelationsTable, "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/relationships/datasettings", false);
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			dictionary.Add("RelDC1", "dataContainer.xml");
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).GenerateFileRelationsCore(writer, dictionary, "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/relationships/datacontainer", false);
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).GenerateFileRelationsCore(writer, dataSourcesRelationsTable, "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/relationships/datasources", false);
		}

		protected internal virtual string CalcSnapBookmarkId(SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			if (!SnapBookmarkIds.TryGetValue(bookmark, out var value))
			{
				value = $"snapBookmark{SnapBookmarkIds.Count}";
				SnapBookmarkIds.Add(bookmark, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal virtual string CalcSnapTemplateIntervalId(SnapTemplateInterval interval)
		{
			if (!SnapTemplareIntervalIds.TryGetValue(interval, out var value))
			{
				value = $"templateInterval{SnapTemplareIntervalIds.Count}";
				SnapTemplareIntervalIds.Add(interval, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal virtual string CalcRootFieldContextId(RootFieldContext context)
		{
			if (!RootFieldContexts.TryGetValue(context, out var value))
			{
				value = $"rootContext{RootFieldContexts.Count}";
				RootFieldContexts.Add(context, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal override void ExportSeparatorTextRun(SeparatorTextRun run)
		{
			((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpStartElement("r");
			try
			{
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).ExportRunProperties((TextRunBase)(object)run);
				ExportSeparatorRunCore();
			}
			finally
			{
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void ExportSeparatorRunCore()
		{
			WriteDxStartElement("spr");
			WriteDxEndElement();
		}

		protected internal override void ExportCustomRun(CustomRun run)
		{
			if (customRunHandlers.TryGetValue(((object)run.CustomRunObject).GetType(), out var value))
			{
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpStartElement("r");
				WriteDxStartElement("customObject");
				try
				{
					value(run);
				}
				finally
				{
					WriteDxEndElement();
					((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpEndElement();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ExportDataContainerRun(DataContainerRun run)
		{
			IDataContainer dataContainer = run.DataContainer;
			((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpStartElement("r");
			WriteDxStartElement("dataContainer");
			WriteDxStringAttr("type", GetDataContainerType(((object)dataContainer).GetType()));
			try
			{
				WriteDxByteArray(dataContainer.GetData());
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpEndElement();
			}
		}

		private string GetDataContainerType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == typeof(Base64StringDataContainer))
			{
				return "base64StringDataContainer";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected override void ExportInlinePictureImageReference(InlinePictureRun run)
		{
			ChartRun chartRun = run as ChartRun;
			SparklineRun sparklineRun = run as SparklineRun;
			if (chartRun != null)
			{
				ExportChartImageReference(chartRun);
			}
			else if (sparklineRun != null)
			{
				ExportSparklineImageReference(sparklineRun);
			}
			else
			{
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).ExportInlinePictureImageReference(run);
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected internal virtual void ExportSnapBookmarkStart(SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			WriteDxStartElement("bookmarkStart");
			try
			{
				WriteDxStringAttr("id", CalcSnapBookmarkId(bookmark));
				WriteDxStringAttr("type", "snapBookmark");
				if (bookmark.Parent != null)
				{
					WriteDxStringAttr("parentId", CalcSnapBookmarkId(bookmark.Parent));
				}
				IFieldContext fieldContext = bookmark.FieldContext;
				WriteDxIntAttr("fieldContextId", fieldContextExporter.ExportFieldContext(fieldContext));
				WriteDxStringAttr("templateIntervalId", CalcSnapTemplateIntervalId(bookmark.TemplateInterval));
				if (bookmark.HeaderBookmark != null)
				{
					WriteDxStringAttr("headerBookmarkId", CalcSnapBookmarkId(bookmark.HeaderBookmark));
				}
				if (bookmark.FooterBookmark != null)
				{
					WriteDxStringAttr("footerBookmarkId", CalcSnapBookmarkId(bookmark.FooterBookmark));
				}
				ExportSnapTemplateInfo(bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal override void ExportTableCellStyles()
		{
			TableCellStyleCollection tableCellStyles = ((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).TableCellStyles;
			int count = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)tableCellStyles).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).ExportTableCellStyle(i);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool AllowExportTableCellProperties(TableCell cell)
		{
			if (((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).AllowExportTableCellProperties(cell))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return cell.StyleIndex > 0;
		}

		protected internal override void ExportTableCellProperties(TableCellProperties cellProperties, bool exportBorders)
		{
			((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).ExportTableCellProperties(cellProperties, true);
		}

		{
			if (cell.StyleIndex > 0)
			{
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpStringValue("tblCStyle", ((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).GetTableCellStyleId(cell.StyleIndex));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ExportTablePropertiesCore(TableProperties tableProperties)
		{
			((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).ExportTablePropertiesCore(tableProperties);
			if (tableProperties.UseAvoidDoubleBorders)
			{
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).WriteWpBoolValue("adb", tableProperties.AvoidDoubleBorders);
