		protected internal override void AddCompressedPackages()
		{
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).AddCompressedPackages();
			((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).AddCompressedPackageContent("word\\dataSettings.xml", xmlContentType, ExportDataSettings());
			((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).AddCompressedPackageContent("word\\fieldContexts.xml", xmlContentType, ExportFieldContexts());
			((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).AddCompressedPackageContent("word\\snapMailMergeOptions.xml", xmlContentType, ExportSnapMailMergeOptions());
			AddThemesContent();
			AddDataSourcesContent();
		}

		private CompressedStream ExportThemeImageRelations()
		{
			return ((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).CreateCompressedXmlContent((Action<XmlWriter>)GenerateThemeImageRelations);
		}

		protected internal virtual void GenerateThemeImageRelations(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement("Relationships", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships");
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).GenerateFileRelationsCore(writer, ((OpenXmlExporter)this).ImageRelationsTable, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image", false);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void AddThemesContent()
		{
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.ThemeCollection themesForExport = GetThemesForExport();
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).ImageRelationsTableStack.Push(new Dictionary<string, string>());
			((OpenXmlExporter)this).ExportedImageTableStack.Push(new Dictionary<OfficeImage, string>());
			try
			{
				((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).AddCompressedPackageContent("word\\themes.xml", xmlContentType, ((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).CreateCompressedXmlContent((Action<XmlWriter>)delegate(XmlWriter xmlWriter)
				{
					GenerateThemesContent(xmlWriter, themesForExport);
				}));
				((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).AddCompressedPackageContent("word\\_rels\\themes.xml.rels", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml", ExportThemeImageRelations());
			}
			finally
			{
				((OpenXmlExporter)this).ImageRelationsTableStack.Pop();
				((OpenXmlExporter)this).ExportedImageTableStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void GenerateThemesContent(XmlWriter writer, DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.ThemeCollection themes)
		{
			((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).DocumentContentWriter = writer;
			WriteDxStartElement("themes");
			try
			{
				ExportActiveTheme();
				int count = ((DXCollectionBase<DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme>)(object)themes).Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme theme = ((DXCollection<DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme>)(object)themes)[i];
					string imageId = string.Empty;
					if (theme.Icon != null)
					{
						((OpenXmlExporter)this).ExportImageData(theme.Icon);
						imageId = ((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).ExportedImageTable[theme.Icon.RootImage];
					}
					ExportTheme(writer, theme, imageId);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void ExportActiveTheme()
		{
			if (DocumentModel.ActiveTheme == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WriteDxStartElement("activeTheme");
			try
			{
				WriteDxStringAttr("val", DocumentModel.ActiveTheme.Name);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected internal DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.ThemeCollection GetThemesForExport()
		{
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.ThemeCollection themeCollection = new DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.ThemeCollection();
			int count = ((DXCollectionBase<DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme>)(object)DocumentModel.Themes).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme theme = ((DXCollection<DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme>)(object)DocumentModel.Themes)[i];
				if (!theme.IsDefault || theme.IsModified)
				{
					((DXCollectionBase<DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme>)(object)themeCollection).Add(theme);
				}
			}
			return themeCollection;
		}

		private void ExportTheme(XmlWriter writer, DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme theme, string imageId)
		{
			WriteDxStartElement("theme");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageId))
			{
				WriteDxStringAttr("imageId", imageId);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(theme.NativeName) && theme.NativeName != theme.Name)
			{
				WriteDxStringAttr("nativeName", theme.NativeName);
			}
			try
			{
				WriteDxStartElement("name");
				try
				{
					WriteDxStringAttr("val", theme.Name);
				}
				finally
				{
					WriteDxEndElement();
				}
				ExportThemeStyles(writer, theme);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void ExportThemeStyles(XmlWriter writer, DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme theme)
		{
			WriteDxStartElement("styles");
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = new SnapDocumentModel(createDefaultStyles: false, DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.CreateNew(), ((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).DocumentFormatsDependencies);
			try
			{
				theme.Apply((DocumentModel)(object)snapDocumentModel);
				SnapExporter snapExporter = new SnapExporter(snapDocumentModel, new SnapDocumentExporterOptions());
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)snapExporter).DocumentContentWriter = writer;
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)snapExporter).ExportTableStyles();
				((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)snapExporter).ExportTableCellStyles();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDocumentModel)?.Dispose();
			}
			WriteDxEndElement();
		}

		private void AddDataSourcesContent()
		{
			IList<IDataSourceExportInfo> dataSources = CollectDataSourcesForExport();
			if (dataSources.Count > 0)
			{
				dataSourcesRelationsTable.Add("RelDSrc1", "dataSources.xml");
				string text = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.dataSources+xml";
				((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).AddCompressedPackageContent("word\\dataSources.xml", text, ((XmlBasedDocumentModelExporter)this).CreateCompressedXmlContent((Action<XmlWriter>)delegate(XmlWriter writer)
				{
					ExportDataSources(writer, dataSources);
				}));
				((OpenXmlExporter)this).RegisterContentTypeOverride("/word/dataSources.xml", text);
			}
		}

		private IList<IDataSourceExportInfo> CollectDataSourcesForExport()
		{
			List<IDataSourceExportInfo> list = new List<IDataSourceExportInfo>();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo dataSource2 in DocumentModel.DataSources)
			{
				if (dataSource2.DataSource == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object dataSource = dataSource2.DataSource;
				IDataComponent val = (IDataComponent)((dataSource is IDataComponent) ? dataSource : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					list.Add(new SnapDataSourceExportInfo(val));
					continue;
				}
				BeforeDataSourceExportEventArgs e = new BeforeDataSourceExportEventArgs(dataSource2.DataSource, dataSource2.DataSourceName);
				DocumentModel.RaiseBeforeDataSourceExport(e);
				if (e.Data != null)
				{
					list.Add(new CustomDataSourceExportInfo(dataSource2.DataSourceName, e.Data));
				}
			}
			return Algorithms.TopologicalSort<IDataSourceExportInfo>((IList<IDataSourceExportInfo>)list, (IComparer<IDataSourceExportInfo>)new DataSourceInfoComparer());
		}

		private void ExportDataSources(XmlWriter writer, IList<IDataSourceExportInfo> dataSources)
		{
			((WordProcessingMLBaseExporter)this).DocumentContentWriter = writer;
			WriteDxStartElement("dataSources");
			try
			{
				foreach (IDataSourceExportInfo dataSource in dataSources)
				{
					dataSource.Write(this);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ExportCalculatedFields()
		{

				WriteDxStartElement("calcFields");
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ExportCalculatedField(calculatedFields[i]);
				}
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private void WriteSnapMailMergeOptionsCore()
		{
			SnapMailMergeVisualOptions snapMailMergeVisualOptions = DocumentModel.SnapMailMergeVisualOptions;
			if (snapMailMergeVisualOptions.DataSourceName != null)
			{
				WriteDxStringElement("dataSourceName", snapMailMergeVisualOptions.DataSourceName);

			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember))
			{
				WriteDxStringElement("dataMember", ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember);
			}
			WriteDxIntElement("currentRecordIndex", snapMailMergeVisualOptions.CurrentRecordIndex);
			WriteDxStringElement("filterString", snapMailMergeVisualOptions.FilterString);
			WriteSnapMailMergeSorting(snapMailMergeVisualOptions.Sorting);
		}

				{
					WriteSortingItem(sorting[i]);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

			WriteDxStringAttr("sortOrder", Enum.GetName(typeof(ColumnSortOrder), item.SortOrder));
			WriteDxEndElement();
		}

	internal interface IDataSourceExportInfoVisitor
	{
		void Visit(CustomDataSourceExportInfo info);

		void Visit(SnapDataSourceExportInfo info);
	}
	internal interface IDataSourceExportInfo
	{
		void Accept(IDataSourceExportInfoVisitor visitor);

		void Write(SnapExporter exporter);
	}
	internal class CustomDataSourceExportInfo : IDataSourceExportInfo
	{
		public string Name { get; private set; }

		public byte[] Data { get; private set; }

		public CustomDataSourceExportInfo(string name, byte[] data)
		{
			Name = name;
			Data = data;
		}

		public void Accept(IDataSourceExportInfoVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public void Write(SnapExporter exporter)
		{
			exporter.WriteDxStartElement("dataSource");
			try
			{
				exporter.WriteDxStringAttr("name", Name);
				exporter.WriteDxStringAttr("data", Convert.ToBase64String(Data));
			}
			finally
			{
				exporter.WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SnapDataSourceExportInfo : IDataSourceExportInfo
	{
		public IDataComponent DataComponent { get; private set; }

		public SnapDataSourceExportInfo(IDataComponent component)
		{
			DataComponent = component;
		}

		public void Accept(IDataSourceExportInfoVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public void Write(SnapExporter exporter)
		{
			XElement element = exporter.DataComponentDispatcher.SaveToXml(DataComponent);
			exporter.WriteXElement(element);
		}
	}
	internal class SnapDataSourceExportInfoVisitor : IDataSourceExportInfoVisitor
	{
		public object DataSource { get; private set; }

		public HashSet<object> Dependencies { get; private set; } = new HashSet<object>();

		public void Visit(CustomDataSourceExportInfo info)
		{
			DataSource = info.Data;
		}

		public void Visit(SnapDataSourceExportInfo info)
		{
			DataSource = info.DataComponent;
			if (!(DataSource is FederationDataSource federationDataSource))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Source source in federationDataSource.Sources)
			{
				Dependencies.Add(source.DataSource);
			}
		}
	}

		{
			return (VisitableDocumentIntervalEndBoundaryFactory)(object)new SnapBookmarkEndBoundaryFactory();
		}

		private List<SnapTemplateInterval> CollectTemplateIntervals()
		{
			Dictionary<SnapTemplateInterval, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<SnapTemplateInterval, object>();
			foreach (SnapBookmark item in (IEnumerable<SnapBookmark>)((SnapPieceTable)(object)((VisitableDocumentIntervalBoundaryIterator)this).PieceTable).SnapBookmarks)
			{
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(item.TemplateInterval))
				{
					dictionary.Add(item.TemplateInterval, null);
				}
			}
			return dictionary.Keys.ToList();
		}
	}
	public class SnapContentWriter
	{
		public const string SnapPrefix = "dx";

		public const string SnapNamespaceConstant = "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/main";

		private readonly XmlWriter documentContentWriter;

		public string SnapNamespace => "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/main";

		public XmlWriter DocumentContentWriter => documentContentWriter;

		public SnapContentWriter(XmlWriter documentContentWriter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentContentWriter, "documentContentWriter");
			this.documentContentWriter = documentContentWriter;
		}

		public void WriteDxStartElement(string tag)
		{
			DocumentContentWriter.WriteStartElement("dx", tag, SnapNamespace);
		}

		public void WriteDxStringAttr(string attr, string value)
		{
			DocumentContentWriter.WriteAttributeString("dx", attr, SnapNamespace, value);
		}

		public void WriteDxBoolAttr(string attr, bool value)
		{
			WriteDxStringAttr(attr, ConvertBoolToString(value));
		}

		public void WriteDxIntAttr(string attr, int value)
		{
			WriteDxStringAttr(attr, value.ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo));
		}

		public void WriteDxEndElement()
		{
			DocumentContentWriter.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private string ConvertBoolToString(bool value)
		{
			if (!value)
			{
				return "0";
			}
			return "1";
		}
	}
	public class SnapFieldsContextExporter
	{
		private class ContextParentExporter : IFieldContextVisitor
		{
			private readonly SnapFieldsContextExporter exporter;

			public ContextParentExporter(SnapFieldsContextExporter exporter)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)exporter, "exporter");
				this.exporter = exporter;
			}

			public void Visit(EmptyFieldContext context)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(ProxyFieldContext context)
			{
				exporter.ExportFieldContext(context.Parent);
			}

			public void Visit(RootFieldContext context)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(SnapMailMergeRootFieldContext context)
			{
				Visit((RootFieldContext)context);
			}

			public void Visit(SingleListItemFieldContext context)
			{
				exporter.ExportFieldContext(context.Parent);
			}

			public void Visit(ListFieldContext context)
			{
				exporter.ExportFieldContext(context.Parent);
			}

			public void Visit(SimplePropertyFieldContext context)
			{
				exporter.ExportFieldContext(context.Parent);
			}
		}

		private class ContextWriter : IFieldContextVisitor
		{
			private readonly SnapFieldsContextExporter exporter;

			private readonly SnapContentWriter contentWriter;

			public SnapContentWriter ContentWriter => contentWriter;

			public ContextWriter(SnapFieldsContextExporter exporter, SnapContentWriter contentWriter)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)exporter, "exporter");
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)contentWriter, "contentWriter");
				this.exporter = exporter;
				this.contentWriter = contentWriter;
			}

			public void Write(IFieldContext context, int id)
			{
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStartElement("fieldContext");
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("id", id);
				context.Accept(this);
				ContentWriter.WriteDxEndElement();
			}

			public void Visit(EmptyFieldContext context)
			{
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("type", "empty");
			}

			public void Visit(ProxyFieldContext context)
			{
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("type", "proxy");
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("path", context.FieldPath);
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("parentId", exporter.GetFieldContextId(context.Parent));
			}

			public void Visit(RootFieldContext context)
			{
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("type", "root");
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("source", exporter.DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.FindDataSourceName(context.Source));
			}

			public void Visit(SnapMailMergeRootFieldContext context)
			{
				Visit((RootFieldContext)context);
			}

			public void Visit(SingleListItemFieldContext context)
			{
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("type", "listItem");
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("visibleIndex", context.VisibleIndex);
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("rowHandle", context.RowHandle);
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("indexInGroup", context.CurrentRecordIndexInGroup);
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("parentId", exporter.GetFieldContextId(context.Parent));
			}

			public void Visit(ListFieldContext context)
			{
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("type", "list");
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("parentId", exporter.GetFieldContextId(context.Parent));
				WriteListParameters(context.ListParameters);
			}

			public void Visit(SimplePropertyFieldContext context)
			{
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("type", "property");
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("path", context.Path);
				ContentWriter.WriteDxIntAttr("parentId", exporter.GetFieldContextId(context.Parent));
			}

			private void WriteListParameters(ListParameters listParameters)
			{
				if (listParameters != null)
				{
					WriteFilters(listParameters.Filters);
					WriteGroups(listParameters.Groups);
				}
			}

			private void WriteFilters(FilterProperties filterProperties)
			{
				if (filterProperties == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<string> filters = filterProperties.Filters;
				if (filters == null || filters.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStartElement("filters");
				foreach (string item in filters)
				{
					ContentWriter.WriteDxStartElement("filter");
					ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("filterstring", item);
					ContentWriter.WriteDxEndElement();
				}
				ContentWriter.WriteDxEndElement();
			}

			private void WriteGroups(List<GroupProperties> groups)
			{
				//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00cc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (groups == null || groups.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				ContentWriter.WriteDxStartElement("groups");
				foreach (GroupProperties group in groups)
				{
					ContentWriter.WriteDxStartElement("group");
					if (group.HasTemplateFooter)
					{
						ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("tf", group.TemplateFooterSwitch);
					}
					if (group.HasTemplateHeader)
					{
						ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("th", group.TemplateHeaderSwitch);
					}
					foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in group.GroupFieldInfos)
					{
						ContentWriter.WriteDxStartElement("groupField");
						ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("name", groupFieldInfo.FieldName);
						ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("sortOrder", ((object)groupFieldInfo.SortOrder/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
						ContentWriter.WriteDxStringAttr("groupInterval", groupFieldInfo.GroupInterval.ToString());
						ContentWriter.WriteDxEndElement();
					}
					ContentWriter.WriteDxEndElement();
				}
				ContentWriter.WriteDxEndElement();
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<IFieldContext, int> fieldContextIds;

		private readonly SnapDocumentModel documentModel;

		private int fieldContextCount;

		private SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		public SnapFieldsContextExporter(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			fieldContextIds = new Dictionary<IFieldContext, int>();
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			fieldContextCount = 0;
		}

		public int ExportFieldContext(IFieldContext fieldContext)
		{
			ExportParentContext(fieldContext);
			if (!fieldContextIds.TryGetValue(fieldContext, out var value))
			{
				fieldContextCount++;
				value = fieldContextCount;
				fieldContextIds.Add(fieldContext, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public int GetFieldContextId(IFieldContext fieldContext)
		{
			return fieldContextIds[fieldContext];
		}

		private void ExportParentContext(IFieldContext fieldContext)
		{
			ContextParentExporter visitor = new ContextParentExporter(this);
			fieldContext.Accept(visitor);
		}

		public void WriteContent(SnapContentWriter contentWriter)
		{
			ContextWriter contextWriter = new ContextWriter(this, contentWriter);
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)contentWriter, "contentWriter");
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IFieldContext, int> fieldContextId in fieldContextIds)
			{
				contextWriter.Write(fieldContextId.Key, fieldContextId.Value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SnapDataComponentDispatcher
	{
		private sealed class DataComponentFactoryCache : ConcurrentDictionary<string, Func<IDataComponent>>
		{
			internal DataComponentFactoryCache()
				: base((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>>)new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>[7]
				{
					new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>(typeof(SqlDataSource).FullName, () => (IDataComponent)(object)new SqlDataSource()),
					new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>(typeof(EFDataSource).FullName, () => (IDataComponent)(object)new EFDataSource()),
					new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>(typeof(ObjectDataSource).FullName, () => (IDataComponent)(object)new ObjectDataSource()),
					new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>(typeof(ExcelDataSource).FullName, () => (IDataComponent)(object)new ExcelDataSource()),
					new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>(typeof(JsonDataSource).FullName, () => (IDataComponent)(object)new JsonDataSource()),
					new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>(typeof(FederationDataSource).FullName, () => (IDataComponent)(object)new FederationDataSource()),
					new KeyValuePair<string, Func<IDataComponent>>(typeof(MongoDBDataSource).FullName, () => (IDataComponent)(object)new MongoDBDataSource())
				}, (IEqualityComparer<string>)StringComparer.Ordinal)
			{
			}
		}

		private sealed class DataComponentLoaderCache : Dictionary<Type, Action<IDataComponent, XElement>>
		{
		}

		private sealed class DataComponentSerializerCache : Dictionary<Type, Func<IDataComponent, XElement>>
		{
		}

		private const string typeNameAttribute = "TypeName";

		private readonly DataComponentLoaderCache loaderCache;

		private readonly DataComponentSerializerCache serializerCache;

		private readonly IDataSourceDispatcher dispatcher;

		private Dictionary<string, IDataComponent> dataComponentTable;

		private static DataComponentFactoryCache dataComponentFactoryCacheCore;

		private static DataComponentFactoryCache DataComponentFactory
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataComponentFactoryCacheCore == null)
				{
					Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref dataComponentFactoryCacheCore, new DataComponentFactoryCache(), null);
				}
				return dataComponentFactoryCacheCore;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<string, IDataComponent> DataComponentTable
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataComponentTable == null)
				{
					dataComponentTable = new Dictionary<string, IDataComponent>();
					foreach (DataSourceInfo info in dispatcher.GetInfos())
					{
						object dataSource = info.DataSource;
						IDataComponent val = (IDataComponent)((dataSource is IDataComponent) ? dataSource : null);
						if (val != null)
						{
							dataComponentTable.Add(info.DataSourceName, val);
						}
					}
				}
				return dataComponentTable;
			}
		}

		public SnapDataComponentDispatcher(IDataSourceDispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dispatcher, "dispatcher");
			this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
			loaderCache = CreateLoaderCache();
			serializerCache = CreateSerializerCache();
		}

		internal static void RegisterCustomDataComponent(Type dataComponentType, Func<IDataComponent> create)
		{
			if (dataComponentType != null && create != null)
			{
				DataComponentFactory.AddOrUpdate(dataComponentType.FullName, create, (string x, Func<IDataComponent> c) => create);
			}
		}

		private DataComponentLoaderCache CreateLoaderCache()
		{
			DataComponentLoaderCache dataComponentLoaderCache = new DataComponentLoaderCache();
			dataComponentLoaderCache.Add(typeof(FederationDataSource), LoadFederationDataSource);
			dataComponentLoaderCache.Add(typeof(MongoDBDataSource), LoadMongoDBDataSource);
			return dataComponentLoaderCache;
		}

		private DataComponentSerializerCache CreateSerializerCache()
		{
			DataComponentSerializerCache dataComponentSerializerCache = new DataComponentSerializerCache();
			dataComponentSerializerCache.Add(typeof(FederationDataSource), SaveFederationDataSource);
			return dataComponentSerializerCache;
		}

		public IDataComponent LoadFromXml(XElement e)
		{
			string attributeValue = e.GetAttributeValue("TypeName");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!DataComponentFactory.TryGetValue(attributeValue, out var value))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("TypeName", attributeValue);
			}
			IDataComponent val = value();
			if (!loaderCache.TryGetValue(((object)val).GetType(), out var value2))
			{
				value2 = LoadDataComponent;
			}
			value2(val, e);
			if (val.Name != null)
			{
				DataComponentTable[val.Name] = val;
			}
			return val;
		}

		private void LoadDataComponent(IDataComponent dataComponent, XElement e)
		{
			dataComponent.LoadFromXml(e.Elements().First());
		}

		private void LoadFederationDataSource(IDataComponent component, XElement e)
		{
			FederationDataSource federationDataSource = (FederationDataSource)(object)component;
			XElement xElement = e.Element("federationSourceMap");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				LoadMappedFederationDataSource(federationDataSource, xElement, e);
			}
			else
			{
				federationDataSource.LoadFromXml(e.Elements().First());
			}
		}

		private void LoadMongoDBDataSource(IDataComponent component, XElement e)
		{
			LoadDataComponent(component, e);
			((MongoDBDataSource)(object)component).RebuildResultSchema();
		}

		private void LoadMappedFederationDataSource(FederationDataSource federation, XElement sourceMap, XElement e)
		{
			foreach (XElement item in sourceMap.Elements("source"))
			{
				string value = item.Attribute("name").Value;
				DataComponentTable.TryGetValue(value, out var value2);
				federation.SerializableSourceMap.Add(new SourceMapItem
				{
					Name = item.Attribute("alias").Value,
					DataSource = value2
				});
			}
			XElement xElement = e.Element("federationDataComponent");
			federation.LoadFromXml(xElement.Elements().First());
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml(IDataComponent dataComponent)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataComponent, "dataComponent");
			if (!serializerCache.TryGetValue(((object)dataComponent).GetType(), out var value))
			{
				value = SaveDataComponent;
			}
			return value(dataComponent);
		}

		private XElement SaveDataComponent(IDataComponent component)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("dataComponent");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("TypeName", ((object)component).GetType().FullName));
			xElement.Add(component.SaveToXml());
			return xElement;
		}

		private XElement SaveFederationDataSource(IDataComponent component)
		{
			FederationDataSource federationDataSource = (FederationDataSource)(object)component;
			XElement xElement = new XElement("dataComponent");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("TypeName", typeof(FederationDataSource).FullName));
			XElement xElement2 = new XElement("federationSourceMap");
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			foreach (Source source in federationDataSource.Sources)
			{
				dictionary.Add(source.Name, dispatcher.FindDataSourceName(source.DataSource));
			}
			xElement2.Add(dictionary.Select(delegate(KeyValuePair<string, string> source)
			{
				XElement xElement4 = new XElement("source");
				xElement4.Add(new XAttribute("alias", source.Key));
				xElement4.Add(new XAttribute("name", source.Value));
				return xElement4;
			}));
			XElement xElement3 = new XElement("federationDataComponent");
			xElement3.Add(federationDataSource.SaveToXml());
			xElement.Add(xElement2);
			xElement.Add(xElement3);
			return xElement;
		}
	}

	public class SnapMailMergeDataService : MailMergeDataService
	{
		private SnapDocumentModel model;

		private readonly SnapMailMergeExportOptions options;

		private int recordCount = -1;

		public SnapMailMergeDataService(RichEditDataControllerAdapterBase dataController, SnapDocumentModel model)
			: this(dataController, 0, -1, model)
		{
		}

		public SnapMailMergeDataService(RichEditDataControllerAdapterBase dataController, int firstRecordIndex, int lastRecordIndex, SnapDocumentModel model)
			: base(dataController, firstRecordIndex, lastRecordIndex)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)model, "model");
			this.model = model;
		}

		internal SnapMailMergeDataService(RichEditDataControllerAdapterBase dataController, SnapMailMergeExportOptions options, SnapDocumentModel model)
			: this(dataController, ((IMailMergeOptions)options).FirstRecordIndex, ((IMailMergeOptions)options).LastRecordIndex, model)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)options, "options");
			this.options = options;
		}

		protected override int CalcActualRecordCount()
		{
			if (recordCount < 0)
			{
				recordCount = CalcActualRecordCountCore();
			}
			return recordCount;
		}

		private int CalcActualRecordCountCore()
		{
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)model).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			if (service == null || options == null)
			{
				return ((MailMergeDataService)this).CalcActualRecordCount();
			}
			IFieldContextService fieldContextService = service.FieldContextService;
			ICalculationContext calculationContext = fieldContextService.BeginCalculation(model.DataSourceDispatcher);
			try
			{
				IFieldContext fieldContext = new RootFieldContext(model.DataSourceDispatcher, options.DataSourceName, ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)options).DataSource);
				FieldPathDataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = service.FieldPathService.FromString(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)options).DataMember ?? string.Empty).DataMemberInfo;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.FilterString))
				{
					dataMemberInfo.AddFilter(options.FilterString);
				}
				List<GroupProperties> list = MailMergeParamsConverter.ConvertToGroupPropertiesList(options.Sorting);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					dataMemberInfo.AddGroup(list[i]);
				}
				IDataEnumerator childDataEnumerator = calculationContext.GetChildDataEnumerator(fieldContext, dataMemberInfo);
				if (childDataEnumerator != null)
				{
					int num = 0;
					while (childDataEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						num++;
					}
					return num;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				fieldContextService.EndCalculation(calculationContext);
			}
			return ((MailMergeDataService)this).CalcActualRecordCount();
		}

		protected override RichEditDataControllerAdapterBase CreateMailMergeDataController()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (RichEditDataControllerAdapterBase)new RichEditDataControllerAdapter((BaseGridController)new RichDataController());
		}

		protected override MailMergeDataService CreateNew(RichEditDataControllerAdapterBase dataController, IMailMergeOptions options)
		{
			return (MailMergeDataService)(object)new SnapMailMergeDataService(dataController, (SnapMailMergeExportOptions)options, model);
		}
	}

		}

	public class SnapMailMergeOptionsDestination : ElementDestination
	{
		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		protected internal override ElementHandlerTable ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

	public class ThemeDestination : ElementDestination
	{
		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		private DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme theme;

		internal SnapImporter Importer => (SnapImporter)(object)((ElementDestination)this).Importer;

		protected internal override ElementHandlerTable ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

		private static ElementHandlerTable CreateElementHandlerTable()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ElementHandlerTable val = new ElementHandlerTable();
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler>)(object)val).Add("styles", new ElementHandler(OnStyles));
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler>)(object)val).Add("name", new ElementHandler(OnName));
			return val;
		}

		private static Destination OnName(WordProcessingMLBaseImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			return (Destination)(object)new PropertyDestination<string>(importer, (Action<string>)delegate(string themeName)
			{
				((ThemeDestination)(object)((DestinationBasedImporter)(object)importer).PeekDestination()).theme.SetNameCore(themeName);
			}, (string)null);
		}

		private static Destination OnStyles(WordProcessingMLBaseImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			return (Destination)(object)new ThemeStylesDestination(importer, ((ThemeDestination)(object)((DestinationBasedImporter)(object)importer).PeekDestination()).theme);
		}

		public ThemeDestination(SnapImporter importer)
			: base((WordProcessingMLBaseImporter)(object)importer)
		{
			theme = new DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme(Importer.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			((ElementDestination)this).ProcessElementOpen(reader);
			string name = Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("name", reader);
			theme.Name = name;
			string text = Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("imageId", reader);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				OfficeImage iconCore = ((OpenXmlImporter)Importer).LookupImageByRelationId(text, ((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)Importer).DocumentRootFolder);
				theme.SetIconCore(iconCore);
			}
			string text2 = Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("nativeName", reader);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				theme.NativeName = text2;
			}
			((WordProcessingMLBaseImporter)Importer).StyleManager.PushTableStyleInfos();
			((WordProcessingMLBaseImporter)Importer).StyleManager.PushTableCellStyleInfos();
		}

		public override void ProcessElementClose(XmlReader reader)
		{
			((ElementDestination)this).ProcessElementClose(reader);
			((WordProcessingMLBaseImporter)Importer).StyleManager.PopTableStyleInfos();
			((WordProcessingMLBaseImporter)Importer).StyleManager.PopTableCellStyleInfos();
			theme.IsLoaded = true;
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.ThemeCollection themes = Importer.DocumentModel.Themes;
			string name = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(theme.NativeName)) ? theme.NativeName : theme.Name);
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme themeByName = themes.GetThemeByName(name);
			if (themeByName != null)
			{
				themeByName.CopyFrom(theme);
				themeByName.Name = theme.Name;
				themeByName.IncreaseVersion();
			}
			else
			{
				((DXCollectionBase<DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme>)(object)themes).Add(theme);
			}
		}
	}

	public class ThemeStyleDestination : StyleDestination
	{
		private DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme theme;

		public ThemeStyleDestination(WordProcessingMLBaseImporter importer, DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Theme theme)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.theme = theme;
		}

		protected internal override int ImportTableStyleCore()
		{
			TableStyle item = ((StyleDestination)this).CreateTableStyle();
			theme.TableStyles.Add(item);
			return theme.TableStyles.Count - 1;
		}

		protected internal override int ImportTableCellStyleCore()
		{
			TableCellStyle item = ((StyleDestination)this).CreateTableCellStyle();
			theme.TableCellStyles.Add(item);
			return theme.TableCellStyles.Count - 1;
		}

		protected internal override TableCellStyle GetParentTableCellStyle(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < theme.TableCellStyles.Count)
			{
				return theme.TableCellStyles[index];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override TableStyle GetParentTableStyle(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < theme.TableStyles.Count)
			{
				return theme.TableStyles[index];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class FieldContextImportInfo
	{

		private List<GroupProperties> groups;

		public string Type { get; set; }

		public int Id { get; set; }

		public string Source { get; set; }

		public int VisibleIndex { get; set; }

		public int RowHandle { get; set; }

		public int ParentId { get; set; }

		public int CurrentIndexInGroup { get; set; }

		public string Path { get; set; }

		public List<string> Filters => filters;

		public List<GroupProperties> Groups => groups;

		public void AddFilter(string filterString)
		{
			if (filters == null)
			{
				filters = new List<string>();
			}
			filters.Add(filterString);
		}

		public void AddGroup(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			if (groups == null)
			{
				groups = new List<GroupProperties>();
			}
			groups.Add(groupProperties);
		}
	}

		{
			string name = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("name", reader);
			DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter parameter = new DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter();
			parameter.Name = name;
			string text = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("type", reader);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				parameter.Type = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(text, (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)null);

			string text2 = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("value", reader);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{

			}
			base.Importer.DocumentModel.AddParameterWithReplace(parameter);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SnapBookmarkElementDestination : SnapLeafElementDestination
	{
		protected internal ImportSnapBookmarkInfo BookmarkInfo { get; private set; }

		protected SnapBookmarkElementDestination(SnapImporter importer)
			: base(importer)
		{
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			string text = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("id", reader);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				BookmarkInfo = GetBookmarkInfo(text, reader);
				AssignSnapBookmarkPosition(BookmarkInfo);
			}
		}

		private ImportSnapBookmarkInfo GetBookmarkInfo(string id, XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (!base.Importer.SnapBookmarks.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				value = new ImportSnapBookmarkInfo(id);
				value.ParentId = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("parentId", reader);
				value.TemplateIntervalId = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("templateIntervalId", reader);
				value.FieldContextId = base.Importer.ReadDxIntAttr("fieldContextId", reader);
				value.HeaderBookmarkId = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("headerBookmarkId", reader);
				value.FooterBookmarkId = base.Importer.ReadDxStringAttr("footerBookmarkId", reader);
				value.TemplateInfo = new ImportSnapTemplateInfo();
				base.Importer.SnapBookmarks.Add(id, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal abstract void AssignSnapBookmarkPosition(ImportSnapBookmarkInfo bookmark);
	}

	public class SnapDocumentImporter : IImporter<DocumentFormat, bool>
	{
		public FileDialogFilter Filter => SnapDocumentExporter.filter;

		public DocumentFormat Format => SnapDocumentFormat.Snap;

		public bool LoadDocument(IDocumentModel documentModel, Stream stream, IImporterOptions options)
		{
			return LoadDocument(documentModel, stream, options, leaveOpen: true);
		}

		public bool LoadDocument(IDocumentModel documentModel, Stream stream, IImporterOptions options, bool leaveOpen)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)documentModel;
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).RaiseBeforeImport(Format, options);
			SnapImporter snapImporter = new SnapImporter(snapDocumentModel, (SnapDocumentImporterOptions)options);
			try
			{
				((OpenXmlImporter)snapImporter).Import(stream, leaveOpen);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapImporter)?.Dispose();
			}
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).RaiseAfterImport();
			return true;
		}

		public IImporterOptions SetupLoading()
		{
			return (IImporterOptions)new SnapDocumentImporterOptions();
		}
	}
	public class SnapDocumentRatingCalculator : IFormatRatingCalculator
	{
		public int Calculate(PreprocessedStream preprocessedStream)
		{
			int num = 0;
			Func<InternalZipFile, int> func = delegate(InternalZipFile entry)
			{
				string fileName = entry.FileName;
				if (fileName.Contains("dataSettings.xml"))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (fileName.Contains("fieldContexts.xml"))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (fileName.Contains("snapMailMergeOptions.xml"))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (fileName.Contains("document.xml"))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return fileName.Contains(".rels") ? 1 : 0;
			};
			if (preprocessedStream.ZipFiles == null)
			{
				return num;
			}
			foreach (InternalZipFile item in (List<InternalZipFile>)(object)preprocessedStream.ZipFiles)
			{
				num += func(item);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		protected internal virtual void InsertSnapBookmarks()
		{
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapPieceTable snapPieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)((RichEditDestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)this).PieceTable;
			foreach (string key in SnapBookmarks.Keys)
			{
				ImportSnapBookmarkInfo importSnapBookmarkInfo = SnapBookmarks[key];
				DocumentLogInterval templateIntervalById = GetTemplateIntervalById(importSnapBookmarkInfo.TemplateIntervalId);
				if (((ImportBookmarkInfoCore)importSnapBookmarkInfo).Validate((PieceTable)(object)snapPieceTable) && templateIntervalById != null)
				{
					IFieldContext fieldContext = GetFieldContext(importSnapBookmarkInfo.FieldContextId);
					SnapBookmark snapBookmark = snapPieceTable.CreateSnapBookmarkCore(((ImportBookmarkInfoCore)importSnapBookmarkInfo).Start, ((ImportBookmarkInfoCore)importSnapBookmarkInfo).End - ((ImportBookmarkInfoCore)importSnapBookmarkInfo).Start, fieldContext, templateIntervalById, snapPieceTable, new SnapTemplateInfo(SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(importSnapBookmarkInfo.ParentId))
					{
						snapBookmark.Parent = CreatedBookmarks[importSnapBookmarkInfo.ParentId];
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(importSnapBookmarkInfo.HeaderBookmarkId))
					{
						snapBookmark.HeaderBookmark = CreatedBookmarks[importSnapBookmarkInfo.HeaderBookmarkId];
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(importSnapBookmarkInfo.FooterBookmarkId))
					{
						snapBookmark.FooterBookmark = CreatedBookmarks[importSnapBookmarkInfo.FooterBookmarkId];
					}
					CreatedBookmarks.Add(importSnapBookmarkInfo.Id, snapBookmark);
				}
			}
			UpdateTemplateIntervals();
			CreatedBookmarks.Clear();
		}

		private void UpdateTemplateIntervals()
		{
			foreach (string key in CreatedBookmarks.Keys)
			{
				ImportSnapBookmarkInfo importSnapBookmarkInfo = SnapBookmarks[key];
				ImportSnapTemplateInfo templateInfo = importSnapBookmarkInfo.TemplateInfo;
				SnapBookmark snapBookmark = CreatedBookmarks[key];
				SnapTemplateInfo templateInfo2 = snapBookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo;
				templateInfo2.FieldInGroupCount = templateInfo.FieldInGroupCount;
				templateInfo2.FirstGroupIndex = templateInfo.FirstGroupIndex;
				templateInfo2.TemplateType = templateInfo.TemplateType;
				templateInfo2.FirstGroupBookmark = GetBookmarkByIdSafe(templateInfo.FirstGroupBookmarkId, snapBookmark);
				templateInfo2.LastGroupBookmark = GetBookmarkByIdSafe(templateInfo.LastGroupBookmarkId, snapBookmark);
				templateInfo2.FirstListBookmark = GetBookmarkByIdSafe(templateInfo.FirstListBookmarkId, snapBookmark);
				templateInfo2.LastListBookmark = GetBookmarkByIdSafe(templateInfo.LastListBookmarkId, snapBookmark);
			}
		}

		private SnapBookmark GetBookmarkByIdSafe(string key, SnapBookmark defaultValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CreatedBookmarks.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private DocumentLogInterval GetTemplateIntervalById(string id)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (SnapTemplateIntervals.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				return new DocumentLogInterval(((ImportBookmarkInfoCore)value).Start, ((ImportBookmarkInfoCore)value).End - ((ImportBookmarkInfoCore)value).Start);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ImportSnapThemes()
		{
			string text = ((OpenXmlImporter)this).LookupRelationTargetByType(((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).DocumentRelations, "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/relationships/theme", ((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).DocumentRootFolder, "themes.xml");

		private void AddCalculatedFields()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < calculatedFields.Count; i++)
			{
				CalculatedField calculatedField = calculatedFields[i];
				DataSourceInfo notNullDocumentModelDataSourceInfo = DocumentModel.GetNotNullDocumentModelDataSourceInfo(calculatedField.DataSourceName);
				notNullDocumentModelDataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields.Add(calculatedField);
			}
		}

		private void ImportDataContainer()
		{
			string text = ((OpenXmlImporter)this).LookupRelationTargetByType(((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).DocumentRelations, "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/relationships/datacontainer", ((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).DocumentRootFolder, "dataContainer.xml");
			XmlReader packageFileXmlReader = ((OpenXmlImporter)this).GetPackageFileXmlReader(text);
			if (packageFileXmlReader != null)
			{
				ImportDataContainerCore(packageFileXmlReader);
			}
		}

		private void ImportDataContainerCore(XmlReader reader)
		{
			DocumentModel.BeginUpdateDataSource();
			try
			{
				IEnumerable<SqlDataSource> enumerable = LoadDataSourcesFromContainer(reader);
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<SqlDataSource>(enumerable, (Action<SqlDataSource>)delegate(SqlDataSource d)
					{
						FillSqlDataSource(d);
						DocumentModel.AddDataSource((IDataComponent)(object)d);
					});
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DocumentModel.EndUpdateDataSource();
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<SqlDataSource> LoadDataSourcesFromContainer(XmlReader reader)
		{
			XDocument xDocument = SafeXml.CreateXDocument(reader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
			XElement xElement = xDocument.Root.Element("DataSources");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<string, SqlDataConnection> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, SqlDataConnection>();
			XElement xElement2 = xDocument.Root.Element("DataConnections");
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				foreach (XElement item in xElement2.Elements("DataConnection"))
				{
					SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = new SqlDataConnection();
					sqlDataConnection.LoadFromXml(item);
					dictionary.Add(sqlDataConnection.Name, sqlDataConnection);
				}
			}
			return LoadDataSourcesFromContainerCore(dictionary, xElement);
		}

		private IEnumerable<SqlDataSource> LoadDataSourcesFromContainerCore(Dictionary<string, SqlDataConnection> connections, XElement dataSourcesElement)
		{
			List<SqlDataSource> list = new List<SqlDataSource>();
			foreach (XElement item in dataSourcesElement.Elements("DataSource"))
			{
				XElement xElement = item.Elements().FirstOrDefault();
				if (xElement == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string attributeValue = xElement.GetAttributeValue("DataConnection");
				if (!connections.TryGetValue(attributeValue, out var value))
				{
					continue;
				}
				value.CreateDataStore(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IDataConnectionParametersService>());
				DataProviderBase dataProvider = new DataProviderBase(value);
				((IDataProvider)dataProvider).LoadFromXml(xElement);
				IDBSchemaProvider service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IDBSchemaProvider>();
				IDBSchemaProviderEx service2 = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IDBSchemaProviderEx>();
				IDBSchemaProviderEx iDBSchemaProviderEx = DBSchemaProviderExFactory.GetIDBSchemaProviderEx(service, service2);
				DBSchema dBSchema = new DBSchema(iDBSchemaProviderEx.GetTables(value), iDBSchemaProviderEx.GetViews(value));
				DBTable[] tables = dBSchema.Tables.Union(dBSchema.Views).ToArray();
				iDBSchemaProviderEx.LoadColumns(value, tables);
				dataProvider.DBSchema = dBSchema;
				SqlDataSource sqlDataSource = new SqlDataSource("connection", value.CreateDataConnectionParameters());
				CompositeDataConnectionParametersService compositeDataConnectionParametersService = new CompositeDataConnectionParametersService();
				compositeDataConnectionParametersService.AddService(sqlDataSource);
				compositeDataConnectionParametersService.AddService(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IDataConnectionParametersService>());
				ServiceContainerExtensions.RemoveService<IDataConnectionParametersService>((IServiceContainer)sqlDataSource);
				ServiceContainerExtensions.AddService<IDataConnectionParametersService>((IServiceContainer)sqlDataSource, (IDataConnectionParametersService)compositeDataConnectionParametersService);
				sqlDataSource.Name = item.GetAttributeValue("Name");
				if (dataProvider.DataSelection.All((DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable t) => t.References.ActionType != ActionType.MasterDetailRelation))
				{
					sqlDataSource.Queries.Add(dataProvider.GetQuery());
				}
				else
				{
					Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable>> tableGroups = dataProvider.DataSelection.GetTableGroups();
					IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable>>>((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable>>>)tableGroups, (Action<KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable>>>)delegate(KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable>> g)
					{
						sqlDataSource.Queries.Add(dataProvider.GetQuery(g.Value, g.Key));
					});
					IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable> enumerable = dataProvider.DataSelection.Where((DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable t) => t.References.ActionType == ActionType.MasterDetailRelation);
					IEnumerableExtensions.ForEach<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable>(enumerable, (Action<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable>)delegate(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable table)
					{
						table.References.ForEach(delegate(DataReference r)
						{
							MasterDetailInfo masterDetailInfo = sqlDataSource.Relations.FirstOrDefault((MasterDetailInfo m) => m.MasterQueryName == r.ParentDataTable.TableName);
							if (masterDetailInfo == null)
							{
								sqlDataSource.Relations.Add(r.ParentDataTable.TableName, r.KeyDBTableName, r.ParentKeyColumn, r.KeyColumn);
							}
							else
							{
								masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Add(new RelationColumnInfo(r.ParentKeyColumn, r.KeyColumn));
							}
						});
					});
				}
				list.Add(sqlDataSource);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void ImportDataSources()
		{
			string text = ((OpenXmlImporter)this).LookupRelationTargetByType(((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).DocumentRelations, "http://devexpress.com/snap/2012/relationships/datasources", ((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).DocumentRootFolder, "dataSources.xml");
			XmlReader packageFileXmlReader = ((OpenXmlImporter)this).GetPackageFileXmlReader(text);
			if (packageFileXmlReader != null)
			{
				ImportDataSourcesCore(packageFileXmlReader);
			}
		}

		private void ImportDataSourcesCore(XmlReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				XElement xElement = SafeXml.CreateXDocument(reader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null)?.Root;
				if (xElement == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				LoadDataComponents(xElement);
				foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements(dx + "dataSource"))
				{
					LoadCustomDataSource(item);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.ErrorHandler.HandleError(new ExtendedErrorInfo(ErrorType.FillDataError, ex.Message));
			}
		}

		private void LoadDataComponents(XElement root)
		{
			List<IDataComponent> list = new List<IDataComponent>();
			foreach (XElement item in root.Elements("dataComponent"))
			{
				list.Add(DataComponentDispatcher.LoadFromXml(item));
			}
			ValidateObjectDataSources(list);
			foreach (IDataComponent item2 in list)
			{
				RegisterDataComponent(item2);
			}
		}

		private void ValidateObjectDataSources(IEnumerable<IDataComponent> dataComponents)
		{
			IObjectDataSourceValidationService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IObjectDataSourceValidationService>();
			if (service != null)
			{
				List<ObjectDataSource> dataSources = dataComponents.OfType<ObjectDataSource>().ToList();
				service.Validate(dataSources);
			}
		}

		private void RegisterDataComponent(IDataComponent dataComponent)
		{
			if (dataComponent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ReplaceDataConnectionParametersService(dataComponent);
			DocumentModel.AddDataSource(dataComponent);
			try
			{
				FillDataComponent(dataComponent);
			}
			catch (AggregateException ex)
			{
				foreach (Exception innerException in ex.InnerExceptions)
				{
					string argument = ((innerException.InnerException != null) ? (innerException.Message + "\r\n" + innerException.InnerException.Message) : innerException.Message);
					DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.ErrorHandler.HandleError(new ExtendedErrorInfo(ErrorType.FillDataError, argument));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceDataConnectionParametersService(IDataComponent dataComponent)
		{
			if (dataComponent is IServiceContainer serviceContainer)
			{
				CompositeDataConnectionParametersService compositeDataConnectionParametersService = new CompositeDataConnectionParametersService();
				if (serviceContainer.GetService(typeof(IDataConnectionParametersService)) is IDataConnectionParametersService srv)
				{
					compositeDataConnectionParametersService.AddService(srv);
					serviceContainer.RemoveService(typeof(IDataConnectionParametersService));
				}
				compositeDataConnectionParametersService.AddService(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IDataConnectionParametersService>());
				serviceContainer.AddService(typeof(IDataConnectionParametersService), compositeDataConnectionParametersService);
			}
		}

		private void FillDataComponent(IDataComponent dataComponent)
		{
			if (dataComponent is SqlDataSource dataSource)
			{
				FillSqlDataSource(dataSource);
			}
			else if (dataComponent is EFDataSource dataSource2)
			{
				FillEFDataSource(dataSource2);
			}
			else if (dataComponent is ExcelDataSource dataSource3)
			{
				FillExcelDataSource(dataSource3);
			}
			else
			{
				dataComponent.Fill((IEnumerable<IParameter>)DocumentModel.Parameters);
			}
		}

		private void FillSqlDataSource(SqlDataSource dataSource)
		{
			DocumentModel.FillSqlDataSource(dataSource);
		}

		private void FillEFDataSource(EFDataSource dataSource)
		{
			dataSource.BeforeLoadCustomAssembly += OnBeforeLoadCustomAssembly;
			try
			{
				dataSource.Fill(DocumentModel.Parameters);
			}
			finally
			{
				dataSource.BeforeLoadCustomAssembly -= OnBeforeLoadCustomAssembly;
			}
		}

		private void FillExcelDataSource(ExcelDataSource dataSource)
		{
			DocumentModel.FillExcelDataSource(dataSource);
		}

		private void OnBeforeLoadCustomAssembly(object sender, BeforeLoadCustomAssemblyEventArgs e)
		{
			DocumentModel.RaiseBeforeLoadCustomAssembly(e);
		}

		private void LoadCustomDataSource(XElement dataSource)
		{
			XAttribute xAttribute = dataSource.Attribute(dx + "name");
			if (xAttribute != null)
			{
				XAttribute xAttribute2 = dataSource.Attribute(dx + "data");
				if (xAttribute2 != null)
				{
					string value = xAttribute2.Value;
					byte[] data = Convert.FromBase64String(value);
					AfterDataSourceImportEventArgs e = new AfterDataSourceImportEventArgs(xAttribute.Value, data);
					DocumentModel.RaiseAfterDataSourceImport(e);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ImportFieldContexts()

			}
		}

		{
			if (ReadToDxRootElement(reader, "fieldContexts"))
			{

				((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).ImportContent(reader, (Destination)(object)fieldContextsDestionation, contentFileName);
				CreateFieldContexts(fieldContextsDestionation.ImportedInfos);
			}
		}

		private void CreateFieldContexts(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfo in importedInfos)
			{
				CreateFieldContext(importedInfos, importedInfo.Value);
			}
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateFieldContext(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos, FieldContextImportInfo importInfo)
		{
			IFieldContext fieldContext = GetFieldContext(importInfo.Id);
			if (fieldContext != null)
			{
				return fieldContext;
			}
			if (!fieldContextHandlers.TryGetValue(importInfo.Type, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			fieldContext = value(importedInfos, importInfo);
			fieldContexts.Add(importInfo.Id, fieldContext);
			return fieldContext;
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateRootFieldContext(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos, FieldContextImportInfo info)
		{
			return new RootFieldContext(DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher, info.Source);
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateProxyFieldContext(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos, FieldContextImportInfo info)
		{
			IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext = (IDataControllerListFieldContext)CreateFieldContext(importedInfos, importedInfos[info.ParentId]);
			return new ProxyFieldContext(info.Path, listContext);
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateEmptyFieldContext(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos, FieldContextImportInfo info)
		{
			return new EmptyFieldContext();
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateSimplePropertyFieldContext(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos, FieldContextImportInfo info)
		{
			ISingleObjectFieldContext parent = (ISingleObjectFieldContext)CreateFieldContext(importedInfos, importedInfos[info.ParentId]);
			return new SimplePropertyFieldContext(parent, info.Path);
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateSingleListItemFieldContext(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos, FieldContextImportInfo info)
		{
			IDataControllerListFieldContext parent = (IDataControllerListFieldContext)CreateFieldContext(importedInfos, importedInfos[info.ParentId]);
			return new SingleListItemFieldContext(parent, info.VisibleIndex, info.RowHandle, info.CurrentIndexInGroup);
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateListFieldContext(Dictionary<int, FieldContextImportInfo> importedInfos, FieldContextImportInfo info)
		{
			ISingleObjectFieldContext parent = (ISingleObjectFieldContext)CreateFieldContext(importedInfos, importedInfos[info.ParentId]);
			FilterProperties filterProperties = null;
			if (info.Filters != null)
			{
				filterProperties = new FilterProperties();
				filterProperties.Filters.AddRange(info.Filters);
			}
			ListParameters listParameters = new ListParameters(info.Groups, filterProperties);
			return new ListFieldContext(parent, listParameters);
		}

		private IFieldContext GetFieldContext(int id)
		{
			if (fieldContexts.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IFieldContext CreateFieldContext(FieldContextImportInfo fieldContextImportInfo)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ReadToDxRootElement(XmlReader reader, string name)
		{
			return ((DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)this).ReadToRootElement(reader, name, SnapNamespace);
		}

		protected internal string ReadDxStringAttr(string name, XmlReader reader)
		{
			string text = reader.GetAttribute(name, SnapNamespace);
			if (text != null)
			{
				text = text.Trim();
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected internal bool ReadDxBoolAttr(string name, XmlReader reader)
		{
			string text = ReadDxStringAttr(name, reader);
			if (int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return result != 0;
			}
			if (bool.TryParse(text, out var result2))
			{
				return result2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal int ReadDxIntAttr(string name, XmlReader reader)
		{
			return Convert.ToInt32(ReadDxStringAttr(name, reader), NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
		}

		protected internal override void CheckVersion()
		{
			if (DocumentVersion == 0 || CurrentVersion < DocumentVersion)
			{
				SnapExceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(SnapStringId.Msg_UnsupportedDocumentVersion);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, IFieldContext> fieldContext in fieldContexts)
				{
					if (fieldContext.Value is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
						IDisposable disposable2 = null;
					}
				}
			}
			((OpenXmlImporter)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Snap.Core.History

	public class AddDataComponentHistoryItem : HistoryItem
	{
		private readonly IDataComponent dataComponent;

		private readonly bool isDataSourceInternal;

		private readonly SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel;

		public AddDataComponentHistoryItem(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, IDataComponent dataSource, bool isDataSourceInternal)
			: base((IDocumentModelPart)documentModel.ActivePieceTable)
		{
			snapDocumentModel = documentModel;
			dataComponent = dataSource;
			this.isDataSourceInternal = isDataSourceInternal;
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			snapDocumentModel.BeginUpdateDataSource();
			snapDocumentModel.DataSources.AddWithReplace(new DataSourceInfo(dataComponent.Name, dataComponent, isDataSourceInternal));
			snapDocumentModel.EndUpdateDataSource();
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			snapDocumentModel.BeginUpdateDataSource();
			try
			{
				int dataSourceInfoIndex = snapDocumentModel.DataSources.GetDataSourceInfoIndex(dataComponent.Name);
				snapDocumentModel.DataSources.RemoveItemCore(dataSourceInfoIndex);
			}
			finally
			{
				snapDocumentModel.EndUpdateDataSource();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DataSourceInfoCollectionHistoryItem : HistoryItem

		}

		public RemoveDataSourceInfoHistoryItem(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)

		}

			Item = base.DataSources[Index];
			base.DataSources.RemoveItemCore(Index);
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()

			base.DataSources.InsertItemCore(Index, Item);
		}
	}

	}

		}
	}

	public class ModificationTracker : IDisposable, ICloneable<ModificationTracker>
	{
		private int unmodifiedIndex;

		private int unmodifiedTransactionIndex;

		private SnapDocumentHistory history;

		public bool Modified => ((DocumentHistory)(object)history).IsModified(unmodifiedIndex, unmodifiedTransactionIndex);

		public ModificationTracker(SnapDocumentHistory history, int unmodifiedIndex)
			: this(history, unmodifiedIndex, -1)
		{
		}

		public ModificationTracker(SnapDocumentHistory history, int unmodifiedIndex, int unmodifiedTransactionIndex)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)history, "history");
			this.history = history;
			this.unmodifiedIndex = unmodifiedIndex;
			this.unmodifiedTransactionIndex = unmodifiedTransactionIndex;
			SubscribeHistoryEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeHistoryEvents()
		{
			((RichEditDocumentHistory)history).HistoryCutted += OnHistoryCutted;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeHistoryEvents()
		{
			((RichEditDocumentHistory)history).HistoryCutted -= OnHistoryCutted;
		}

		private void OnHistoryCutted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (unmodifiedIndex > ((DocumentHistory)(object)history).CurrentIndex)
			{
				unmodifiedIndex = -2;
				unmodifiedTransactionIndex = -1;
				UnsubscribeHistoryEvents();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && history != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeHistoryEvents();
			}
			history = null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~ModificationTracker()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public ModificationTracker Clone()
		{
			return new ModificationTracker(history, unmodifiedIndex, unmodifiedTransactionIndex);
		}
	}

		{
			int[] childSnapBookmarkIndexes = PieceTable.GetChildSnapBookmarkIndexes(base.Bookmark);
			int num = childSnapBookmarkIndexes.Length;
			SnapBookmark parent = base.Bookmark.Parent;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				((DocumentIntervalCollection<SnapBookmark>)(object)PieceTable.SnapBookmarks)[childSnapBookmarkIndexes[i]].Parent = parent;
			}
			base.Bookmark.Deleted = true;
			base.UndoCore();
			base.Bookmark.DetachInterval(PieceTable.DocumentPositionManager);
		}

		protected internal override BookmarkBaseCollection<SnapBookmark> GetBookmarkCollection()
		{
			return PieceTable.SnapBookmarks;
		}
	}

	public class MailMergeExportFormController : FormController
	{
		internal enum ModeType
		{
			AllRecords,
			CurrentRecord,
			Range
		}

		private readonly ISnapControl control;

		private int from;

		private int count;

		private SnapMailMergeExportOptions properties;

		private ModeType mode;

		private RecordSeparator separator;

		internal int From
		{
			get
			{
				return from;
			}
			set
			{
				from = value;
			}
		}

		internal int Count
		{
			get
			{
				return count;
			}
			set
			{
				count = value;
			}
		}

		internal RecordSeparator Separator
		{
			get
			{
				return separator;
			}
			set
			{
				separator = value;
			}
		}

		internal ModeType Mode
		{
			get
			{
				return mode;
			}
			set
			{
				mode = value;
			}
		}

		internal SnapMailMergeExportOptions Properties => properties;

		internal MailMergeExportFormController(MailMergeExportFormControllerParameters controllerParameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)controllerParameters, "controllerParameters");
			control = (ISnapControl)((FormControllerParameters)controllerParameters).Control;
			properties = controllerParameters.Properties;
			separator = properties.RecordSeparator;
			if (properties.ExportRecordsCount <= 0)
			{
				mode = ModeType.AllRecords;
				from = properties.ExportFrom + 1;
				count = 5;
			}
			else
			{
				mode = ModeType.Range;
				from = properties.ExportFrom + 1;
				count = properties.ExportRecordsCount;
			}
		}

		public override void ApplyChanges()
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ModeType.AllRecords:
				properties.ExportFrom = 0;
				properties.ExportRecordsCount = -1;
				break;
			case ModeType.CurrentRecord:
				properties.ExportFrom = ((ISnapControlOptions)((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)((IRichEditControl)control).InnerControl).Options).SnapMailMergeVisualOptions.CurrentRecordIndex;
				properties.ExportRecordsCount = 1;
				break;
			case ModeType.Range:
				properties.ExportFrom = from - 1;
				properties.ExportRecordsCount = count;
				break;
			}
			properties.RecordSeparator = separator;
		}
	}

	public class MailMergeSortingFormController : SortingFormControllerBase
	{
		protected override bool AllowEmptySortList => true;

		private SnapMailMergeVisualOptions SnapMailMergeVisualOptions => ((ISnapControlOptions)((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)((IRichEditControl)base.Control).InnerControl).Options).SnapMailMergeVisualOptions;

		public MailMergeSortingFormController(SortingFormControllerBaseParameters controllerParameters)
			: base(controllerParameters)
		{
		}

		protected override SnapListFieldInfo GetListFieldInfo()
		{
			return new SnapListFieldInfo(((SnapNativeDocument)(object)((IRichEditControl)base.Control).Document).PieceTable, null);
		}

		protected override FieldPathInfo GetFieldPathInfo()
		{
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapMailMergeVisualOptions snapMailMergeVisualOptions = SnapMailMergeVisualOptions;
			RootFieldDataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = new RootFieldDataSourceInfo(snapMailMergeVisualOptions.DataSourceName);
			FieldPathDataMemberInfo fieldPathDataMemberInfo = new FieldPathDataMemberInfo();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember))
			{
				fieldPathDataMemberInfo.AddFieldName(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(snapMailMergeVisualOptions.FilterString))
			{
				fieldPathDataMemberInfo.AddFilter(snapMailMergeVisualOptions.FilterString);
			}
			foreach (SnapListGroupParam item2 in snapMailMergeVisualOptions.Sorting)
			{
				GroupProperties groupProperties = new GroupProperties();
				GroupFieldInfo item = new GroupFieldInfo(item2.FieldName)
				{
					SortOrder = item2.SortOrder,
					GroupInterval = item2.Interval
				};
				groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos.Add(item);
				fieldPathDataMemberInfo.AddGroup(groupProperties);
			}
			return new FieldPathInfo
			{
				DataSourceInfo = dataSourceInfo,
				DataMemberInfo = fieldPathDataMemberInfo
			};
		}

		private string GetListDataMember()
		{
			return ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)SnapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember;
		}

		public override void ApplyChanges()
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapListSorting sorting = SnapMailMergeVisualOptions.Sorting;
			sorting.Clear();
			foreach (SortField sort in base.SortList)
			{
				sorting.Add(new SnapListGroupParam(sort.FieldName, sort.SortOrder));
			}
		}

		public override string GetFieldName(string dataMember)
		{
			string dataMember2 = ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)SnapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember;
			if (string.CompareOrdinal(dataMember2, dataMember) == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember2))
			{
				return dataMember.Substring(dataMember2.Length + 1);
			}
			return dataMember;
		}

		public override string GetDisplayName(string fieldName)
		{
			if (base.DataAccessService == null)
			{
				return fieldName;
			}
			SnapMailMergeVisualOptions snapMailMergeVisualOptions = SnapMailMergeVisualOptions;
			return base.DataAccessService.GetFieldDisplayName(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataSource, ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember, fieldName);
		}
	}
