	public class ReportStructureEditorFormController : FormController
	{
		private readonly ISnapControl control;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, FieldPathInfo> pathInfos = new Dictionary<string, FieldPathInfo>();

		private IFieldPathService fieldPathService;

		public ISnapControl Control => control;

		public Pair<string, int> FocusedNodeTag { get; set; }

		protected IFieldPathService FieldPathService
		{
			get
			{
				if (fieldPathService == null)
				{
					IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
					if (service != null)
					{
						fieldPathService = service.FieldPathService;
					}
				}
				return fieldPathService;
			}
		}

		protected Dictionary<string, FieldPathInfo> PathInfos => pathInfos;

		protected SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)((IRichEditControl)Control).InnerControl).DocumentModel;

		protected SnapPieceTable PieceTable => DocumentModel.ActivePieceTable;

		public ReportStructureEditorFormController(ReportStructureEditorFormControllerParameters controllerParameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)controllerParameters, "controllerParameters");
			control = controllerParameters.Control;
			FocusedNodeTag = GetFocusedNodeTag();
		}

		public void MoveUp()
		{
			FieldPathDataMemberInfo editedDataMemberInfo = GetEditedDataMemberInfo();
			if (editedDataMemberInfo != null && !editedDataMemberInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				int second = FocusedNodeTag.Second;
				Algorithms.SwapElements<GroupProperties>((IList<GroupProperties>)editedDataMemberInfo.LastItem.Groups, second - 1, second);
			}
		}

		public void MoveDown()
		{
			FieldPathDataMemberInfo editedDataMemberInfo = GetEditedDataMemberInfo();
			if (editedDataMemberInfo != null && !editedDataMemberInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				int second = FocusedNodeTag.Second;
				Algorithms.SwapElements<GroupProperties>((IList<GroupProperties>)editedDataMemberInfo.LastItem.Groups, second, second + 1);
			}
		}

		public override void ApplyChanges()
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (PathInfos.Count == 0 || FieldPathService == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				ApplyChangesCore();
				Field topLevelListFieldBySelection = new SnapObjectModelController(PieceTable).GetTopLevelListFieldBySelection();
				if (topLevelListFieldBySelection != null)
				{
					Selection selection = ((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).Selection;
					SnapCaretPosition snapCaretPositionFromSelection = DocumentModel.SelectionInfo.GetSnapCaretPositionFromSelection(selection.PieceTable, selection.NormalizedStart);
					((PieceTable)PieceTable).FieldUpdater.UpdateFieldAndNestedFields(topLevelListFieldBySelection);
					if (snapCaretPositionFromSelection != null)
					{
						DocumentModel.SelectionInfo.RestoreCaretPosition(snapCaretPositionFromSelection);
					}
					if (!((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).IsUpdateLocked)
					{
						((IRichEditControl)Control).InnerControl.ActiveView.EnsureCaretVisible();
					}
					else
					{
						((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).DeferredChanges.EnsureCaretVisible = true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyChangesCore()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, FieldPathInfo> pathInfo in PathInfos)
			{
				if (pathInfo.Value != null)
				{
					InstructionController val = CreateInstructionControllerByFieldName(pathInfo.Key);
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.SuppressFieldsUpdateAfterUpdateInstruction = true;
						val.SetArgument(0, FieldPathService.GetStringPath(pathInfo.Value));
						val.ApplyDeferredActions();
						PieceTable.UpdateTemplateByField(val.Field, clearUnusedSwitches: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public Field FindSelectedListField()
		{
			return new ListFieldSelectionController(DocumentModel).FindListField()?.Field;
		}

		private FieldPathDataMemberInfo GetEditedDataMemberInfo()
		{
			string first = FocusedNodeTag.First;
			if (FieldPathService == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!PathInfos.TryGetValue(first, out var value))
			{
				InstructionController val = CreateInstructionControllerByFieldName(first);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				value = FieldPathService.FromString(val.GetArgumentAsString(0));
				PathInfos.Add(first, value);
			}
			return value.DataMemberInfo;
		}

		private InstructionController CreateInstructionControllerByFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			Field val = PieceTable.FindFieldNearestToSelection(fieldName, allowEmptyResult: false);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return PieceTable.CreateFieldInstructionController(val);
		}

		private Pair<string, int> GetFocusedNodeTag()
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapDocumentModel documentModel = DocumentModel;
			SnapListFieldInfo selectedSNListField = FieldsHelper.GetSelectedSNListField(documentModel);
			if (selectedSNListField == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapPieceTable activePieceTable = documentModel.ActivePieceTable;
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = new SnapBookmarkController(activePieceTable).FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByPosition(((DocumentModel)documentModel).Selection.Start);
			if (snapBookmark == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new SnapObjectModelController(activePieceTable).GetTag(snapBookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo, selectedSNListField);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SortingFormControllerBase : FormController
	{
		private readonly ISnapControl control;

		private IDataAccessService dataAccessService;

		private IFieldPathService fieldPathService;

		private SnapListFieldInfo listFieldInfo;

		private FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo;

		public ISnapControl Control => control;

		public SortField DefaultSorting { get; set; }

		public BindingList<SortField> SortList { get; set; }

		public string ListName => ListFieldInfo.ParsedInfo.Name;

		public string ListDataMember { get; set; }

		protected IFieldPathService FieldPathService
		{
			get
			{
				if (fieldPathService == null)
				{
					IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
					if (service != null)
					{
						fieldPathService = service.FieldPathService;
					}
				}
				return fieldPathService;
			}
		}

		protected IDataAccessService DataAccessService
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataAccessService == null)
				{
					dataAccessService = control.GetService(typeof(IDataAccessService)) as IDataAccessService;
				}
				return dataAccessService;
			}
		}

		protected SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)((IRichEditControl)Control).InnerControl).DocumentModel;

		protected SnapPieceTable PieceTable => DocumentModel.ActivePieceTable;

		protected SnapListFieldInfo ListFieldInfo => listFieldInfo;

		protected FieldPathInfo FieldPathInfo => fieldPathInfo;

		protected FieldPathDataMemberInfo FieldPath => fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo;

		protected virtual bool AllowEmptySortList => false;

		protected SortingFormControllerBase(SortingFormControllerBaseParameters controllerParameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)controllerParameters, "controllerParameters");
			control = controllerParameters.Control;
			SortList = new BindingList<SortField>();
			listFieldInfo = GetListFieldInfo();
			if (listFieldInfo != null)
			{
				fieldPathInfo = GetFieldPathInfo();
				if (fieldPathInfo != null)
				{
					ListDataMember = GetListDataMember();
					FillSortList();
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract FieldPathInfo GetFieldPathInfo();

		protected abstract SnapListFieldInfo GetListFieldInfo();

		protected void FillSortList()
		{
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = !AllowEmptySortList;
			foreach (FieldDataMemberInfoItem item in FieldPath.Items)
			{
				if (item.Groups == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < item.Groups.Count; i++)
				{
					GroupProperties groupProperties = item.Groups[i];
					flag &= groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates;
					for (int j = 0; j < groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos.Count; j++)
					{
						GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo = groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos[j];
						string displayName = GetDisplayName(groupFieldInfo.FieldName);
						SortList.Add(new SortField(displayName, groupFieldInfo.SortOrder, groupFieldInfo.FieldName, groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates, i, j));
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag && !CreateSortingBySelectedField())
			{
				SortList.Add(new SortField());
			}
		}

		private bool CreateSortingBySelectedField()
		{
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = new ListFieldSelectionController(DocumentModel).FindDataField();
			SNDataInfo dataInfo = GetDataInfo(snapFieldInfo);
			if (dataInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = DataMemberInfo.Create(dataInfo.DataPaths);
			if (!AllowGroupAndSort(((DataPair)dataInfo).Source, dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo.DataMember, dataMemberInfo.ColumnName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string argumentAsString = PieceTable.CreateFieldInstructionController(snapFieldInfo.Field).GetArgumentAsString(0);
			string displayName = GetDisplayName(argumentAsString);
			SortList.Add(new SortField(displayName, (ColumnSortOrder)1, argumentAsString, isGroupSorting: false, 0, 0));
			return true;
		}

		protected InstructionController CreateInstructionControllerByFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			Field field = PieceTable.FindFieldNearestToSelection(fieldName, allowEmptyResult: false);
			return PieceTable.CreateFieldInstructionController(field);
		}

		public void AddSortField()
		{
			SortList.Add(DefaultSorting.Clone());
		}

		public void SetDefaultSorting(string dataMember)
		{
			DefaultSorting = new SortField();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				string fieldName = GetFieldName(dataMember);
				DefaultSorting.FieldName = fieldName;
				DefaultSorting.DisplayName = GetDisplayName(fieldName);
			}
			if (SortList.Count != 0 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SortList[SortList.Count - 1].DisplayName))
			{
				SortList[SortList.Count - 1] = DefaultSorting.Clone();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveEmptySortListElements()
		{
			List<SortField> list = SortList.Where((SortField p) => string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.DisplayName)).ToList();
			foreach (SortField item in list)
			{
				SortList.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public void SwapSortListElements(int index1, int index2)
		{
			Algorithms.SwapElements<SortField>((IList<SortField>)SortList, index1, index2);
		}

		public virtual string GetFieldName(string dataMember)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ListDataMember))
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			return dataMember.Substring(ListDataMember.Length + 1);
		}

		public virtual string GetDisplayName(string fieldName)
		{
			return FieldsHelper.GetFieldDisplayName(DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher, listFieldInfo, fieldName, fieldName);
		}

		public bool AllowGroupAndSort(object dataSource, string dataMember, string fieldName)
		{
			if (DataAccessService == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DataAccessService.AllowGroupAndSort(dataSource, dataMember, fieldName);
		}

		private string GetListDataMember()
		{
			DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher, listFieldInfo);
			if (fieldDesignBinding == null || (fieldDesignBinding.DataSource == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldDesignBinding.DataMember)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return fieldDesignBinding.DataMember;
		}

		protected SNDataInfo GetDataInfo(SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			if (fieldInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher = DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher;
			DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(dataSourceDispatcher, fieldInfo);
			if (fieldDesignBinding == null || (fieldDesignBinding.DataSource == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldDesignBinding.DataMember)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = fieldDesignBinding.DataMember;
			Field parent = fieldInfo.Field.Parent;
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo2 = new SnapFieldInfo(PieceTable, parent);
				DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding2 = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(dataSourceDispatcher, fieldInfo2);
				text2 = fieldDesignBinding2.DataMember;
				text = ((string.CompareOrdinal(text2, fieldDesignBinding.DataMember) != 0) ? ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2)) ? fieldDesignBinding.DataMember.Substring(text2.Length + 1) : fieldDesignBinding.DataMember) : string.Empty);
			}
			string fieldDisplayName = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDisplayName(dataSourceDispatcher, listFieldInfo, text, text);
			return new SNDataInfo(fieldDesignBinding.DataSource, new string[2] { text2, text }, fieldDisplayName);
		}
	}

		}

			SortOrder = sortOrder;
			FieldName = fieldName;
			IsGroupSorting = isGroupSorting;
			GroupIndex = groupIndex;
			GroupFieldInfoIndex = groupFieldInfoIndex;
		}

		}
	}

		private void InsertDisplayFieldValue(PieceTable sourcePieceTable, MailMergeDataMode mailMergeDataMode, Field documentField, DocumentModel targetModel, string navigateUri)

				targetModel.MainPieceTable.ApplyHyperlinkStyle(val, true);
			}

		static SNSparklineField()
		{
			FieldType = "SNSPARKLINE";
			SnSparklineDataSourceNameSwitch = "dsn";
			SnSparklineViewTypeSwitch = "vt";
			SnSparklineWidthSwitch = "w";
			SnSparklineHeightSwitch = "h";
			SnSparklineHighlightMaxPointSwitch = "hmxp";
			SnSparklineHighlightMinPointSwitch = "hmnp";
			SnSparklineHighlightStartPointSwitch = "hsp";
			SnSparklineHighlightEndPointSwitch = "hep";
			SnSparklineColorSwitch = "cl";
			SnSparklineMaxPointColorSwitch = "mxpcl";
			SnSparklineMinPointColorSwitch = "mnpcl";
			SnSparklineStartPointColorSwitch = "spcl";
			SnSparklineEndPointColorSwitch = "epcl";
			SnSparklineNegativePointColorSwitch = "npcl";
			SnSparklineLineWidthSwitch = "lnw";
			SnSparklineHighlightNegativePointsSwitch = "hnp";
			SnSparklineShowMarkersSwitch = "sm";
			SnSparklineMarkerSizeSwitch = "msz";
			SnSparklineMaxPointMarkerSizeSwitch = "mxpmsz";
			SnSparklineMinPointMarkerSizeSwitch = "mnpmsz";
			SnSparklineStartPointMarkerSizeSwitch = "spmsz";
			SnSparklineEndPointMarkerSizeSwitch = "epmsz";
			SnSparklineNegativePointMarkerSizeSwitch = "npmsz";
			SnSparklineMarkerColorSwitch = "mcl";
			SnSparklineAreaOpacitySwitch = "ao";
			SnSparklineBarDistanceSwitch = "bd";
			AliasForEmptyFieldData = "<<IncorrectData>>";
			SparklineViewTypeStringDictionary = new Dictionary<SparklineViewType, string>();
			sparklineSwitchesWithArgument = CalculatedFieldBase.CreateSwitchesWithArgument(new string[27]
			{
				SnSparklineViewTypeSwitch,
				SnSparklineWidthSwitch,
				SnSparklineHeightSwitch,
				SnSparklineHighlightMaxPointSwitch,
				SnSparklineHighlightMinPointSwitch,
				SnSparklineHighlightStartPointSwitch,
				SnSparklineHighlightEndPointSwitch,
				SnSparklineColorSwitch,
				SnSparklineMaxPointColorSwitch,
				SnSparklineMinPointColorSwitch,
				SnSparklineStartPointColorSwitch,
				SnSparklineEndPointColorSwitch,
				SnSparklineNegativePointColorSwitch,
				SnSparklineLineWidthSwitch,
				SnSparklineHighlightNegativePointsSwitch,
				SnSparklineShowMarkersSwitch,
				SnSparklineMarkerSizeSwitch,
				SnSparklineMaxPointMarkerSizeSwitch,
				SnSparklineMinPointMarkerSizeSwitch,
				SnSparklineStartPointMarkerSizeSwitch,
				SnSparklineEndPointMarkerSizeSwitch,
				SnSparklineNegativePointMarkerSizeSwitch,
				SnSparklineMarkerColorSwitch,
				SnSparklineAreaOpacitySwitch,
				SnSparklineBarDistanceSwitch,
				SnSparklineDataSourceNameSwitch,
				SNMergeFieldSupportsEmptyFieldDataAlias.EmptyFieldDataAliasSwitch
			});
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, bool> item in MergefieldField.SwitchesWithArgument)
			{
				sparklineSwitchesWithArgument.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
			SparklineViewTypeStringDictionary.Add(SparklineViewType.Area, "Area");
			SparklineViewTypeStringDictionary.Add(SparklineViewType.Bar, "Bar");
			SparklineViewTypeStringDictionary.Add(SparklineViewType.Line, "Line");
			SparklineViewTypeStringDictionary.Add(SparklineViewType.WinLoss, "WinLoss");
		}

		public static string GetSparklineViewTypeString(SparklineViewType type)
		{
			return SparklineViewTypeStringDictionary[type];
		}

		public SNSparklineField()
		{
			InitSparklineViewTypeToViewFields();
		}

		public override void Initialize(PieceTable pieceTable, InstructionCollection instructions)
		{
			base.Initialize(pieceTable, instructions);
			SetDataSourceName(instructions);
			SetViewType(instructions);
			SetWidth(instructions);
			SetHeight(instructions);
			SetHighlightMaxPoint(instructions);
			SetHighlightMinPoint(instructions);
			SetHighlightStartPoint(instructions);
			SetHighlightEndPoint(instructions);
			SetColor(instructions);
			SetMaxPointColor(instructions);
			SetMinPointColor(instructions);
			SetStartPointColor(instructions);
			SetEndPointColor(instructions);
			SetNegativePointColor(instructions);
			SetLineWidth(instructions);
			SetHighlightNegativePoints(instructions);
			SetShowMarkers(instructions);
			SetMarkerSize(instructions);
			SetMaxPointMarkerSize(instructions);
			SetMinPointMarkerSize(instructions);
			SetStartPointMarkerSize(instructions);
			SetEndPointMarkerSize(instructions);
			SetNegativePointMarkerSize(instructions);
			SetMarkerColor(instructions);
			SetAreaOpacity(instructions);
			SetBarDistance(instructions);
		}

		private void InitSparklineViewTypeToViewFields()
		{
			if (SparklineViewTypeToViewFields.Count == Enum.GetValues(typeof(SparklineViewType)).Length)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SparklineViewTypeToViewFields.Count != 0)
			{
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields.Clear();
			}
			foreach (SparklineViewType value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(SparklineViewType)))
			{
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields.Add(value, SparklineViewFields.None);
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(FieldViewType fieldViewType, SparklineViewFields flags)
		{
			if (fieldViewType.HasFlag(FieldViewType.Area))
			{
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[SparklineViewType.Area] |= flags;
			}
			if (fieldViewType.HasFlag(FieldViewType.Bar))
			{
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[SparklineViewType.Bar] |= flags;
			}
			if (fieldViewType.HasFlag(FieldViewType.Line))
			{
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[SparklineViewType.Line] |= flags;
			}
			if (fieldViewType.HasFlag(FieldViewType.WinLoss))
			{
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[SparklineViewType.WinLoss] |= flags;
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeCurrentView()
		{
			if (SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[ViewType] != SparklineViewFields.None)
			{
				SetBarDistance();
				SetAreaOpacity();
				SetLineWidth();
				SetMarkers();
				SetViewColor();
				SetPointColors();
				SetPointHighlight();
			}
		}

		private void SetBarDistance()
		{
			if (SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[ViewType].HasFlag(SparklineViewFields.BarDistance))
			{
				if (View is BarSparklineViewBase barSparklineViewBase)
				{
					barSparklineViewBase.BarDistance = BarDistance;
				}
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[ViewType] &= ~SparklineViewFields.BarDistance;
			}
		}

		private void SetAreaOpacity()
		{
			if (SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[ViewType].HasFlag(SparklineViewFields.AreaOpacity))
			{
				if (View is AreaSparklineView areaSparklineView)
				{
					areaSparklineView.AreaOpacity = AreaOpacity;
				}
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[ViewType] &= ~SparklineViewFields.AreaOpacity;
			}
		}

		private void SetLineWidth()
		{
			if (SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[ViewType].HasFlag(SparklineViewFields.LineWidth))
			{
				if (View is LineSparklineView lineSparklineView)
				{
					lineSparklineView.LineWidth = LineWidth;
				}
				SparklineViewTypeToViewFields[ViewType] &= ~SparklineViewFields.LineWidth;
			}
		}

		private void SetMarkers()
		{
			LineSparklineView lineSparklineView = View as LineSparklineView;
			SetLineViewShowMarkers(lineSparklineView);
			SetLineViewMarkerSize(lineSparklineView);
			SetLineViewMaxPointMarkerSize(lineSparklineView);
			SetLineViewMinPointMarkerSize(lineSparklineView);
			SetLineViewStartPointMarkerSize(lineSparklineView);
			SetLineViewEndPointMarkerSize(lineSparklineView);
			SetLineViewNegativePointMarkerSize(lineSparklineView);
			SetLineViewMarkerColor(lineSparklineView);
		}

		{

		private void InitView()
		{
			if (!viewTypeViewBase.TryGetValue(ViewType, out var value))
			{
				value = CreateViewBaseByViewType();
				viewTypeViewBase.Add(ViewType, value);
			}
			sparklineSettings.SetView(value);
		}

		private SparklineViewBase CreateViewBaseByViewType()
		{
			return ViewType switch
			{
				SparklineViewType.Line => new LineSparklineView(), 
				SparklineViewType.Area => new AreaSparklineView(), 
				SparklineViewType.Bar => new BarSparklineView(), 
				SparklineViewType.WinLoss => new WinLossSparklineView(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private Image GetImage()
		{
			Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(0, 0, Width, Height);
			Image image = null;
			if (bounds.Width > 0 && bounds.Height > 0)
			{
				image = new Bitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
				CustomizeCurrentView();
				BaseSparklinePainter painter = paintersCache.GetPainter(View);
				painter.Initialize(sparklineData, sparklineSettings, bounds);
				using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image);
				painter.Draw(graphics, null);
			}
			return image;
		}

		public override CalculatedFieldValue GetCalculatedValueCore(PieceTable sourcePieceTable, MailMergeDataMode mailMergeDataMode, Field documentField)
		{
			//IL_015f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02b9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02d8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02de: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_028c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ce: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0117: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((MergefieldField)this).DataFieldName))
			{
				IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)sourcePieceTable.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
				if (service == null)
				{
					return ((MergefieldField)this).GetCalculatedValueCore(sourcePieceTable, mailMergeDataMode, documentField);
				}
				FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldValueDescriptor = service.GetFieldValueDescriptor((SnapPieceTable)(object)sourcePieceTable, documentField, DataSourceName, new DataSourceNameStringScanner(DataSourceName));
				ICalculationContext calculationContext = service.FieldContextService.BeginCalculation(((SnapDocumentModel)(object)sourcePieceTable.DocumentModel).DataSourceDispatcher);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((MergefieldField)this).DataFieldName) && ((MergefieldField)this).DataFieldName.Contains("."))
				{
					calculationContext.FieldNames = new string[1] { ((MergefieldField)this).DataFieldName };
				}
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				try
				{
					using (IDataEnumerator dataEnumerator = calculationContext.GetChildDataEnumerator(fieldValueDescriptor.ParentDataContext, fieldValueDescriptor.RelativePath))
					{
						if (dataEnumerator != null && !IsSingleValueEnum(dataEnumerator))
						{
							while (dataEnumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								object columnValue = dataEnumerator.GetColumnValue(((MergefieldField)this).DataFieldName);
								if (columnValue != null)
								{
									list.Add(columnValue);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (base.EnableEmptyFieldDataAlias && list.Count == 0)
					{
						return new CalculatedFieldValue((object)base.EmptyFieldDataAlias);
					}
					sparklineData.SetValues(GetList(list));
				}
				finally
				{
					service.FieldContextService.EndCalculation(calculationContext);
				}
			}
			SnapDocumentModel documentModel = ((SnapPieceTable)(object)sourcePieceTable).DocumentModel;
			TextRunBase obj = ((List<TextRunBase, RunIndex>)(object)sourcePieceTable.Runs)[documentField.Result.Start];
			InlinePictureRun val = (InlinePictureRun)(object)((obj is InlinePictureRun) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null && ((InlineObjectRun)val).ActualSize != ((InlineObjectRun)val).OriginalSize)
			{
				Size size = SnapSizeConverter.ModelUnitsToPixels(documentModel, ((InlineObjectRun)val).ActualSize, val.Image.HorizontalResolution);
				if (Width != size.Width || Height != size.Height)
				{
					InstructionController val2 = new InstructionController(documentField, (CalculatedFieldBase)(object)this);
					try
					{
						string value = ((CalculatedFieldBase)this).Switches.GetString(SnSparklineWidthSwitch);
						string value2 = ((CalculatedFieldBase)this).Switches.GetString(SnSparklineHeightSwitch);
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || Width != size.Width)
						{
							Width = size.Width;
							SNSparklineHelper.SaveSwitchValue(val2, SnSparklineWidthSwitch, Width.ToString());
						}
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2) || Height != size.Height)
						{
							Height = size.Height;
							SNSparklineHelper.SaveSwitchValue(val2, SnSparklineHeightSwitch, Height.ToString());
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			Image image = GetImage();
			if (image == null)
			{
				return ((MergefieldField)this).GetCalculatedValueCore(sourcePieceTable, mailMergeDataMode, documentField);
			}
			OfficeImage image2 = OfficeImage.CreateImage(GdiPlusImage.Wrap(image));
			DocumentModel fieldResultModel = sourcePieceTable.DocumentModel.GetFieldResultModel();
			SparklineRun sparklineRun = ((SnapPieceTable)(object)fieldResultModel.MainPieceTable).InsertSparkline(DocumentLogPosition.Zero, image2);
			((InlinePictureRun)sparklineRun).ResizingShadowDisplayMode = (ResizingShadowDisplayMode)1;
			((InlineObjectRun)sparklineRun).LockAspectRatio = false;
			return new CalculatedFieldValue((object)fieldResultModel);
		}

		private bool IsSingleValueEnum(IDataEnumerator enumerator)
		{
			if (enumerator != null)
			{
				return enumerator is SingleValueDataEnumerator;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IList<double> GetList(List<object> values)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			try
			{
				foreach (object value in values)
				{
					double item = Convert.ToDouble(value);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static Base64StringDataContainer FromBase64String(string str)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(str, "str");
			Base64StringDataContainer base64StringDataContainer = new Base64StringDataContainer();
			base64StringDataContainer.SetData(Convert.FromBase64String(str));
			return base64StringDataContainer;
		}

		public Base64StringDataContainer()
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			stream = new ChunkedMemoryStream();
		}

		public void SetData(string str)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
			{
				SetData(Convert.FromBase64String(str));
			}
		}

		public void SetData(byte[] data)
		{
			if (stream != null)
			{
				((Stream)(object)stream).Write(data, 0, data.Length);
				RaisePropertiesChanged(null);
			}
		}

		public byte[] GetData()
		{
			if (stream != null)
			{
				return stream.ToArray();
			}
			return new byte[0];
		}

		private void RaisePropertiesChanged(IDataContainerPropertiesChangedInfo info)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (propertiesChanged != null)
			{
				DataContainerPropertiesChangedEventArgs e = new DataContainerPropertiesChangedEventArgs();
				e.ChangedInfo = info;
				propertiesChanged.Invoke((object)this, e);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			Base64StringDataContainer dataContainer = obj as Base64StringDataContainer;
			return Equals(dataContainer);
		}

		public bool Equals(Base64StringDataContainer dataContainer)
		{
			if (dataContainer == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return stream == dataContainer.stream;
		}

		{

		public bool IsPageBreakSeparator(TemplateInfo separatorTemplateInfo)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (separatorTemplateInfo.TemplateContentType == TemplateContentType.NoTemplate)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (separatorTemplateInfo.ActualInterval.Length != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RunInfo val = ((PieceTable)separatorTemplateInfo.PieceTable).FindRunInfo(separatorTemplateInfo.ActualInterval.Start, separatorTemplateInfo.ActualInterval.Length);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TextRunBase val2 = ((List<TextRunBase, RunIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)separatorTemplateInfo.PieceTable).Runs)[val.Start.RunIndex];
			if (((object)val2).GetType() != typeof(TextRun) || val.Start.RunOffset >= val2.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string textFast = val2.GetTextFast(((PieceTable)separatorTemplateInfo.PieceTable).TextBuffer);
			return textFast[val.Start.RunOffset] == '\f';
		}

		private string GetRelativePath(FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{

				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		{

			}
			else
			{
				calculationContext.FieldNames = fieldNames;
			}
			try
			{

			finally

		}

				num = int.MaxValue;
			}
			string[] fieldsWithParent = GetFieldsWithParent((PieceTable)(object)sourcePieceTable, documentField);
			SNListFieldResultBuilder builder = new SNListFieldResultBuilder(this, num, fieldsWithParent);
			ProcessItems(sourcePieceTable.DocumentModel, fieldDataAccessService.FieldContextService, fieldDataValueDescriptor, num, fieldsWithParent, delegate(IDataEnumerator enumerator)
			{
				builder.ProcessItems(sourcePieceTable, fieldDataValueDescriptor, enumerator);
			});
			return builder.ResultItems;
		}

		private string[] GetFieldsWithParent(PieceTable pieceTable, Field parent)
		{
			List<string> result = new List<string>();
			pieceTable.Fields.ForEach((Action<Field>)delegate(Field field)
			{
				//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if ((field.Parent == parent || (field.Parent != null && field.Parent.DisableUpdate && field.Parent.Parent == parent)) && (parent == null || !(field.FirstRunIndex >= parent.Code.End)))
				{
					SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
					if (((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField(pieceTable, field) is SNMergeFieldBase sNMergeFieldBase)
					{
						result.Add(((MergefieldField)sNMergeFieldBase).DataFieldName);
					}
				}
			});
			return result.ToArray();
		}

		public override void OnRemoveTemplateSwitches(PieceTable pieceTable, InstructionController instructionController, List<string> templateSwitches)
		{
			base.OnRemoveTemplateSwitches(pieceTable, instructionController, templateSwitches);
			if (templateSwitches.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = ProcessGroups(pieceTable, (GroupProperties group) => OnRemoveTemplateSwitch(group, templateSwitches));
			if (fieldPathInfo != null)
			{
				IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
				if (service != null)
				{
					IFieldPathService fieldPathService = service.FieldPathService;
					instructionController.SetArgument(0, fieldPathService.GetStringPath(fieldPathInfo));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OnRemoveTemplateSwitch(GroupProperties group, List<string> templateSwitches)
		{
			if (!group.HasGroupTemplates)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			if (templateSwitches.Contains(group.TemplateHeaderSwitch))
			{
				group.TemplateHeaderSwitch = string.Empty;
				result = true;
			}
			if (templateSwitches.Contains(group.TemplateFooterSwitch))
			{
				group.TemplateFooterSwitch = string.Empty;
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual FieldPathInfo ProcessGroups(PieceTable pieceTable, Func<GroupProperties, bool> groupAction)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			if (service == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IFieldPathService fieldPathService = service.FieldPathService;
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = fieldPathService.FromString(base.DataSourceName);
			List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem> items = fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = items[i];
				if (fieldDataMemberInfoItem.HasGroups)
				{
					List<GroupProperties> groups = fieldDataMemberInfoItem.Groups;
					int count2 = groups.Count;
					for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
					{
						GroupProperties arg = groups[j];
						flag |= groupAction(arg);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return fieldPathInfo;
		}

		public override List<TemplateFieldInterval> GetTemplateIntervals(PieceTable pieceTable)
		{
			List<TemplateFieldInterval> result = new List<TemplateFieldInterval>();
			AddTemplateIntervalIfExists(result, TemplatedFieldBase.TemplateSwitch);
			ProcessGroups(pieceTable, (GroupProperties group) => AppendGroupTemplates(result, group));
			AddTemplateIntervalIfExists(result, ListHeaderTemplateSwitch);
			AddTemplateIntervalIfExists(result, ListFooterTemplateSwitch);
			AddTemplateIntervalIfExists(result, SeparatorTemplateSwitch);
			return result;
		}

		private bool AppendGroupTemplates(List<TemplateFieldInterval> target, GroupProperties group)
		{
			AddTemplateIntervalIfExists(target, group.TemplateFooterSwitch);
			AddTemplateIntervalIfExists(target, group.TemplateHeaderSwitch);
			AddTemplateIntervalIfExists(target, group.TemplateSeparatorSwitch);
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsSwitchWithArgument(string fieldSpecificSwitch)
		{
			string text = fieldSpecificSwitch.ToLower();
			if (text != KeepLastSeparatorSwitchWithPrefix && text != SkipEmptyListOnExportSwitchWithPrefix)
			{
				return text != BottomBorderVisibleWhenNestedSwitchWithPrefix;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsSwitchArgumentField(string fieldSpecificSwitch)
		{
			string text = fieldSpecificSwitch.ToLower();
			if (text != NameSwitchWithPrefix)
			{
				return text != EditorRowLimitSwitchWithPrefix;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool SkipEmptyResultItem(bool modelForExport)
		{
			if (modelForExport)
			{
				return ((CalculatedFieldBase)this).Switches.GetBool(SkipEmptyListOnExportSwitch);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class GroupFooterInfo
	{
		public GroupProperties Properties { get; set; }

		public IFieldContext FieldContext { get; set; }

		public GroupFooterInfo(GroupProperties properties, IFieldContext fieldContext)
		{
			Properties = properties;
			FieldContext = fieldContext;
		}
	}
	public class ItemsIntervalInfo
	{
		private int endGroupIndex;

		public int StartGroupIndex { get; private set; }

		public int GroupPropertiesIndex { get; private set; }

		public int FieldInGroupCount { get; private set; }

		public GroupProperties GroupProperties { get; private set; }

		public int EndGroupIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return endGroupIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < StartGroupIndex)
				{
					Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				}
				endGroupIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public ItemsIntervalInfo(GroupProperties groupProperties, int groupPropertiesIndex, int startGroupIndex, int fieldInGroupCount)
		{
			StartGroupIndex = startGroupIndex;
			GroupProperties = groupProperties;
			GroupPropertiesIndex = groupPropertiesIndex;
			FieldInGroupCount = fieldInGroupCount;
		}
	}
	public class ResultItemInfo
	{
		public TemplateInfo TemplateInfo { get; private set; }

		public IFieldContext DataContext { get; private set; }

		public bool PageBreakBefore { get; private set; }

		public ItemsIntervalInfo IntervalInfo { get; set; }

		public ResultItemInfo(TemplateInfo templateInfo, IFieldContext dataContext, ItemsIntervalInfo intervalInfo, bool pageBreakBefore)
		{
			TemplateInfo = templateInfo;
			DataContext = dataContext;
			IntervalInfo = intervalInfo;
			PageBreakBefore = pageBreakBefore;
		}
	}
	public class ResultItemInfoCollection
	{
		private bool pageBreakBeforeNextTemplate;

		private bool separatorLastItem;

		private List<ResultItemInfo> innerList;

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		public ResultItemInfo this[int index] => innerList[index];

		public ResultItemInfoCollection()
		{
			innerList = new List<ResultItemInfo>();
		}

		public void AddTemplateIfExists(TemplateInfo templateInfo, IFieldContext dataContext)
		{
			AddTemplateIfExists(templateInfo, dataContext, null);
		}

		public bool AddTemplateIfExists(TemplateInfo templateInfo, IFieldContext dataContext, ItemsIntervalInfo intervalInfo)
		{
			if (templateInfo.TemplateContentType == TemplateContentType.NoTemplate)
			{
				return false;
			}
			innerList.Add(new ResultItemInfo(templateInfo, dataContext, intervalInfo, pageBreakBeforeNextTemplate));
			separatorLastItem = false;
			pageBreakBeforeNextTemplate = false;
			return true;
		}

		public void AddSeparatorIfExists(TemplateInfo separatorTemplateInfo, IFieldContext relatedFieldContext, ItemsIntervalInfo intervalInfo)
		{
			if (!separatorTemplateInfo.SeparateAsPageBreakBefore)
			{
				if (AddTemplateIfExists(separatorTemplateInfo, relatedFieldContext, intervalInfo))
				{
					separatorLastItem = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				pageBreakBeforeNextTemplate = true;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveLastSeparatorIfExists()
		{
			if (pageBreakBeforeNextTemplate)
			{
				pageBreakBeforeNextTemplate = false;
			}
			else if (separatorLastItem)
			{
				innerList.RemoveAt(Count - 1);
			}
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum GroupBookmarkKind
	{
		GroupHeader = 1,
		GroupFooter = 2,
		GroupHeaderOrGroupFooter = 3
	}
	public class SNListFieldResultBuilder
	{
		private readonly SNListField owner;

		private readonly ResultItemInfoCollection resultItems = new ResultItemInfoCollection();

		private readonly int maxRecordCount;

		private string[] fieldNames;

		private int progressIndicatorToken;

		private int recordCount;

		private int groupIndex = -1;

		private TemplateInfo itemTemplateInfo;

		private TemplateInfo separatorTemplateInfo;

		private IFieldContext lastRecordFieldContext;

		private ISnapProgressIndicationService progressIndicatorService;

		private List<GroupFooterInfo> groupFooters = new List<GroupFooterInfo>();

		private Stack<ItemsIntervalInfo> groupIntervalInfos = new Stack<ItemsIntervalInfo>();

		public ResultItemInfoCollection ResultItems => resultItems;

		public SNListFieldResultBuilder(SNListField owner, int maxRecordCount, string[] fieldNames)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentPositive(maxRecordCount, "maxRecorCount");
			this.owner = owner;
			this.maxRecordCount = maxRecordCount;
			this.fieldNames = fieldNames;
		}

		public void ProcessItems(SnapPieceTable sourcePieceTable, FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldDataValueDescriptor, IDataEnumerator enumerator)
		{
			progressIndicatorService = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)sourcePieceTable.DocumentModel).GetService<ISnapProgressIndicationService>();
			if (progressIndicatorService != null)
			{
				progressIndicatorToken = progressIndicatorService.Begin("SNListField.GetResultItems", 0, Math.Max(fieldNames.Length, maxRecordCount), 0);
			}
			try
			{
				ProcessItemsCore(sourcePieceTable, fieldDataValueDescriptor, enumerator);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (progressIndicatorService != null)
				{
					progressIndicatorService.End(progressIndicatorToken);
					progressIndicatorService = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ProcessItemsCore(SnapPieceTable sourcePieceTable, FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldDataValueDescriptor, IDataEnumerator enumerator)
		{
			if (enumerator == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TemplateController templateController = new TemplateController(sourcePieceTable);
			PrepareTemplateInfos(templateController);
			while (enumerator.MoveNext() && recordCount < maxRecordCount)
			{
				AppendNextRecord(templateController, fieldDataValueDescriptor, enumerator);
			}
			FixLastSeparator();
			for (int num = groupFooters.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				GroupProperties properties = groupFooters[num].Properties;
				if (properties.HasTemplateFooter && (num <= 0 || !properties.HasTemplateSeparator || properties != groupFooters[num - 1].Properties))
				{
					TemplateInfo templateInfoBySwitch = owner.GetTemplateInfoBySwitch(templateController, properties.TemplateFooterSwitch, SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter);
					IFieldContext fieldContext = groupFooters[num].FieldContext;
					ItemsIntervalInfo groupIntervalInfo = GetGroupIntervalInfo(groupIntervalInfos, properties, resultItems.Count);
					resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(templateInfoBySwitch, fieldContext, groupIntervalInfo);
				}
			}
			if (recordCount == 0)
			{
				CreateProxyItems((DocumentModel)(object)sourcePieceTable.DocumentModel, templateController, fieldDataValueDescriptor, enumerator);
			}
			else
			{
				resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(templateController.GetTemplateInfo(owner.ListFooterTemplateInterval, SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListFooter), lastRecordFieldContext, groupIntervalInfos.Peek());
			}
			Finish();
		}

		private void PrepareTemplateInfos(TemplateController templateController)
		{
			itemTemplateInfo = PrepareTemplateInfo(templateController, owner.TemplateInterval, SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow);
			separatorTemplateInfo = PrepareTemplateInfo(templateController, owner.SeparatorTemplateInterval, SnapTemplateIntervalType.Separator);
			separatorTemplateInfo.SeparateAsPageBreakBefore = ShouldUsePageBreakBefore(separatorTemplateInfo, itemTemplateInfo);
			groupIntervalInfos.Push(new ItemsIntervalInfo(null, -1, resultItems.Count, 0));
		}

		private TemplateInfo PrepareTemplateInfo(TemplateController templateController, DocumentLogInterval interval, SnapTemplateIntervalType type)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TemplateInfo templateInfo = templateController.GetTemplateInfo(interval, type);
			if (templateInfo.TemplateContentType == TemplateContentType.Table)
			{
				ParagraphIndex val = ((PieceTable)templateInfo.PieceTable).FindParagraphIndex(templateInfo.Interval.Start);
				ParagraphIndex val2 = ((PieceTable)templateInfo.PieceTable).FindParagraphIndex(templateInfo.Interval.Start + templateInfo.Interval.Length - 1);
				foreach (Table item in ((PieceTable)templateInfo.PieceTable).FindTablesByRange(templateInfo.Interval.Start, templateInfo.Interval.Length))
				{
					if (item.StartParagraphIndex >= val && item.EndParagraphIndex <= val2)
					{
						item.TableProperties.AvoidDoubleBorders = !owner.BottomBorderVisibleWhenNested;
					}
				}
			}
			return templateInfo;
		}

		private void AppendNextRecord(TemplateController templateController, FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldDataValueDescriptor, IDataEnumerator enumerator)
		{
			if (recordCount == 0)
			{
				IFieldContext dataContext = enumerator.CreateFieldContext();
				resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(templateController.GetTemplateInfo(owner.ListHeaderTemplateInterval, SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListHeader), dataContext, groupIntervalInfos.Peek());
			}
			List<GroupProperties> changedGroupsWithTemplates = enumerator.GetChangedGroupsWithTemplates();
			int num = changedGroupsWithTemplates?.Count ?? 0;
			if (recordCount > 0)
			{
				for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (changedGroupsWithTemplates[num2].HasGroupTemplates)
					{
						ItemsIntervalInfo itemsIntervalInfo = groupIntervalInfos.Pop();
						AddClosedGroupFootersAndSeparators(resultItems, templateController, groupFooters, itemsIntervalInfo, changedGroupsWithTemplates[num2]);
						itemsIntervalInfo.EndGroupIndex = resultItems.Count - 1;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				GroupProperties groupProperties = changedGroupsWithTemplates[i];
				groupIndex = GetGroupIndex(groupProperties, fieldDataValueDescriptor.RelativePath.Items);
				if (groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates)
				{
					groupIntervalInfos.Push(new ItemsIntervalInfo(groupProperties, groupIndex, resultItems.Count, groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos.Count));
				}
				if (groupProperties.HasTemplateHeader)
				{
					TemplateInfo templateInfoBySwitch = owner.GetTemplateInfoBySwitch(templateController, groupProperties.TemplateHeaderSwitch, SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupHeader);
					IFieldContext dataContext2 = enumerator.CreateFieldContext();
					resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(templateInfoBySwitch, dataContext2, groupIntervalInfos.Peek());
				}
				if (groupProperties.HasTemplateFooter)
				{
					groupFooters.Add(new GroupFooterInfo(groupProperties, enumerator.CreateFieldContext()));
				}
				if (groupProperties.HasTemplateSeparator)
				{
					groupFooters.Add(new GroupFooterInfo(groupProperties, enumerator.CreateFieldContext()));
				}
			}
			IFieldContext fieldContext = enumerator.CreateFieldContext();
			resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(itemTemplateInfo, fieldContext, groupIntervalInfos.Peek());
			resultItems.AddSeparatorIfExists(separatorTemplateInfo, fieldContext, groupIntervalInfos.Peek());
			lastRecordFieldContext = fieldContext;
			num = groupFooters.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				groupFooters[j].FieldContext = enumerator.CreateFieldContext();
			}
			recordCount++;
			if (progressIndicatorService != null)
			{
				progressIndicatorService.SetProgress(progressIndicatorToken, recordCount);
			}
		}

		private void FixLastSeparator()
		{
			if (!owner.KeepLastSeparator)
			{
				resultItems.RemoveLastSeparatorIfExists();
			}
			else if (separatorTemplateInfo.SeparateAsPageBreakBefore)
			{
				resultItems.RemoveLastSeparatorIfExists();
				resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(separatorTemplateInfo, lastRecordFieldContext);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldUsePageBreakBefore(TemplateInfo separatorTemplateInfo, TemplateInfo itemTemplateInfo)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!owner.IsPageBreakSeparator(separatorTemplateInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (itemTemplateInfo.TemplateContentType == TemplateContentType.NoTemplate)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RunInfo val = ((PieceTable)itemTemplateInfo.PieceTable).FindRunInfo(itemTemplateInfo.ActualInterval.Start, itemTemplateInfo.ActualInterval.Length);
			TextRunBase obj = ((List<TextRunBase, RunIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)itemTemplateInfo.PieceTable).Runs)[val.End.RunIndex];
			ParagraphRun val2 = (ParagraphRun)(object)((obj is ParagraphRun) ? obj : null);
			return val2 != null;
		}

		private void AddClosedGroupFootersAndSeparators(ResultItemInfoCollection resultItems, TemplateController templateController, List<GroupFooterInfo> groupFooters, ItemsIntervalInfo groupIntervalInfo, GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			int num = groupFooters.Count - 1;
			if (num >= 0 && groupFooters[num].Properties == groupProperties)
			{
				if (groupProperties.HasTemplateFooter)
				{
					AddClosedTemplate(num, resultItems, templateController, groupProperties.TemplateFooterSwitch, SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter, groupFooters, groupIntervalInfo);
				}
				num = groupFooters.Count - 1;
				if (num >= 0 && groupFooters[num].Properties == groupProperties && groupProperties.HasTemplateSeparator)
				{
					AddClosedTemplate(num, resultItems, templateController, groupProperties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch, SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupSeparator, groupFooters, groupIntervalInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddClosedTemplate(int index, ResultItemInfoCollection resultItems, TemplateController templateController, string templateSwitch, SnapTemplateIntervalType templateType, List<GroupFooterInfo> groupFooters, ItemsIntervalInfo groupIntervalInfo)
		{
			TemplateInfo templateInfoBySwitch = owner.GetTemplateInfoBySwitch(templateController, templateSwitch, templateType);
			IFieldContext fieldContext = groupFooters[index].FieldContext;
			if (templateType != SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupSeparator)
			{
				resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(templateInfoBySwitch, fieldContext, groupIntervalInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				resultItems.AddSeparatorIfExists(templateInfoBySwitch, fieldContext, groupIntervalInfo);
			}
			groupFooters.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		private int GetGroupIndex(GroupProperties groupProperties, List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem> list)
		{
			int count = list.Count;
			if (count < 1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (!list[0].HasGroups)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = list[0].Groups.IndexOf(groupProperties);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				num2 += list[0].Groups[i].GroupFieldInfos.Count;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private ItemsIntervalInfo GetGroupIntervalInfo(Stack<ItemsIntervalInfo> groupIntervalInfos, GroupProperties groupProperties, int endGroupIndex)
		{
			ItemsIntervalInfo itemsIntervalInfo;
			do
			{
				itemsIntervalInfo = groupIntervalInfos.Pop();
				itemsIntervalInfo.EndGroupIndex = endGroupIndex;
			}
			while (itemsIntervalInfo.GroupProperties != groupProperties);
			return itemsIntervalInfo;
		}

		private void CreateProxyItems(DocumentModel documentModel, TemplateController templateController, FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldDataValueDescriptor, IDataEnumerator enumerator)
		{
			bool modelForExport = documentModel.ModelForExport;
			if (modelForExport && owner.SkipEmptyListOnExport)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDataControllerListFieldContext listFieldContext = enumerator.GetListFieldContext();
			AddProxyResult(templateController.GetTemplateInfo(owner.ListHeaderTemplateInterval, SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListHeader), fieldDataValueDescriptor, (IServiceProvider)documentModel, groupIntervalInfos.Peek(), listFieldContext);
			if (!modelForExport)
			{
				if (listFieldContext.HasGroups)
				{
					List<GroupProperties> groups = listFieldContext.ListParameters.Groups;
					int count = groups.Count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						GroupProperties groupProperties = groups[i];
						groupIndex = GetGroupIndex(groupProperties, fieldDataValueDescriptor.RelativePath.Items);
						if (groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates)
						{
							groupIntervalInfos.Push(new ItemsIntervalInfo(groupProperties, groupIndex, resultItems.Count, groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos.Count));
						}
						if (groupProperties.HasTemplateHeader)
						{
							TemplateInfo templateInfoBySwitch = owner.GetTemplateInfoBySwitch(templateController, groupProperties.TemplateHeaderSwitch, SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupHeader);
							AddProxyResult(templateInfoBySwitch, fieldDataValueDescriptor, (IServiceProvider)documentModel, groupIntervalInfos.Peek(), listFieldContext);
						}
						if (groupProperties.HasTemplateFooter)
						{
							groupFooters.Add(new GroupFooterInfo(groupProperties, enumerator.CreateFieldContext()));
						}
						if (groupProperties.HasTemplateSeparator)
						{
							groupFooters.Add(new GroupFooterInfo(groupProperties, enumerator.CreateFieldContext()));
						}
					}
				}
				AddProxyResult(itemTemplateInfo, fieldDataValueDescriptor, (IServiceProvider)documentModel, groupIntervalInfos.Peek(), listFieldContext);
				AddProxyResult(separatorTemplateInfo, fieldDataValueDescriptor, (IServiceProvider)documentModel, groupIntervalInfos.Peek(), listFieldContext);
				for (int num = groupFooters.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					GroupProperties properties = groupFooters[num].Properties;
					if (properties.HasTemplateFooter && (num <= 0 || !properties.HasTemplateSeparator || properties != groupFooters[num - 1].Properties))
					{
						TemplateInfo templateInfoBySwitch2 = owner.GetTemplateInfoBySwitch(templateController, properties.TemplateFooterSwitch, SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter);
						ItemsIntervalInfo groupIntervalInfo = GetGroupIntervalInfo(groupIntervalInfos, properties, resultItems.Count);
						AddProxyResult(templateInfoBySwitch2, fieldDataValueDescriptor, (IServiceProvider)documentModel, groupIntervalInfo, listFieldContext);
					}
				}
			}
			AddProxyResult(templateController.GetTemplateInfo(owner.ListFooterTemplateInterval, SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListFooter), fieldDataValueDescriptor, (IServiceProvider)documentModel, groupIntervalInfos.Peek(), listFieldContext);
		}

		private void AddProxyResult(TemplateInfo itemTemplateInfo, FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldDataValueDescriptor, IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ItemsIntervalInfo intervalInfo, IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext)
		{
			IFieldContext parentDataContext = fieldDataValueDescriptor.ParentDataContext;
			FieldPathDataMemberInfo relativePath = fieldDataValueDescriptor.RelativePath;
			if (parentDataContext != null || relativePath != null)
			{
				string fieldPath = string.Empty;
				if (relativePath != null && relativePath.LastItem != null)
				{
					fieldPath = relativePath.LastItem.FieldName;
				}
				resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(itemTemplateInfo, new ProxyFieldContext(fieldPath, listContext), intervalInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				resultItems.AddTemplateIfExists(itemTemplateInfo, new EmptyFieldContext(), intervalInfo);
			}
		}

		private void Finish()
		{
			if (resultItems.Count != 0)
			{
				while (groupIntervalInfos.Count > 0)
				{
					ItemsIntervalInfo itemsIntervalInfo = groupIntervalInfos.Pop();
					itemsIntervalInfo.EndGroupIndex = resultItems.Count - 1;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DisplayObjectField : TemplatedFieldBase
	{
		public static readonly string FieldType = "DISPLAYOBJECT";

		protected override string FieldTypeName => FieldType;

		public static CalculatedFieldBase Create()
		{
			return (CalculatedFieldBase)(object)new DisplayObjectField();
		}

		protected override ResultItemInfoCollection GetResultItems(SnapPieceTable sourcePieceTable, IFieldDataAccessService fieldDataAccessService, FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldDataValueDescriptor, bool modelForExport, Field documentField)
		{

		private OfficeImage TileImage(OfficeImage source, Size actualSizeInTwips)
		{
			Bitmap image = CreateBitmap(source, actualSizeInTwips);
			using (Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image))
			{
				using TextureBrush textureBrush = new TextureBrush(source.NativeImage, WrapMode.Tile);
				textureBrush.ScaleTransform(graphics.DpiX / source.HorizontalResolution, graphics.DpiY / source.VerticalResolution);
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, actualSizeInTwips);
				graphics.FillRectangle(textureBrush, rect);
			}
			return OfficeImage.CreateImage(GdiPlusImage.Wrap(image));
		}

		private Bitmap CreateBitmap(OfficeImage source, Size actualSizeInTwips)
		{
			float resolution = source.GetResolution();
			Size size = Units.TwipsToPixels(actualSizeInTwips, resolution, resolution);
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(size.Width, size.Height);
			bitmap.SetResolution(resolution, resolution);
			return bitmap;
		}

		private void SetSizingProperties(InlinePictureRun run, OfficeImage sourceOfficeImage, Size actualSize)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
			case 6:
				((InlineObjectRunBase<InlinePictureInfo>)(object)run).SetActualUncroppedSizeInternal(actualSize);
				break;
			case 0:
				SetNormalSizingProperties(run, sizeInTwips, actualSize);
				break;
			case 3:
				SetCroppedSizingProperties(run, sizeInTwips, actualSize);
				break;
			case 5:
				if (actualSize.Height > sizeInTwips.Height && actualSize.Width > sizeInTwips.Width)

					SetCroppedSizingProperties(run, sizeInTwips, actualSize);
				}
				else
				{
					SetScaledCroppedSizingProperties(run, sizeInTwips, actualSize);
				}
				break;
			case 4:
			case 7:
				SetScaledCroppedSizingProperties(run, sizeInTwips, actualSize);
				break;
			default:
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetNormalSizingProperties(InlinePictureRun run, Size imageSize, Size actualSize)

		private int GetHorizontalCrop(Size actualSize, Size imageSize)
		{
			return 100000 - MathUtils.MulDivRoundChecked(actualSize.Width, 100000, imageSize.Width);
		}

		private int GetVerticalCrop(Size actualSize, Size imageSize)
		{
			return 100000 - MathUtils.MulDivRoundChecked(actualSize.Height, 100000, imageSize.Height);
		}

		private int GetHalfHorizontalCrop(Size actualSize, Size imageSize)
		{

		}

		private int GetHalfVerticalCrop(Size actualSize, Size imageSize)
		{
			return 50000 - MathUtils.MulDivRoundChecked(actualSize.Height, 50000, imageSize.Height);
		}

		private void UpdateRunSize(InlinePictureRun run)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			run.Sizing = Sizing;
			if ((int)Sizing == 2)
			{
				ScalableObjectUtils.UpdateScale((IRectangularScalableObject)(object)run, 1f, 1f);
				return;
			}
			if (UpdateMode == UpdateMergeImageFieldMode.KeepScale)
			{
				float num = (float)((CalculatedFieldBase)this).Switches.GetInt(ScaleXSwitch) / 10000f;
				if ((double)num != 0.0)
				{
					ScalableObjectUtils.UpdateScaleX((IRectangularScalableObject)(object)run, num);
				}
				float num2 = (float)((CalculatedFieldBase)this).Switches.GetInt(ScaleYSwitch) / 10000f;
				if ((double)num2 != 0.0)
				{
					ScalableObjectUtils.UpdateScaleY((IRectangularScalableObject)(object)run, num2);
				}
				return;
			}
			int num3 = ((CalculatedFieldBase)this).Switches.GetInt(WidthSwitch);
			if (num3 == 0)
			{
				num3 = ((InlineObjectRun)run).ActualSize.Width;
			}
			int num4 = ((CalculatedFieldBase)this).Switches.GetInt(HeightSwitch);
			if (num4 == 0)
			{
				num4 = ((InlineObjectRun)run).ActualSize.Height;
			}
			((InlineObjectRun)run).ActualSize = new Size(num3, num4);
		}

		private OfficeImage TryCreateImage(object rawValue)
		{
			if (rawValue is Image image)
			{
				return OfficeImage.CreateImage(GdiPlusImage.Wrap(image));
			}
			if (rawValue is byte[] buffer)
			{
				DXImage dXImage = DXImageHelper.ImageFromBytes(buffer);
				if (dXImage != null)
				{
					return OfficeImage.CreateImage(dXImage);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetNativeSwithes()
		{
			return new string[8]
			{
				ImageSizeModeSwitch,
				UpdateModeSwitch,
				ScaleXSwitch,
				ScaleYSwitch,
				HeightSwitch,
				WidthSwitch,
				SNMergeFieldSupportsEmptyFieldDataAlias.EmptyFieldDataAliasSwitch,
				SNMergeFieldSupportsEmptyFieldDataAlias.EnableEmptyFieldDataAliasSwitch
			};
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetInvariableSwitches()
		{
			return new string[2]
			{

				SNMergeFieldSupportsEmptyFieldDataAlias.EnableEmptyFieldDataAliasSwitch

			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
			CalculatedFieldBase obj = ((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)source, field);
			IDataFieldNameOwner val = (IDataFieldNameOwner)(object)((obj is IDataFieldNameOwner) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)

				return true;
			}
			if (field.Parent != null)
			{
				CalculatedFieldBase obj2 = ((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)source, field.Parent);
				IDataFieldNameOwner val2 = (IDataFieldNameOwner)(object)((obj2 is IDataFieldNameOwner) ? obj2 : null);

	public abstract class SizeAndScaleFieldController
	{
		public abstract bool IsReady { get; }

		public static SizeAndScaleFieldController Create(CalculatedFieldBase field, InstructionController controller)
		{
			if (field is SNImageField)
			{
				return new SNImageFieldController(controller);
			}
			if (field is SNBarCodeField)
			{
				return new SNBarCodeFieldController(controller);
			}
			if (field is SNChartField)
			{
				return new SNChartFieldController(controller);
			}
			if (field is SNSparklineField)
			{
				return new SNSparklineFieldController(controller);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public abstract void SetImageSizeInfo();
	}
	public abstract class SizeAndScaleFieldController<TField> : SizeAndScaleFieldController where TField : MergefieldField
	{
		private readonly InstructionController controller;

		private readonly IRectangularObject rectangularObject;

		protected InstructionController Controller => controller;

		public override bool IsReady => rectangularObject != null;

		protected SizeAndScaleFieldController(InstructionController controller, IRectangularObject rectangularObject)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)controller, "controller");
			this.controller = controller;
			this.rectangularObject = rectangularObject;
		}

		protected TField GetField()
		{
			return (TField)(object)controller.ParsedInfo;
		}

		public override void SetImageSizeInfo()
		{
			controller.SuppressFieldsUpdateAfterUpdateInstruction = true;
			SetImageSizeInfoCore();
			controller.ApplyDeferredActions();
		}

		protected abstract void SetImageSizeInfoCore();

		protected void ClearSize()
		{
			controller.RemoveSwitch("h");
			controller.RemoveSwitch("w");
		}

		protected void SetSize()
		{
			controller.SetSwitch("w", rectangularObject.ActualSize.Width.ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo));
			controller.SetSwitch("h", rectangularObject.ActualSize.Height.ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo));
		}

		protected void ClearScale()
		{
			controller.RemoveSwitch("sx");
			controller.RemoveSwitch("sy");
		}

		protected void SetScale()
		{
			IRectangularObject obj = rectangularObject;
			IRectangularScalableObject val = (IRectangularScalableObject)(object)((obj is IRectangularScalableObject) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				SizeF sizeF = ScalableObjectUtils.CalculateScale(val);
				controller.SetSwitch("sx", Math.Round(sizeF.Width * 10000f).ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo));
				controller.SetSwitch("sy", Math.Round(sizeF.Height * 10000f).ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo));
			}
		}
	}

			else if (obj.Value >= obj.MaxValue)

				obj.Value = obj.MaxValue;
			}
			else
			{
				obj.Value++;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public static MailMergeCurrentRecordCommandValue operator --(MailMergeCurrentRecordCommandValue obj)
		{
			if (obj.MaxValue < 1)
			{
				obj.Value = 0;
			}
			else if (obj.Value <= 1)
			{
				obj.Value = 1;
			}
			else if (obj.Value > obj.MaxValue)
			{
				obj.Value = obj.MaxValue;
			}
			else
			{
				obj.Value--;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public static MailMergeCurrentRecordCommandValue operator +(MailMergeCurrentRecordCommandValue obj, int n)
		{
			int num = obj.Value + n;
			if (num < 1)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			if (num > obj.MaxValue)
			{
				num = obj.MaxValue;
			}
			return new MailMergeCurrentRecordCommandValue(num, obj.options);
		}

		public static MailMergeCurrentRecordCommandValue operator -(MailMergeCurrentRecordCommandValue obj, int n)
		{
			return obj + -n;
		}

	public class SnapSelectionRangesValidator
	{
		private readonly SnapPieceTable pieceTable;

		public SnapPieceTable PieceTable => pieceTable;

		public SnapSelectionRangesValidator(SnapPieceTable pieceTable)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pieceTable, "pieceTable");
			this.pieceTable = pieceTable;
		}

		public bool ValidateSelectionRanges(SelectionRangeCollection sorted)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController(PieceTable);
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = null;
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark2 = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((List<SelectionRange>)(object)sorted).Count; i++)
			{
				SelectionRange val = ((List<SelectionRange>)(object)sorted)[i];
				SnapBookmark snapBookmark3 = snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByPosition(val.Start);
				SnapBookmark snapBookmark4 = snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByPosition(val.End);
				if (snapBookmark3 != snapBookmark4)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((snapBookmark3 != snapBookmark || snapBookmark4 != snapBookmark2) && i > 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (snapBookmark3 != null)
				{
					int num = Math.Max(1, Math.Abs(val.Length));
					if (num >= ((DocumentInterval)snapBookmark3).Length)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				snapBookmark = snapBookmark3;
				snapBookmark2 = snapBookmark4;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public abstract class FinishAndMergeCommandBase : SnapMenuItemSimpleCommand
	{
		private MailMergeCrossThreadHelper crossThreadHelper;

		protected virtual MailMergeCrossThreadHelper CrossThreadHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (crossThreadHelper == null)
				{
					crossThreadHelper = new MailMergeCrossThreadHelper(((ControlCommand<IRichEditControl, RichEditCommandId, XtraRichEditStringId>)(object)this).Control);
					crossThreadHelper.ApplyMailMergeResultAction = ApplyMailMergeResultAction;
				}
				return crossThreadHelper;
			}
		}

		protected FinishAndMergeCommandBase(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ApplyCommandsRestriction(ICommandUIState state, DocumentCapability option)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.ApplyCommandsRestriction(state, option);
			state.Enabled = state.Enabled && IsMailMergeAvailable();
		}

		protected override bool CheckIsContentEditable()
		{
			return ((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)(object)this).DocumentServer.Enabled;
		}

		private bool IsMailMergeAvailable()
		{
			if (base.DocumentModel.SnapMailMergeVisualOptions.IsMailMergeEnabled)
			{
				return !base.DocumentModel.AsynchronousOperationPerforming;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (base.DocumentModel.AsynchronousOperationPerforming)
			{
				SnapExceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(SnapStringId.Msg_CannotPerformAsynchronousOperation);
			}
			SnapMailMergeExportOptions snapMailMergeExportOptions = ((SnapDocument)((ControlCommand<IRichEditControl, RichEditCommandId, XtraRichEditStringId>)(object)this).Control.Document).CreateSnapMailMergeExportOptions();
			if (snapMailMergeExportOptions.DataSourceName != null)
			{
				((ISnapControl)((ControlCommand<IRichEditControl, RichEditCommandId, XtraRichEditStringId>)(object)this).Control).ShowMailMergeExportOptionsForm(snapMailMergeExportOptions, ShowMailMergeExportOptionsFormCallback, null);
			}
		}

		protected internal void ShowMailMergeExportOptionsFormCallback(SnapMailMergeExportOptions properties, object callbackData)
		{
			CrossThreadHelper.ShowMailMergeExportOptionsForm(properties);
		}

		protected void ExecuteCommandFromBackgroundThread(MailMergeData data)
		{
			CrossThreadHelper.ExecuteCommandFromBackgroundThread(data);
		}

		protected abstract void ApplyMailMergeResultAction();
	}
	public class MailMergeData
	{
		private byte[] documentBytes;

		private SnapMailMergeExportOptions options;

		public byte[] DocumentBytes => documentBytes;

		public SnapMailMergeExportOptions Options => options;

		public MailMergeData(byte[] documentBytes, SnapMailMergeExportOptions options)
		{
			this.documentBytes = documentBytes;
			this.options = options;
		}

	public class MailMergeCrossThreadHelper
	{
		private IRichEditControl control;

		private Action applyMailMergeResultAction;

		protected InnerRichEditControl InnerControl => Control.InnerControl;

		protected IRichEditControl Control => control;

		protected InnerRichEditDocumentServer DocumentServer => Control.InnerDocumentServer;

		protected SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)DocumentServer.DocumentModel;

		public Action ApplyMailMergeResultAction
		{
			get
			{
				return applyMailMergeResultAction;
			}
			set
			{
				applyMailMergeResultAction = value;
			}
		}

		public MailMergeCrossThreadHelper(IRichEditControl control)
		{
			this.control = control;
		}

		public void ShowMailMergeExportOptionsForm(SnapMailMergeExportOptions properties)
		{
			ParameterizedThreadStart start = delegate(object obj)
			{
				ExecuteCommandFromBackgroundThread((MailMergeData)obj);
			};
			Thread thread = new Thread(start);
			thread.IsBackground = true;
			if (Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId == ((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)InnerControl).ThreadId)
			{
				thread.CurrentCulture = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture;
				thread.CurrentUICulture = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture;
			}
			thread.Priority = ThreadPriority.Lowest;
			DocumentModel.RaiseAsynchronousOperationStarted();
			thread.Start(CalculateParameter(properties));
			AfterBackgroundThreadStart();
		}

		public void ExecuteCommandFromBackgroundThread(MailMergeData data)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(data.DocumentBytes);
			InternalSnapDocumentServer internalSnapDocumentServer = new InternalSnapDocumentServer(((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).DocumentFormatsDependencies);
			((FieldOptions)internalSnapDocumentServer.DocumentModel.FieldOptions).CopyFrom((FieldOptions)(object)DocumentModel.FieldOptions);
			SubscribeServerEvents(internalSnapDocumentServer);
			try
			{
				((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)internalSnapDocumentServer).LoadDocument((Stream)memoryStream, SnapDocumentFormat.Snap);
				((DocumentModel)internalSnapDocumentServer.DocumentModel).InheritDataServices((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
				SnapDocumentModel targetDocumentModel = GetTargetDocumentModel(internalSnapDocumentServer, DocumentModel);
				try
				{
					BeforeSnapMailMerge(targetDocumentModel);
					bool mailMergeSuccess = SnapMailMerge(internalSnapDocumentServer, data, targetDocumentModel);
					if (IsSnapMailMergeSuccess(mailMergeSuccess))
					{
						DoIfMailMergeSuccess(targetDocumentModel);
					}
					else
					{
						DoIfMailMergeFailure();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					AfterSnapMailMerge(targetDocumentModel);
				}
				DocumentModel.RaiseAsynchronousOperationFinished();
				Action method = delegate
				{
					((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)InnerControl).OnUpdateUI();
				};
				((ISnapInnerControlOwner)Control).BeginInvokeMethod(method);
			}
			finally
			{
				UnsubscribeServerEvents(internalSnapDocumentServer);
				((InternalRichEditDocumentServer)internalSnapDocumentServer).Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool SnapMailMerge(InternalSnapDocumentServer server, MailMergeData data, SnapDocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			if (data.Options.ProgressIndicationFormVisible)
			{
				return server.InnerServer.SnapMailMerge(data.Options, targetModel, (IProgressIndicationService)(object)new SnapMailMergeProgressIndication((IServiceProvider)DocumentModel));
			}
			return server.InnerServer.SnapMailMerge(data.Options, targetModel);
		}

		protected virtual object CalculateParameter(SnapMailMergeExportOptions properties)
		{
			return new MailMergeData(GetDocumentBytes(DocumentModel), properties);
		}

		private byte[] GetDocumentBytes(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).SaveDocument((Stream)memoryStream, SnapDocumentFormat.Snap, string.Empty);
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		protected virtual void AfterBackgroundThreadStart()
		{
		}

		protected virtual SnapDocumentModel GetTargetDocumentModel(InternalSnapDocumentServer server, SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((DocumentModel)server.DocumentModel).CreateNew();
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).ModelForExport = true;
			((FieldOptions)snapDocumentModel.FieldOptions).CopyFrom((FieldOptions)(object)documentModel.FieldOptions);
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).DocumentExportOptions.CopyFrom(((DocumentModel)documentModel).DocumentExportOptions);
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).DocumentImportOptions.CopyFrom(((DocumentModel)documentModel).DocumentImportOptions);
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).PrintingOptions.CopyFrom(((DocumentModel)documentModel).PrintingOptions, false);
			return snapDocumentModel;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSnapMailMergeSuccess(bool mailMergeSuccess)
		{
			return mailMergeSuccess;
		}

		protected virtual void DoIfMailMergeSuccess(SnapDocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			Action method = delegate
			{
				DocumentModel.CreateModelForExportFunction = () => targetModel;
				ApplyMailMergeResultAction();
				DocumentModel.CreateModelForExportFunction = null;
			};
			((ISnapInnerControlOwner)Control).BeginInvokeMethod(method);
		}

		protected virtual void DoIfMailMergeFailure()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeSnapMailMerge(SnapDocumentModel targetModel)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void AfterSnapMailMerge(SnapDocumentModel targetModel)
		{
		}

		protected void SubscribeServerEvents(InternalSnapDocumentServer mailMergeServer)
		{
			InnerSnapControl innerSnapControl = (InnerSnapControl)(object)InnerControl;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeStarted += innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeStarted;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeRecordStarted += innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeRecordStarted;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeRecordFinished += innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeRecordFinished;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeFinished += innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeFinished;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanging += innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanging;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanged += innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanged;
		}

		protected void UnsubscribeServerEvents(InternalSnapDocumentServer mailMergeServer)
		{
			InnerSnapControl innerSnapControl = (InnerSnapControl)(object)InnerControl;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeStarted -= innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeStarted;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeRecordStarted -= innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeRecordStarted;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeRecordFinished -= innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeRecordFinished;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeFinished -= innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeFinished;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanging -= innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanging;
			mailMergeServer.SnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanged -= innerSnapControl.OnSnapMailMergeActiveRecordChanged;
		}
	}

		private bool IsChartSelected()
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).DocumentModel;
			if (((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).Selection.Length > 0)

		}

	[CommandLocalization(SnapStringId.FilterFieldCommand_MenuCaption, SnapStringId.FilterFieldCommand_Description)]
	public class FilterFieldPlaceHolderCommand : DropDownCommandBase
	{
		public override RichEditCommandId Id => SnapCommandId.FilterFieldPlaceHolder;

		public override string ImageName => "QuickFilter";

		public FilterFieldPlaceHolderCommand(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		public override RichEditCommandId[] GetChildCommandIds()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return (RichEditCommandId[])(object)new RichEditCommandId[1] { SnapCommandId.SnapFilterField };
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabled()
		{
			if (!IsInDetailList())
			{
				return base.IsEnabled();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsInDetailList()
		{
			ListFieldSelectionController listFieldSelectionController = new ListFieldSelectionController(base.DocumentModel);
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = listFieldSelectionController.FindDataField();
			if (snapFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
			IFieldPathService fieldPathService = GetFieldPathService();
			if (fieldPathService == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Field parentSNList = GetParentSNList((PieceTable)(object)snapFieldInfo.PieceTable, snapFieldInfo.Field);
			if (parentSNList != null && HasParentSnListField((PieceTable)(object)snapFieldInfo.PieceTable, parentSNList))
			{
				SNListField sNListField = ((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)snapFieldInfo.PieceTable, parentSNList) as SNListField;
				FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = fieldPathService.FromString(sNListField.DataSourceName);
				if (fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo.FieldDataSourceType == FieldDataSourceType.Relative)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IFieldPathService GetFieldPathService()
		{
			return ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>()?.FieldPathService;
		}

		private bool HasParentSnListField(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field)
		{
			return GetParentSNList(pieceTable, field) != null;
		}

		private Field GetParentSNList(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field)
		{
			SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
			while (field.Parent != null)
			{
				Field parent = field.Parent;
				if (((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField(pieceTable, parent) is SNListField)
				{
					return parent;
				}
				field = field.Parent;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		public List<GroupField> GroupFields

				//IL_00b7: Expected O, but got Unknown

				}
				return list;
			}
