		public GroupFieldsCollectionCommand(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
			dataSourceCollectionProvider = new DataSourceCollectionProvider();
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabled()
		{
			if (base.EditedFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return SnapObjectModelController.IsBookmarkCorrespondsToGroup(base.Bookmark);
		}

		protected internal override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			GroupIndex = base.EditedFieldInfo.ParsedInfo.GetGroupIndex(base.EditedFieldInfo.PieceTable.DocumentModel, base.Bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.FirstGroupIndex);
			fieldChanger = new FieldChanger(base.EditedFieldInfo, new SNListFieldProvider(base.EditedFieldInfo.ParsedInfo));
			((ISnapControl)((ControlCommand<IRichEditControl, RichEditCommandId, XtraRichEditStringId>)(object)this).Control).ShowGroupFieldsForm(this, this);
		}

		public object GetService(Type serviceType)
		{
			if (serviceType == typeof(IFieldChanger))
			{
				return fieldChanger;
			}
			if (serviceType == typeof(IDataSourceCollectionProvider))
			{
				return dataSourceCollectionProvider;
			}
			if (serviceType == typeof(SnapListFieldInfo))
			{
				return base.EditedFieldInfo;
			}
			if (serviceType == typeof(IFieldPathService))
			{
				return base.FieldPathService;
			}
			object platformService = ((ISnapControl)((ControlCommand<IRichEditControl, RichEditCommandId, XtraRichEditStringId>)(object)this).Control).GetPlatformService(serviceType);
			if (platformService != null)
			{
				return platformService;
			}
			return ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).GetService(serviceType);
		}
	}

	public class SeparatorTemplateComparer
	{
		private readonly SnapObjectModelController controller;

		protected SnapObjectModelController Controller => controller;

		public SeparatorTemplateComparer(SnapPieceTable pieceTable)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pieceTable, "pieceTable");
			controller = new SnapObjectModelController(pieceTable);
		}

		public bool IsPageBreak(DocumentLogInterval interval)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (interval.Length == 1)
			{
				return controller.GetRunPlainText(interval.Start)[0] == '\f';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsEmptyParagraph(DocumentLogInterval interval)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (interval.Length != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TextRunBase obj = Controller.FindRunByLogPosition(interval.Start);
			ParagraphRun val = (ParagraphRun)(object)((obj is ParagraphRun) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return !((TextRunBase)val).Paragraph.IsInCell();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsEmptyRow(DocumentLogInterval interval)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (interval.Length != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TextRunBase obj = Controller.FindRunByLogPosition(interval.Start);
			ParagraphRun val = (ParagraphRun)(object)((obj is ParagraphRun) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Paragraph paragraph = ((TextRunBase)val).Paragraph;
			ParagraphIndex index = paragraph.Index;
			TableCell cell = paragraph.GetCell();
			if (cell != null && cell.StartParagraphIndex == index)
			{
				return cell.EndParagraphIndex == index;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsSectionBreak(DocumentLogInterval interval, SectionStartType startType)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (interval.Length != 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentLogPosition start = interval.Start;
			TextRunBase obj = Controller.FindRunByLogPosition(start);
			SectionRun val = (SectionRun)(object)((obj is SectionRun) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null || Controller.GetSectionByRun((TextRunBase)(object)val).GeneralSettings.StartType != startType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Controller.FindRunByLogPosition(start + 1) is ParagraphRun;
		}
	}
	public class SeparatorTemplateExecutor
	{
		public void InsertPageBreakSeparator(PieceTable target)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = new string('\f', 1);
			target.InsertText(DocumentLogPosition.Zero, text);
		}

		public void InsertEmptyParagraphSeparator(PieceTable target)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			target.InsertParagraph(DocumentLogPosition.Zero);
			target.InsertParagraph(DocumentLogPosition.Zero);
		}

		public void InsertSectionSeparator(PieceTable pieceTable, SectionStartType startType)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			pieceTable.InsertParagraph(DocumentLogPosition.Zero);
			pieceTable.DocumentModel.InsertSection(DocumentLogPosition.Zero);
			((List<Section, SectionIndex>)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel.Sections)[new SectionIndex(0)].GeneralSettings.StartType = startType;
			pieceTable.InsertParagraph(DocumentLogPosition.Zero);
		}
	}

	public abstract class InsertGroupSeparatorCommandBase : InsertGroupTemplateCommandBase
	{
		protected override GroupModifyType GroupType => GroupModifyType.InsertGroupSeparator;

		protected InsertGroupSeparatorCommandBase(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateUIStateCoreInternal(ICommandUIState state)
		{
			state.Enabled = IsEnabled();
			if (state.Enabled)
			{
				state.Checked = IsChecked();
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabled()
		{
			if (base.EditedFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return SnapObjectModelController.IsBookmarkCorrespondsToGroup(base.Bookmark);
		}

		protected override bool IsChecked()
		{
			InstructionController val = base.EditedFieldInfo.CreateFieldInstructionController();
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PrepareFieldPathInfo(val);
			GroupProperties editedGroupProperties = GetEditedGroupProperties();
			return CheckGroupSeparatorTemplate(val, editedGroupProperties);
		}

		protected virtual bool CheckGroupSeparatorTemplate(InstructionController controller, GroupProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties == null || !properties.HasTemplateSeparator)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentLogInterval switchArgumentDocumentInterval = controller.Instructions.GetSwitchArgumentDocumentInterval(properties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch);
			if (switchArgumentDocumentInterval == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)(object)this).ActivePieceTable;
			DocumentLogInterval actualTemplateInterval = new TemplateController(pieceTable).GetActualTemplateInterval(switchArgumentDocumentInterval);
			return CompareWithTemplate(actualTemplateInterval, new SeparatorTemplateComparer(pieceTable));
		}

		protected virtual bool CompareWithTemplate(DocumentLogInterval interval, SeparatorTemplateComparer comparer)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateFieldCode(InstructionController controller)
		{
			BeginUpdate(controller);
			try
			{
				UpdateFieldCodeCore(controller);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(controller);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateFieldCodeCore(InstructionController controller)
		{
			DocumentModel groupTemplate = CreateGroupTemplate(controller, GroupType);
			ProcessGroups(controller, groupTemplate);
		}

		private void ProcessGroups(InstructionController controller, DocumentModel groupTemplate)
		{
			GroupProperties editedGroupProperties = GetEditedGroupProperties();
			SetGroupSeparator(controller, editedGroupProperties, groupTemplate);
		}

		private GroupProperties GetEditedGroupProperties()
		{
			FieldDataMemberInfoItem lastItem = base.FieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem;
			string templateSwitch = SnapBookmarksHelper.GetTemplateSwitch(base.EditedFieldInfo.ParsedInfo, base.Bookmark);
			int count = lastItem.Groups.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				GroupProperties groupProperties = lastItem.Groups[i];
				if (groupProperties.TemplateHeaderSwitch == templateSwitch || groupProperties.TemplateFooterSwitch == templateSwitch || groupProperties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch == templateSwitch)
				{
					return groupProperties;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void SetGroupSeparator(InstructionController controller, GroupProperties properties, DocumentModel groupTemplate)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(properties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch))
			{
				properties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch = controller.GetNonUsedSwitch();
			}
			controller.SetSwitch(properties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch, groupTemplate);
		}

		protected override void ProcessGroups<T>(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item, ModifyGroupPropertiesAction<T> modifyAction, T modifyInfo)
		{
		}
	}

				return false;

			}
		}

	[CommandLocalization(SnapStringId.InsertPageBreakGroupSeparatorCommand_MenuCaption, SnapStringId.InsertPageBreakGroupSeparatorCommand_Description)]
	public class InsertPageBreakGroupSeparatorCommand : InsertGroupSeparatorCommandBase

		protected internal override bool CanDeleteTableColumns()

			((DeleteTableColumnsCommand)this).PerformModifyModelCore(selectedCellsCollection);

		{
		}

		private void CalculateModifiedCells(SelectedCellsCollection selectedCells)
		{
			TableRowCollection rows = selectedCells.NormalizedFirst.Table.Rows;
			ColumnIndexesInfo columnIndexesInfo = TableCommandsHelper.CalculateSelectedColumnIndexes(selectedCells);
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				CalculateModifiedCellsCore(rows, columnIndexesInfo.StartColumnIndex, columnIndexesInfo.EndColumnIndex);
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void CalculateModifiedCellsCore(TableRowCollection rows, int start, int end)
		{
			modifiedCells = new List<TableCell>();
			SnapObjectModelController snapObjectModelController = new SnapObjectModelController((SnapPieceTable)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).ActivePieceTable);
			SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController((SnapPieceTable)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).ActivePieceTable);
			int count = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)rows).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				TableRow val = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)rows)[i];
				int j = start;
				bool flag = false;
				TableCell cellByColumnIndex;
				for (; j <= end; j += cellByColumnIndex.ColumnSpan)
				{
					cellByColumnIndex = TableCellVerticalBorderCalculator.GetCellByColumnIndex(val, j);
					if (cellByColumnIndex == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (snapObjectModelController.GetFirstCellRun(cellByColumnIndex) is SeparatorTextRun)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					TableCell cellByColumnIndex2 = TableCellVerticalBorderCalculator.GetCellByColumnIndex(val, end);
					if (cellByColumnIndex2 != null && !snapBookmarkController.IsTableCellLastInTemplateBookmark(cellByColumnIndex2))
					{
						modifiedCells.Add(cellByColumnIndex2.Next);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	{
		public SnapDeleteTableRowsCommand(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{

		protected internal override void PerformModifyModelCore(List<TableRow> selectedRows)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<TableCell> cells = CalculateModifiedCells(selectedRows);
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).DocumentModel;
			SnapCaretPosition snapCaretPositionFromSelection = snapDocumentModel.SelectionInfo.GetSnapCaretPositionFromSelection(((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).Selection.PieceTable, ((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).Selection.NormalizedStart);
			((DeleteTableRowsCommand)this).PerformModifyModelCore(selectedRows);

			((SnapPieceTable)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).ActivePieceTable).UpdateTemplate(clearUnusedSwitches: false);
			if (snapCaretPositionFromSelection != null)
			{
				snapDocumentModel.SelectionInfo.RestoreCaretPosition(snapCaretPositionFromSelection);
			}
		}

		private List<TableCell> CalculateModifiedCells(List<TableRow> selectedRows)
		{
			List<TableCell> list = new List<TableCell>();
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SnapBookmark snapBookmark = null;
				int num = int.MinValue;
				bool flag = false;
				int count = selectedRows.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					TableRow val = selectedRows[i];
					SnapObjectModelController snapObjectModelController = new SnapObjectModelController((SnapPieceTable)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).ActivePieceTable);
					SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController((SnapPieceTable)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).ActivePieceTable);
					SnapBookmark snapBookmark2 = snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByTableCell(val.FirstCell);
					if (snapBookmark2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (snapBookmark2 != snapBookmark || val.IndexInTable != num + 1)
					{
						snapBookmark = snapBookmark2;
						if (flag)
						{
							list.Add(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)val.Next.Cells)[0]);
						}
						flag = false;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)val.Cells).Count; j++)
					{
						if (snapObjectModelController.GetFirstCellRun(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)val.Cells)[j]) is SeparatorTextRun)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					num = val.IndexInTable;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(selectedRows[count - 1].Next.FirstCell);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

					}

					{

						UpdateSelection(selection, runIndex, runIndex);
					}
					normalizedStart = selection.NormalizedStart;
				}
				Field val = pieceTable.CreateField(normalizedStart, 0);
				pieceTable.InsertText(normalizedStart + 1, FieldType);

				if (SelectAfterInsertion)

				}
			}
			finally
			{

			}
		}

	public class ListFieldSelectionController

		public SnapFieldInfo FindDataField()
		{

			if (selectedField != null && IsDataField(selectedField))
			{
				return selectedField;
			}
			if (listFieldInfo == null && FindListField() == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Selection selection = ((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).Selection;
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)selection.PieceTable;
			if (selection.Length == 0)

			}

		private SnapFieldInfo FindDataFieldByCaretPosition(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, DocumentModelPosition caretPosition)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				return null;
			}

			Paragraph val = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)pieceTable).Paragraphs)[paragraphIndex];
			TableCell cell = val.GetCell();
			if (cell == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapTemplateInfo templateInfo = bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo;
			switch (templateInfo.TemplateType)
			{
			case SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow:
				return FindDataFieldByCaretPositionInDataRow(pieceTable, caretPosition, cell);
			case SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListHeader:
			case SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListFooter:

			case SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter:
				return FindDataFieldByCaretPositionInGroupHeaderOrFooter(pieceTable, caretPosition, cell, templateInfo);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private SnapFieldInfo FindSingleSNFieldInCell(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, TableCell cell)
		{
			while (cell != null && IsCellInsideList(pieceTable, cell))
			{
				SnapFieldInfo singleSNFieldInCell = GetSingleSNFieldInCell(pieceTable, cell);
				if (singleSNFieldInCell != null)
				{
					return singleSNFieldInCell;
				}
				cell = cell.Table.ParentCell;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private SnapFieldInfo FindDataFieldByCaretPositionInDataRow(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, DocumentModelPosition caretPosition, TableCell caretCell)
		{

		}

		private SnapFieldInfo FindDataFieldByCaretPositionInGroupHeaderOrFooter(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, DocumentModelPosition caretPosition, TableCell caretCell, SnapTemplateInfo templateInfo)
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			}

			if (fieldsInsideInterval == null || fieldsInsideInterval.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string fieldName = groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos[0].FieldName;
			foreach (Field item in fieldsInsideInterval)
			{

				CalculatedFieldBase parsedInfo = snapFieldInfo.ParsedInfo;

				if (val != null && string.CompareOrdinal(val.DataFieldName, fieldName) == 0)

					return snapFieldInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private SnapFieldInfo FindDataFieldByCaretPositionInListHeaderOrFooter(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, DocumentModelPosition caretPosition, TableCell caretCell)
		{
			TableCell val = FindTopmostTableCellInList(pieceTable, caretCell);
			int startColumnIndex = TableCommandsHelper.GetStartColumnIndex(val);
			int endColumnIndex = TableCommandsHelper.GetEndColumnIndex(val);
			List<TableCell> list = FindCellsByColumnIndexInDataRowBookmark(val.Table, startColumnIndex, endColumnIndex);
			int count = list.Count;
			if (count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				SnapFieldInfo singleSNFieldInCell = GetSingleSNFieldInCell(pieceTable, list[i]);
				if (singleSNFieldInCell == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (snapFieldInfo != null)
				{
					if (!SameDataFieldName(snapFieldInfo, singleSNFieldInCell))
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					snapFieldInfo = singleSNFieldInCell;
				}
			}
			return snapFieldInfo;
		}

		private List<TableCell> FindCellsByColumnIndexInDataRowBookmark(Table table, int leftColumnIndex, int rightColumnIndex)
		{
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			TableRowCollection rows = table.Rows;
			int count = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)rows).Count;
			int i = 0;
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = null;
			for (; i < count; i++)
			{
				snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)rows)[i]);
				if (snapBookmark != null && snapBookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			List<TableCell> list = new List<TableCell>();
			for (; i < count; i++)
			{
				SnapBookmark snapBookmark2 = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)rows)[i]);
				if (snapBookmark2 != snapBookmark)
				{
					break;
				}
				TableCell cellByStartAndEndColumnIndex = GetCellByStartAndEndColumnIndex(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)rows)[i], leftColumnIndex, rightColumnIndex);
				if (cellByStartAndEndColumnIndex != null && ((int)cellByStartAndEndColumnIndex.VerticalMerging == 0 || (int)cellByStartAndEndColumnIndex.VerticalMerging == 2))
				{
					list.Add(cellByStartAndEndColumnIndex);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private TableCell GetCellByStartAndEndColumnIndex(TableRow tableRow, int leftColumnIndex, int rightColumnIndex)
		{
			int num = tableRow.GridBefore;
			TableCellCollection cells = tableRow.Cells;
			int count = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cells).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				TableCell val = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cells)[i];
				int columnSpan = val.ColumnSpan;
				if (num == leftColumnIndex)
				{
					if (num + columnSpan - 1 == rightColumnIndex)
					{
						return val;
					}
					return null;
				}
				if (num > leftColumnIndex)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num += columnSpan;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsSingleGroupField(SnapFieldInfo field, SnapTemplateInfo templateInfo)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)field, "field");
			CalculatedFieldBase parsedInfo = field.ParsedInfo;
			MergefieldField val = (MergefieldField)(object)((parsedInfo is MergefieldField) ? parsedInfo : null);
			string dataFieldName = val.DataFieldName;
			GroupProperties groupProperties = ListFieldInfo.ParsedInfo.GetGroupProperties(DocumentModel, templateInfo.FirstGroupIndex);
			if (groupProperties == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos.Count != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.CompareOrdinal(dataFieldName, groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos[0].FieldName) == 0;
		}

		private SnapFieldInfo FindDataFieldBySelectionIntervals(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, Selection selection)
		{
			if (selection.IsMultiSelection)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (selection.IsEntireTableCellSelected)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = FindDataFieldByCaretPosition(pieceTable, selection.Interval.NormalizedStart);
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo2 = FindDataFieldByCaretPosition(pieceTable, selection.Interval.NormalizedEnd);
			if (snapFieldInfo == null && snapFieldInfo2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (snapFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return snapFieldInfo2;
			}
			if (snapFieldInfo2 == null || snapFieldInfo.Field == snapFieldInfo2.Field)
			{
				return snapFieldInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private SnapFieldInfo GetSingleSNFieldInCell(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, TableCell cell)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RunIndex firstRunIndex = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)pieceTable).Paragraphs)[cell.StartParagraphIndex].FirstRunIndex;
			RunIndex lastRunIndex = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)pieceTable).Paragraphs)[cell.EndParagraphIndex].LastRunIndex;
			List<Field> fieldsInsideInterval = ((PieceTable)pieceTable).GetFieldsInsideInterval(firstRunIndex, lastRunIndex);
			int count = fieldsInsideInterval.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo2 = new SnapFieldInfo(pieceTable, fieldsInsideInterval[i]);
				if (!IsDataField(snapFieldInfo2))

					continue;
				}
				if (snapFieldInfo != null)
				{
					if (!SameDataFieldName(snapFieldInfo2, snapFieldInfo))
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					snapFieldInfo = snapFieldInfo2;
				}
			}
			return snapFieldInfo;
		}

		private bool IsDataField(SnapFieldInfo field)
		{
			return field.ParsedInfo is MergefieldField;
		}

		private bool SameDataFieldName(SnapFieldInfo field1, SnapFieldInfo field2)
		{
			CalculatedFieldBase parsedInfo = field1.ParsedInfo;
			MergefieldField val = (MergefieldField)(object)((parsedInfo is MergefieldField) ? parsedInfo : null);
			CalculatedFieldBase parsedInfo2 = field2.ParsedInfo;
			MergefieldField val2 = (MergefieldField)(object)((parsedInfo2 is MergefieldField) ? parsedInfo2 : null);
			string dataFieldName = val.DataFieldName;
			string dataFieldName2 = val2.DataFieldName;
			return string.CompareOrdinal(dataFieldName, dataFieldName2) == 0;
		}

		private bool IsCellInsideList(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, TableCell cell)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ListFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RunIndex firstRunIndex = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)pieceTable).Paragraphs)[cell.StartParagraphIndex].FirstRunIndex;
			if (!ListFieldInfo.Field.ContainsRun(firstRunIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RunIndex lastRunIndex = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)pieceTable).Paragraphs)[cell.EndParagraphIndex].LastRunIndex;
			return ListFieldInfo.Field.ContainsRun(lastRunIndex);
		}

		protected TableCell FindTopmostTableCellInList(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, TableCell cell)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			while (cell != null)
			{
				TableCell parentCell = cell.Table.ParentCell;
				if (parentCell == null)
				{
					return cell;
				}
				ParagraphIndex startParagraphIndex = parentCell.StartParagraphIndex;
				RunIndex firstRunIndex = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)pieceTable).Paragraphs)[startParagraphIndex].FirstRunIndex;
				if (firstRunIndex <= ListFieldInfo.Field.FirstRunIndex)
				{
					return cell;
				}
				cell = parentCell;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class EditListCommandBase : EditFieldCommandBase<SNListField, SnapListFieldInfo>
	{
		private SnapBookmark bookmark;

		private IFieldPathService fieldPathService;

		private ListFieldSelectionController listFieldSelectionController;

		protected new SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => base.DocumentModel;

		protected IFieldPathService FieldPathService
		{
			get
			{
				if (fieldPathService == null)
				{
					IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
					if (service != null)
					{
						fieldPathService = service.FieldPathService;
					}
				}
				return fieldPathService;
			}
		}

		protected SnapBookmark Bookmark => bookmark;

		protected EditListCommandBase(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected override SnapListFieldInfo GetEditedField()
		{
			listFieldSelectionController = new ListFieldSelectionController(DocumentModel);
			bookmark = listFieldSelectionController.FindBookmark();
			return listFieldSelectionController.FindListField();
		}

		protected SnapFieldInfo FindDataField()
		{
			if (base.EditedFieldInfo == null || bookmark == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return listFieldSelectionController.FindDataField();
		}

		protected SNDataInfo GetDataInfo()
		{
			return GetDataInfo(createNewSummary: false);
		}

		protected SNDataInfo GetDataInfo(bool createNewSummary)
		{
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = FindDataField();
			if (snapFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(base.DataSourceDispatcher, snapFieldInfo);
			if (fieldDesignBinding == null || (fieldDesignBinding.DataSource == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldDesignBinding.DataMember)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = fieldDesignBinding.DataMember;
			Field parent = snapFieldInfo.Field.Parent;
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo = new SnapFieldInfo(base.EditedFieldInfo.PieceTable, parent);
				DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding2 = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(base.DataSourceDispatcher, fieldInfo);
				text2 = fieldDesignBinding2.DataMember;
				text = ((string.CompareOrdinal(text2, fieldDesignBinding.DataMember) != 0) ? ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2)) ? fieldDesignBinding.DataMember.Substring(text2.Length + 1) : fieldDesignBinding.DataMember) : string.Empty);
			}
			string fieldDisplayName = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDisplayName(base.DataSourceDispatcher, base.EditedFieldInfo, text, text);
			if (createNewSummary && snapFieldInfo.ParsedInfo is SNTextField sNTextField && ((MergefieldField)sNTextField).DataFieldName.Contains("\\"))
			{
				return new SNDataInfo(fieldDesignBinding.DataSource, string.Join(".", text2, text), new string[2]
				{
					text2,
					((MergefieldField)sNTextField).DataFieldName
				}, fieldDisplayName);
			}
			return new SNDataInfo(fieldDesignBinding.DataSource, new string[2] { text2, text }, fieldDisplayName);
		}
	}
	public abstract class EditListFromInnerFieldCommandBase : EditListCommandBase
	{
		protected enum GroupModifyType
		{
			None,
			InsertHeader,
			InsertFooter,
			Both,
			InsertGroupSeparator
		}

		protected class GroupModifyInfo
		{
			private static readonly GroupModifyInfo empty = new GroupModifyInfo();

			private readonly string newSwitch;

			private readonly GroupModifyType modifyType;

			private readonly DocumentModel groupTemplate;

			public static GroupModifyInfo Empty => empty;

			public string NewSwitch => newSwitch;

			public GroupModifyType ModifyType => modifyType;

			public DocumentModel GroupTemplate => groupTemplate;

			private GroupModifyInfo()
			{
			}

			public GroupModifyInfo(string newSwitch, GroupModifyType modifyType, DocumentModel groupTemplate)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(newSwitch, "newSwitch");
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)groupTemplate, "groupTemplate");
				this.newSwitch = newSwitch;
				this.modifyType = modifyType;
				this.groupTemplate = groupTemplate;
			}
		}

		protected delegate void ModifyGroupPropertiesAction<T>(GroupProperties groupProperties, GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo, T modifyInfo);

		private GroupProperties currentGroupProperties;

		private GroupFieldInfo currentGroupFieldInfo;

		private SnapFieldInfo dataField;

		public string DataFieldName { get; protected set; }

		public string DataFieldType { get; protected set; }

		protected bool HasGroupTemplates { get; private set; }

		protected EditListFromInnerFieldCommandBase(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareCommandInfo()
		{
			base.PrepareCommandInfo();
			dataField = FindDataField();
			if (dataField != null)
			{
				InstructionController controller = dataField.PieceTable.CreateFieldInstructionController(dataField.Field);
				DataFieldName = GetDataFieldName(controller);
				DataFieldType = GetDataFieldType(controller);
			}
		}

		protected string GetDisplayDataFieldName()
		{
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = FindDataField();
			if (snapFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return FieldsHelper.GetFieldDisplayName(base.DataSourceDispatcher, base.EditedFieldInfo, DataFieldName, DataFieldName);
		}

		protected virtual string GetDataFieldName(InstructionController controller)
		{
			if (controller == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return controller.GetArgumentAsString(0);
		}

		protected virtual string GetDataFieldType(InstructionController controller)
		{
			if (controller != null)
			{
				return controller.GetFieldType();
			}
			return SNTextField.FieldType;
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabled()
		{
			if (!base.IsEnabled() || string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataFieldName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).GetService<IDataAccessService>();
			if (service == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SNDataInfo dataInfo = GetDataInfo();
			if (dataInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = DataMemberInfo.Create(dataInfo.DataPaths);
			return service.AllowGroupAndSort(((DataPair)dataInfo).Source, dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo.DataMember, dataMemberInfo.ColumnName);
		}

		protected virtual DesignBinding GetDesignBinding()
		{
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = FindDataField();
			if (snapFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(base.DataSourceDispatcher, snapFieldInfo);
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateFieldCode(InstructionController controller)
		{
			string argumentAsString = controller.GetArgumentAsString(0);
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = base.FieldPathService.FromString(argumentAsString);
			fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.EnsureItemsNotEmpty();
			ProcessGroups(fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem);
			controller.SetArgument(0, base.FieldPathService.GetStringPath(fieldPathInfo));
		}

		protected internal virtual void ProcessGroups(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item)
		{
			if (ShouldAddNewGroup(item))
			{
				AddNewGroup(item, UpdateGroupInfo, GroupModifyInfo.Empty);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldAddNewGroup(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item)
		{
			if (!item.HasGroups)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int count = item.Groups.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (ProcessGroupProperties(item.Groups[i]))
				{
					if (item.Groups[i].GroupFieldInfos.Count == 0)
					{
						item.Groups.RemoveAt(i);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ProcessGroupProperties(GroupProperties properties)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int count = properties.GroupFieldInfos.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo = properties.GroupFieldInfos[i];
				if (groupFieldInfo.FieldName == DataFieldName)
				{
					UpdateGroupInfo(properties, groupFieldInfo, GroupModifyInfo.Empty);
					if ((int)groupFieldInfo.SortOrder == 0)
					{
						properties.GroupFieldInfos.RemoveAt(i);
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void AddNewGroup<T>(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item, ModifyGroupPropertiesAction<T> modifyAction, T modifyInfo)
		{
			GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo = new GroupFieldInfo(DataFieldName);
			GroupProperties groupProperties = new GroupProperties();
			groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos.Add(groupFieldInfo);
			modifyAction(groupProperties, groupFieldInfo, modifyInfo);
			if (groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates)
			{
				item.InsertGroup(groupProperties);
			}
			else
			{
				item.AddGroup(groupProperties);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateGroupInfo(GroupProperties groupProperties, GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo, GroupModifyInfo modifyInfo)
		{
		}

		protected FieldPathDataMemberInfo GetCorrespondingDataMemberInfo()
		{
			if (base.EditedFieldInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable = base.EditedFieldInfo.PieceTable;
			InstructionController val = pieceTable.CreateFieldInstructionController(base.EditedFieldInfo.Field);
			if (val == null || base.FieldPathService == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.FieldPathService.FromString(val.GetArgumentAsString(0)).DataMemberInfo;
		}

		protected GroupProperties GetCorrespondingGroupProperties()
		{
			if (currentGroupProperties == null)
			{
				GetCorrespondingGroupInfo();
			}
			return currentGroupProperties;
		}

		protected internal GroupFieldInfo GetCorrespondingGroupFieldInfo()
		{
			if (currentGroupFieldInfo == null)
			{
				GetCorrespondingGroupInfo();
			}
			return currentGroupFieldInfo;
		}

		protected void GetCorrespondingGroupInfo()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataFieldName))
			{
				return;
			}
			FieldPathDataMemberInfo correspondingDataMemberInfo = GetCorrespondingDataMemberInfo();
			if (correspondingDataMemberInfo == null || correspondingDataMemberInfo.IsEmpty || !correspondingDataMemberInfo.LastItem.HasGroups)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GroupProperties group in correspondingDataMemberInfo.LastItem.Groups)
			{
				foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in group.GroupFieldInfos)
				{
					if (groupFieldInfo.FieldName == DataFieldName)
					{
						HasGroupTemplates = CalcHasGroupTemplates(group);
						currentGroupFieldInfo = groupFieldInfo;
						currentGroupProperties = group;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool IsGrouped()
		{
			if (GetCorrespondingGroupFieldInfo() != null)
			{
				return HasGroupTemplates;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CalcHasGroupTemplates(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			return groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates;
		}
	}
	public abstract class FilterListCommandBase : EditListCommandBase
	{
		private string filterString;

		protected FilterListCommandBase(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (base.EditedFieldInfo != null)
			{
				DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(base.DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher, base.EditedFieldInfo);
				filterString = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).GetService<IFilterStringAccessService>()?.GetFilterString(base.EditedFieldInfo.ParsedInfo);
				if (ModifyFilterString(fieldDesignBinding, ref filterString))
				{
					base.ExecuteCore();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateFieldCode(InstructionController controller)
		{
			string argumentAsString = controller.GetArgumentAsString(0);
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = base.FieldPathService.FromString(argumentAsString);
			if (fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.Items.Add(new FieldDataMemberInfoItem(string.Empty));
			}
			if (fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem.HasFilters)
			{
				fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem.FilterProperties.Filters.Clear();
			}
			fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem.AddFilter(filterString);
			controller.SetArgument(0, base.FieldPathService.GetStringPath(fieldPathInfo));
		}

		protected abstract bool ModifyFilterString(DesignBinding binding, ref string filterString);
	}

	public abstract class GroupByFieldCommandBase : InsertGroupTemplateCommandBase
	{
		public SummaryItemType SummaryType { get; protected set; }

		public string SummaryDataFieldName { get; protected set; }

		protected GroupByFieldCommandBase(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
			SummaryType = (SummaryItemType)3;
		}

		protected override bool IsChecked()
		{
			return IsGrouped();
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareCommandInfo()
		{
			base.PrepareCommandInfo();
			SummaryDataFieldName = base.DataFieldName;
		}

		protected override void ProcessGroups<T>(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item, ModifyGroupPropertiesAction<T> modifyAction, T modifyInfo)
		{
			if (ShouldAddNewGroup(item, modifyAction, modifyInfo))
			{
				AddNewGroup(item, modifyAction, modifyInfo);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldAddNewGroup<T>(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item, ModifyGroupPropertiesAction<T> modifyAction, T modifyInfo)
		{
			if (!item.HasGroups)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int count = item.Groups.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (ProcessGroupProperties(item.Groups[i], modifyAction, modifyInfo))
				{
					item.MoveToGrouped(i);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateFieldCode(InstructionController controller)
		{
			if (!IsGrouped())
			{
				Group(controller);
			}
			else
			{
				Ungroup(controller);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Group(InstructionController controller)
		{
			BeginUpdate(controller);
			try
			{
				if (GroupType != GroupModifyType.Both)
				{
					GroupModifyInfo modifyInfo = InsertGroupTemplate(controller, GroupType);
					ModifyFieldGroupProperties(UpdateGroupInfo, modifyInfo);
					return;
				}
				GroupModifyInfo modifyInfo2 = InsertGroupTemplate(controller, GroupModifyType.InsertHeader);
				ModifyFieldGroupProperties(UpdateGroupInfo, modifyInfo2);
				modifyInfo2 = InsertGroupTemplate(controller, GroupModifyType.InsertFooter);
				ModifyFieldGroupProperties(UpdateGroupInfo, modifyInfo2);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(controller);
			}
		}

		protected void Ungroup(InstructionController controller)
		{
			string argumentAsString = controller.GetArgumentAsString(0);
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = base.FieldPathService.FromString(argumentAsString);
			ProcessGroups(controller, fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem);
			controller.SetArgument(0, base.FieldPathService.GetStringPath(fieldPathInfo));
		}

		private void ProcessGroups(InstructionController controller, FieldDataMemberInfoItem item)
		{
			int count = item.Groups.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				GroupProperties groupProperties = item.Groups[i];
				if (ProcessGroupProperties(groupProperties))
				{
					RemoveTemplateHeaderAndFooter(controller, groupProperties);
					if (!groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates)
					{
						item.RemoveGroup(groupProperties);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateGroupInfo(GroupProperties groupProperties, GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo, GroupModifyInfo modifyInfo)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)groupFieldInfo.SortOrder == 0)
			{
				groupFieldInfo.SortOrder = (ColumnSortOrder)1;
			}
			if (modifyInfo.ModifyType == GroupModifyType.InsertHeader)
			{
				groupProperties.TemplateHeaderSwitch = modifyInfo.NewSwitch;
			}
			if (modifyInfo.ModifyType == GroupModifyType.InsertFooter)
			{
				groupProperties.TemplateFooterSwitch = modifyInfo.NewSwitch;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetGroupTemplateContentCore(TemplateWriter templateWriter, GroupModifyType modifyType)
		{
			templateWriter.WriteText(GetDisplayDataFieldName() + ": ");
			templateWriter.BeginField();
			templateWriter.WriteText($"{base.DataFieldType} {base.DataFieldName}");
			templateWriter.EndField();
		}

		protected virtual void SetGroupSummaryTemplateContentCore(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			templateWriter.WriteText(SNTextField.GetDisplaySummaryString(GetSummaryDisplayDataFieldName(), SummaryType));
			templateWriter.BeginField();
			string fieldCodeCore = GetFieldCodeCore();
			templateWriter.WriteText(fieldCodeCore);
			templateWriter.EndField();
			templateWriter.WriteText(" ");
		}

		protected virtual string GetSummaryDisplayDataFieldName()
		{
			return GetDisplayDataFieldName();
		}

		protected virtual string GetFieldCodeCore()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return SNTextField.GetSummaryFieldCode(SummaryDataFieldName, "group", SummaryType);
		}

		protected abstract void RemoveTemplateHeaderAndFooter(InstructionController controller, GroupProperties groupProperties);
	}

			{

		}

	public static class TableCommandsHelper
	{
		public static bool IsWholeSelectionInOneBookmark(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, SelectedCellsIntervalInRow interval, TableCell startCell)
		{
			return IsWholeSelectionInOneBookmarkCore(pieceTable, startCell, interval.Row.Cells, interval.NormalizedStartCellIndex, interval.NormalizedEndCellIndex);
		}

		public static bool IsWholeSelectionInOneBookmark(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, TableRow row)
		{
			return IsWholeSelectionInOneBookmarkCore(pieceTable, ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).First, row.Cells, 0, ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Count - 1);
		}

		private static bool IsWholeSelectionInOneBookmarkCore(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, TableCell startCell, TableCellCollection cells, int startCellIndex, int endCellIndex)
		{
			SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController(pieceTable);
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByTableCell(startCell);
			for (int i = startCellIndex; i <= endCellIndex; i++)
			{
				TableCell cell = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cells)[i];
				if (snapBookmark != snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByTableCell(cell))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool CanDeleteTableCells(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (!CanPerformTableCellOperationWithColumn(documentModel) && !CanPerformTableCellsOperationWithRow(documentModel))
			{
				return CanShiftToTheVertically(documentModel);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool CanShiftToTheVertically(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)documentModel.ActivePieceTable;
			SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController(pieceTable);
			return snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByTableCell(documentModel.Selection.SelectedCells.FirstSelectedCell) == null;
		}

		public static bool CanPerformTableCellOperationWithColumn(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				return CanDeleteTableColumnsCore(documentModel);
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private static bool CanDeleteTableColumnsCore(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SelectedCellsCollection val = (SelectedCellsCollection)documentModel.Selection.SelectedCells;
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)documentModel.ActivePieceTable;
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!CheckSelectedCellsIntervalInRow(pieceTable, val[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool CheckSelectedCellsIntervalInRow(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, SelectedCellsIntervalInRow interval)
		{
			if (!IsWholeSelectionInOneBookmark(pieceTable, interval, interval.NormalizedStartCell))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!CanMoveSeparatorTextRunToSameRow(pieceTable, interval))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool CanMoveSeparatorTextRunToSameRow(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, SelectedCellsIntervalInRow interval)
		{

		public static ColumnIndexesInfo CalculateSelectedColumnIndexes(SelectedCellsCollection selectedCells)
		{
			ColumnIndexesInfo result = default(ColumnIndexesInfo);
			TableCell normalizedStartCell = selectedCells.NormalizedFirst.NormalizedStartCell;
			TableCell normalizedEndCell = selectedCells.NormalizedFirst.NormalizedEndCell;
			result.StartColumnIndex = GetStartColumnIndex(normalizedStartCell);
			result.EndColumnIndex = GetEndColumnIndex(normalizedEndCell);
			int bottomRowIndex = selectedCells.GetBottomRowIndex();
			for (int i = selectedCells.GetTopRowIndex(); i <= bottomRowIndex; i++)
			{
				normalizedStartCell = selectedCells[i].NormalizedStartCell;
				normalizedEndCell = selectedCells[i].NormalizedEndCell;
				result.StartColumnIndex = Algorithms.Max<int>(result.StartColumnIndex, GetStartColumnIndex(normalizedStartCell));
				result.EndColumnIndex = Algorithms.Min<int>(result.EndColumnIndex, GetEndColumnIndex(normalizedEndCell));
			}
			return result;
		}

					TableCellCollection cells = val.Row.Cells;
					for (int j = val.NormalizedStartCellIndex; j <= val.NormalizedEndCellIndex; j++)
					{

						{
							list.Add(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cells)[val.NormalizedEndCellIndex + 1]);

					}
				}
				return list;
			}

		private bool HasGroups()
		{

			SnapListFieldInfo selectedSNListField = FieldsHelper.GetSelectedSNListField((SnapDocumentModel)(object)((RichEditCommandBase<XtraRichEditStringId>)this).DocumentModel);
			if (selectedSNListField == null)

	public abstract class ErrorHandlerBase : IErrorHandler, IErrorInfoVisitor
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<ErrorType, SnapStringId> errorDescriptionsTable = CreateErrorDescriptionsTable();

		private static Dictionary<ErrorType, SnapStringId> CreateErrorDescriptionsTable()
		{
			Dictionary<ErrorType, SnapStringId> dictionary = new Dictionary<ErrorType, SnapStringId>();
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.FillDataError, SnapStringId.Msg_FillDataError);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.InvalidCalculatedFieldName, SnapStringId.Msg_InvalidCalculatedFieldName);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.AssignChartDataSourceError, SnapStringId.Msg_AssignChartDataSourceError);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.BindChartSeriesError, SnapStringId.Msg_BindChartSeriesError);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.IncompatibleArgumentDataMember, SnapStringId.Msg_IncompatibleArgumentDataMember);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.IncompatibleValueDataMember, SnapStringId.Msg_IncompatibleValueDataMember);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.InvalidDataSourceName, SnapStringId.Msg_InvalidDataSourceName);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.FilterCriteriaInvalidExpression, SnapStringId.Msg_FilterCriteriaInvalidExpression);
			dictionary.Add(ErrorType.FilterCriteriaInvalidExpressionEx, SnapStringId.Msg_FilterCriteriaInvalidExpressionEx);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public ErrorHandlingResult HandleError(ErrorType errorType)
		{
			return HandleError(new ErrorInfo(errorType));
		}

		public ErrorHandlingResult HandleError(IErrorInfo errorInfo)
		{
			return errorInfo?.Visit(this) ?? ErrorHandlingResult.Ignore;
		}

		public abstract ErrorHandlingResult Visit(ErrorInfo info);

		public abstract ErrorHandlingResult Visit(ClarificationErrorInfo info);

		public abstract ErrorHandlingResult Visit(ExtendedErrorInfo info);

		protected SnapStringId GetErrorDescriptionStringId(ErrorType errorType)
		{
			return errorDescriptionsTable[errorType];
		}
	}
	public class APIErrorHandler : ErrorHandlerBase
	{
		public override ErrorHandlingResult Visit(ErrorInfo info)
		{
			SnapStringId errorDescriptionStringId = GetErrorDescriptionStringId(info.ErrorType);
			Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(SnapLocalizer.GetString(errorDescriptionStringId));
			return ErrorHandlingResult.Abort;
		}

		public override ErrorHandlingResult Visit(ClarificationErrorInfo info)
		{
			return ErrorHandlingResult.Ignore;
		}

		public override ErrorHandlingResult Visit(ExtendedErrorInfo info)
		{
			SnapStringId errorDescriptionStringId = GetErrorDescriptionStringId(info.ErrorType);
			string message = string.Format(SnapLocalizer.GetString(errorDescriptionStringId), info.Arguments);
			Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(message);
			return ErrorHandlingResult.Abort;
		}
	}

	public class BoxHotZonePainter : SnapHotZonePainter
	{
		private const float TransparencyCoeff = 0.55f;

		private const float TailToHeadWidthsRatio = 0.56f;

		private const int MinRadius = 5;

		protected const int DefaultFontSize = 10;

		public static readonly string UIString_SecondLine = SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.HotZonePainter_SecondLine);

		private readonly Color backgroundColor;

		private readonly DXBrush backgroundBrush;

		private readonly DXBrush foregroundBrush = new DXSolidBrush(Color.White);

		protected DXBrush BackgroundBrush => backgroundBrush;

		protected DXBrush ForegroundBrush => foregroundBrush;

		public BoxHotZonePainter(Painter painter)
			: base(painter)
		{
			backgroundColor = Color.FromArgb(140, base.BackgroundHoverColor);
			backgroundBrush = new DXSolidBrush(backgroundColor);
		}

		public override void DrawHotZone(HotZone hotZone)
		{
			DrawHotZone((DropFieldRoundHotZone)(object)hotZone, string.Empty);
		}

		public void DrawHotZone(DropFieldRoundHotZone hotZone, string hint)
		{
			if (((RoundHotZone)hotZone).Radius < 5f)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Painter.PushSmoothingMode(highQuality: true);
			try
			{
				DrawHotZoneCore(hotZone, hint);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Painter.PopSmoothingMode();
			}
		}

		protected internal void DrawHotZoneCore(DropFieldRoundHotZone hotZone, string hint)
		{
			RectangleF arrowBounds = GetPolygonBounds(hotZone);
			RectangleF ellipseBounds = GetEllipseBounds(arrowBounds);
			FillEllipse(hotZone.IsHovered ? base.BackgroundHoverBrush : BackgroundBrush, ellipseBounds);
			WithHighQualityPixelOffsetMode(base.Painter, delegate
			{
				FillPolygon(ForegroundBrush, GetPolygon(arrowBounds, hotZone.ArrowSegment));
			});
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(hint))
			{
				DrawText(((HotZone)hotZone).Bounds, hint, UIString_SecondLine);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual PointF[] GetPolygon(RectangleF bounds, float segment)
		{
			return GetArrowPolygon(bounds, segment);
		}

		private PointF[] GetArrowPolygon(RectangleF bounds, float arrowSegment)
		{
			int num = (int)(bounds.Width * arrowSegment / 2f);
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = (int)((float)num * 0.56f);
			int num4 = num3 * 2 + 1;
			int num5 = num4;
			PointF headMiddleCenter = GetHeadMiddleCenter(bounds, arrowSegment);
			headMiddleCenter.X = (float)(int)((double)headMiddleCenter.X + 0.5) + 0.5f;
			headMiddleCenter.Y = (int)((double)headMiddleCenter.Y + 0.5);
			PointF pointF = new PointF(headMiddleCenter.X - (float)num - 0.5f, headMiddleCenter.Y - (float)num2);
			PointF pointF2 = new PointF(headMiddleCenter.X + (float)num + 0.5f, headMiddleCenter.Y - (float)num2);
			PointF pointF3 = new PointF(headMiddleCenter.X - (float)num3 - 0.5f, pointF.Y);
			PointF pointF4 = new PointF(headMiddleCenter.X + (float)num3 + 0.5f, pointF2.Y);
			PointF pointF5 = new PointF(pointF3.X, pointF3.Y - (float)num5);
			PointF pointF6 = new PointF(pointF4.X, pointF4.Y - (float)num5);
			return new PointF[7] { pointF5, pointF6, pointF4, pointF2, headMiddleCenter, pointF, pointF3 };
		}

		protected virtual PointF GetHeadMiddleCenter(RectangleF bounds, float arrowSegment)
		{
			return new PointF(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2f, bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2f);
		}

		protected virtual RectangleF GetPolygonBounds(DropFieldRoundHotZone hotZone)
		{
			RectangleF result = ((HotZone)hotZone).Bounds;
			if (result.Width % 2f == 0f)
			{
				result.Width++;
				result.Height++;
			}
			result.X -= 0.5f;
			result.Y -= 0.5f;
			return result;
		}

		private RectangleF GetEllipseBounds(RectangleF arrowBounds)
		{
			RectangleF result = arrowBounds;
			result.Width++;
			result.Height++;
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual string GetLongestString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private float GetFontSize(float width)
		{
			string longestString = GetLongestString();
			int num = 10;
			while (GetLineSize(longestString, num++).Width < width)
			{
			}
			while (GetLineSize(longestString, num--).Width > width && num > 1)
			{
			}
			return num;
		}

		private SizeF GetLineSize(string str, int fontSize)
		{
			using Font font = new Font(SystemFonts.DefaultFont.FontFamily, fontSize);
			return base.Painter.MeasureString(str, font);
		}

		private void FillEllipse(DXBrush brush, RectangleF boundsF)
		{
			Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle((int)boundsF.X, (int)boundsF.Y, (int)boundsF.Width, (int)boundsF.Height);
			base.Painter.FillEllipse(brush, bounds);
		}

		private void FillPolygon(DXBrush brush, PointF[] points)
		{
			base.Painter.FillPolygon(brush, points);
		}

		private void DrawText(Rectangle bounds, string line1, string line2)
		{
			float fontSize = GetFontSize((float)bounds.Width * 0.9f);
			using Font font = new Font(SystemFonts.DefaultFont.FontFamily, fontSize);
			SizeF sizeF = MeasureString(line1, font);
			float num = bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2;
			DrawString(line1, ForegroundBrush, font, (float)bounds.X + ((float)bounds.Width - sizeF.Width) / 2f, num);
			SizeF sizeF2 = MeasureString(line2, font);
			DrawString(line2, ForegroundBrush, font, (float)bounds.X + ((float)bounds.Width - sizeF2.Width) / 2f, num + sizeF2.Height);
		}

		protected SizeF MeasureString(string text, Font font)
		{
			return base.Painter.MeasureString(text, font);
		}

		private void DrawString(string text, DXBrush brush, Font font, float x, float y)
		{
			base.Painter.DrawString(text, brush, font, x, y);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing)
			{
				BackgroundBrush.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartBox : InlinePictureBox
	{
		private const int Margin = 20;

		private const int InnerMargin = 20;

		private List<string> arguments;

		private List<string> values;

		private bool isEmpty;

		private readonly HotZoneCollection hotZones = new HotZoneCollection();

		public HotZoneCollection HotZones
		{
			get
			{
				if (((List<HotZone>)(object)hotZones).Count == 0)
				{
					InitializeHotZones();
				}
				return hotZones;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty => isEmpty;

		public bool HasDataBoundSeries
		{
			get
			{
				if (arguments != null && arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (values != null && values.Count > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeHotZones()
		{
			if (!((LayoutItem)this).ActualSizeBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				float radius = CalculateRadius(((LayoutItem)this).ActualSizeBounds);
				PointF[] hotZoneCenters = GetHotZoneCenters(((LayoutItem)this).ActualSizeBounds, radius);
				((List<HotZone>)(object)hotZones).Add((HotZone)(object)new DropValuesHotZone(hotZoneCenters[0], radius));
				((List<HotZone>)(object)hotZones).Add((HotZone)(object)new DropArgumentsHotZone(hotZoneCenters[1], radius));
			}
		}

		private float CalculateRadius(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int val = bounds.Height - 40;
			int val2 = (int)((float)bounds.Width * 0.5714286f - 20f) / 2;
			return Math.Min(val, val2) / 2;
		}

		private PointF[] GetHotZoneCenters(Rectangle bounds, float radius)
		{
			float y = bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2;
			float num = (float)(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2 - 10) - radius;
			return new PointF[2]
			{
				new PointF
				{
					X = num,
					Y = y
				},
				new PointF
				{
					X = num + 2f * radius + 20f,
					Y = y
				}
			};
		}

		public override Box CreateBox()
		{
			return (Box)(object)new ChartBox();
		}

		protected override OfficeImage GetImageCore(TextRunBase run)
		{
			return ((InlinePictureRun)(ChartRun)(object)run).Image;
		}

		protected override void DecorateCore(IRunVisual run, Painter painter)
		{
			CheckChartSeries(run);
			DrawInfoPanel(run, painter);
			DrawHotZones(painter);
		}

		private void CheckChartSeries(IRunVisual chartRun)
		{
			using ISNChartContainer iSNChartContainer = GetChartContainer(chartRun);
			if (iSNChartContainer != null)
			{
				SNChart chart = iSNChartContainer.Chart;
				values = chart.GetUniqueValues();
				arguments = chart.GetUniqueArguments();
				isEmpty = chart.IsEmpty();
			}
		}

		private ISNChartContainer GetChartContainer(IRunVisual chartRun)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapPieceTable snapPieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)chartRun.PieceTable;
			FormatterPosition startPos = ((Box)this).StartPos;
			Field val = snapPieceTable.FindNonTemplateFieldByRunIndex(((FormatterPosition)(ref startPos)).RunIndex);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(((FieldCalculatorService)new SnapFieldCalculatorService()).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)snapPieceTable, val) is SNChartField sNChartField))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return sNChartField.GetChartContainer(val);
		}

		private void DrawHotZones(Painter painter)
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				DrawHotZonesCore(painter);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawHotZonesCore(Painter painter)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			using ChartBoxHotZonePainter chartBoxHotZonePainter = new ChartBoxHotZonePainter(painter);
			foreach (IRoundHotZone item in (List<HotZone>)(object)HotZones)
			{
				IRoundHotZone val = item;
				((IHotZone)val).Accept((IHotZoneVisitor)(object)chartBoxHotZonePainter);
			}
		}

		private void DrawInfoPanel(IRunVisual chartRun, Painter painter)
		{
			if (HasDataBoundSeries && ((SnapFieldOptions)(object)chartRun.DocumentModel.FieldOptions).ShowChartInfoPanel)
			{
				DrawInfoPanelCore(chartRun, painter);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawInfoPanelCore(IRunVisual chartRun, Painter painter)
		{
			ChartBoxDecorator chartBoxDecorator = new ChartBoxDecorator(painter, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)chartRun.DocumentModel).LayoutUnitConverter);
			chartBoxDecorator.DrawInfoPanel(((LayoutItem)this).ActualSizeBounds, values, arguments);
		}
	}

	internal class ChartBoxDecorator
	{
		public const string UIStringValues = "VALUES";

		public const string UIStringArguments = "ARGUMENTS";

		private const int Margin = 8;

		private const int Padding = 24;

		private const int TextPadding = 3;

		private const int AdditionalPanelWidth = 45;

		private static readonly Font font = new Font(SystemFonts.DefaultFont.FontFamily, 10f);

		private static readonly Font boldFont = new Font(font, FontStyle.Bold);

		private static readonly DXBrush fontBrush = new DXSolidBrush(Color.White);

		private static readonly DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(230, Color.FromArgb(134, 134, 134)));

		private readonly int marginInLayoutUnits;

		private readonly int paddingInLayoutUnits;

		private readonly int textPaddingInLayoutUnits;

		private readonly int additionalPanelWidthInLayoutUnits;

		private readonly Painter painter;

		private readonly int fontHeight;

		internal static Font Font => font;

		internal int MarginInLayoutUnits => marginInLayoutUnits;

		internal int PaddingInLayoutUnits => paddingInLayoutUnits;

		internal int TextPaddingInLayoutUnits => textPaddingInLayoutUnits;

		internal int AdditionalPanelWidthInLayoutUnits => additionalPanelWidthInLayoutUnits;

		public ChartBoxDecorator(Painter painter, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			this.painter = painter;
			marginInLayoutUnits = unitConverter.DocumentsToLayoutUnits(8);
			paddingInLayoutUnits = unitConverter.DocumentsToLayoutUnits(24);
			textPaddingInLayoutUnits = unitConverter.DocumentsToLayoutUnits(3);
			additionalPanelWidthInLayoutUnits = unitConverter.DocumentsToLayoutUnits(45);
			fontHeight = painter.MeasureString("gM", boldFont).ToSize().Height;
		}

		public void DrawInfoPanel(Rectangle boxBounds, List<string> values, List<string> arguments)
		{
			ChartInfoPanelViewInfo viewInfo = CalcViewInfo(boxBounds, values, arguments);
			if (CalcInfoPanelVisibility(viewInfo, boxBounds))
			{
				DrawInfoPanelCore(viewInfo);
			}
		}

		internal ChartInfoPanelViewInfo CalcViewInfo(Rectangle boxBounds, List<string> values, List<string> arguments)
		{
			ChartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo = CalculateSection("VALUES", values, 0);
			int num = ((chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo != null) ? GetSectionBottom(chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo) : 0);
			ChartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo2 = CalculateSection("ARGUMENTS", arguments, num);
			num = ((chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo2 != null) ? GetSectionBottom(chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo2) : num);
			Rectangle panelBounds = GetPanelBounds(boxBounds, values, arguments, num - paddingInLayoutUnits);
			ChartInfoPanelViewInfo chartInfoPanelViewInfo = new ChartInfoPanelViewInfo(panelBounds);
			if (chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo != null)
			{
				chartInfoPanelViewInfo.Sections.Add(chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo);
			}
			if (chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo2 != null)
			{
				chartInfoPanelViewInfo.Sections.Add(chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo2);
			}
			return chartInfoPanelViewInfo;
		}

		internal bool CalcInfoPanelVisibility(ChartInfoPanelViewInfo viewInfo, Rectangle boxBounds)
		{
			if (boxBounds.Height >= viewInfo.Bounds.Height + 2 * marginInLayoutUnits)
			{
				return boxBounds.Width >= viewInfo.Bounds.Width + 2 * marginInLayoutUnits;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ChartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo CalculateSection(string header, List<string> values, int top)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			top += paddingInLayoutUnits;
			ChartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo = new ChartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo();
			chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo.Header = new StringViewInfo(header, new Point(paddingInLayoutUnits, top));
			foreach (string value in values)
			{
				top += fontHeight + textPaddingInLayoutUnits;
				chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo.Items.Add(new StringViewInfo(value, new Point(paddingInLayoutUnits, top)));
			}
			return chartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo;
		}

		private int GetSectionBottom(ChartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo section)
		{
			return ((section.Items.Count > 0) ? section.Items[section.Items.Count - 1] : section.Header).Location.Y + fontHeight;
		}

		private Rectangle GetPanelBounds(Rectangle boxBounds, List<string> values, List<string> arguments, int height)
		{
			int num = 2 * paddingInLayoutUnits;
			int x = boxBounds.X + marginInLayoutUnits;
			int y = boxBounds.Y + boxBounds.Height - height - marginInLayoutUnits - num;
			int num2 = GetMaxWidth(values, arguments) + additionalPanelWidthInLayoutUnits;
			return new Rectangle(x, y, num2 + num, height + num);
		}

		private int GetMaxWidth(List<string> values, List<string> arguments)
		{
			int num = 0;
			List<string> list = new List<string>(arguments);
			list.AddRange(values);
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				int width = painter.MeasureString(item, font).ToSize().Width;
				if (width > num)
				{
					num = width;
				}
			}
			if (values.Count > 0)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, MeasureHeaderString("VALUES"));
			}
			if (arguments.Count > 0)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, MeasureHeaderString("ARGUMENTS"));
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int MeasureHeaderString(string header)
		{
			return painter.MeasureString(header, boldFont).ToSize().Width;
		}

		private void DrawInfoPanelCore(ChartInfoPanelViewInfo viewInfo)
		{
			DrawBackground(viewInfo.Bounds);
			DrawArgumentsAndValues(viewInfo);
		}

		private void DrawBackground(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			painter.FillRectangle(brush, bounds);
		}

		private void DrawArgumentsAndValues(ChartInfoPanelViewInfo viewInfo)
		{
			painter.PushSmoothingMode(highQuality: true);
			try
			{
				DrawArgumentsAndValuesCore(viewInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				painter.PopSmoothingMode();
			}
		}

		private void DrawArgumentsAndValuesCore(ChartInfoPanelViewInfo viewInfo)
		{
			foreach (ChartInfoPanelSectionViewInfo section in viewInfo.Sections)
			{
				DrawText(viewInfo.Bounds, section.Header, boldFont);
				foreach (StringViewInfo item in section.Items)
				{
					DrawText(viewInfo.Bounds, item, font);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawText(Rectangle panelBounds, StringViewInfo stringViewInfo, Font font)
		{
			int num = panelBounds.X + stringViewInfo.Location.X;
			int num2 = panelBounds.Y + stringViewInfo.Location.Y;
			painter.DrawString(stringViewInfo.Text, fontBrush, font, num, num2);
		}
	}
	public class ChartBoxHotZonePainter : BoxHotZonePainter, IChartDropZoneVisitor, IHotZoneVisitor
	{
		public static readonly string UIString_DropValues = SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.HotZonePainter_DropValues);

		public static readonly string UIString_DropArguments = SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.HotZonePainter_DropArguments);

		public ChartBoxHotZonePainter(Painter painter)
			: base(painter)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetLongestString()
		{
			using Font font = new Font(SystemFonts.DefaultFont.FontFamily, 10f);
			float width = MeasureString(UIString_DropValues, font).Width;
			float width2 = MeasureString(UIString_DropArguments, font).Width;
			float width3 = MeasureString(BoxHotZonePainter.UIString_SecondLine, font).Width;
			if (width3 > Math.Max(width2, width))
			{
				return BoxHotZonePainter.UIString_SecondLine;
			}
			return (width2 > width) ? UIString_DropArguments : UIString_DropValues;
		}

		void IChartDropZoneVisitor.Visit(DropValuesHotZone hotZone)
		{
			DrawHotZone(hotZone, UIString_DropValues);
		}

		void IChartDropZoneVisitor.Visit(DropArgumentsHotZone hotZone)
		{
			DrawHotZone(hotZone, UIString_DropArguments);
		}
	}
