	public abstract class DataSourceDispatcherBase : IDataSourceDispatcher, IDisposable
	{
		private int refCount;

		private bool isDisposed;

		public string DefaultDataSourceName => string.Empty;

		public bool IsDisposed => isDisposed;

		public abstract IErrorHandler ErrorHandler { get; }

		public abstract object DefaultDataSource { get; }

		public abstract DataSourceInfo DefaultDataSourceInfo { get; }

		public event EventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public event EventHandler DataSourceChanged;

		public event EventHandler CalculatedFieldAdding;

		public void Capture()
		{
			refCount++;
		}

		public void Release()
		{
			if (refCount == 0)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			refCount--;
			if (refCount == 0)
			{
				Dispose(disposing: true);
			}
		}

		public DataSourceInfo GetInfo(object dataSource, bool allowNullDataSource)
		{
			if (!allowNullDataSource || dataSource != null)
			{
				return GetInfo(dataSource);
			}
			return FindNullDataSource();
		}

		protected bool RaiseDataSourceChangedCore()
		{
			if (this.DataSourceChanged != null)
			{
				this.DataSourceChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool RaiseCollectionChangedCore()
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool RaiseCalculatedFieldAddingCore()
		{
			if (this.CalculatedFieldAdding != null)
			{
				this.CalculatedFieldAdding(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object GetDataSourceOrDefault(string name)
		{
			if (name == null || string.Equals(name, DefaultDataSourceName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return DefaultDataSource;
			}
			return GetDataSource(name);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposeCore();
				isDisposed = true;
			}
		}

		~DataSourceDispatcherBase()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeCore()
		{
		}

		public abstract void Initialize(SnapDocumentModel documentModel);

		public abstract ICollection<object> GetDataSources();

		public abstract object GetDataSource(string name);

		public abstract bool IsDefaultDataSource(object dataSource);

		public abstract ICollection<DataSourceInfo> GetInfos();

		public abstract DataSourceInfo GetInfo(string dataSourceName);

		public abstract DataSourceInfo GetInfo(object dataSource);

		public abstract string FindDataSourceName(object dataSource);

		public abstract ICollection<ICalculatedField> GetCalculatedFields();

		public abstract ICollection<ICalculatedField> GetCalculatedFields(string dataSourceName);

		public abstract ICollection<ICalculatedField> GetCalculatedFields(object dataSource);

		public abstract ICalculatedField GetCalculatedField(string dataSourceName, string calculatedFieldName);

		public abstract void BeginUpdate();

		public abstract void EndUpdate();

		public abstract IDataSourceDispatcher CreateNew();

		protected abstract DataSourceInfo FindNullDataSource();
	}
	public abstract class CollectionBasedDataSourceDispatcher : DataSourceDispatcherBase
	{
		internal const string DefaultDataSourceInfoName = "";

		private int updateCount;

		private bool deferredRaiseCollectionChanged;

		private bool deferredRaiseDataSourceChanged;

		private bool deferredRaiseCalculatedFieldAdding;

		private bool initialized;

		public override object DefaultDataSource => GetDataSource(base.DefaultDataSourceName);

		public override DataSourceInfo DefaultDataSourceInfo => GetInfo(base.DefaultDataSourceName) ?? new DataSourceInfo(base.DefaultDataSourceName, null);

		protected void RaiseCollectionChanged()
		{
			deferredRaiseCollectionChanged = TryRaiseEvent(base.RaiseCollectionChangedCore);
		}

		protected void RaiseDataSourceChanged()
		{
			deferredRaiseDataSourceChanged = TryRaiseEvent(base.RaiseDataSourceChangedCore);
		}

		protected void RaiseCalculatedFieldAdding()
		{
			deferredRaiseCalculatedFieldAdding = TryRaiseEvent(base.RaiseCalculatedFieldAddingCore);
		}

		private bool TryRaiseEvent(Func<bool> raise)
		{
			if (updateCount == 0)
			{
				return raise();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeToEvents(DataSourceInfoCollection dataSources)
		{
			UnsubscribeFromEvents(dataSources);
			dataSources.CollectionChanged += OnCollectionChanged;
			dataSources.CalculatedFieldAdding += OnCalculatedFieldAdding;
			dataSources.DataSourceChanged += OnDataSourceChanged;
			dataSources.DataSourceRemoved += OnDataSourceRemoved;
			dataSources.DataSourceAdded += OnDataSourceAdded;
		}

		protected void UnsubscribeFromEvents(DataSourceInfoCollection dataSources)
		{
			dataSources.CollectionChanged -= OnCollectionChanged;
			dataSources.DataSourceChanged -= OnDataSourceChanged;
			dataSources.CalculatedFieldAdding -= OnCalculatedFieldAdding;
			dataSources.DataSourceRemoved -= OnDataSourceRemoved;
			dataSources.DataSourceAdded -= OnDataSourceAdded;
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDataSourceChanged(object sender, DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.DataSourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseDataSourceChanged();
		}

		private void OnCalculatedFieldAdding(object sender, CalculatedFieldEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Field.DataSourceDispatcher = this;
			UpdateCalculatedFields(e.Field);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCalculatedFields(CalculatedField field)
		{
		}

		private void OnDataSourceRemoved(object sender, DataSourceRemovedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields = e.DataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields;
			for (int i = 0; i < calculatedFields.Count; i++)
			{
				calculatedFields[i].DataSourceDispatcher = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnDataSourceAdded(object sender, DataSourceAddedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields = e.DataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields;
			for (int i = 0; i < calculatedFields.Count; i++)
			{
				calculatedFields[i].DataSourceDispatcher = this;
			}
		}

		public override void Initialize(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (initialized)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			initialized = true;
		}

		[GeneratedCode("Suppress FxCop check", "")]
		public override bool IsDefaultDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			DataSourceInfo info = GetInfo(dataSource);
			if (info == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.Equals(info.DataSourceName, "");
		}

		public override DataSourceInfo GetInfo(string dataSourceName)
		{
			foreach (DataSourceInfo info in GetInfos())
			{
				if (string.Equals(info.DataSourceName, dataSourceName))
				{
					return info;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override DataSourceInfo GetInfo(object dataSource)
		{
			foreach (DataSourceInfo info in GetInfos())
			{
				if (info.DataSource == dataSource)
				{
					return info;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override ICollection<ICalculatedField> GetCalculatedFields(object dataSource)
		{
			string text = FindDataSourceName(dataSource);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return new List<ICalculatedField>(0);
			}
			return GetCalculatedFields(text);
		}

		public override void BeginUpdate()
		{
			updateCount++;
		}

		public override void EndUpdate()
		{
			if (updateCount <= 0)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException("EndUpdate without BeginUpdate");
			}
			if (--updateCount == 0)
			{
				if (deferredRaiseCollectionChanged)
				{
					RaiseCollectionChangedCore();
				}
				if (deferredRaiseDataSourceChanged)
				{
					RaiseDataSourceChangedCore();
				}
				if (deferredRaiseCalculatedFieldAdding)
				{
					RaiseCalculatedFieldAddingCore();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ControlDataSourceDispatcher : CollectionBasedDataSourceDispatcher
	{
		private ISnapControl snapControl;

		private IErrorHandler errorHandler;

		private DataSourceInfoCollection documentDataSources;

		private DataSourceInfoCollection controlDataSources;

		private ICollection<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields;

		public override IErrorHandler ErrorHandler => errorHandler ?? new APIErrorHandler();

		internal ControlDataSourceDispatcher(ISnapControl snapControl)
			: this(snapControl.DataSources)
		{
			this.snapControl = snapControl;
			errorHandler = new UIErrorHandler(snapControl);
		}

		protected ControlDataSourceDispatcher(DataSourceInfoCollection dataSources)
		{
			controlDataSources = dataSources;
			SubscribeToEvents(controlDataSources);
		}

		protected override void OnDataSourceChanged(object sender, DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.DataSourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Reset();
			base.OnDataSourceChanged(sender, e);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Reset();
			base.OnCollectionChanged(sender, e);
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			calculatedFields = null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateCalculatedFields(CalculatedField field)
		{
			if (calculatedFields != null)
			{
				calculatedFields.Add((ICalculatedField)(object)field);
			}
			RaiseCalculatedFieldAdding();
		}

		public override void Initialize(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			base.Initialize(documentModel);
			documentDataSources = documentModel.DataSources;
			SubscribeToEvents(documentDataSources);
		}

		public override IDataSourceDispatcher CreateNew()
		{
			return new ControlDataSourceDispatcher(snapControl);
		}

		public override ICollection<object> GetDataSources()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>(documentDataSources.Count);
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo documentDataSource in documentDataSources)
			{
				object dataSource = documentDataSource.DataSource;
				if (dataSource != null)
				{
					list.Add(dataSource);
					hashSet.Add(documentDataSource.DataSourceName);
				}
			}
			foreach (DataSourceInfo controlDataSource in controlDataSources)
			{
				object dataSource2 = controlDataSource.DataSource;
				if (dataSource2 != null && !hashSet.Contains(controlDataSource.DataSourceName))
				{
					list.Add(dataSource2);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override object GetDataSource(string name)
		{
			object dataSourceByName = documentDataSources.GetDataSourceByName(name);
			if (dataSourceByName != null)
			{
				return dataSourceByName;
			}
			return controlDataSources.GetDataSourceByName(name);
		}

		public override ICollection<DataSourceInfo> GetInfos()
		{
			List<DataSourceInfo> list = new List<DataSourceInfo>();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo documentDataSource in documentDataSources)
			{
				if (documentDataSource.DataSource != null)
				{
					list.Add(documentDataSource);
					hashSet.Add(documentDataSource.DataSourceName);
				}
			}
			foreach (DataSourceInfo controlDataSource in controlDataSources)
			{
				if (controlDataSource.DataSource != null && !hashSet.Contains(controlDataSource.DataSourceName))
				{
					list.Add(controlDataSource);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CollectCalculatedFields()
		{
			calculatedFields = new List<ICalculatedField>();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			HashSet<string> hashSet2 = new HashSet<string>();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo documentDataSource in documentDataSources)
			{
				string dataSourceName = documentDataSource.DataSourceName;
				if (documentDataSource.DataSource != null)
				{
					foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in documentDataSource.CalculatedFields)
					{
						calculatedFields.Add((ICalculatedField)(object)calculatedField);
					}
					hashSet.Add(dataSourceName);
				}
				else
				{
					hashSet2.Add(dataSourceName);
				}
			}
			foreach (DataSourceInfo controlDataSource in controlDataSources)
			{
				string dataSourceName2 = controlDataSource.DataSourceName;
				if (hashSet.Contains(dataSourceName2) || controlDataSource.DataSource == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (hashSet2.Contains(dataSourceName2))
				{
					HashSet<string> hashSet3 = new HashSet<string>();
					foreach (CalculatedField item in documentDataSources.GetCalculatedFieldsByDataSourceName(dataSourceName2))
					{
						calculatedFields.Add((ICalculatedField)(object)item);
						hashSet3.Add(item.Name);
					}
					foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField2 in controlDataSource.CalculatedFields)
					{
						if (!hashSet3.Contains(calculatedField2.Name))
						{
							calculatedFields.Add((ICalculatedField)(object)calculatedField2);
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField3 in controlDataSource.CalculatedFields)
				{
					calculatedFields.Add((ICalculatedField)(object)calculatedField3);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string FindDataSourceName(object dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo documentDataSource in documentDataSources)
			{
				object dataSource2 = documentDataSource.DataSource;
				object bindingSourceDataSource = GetBindingSourceDataSource(dataSource2);
				string dataSourceName = documentDataSource.DataSourceName;
				if (dataSource2 == dataSource || bindingSourceDataSource == dataSource)
				{
					return dataSourceName;
				}
				if (dataSource2 != null)
				{
					hashSet.Add(dataSourceName);
				}
			}
			foreach (DataSourceInfo controlDataSource in controlDataSources)
			{
				object dataSource3 = controlDataSource.DataSource;
				object bindingSourceDataSource2 = GetBindingSourceDataSource(dataSource3);
				string dataSourceName2 = controlDataSource.DataSourceName;
				if ((dataSource3 == dataSource || bindingSourceDataSource2 == dataSource) && !hashSet.Contains(dataSourceName2))
				{
					return dataSourceName2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static object GetBindingSourceDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource is BindingSource bindingSource && string.IsNullOrEmpty(bindingSource.DataMember))
			{
				return bindingSource.DataSource;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override ICollection<ICalculatedField> GetCalculatedFields()
		{
			if (calculatedFields == null)
			{
				CollectCalculatedFields();
			}
			return calculatedFields;
		}

		public override ICollection<ICalculatedField> GetCalculatedFields(string dataSourceName)
		{
			List<ICalculatedField> list = new List<ICalculatedField>();
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = documentDataSources[dataSourceName];
			if (dataSourceInfo != null)
			{
				list.AddRange((IEnumerable<ICalculatedField>)dataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields);
			}
			if (dataSourceInfo == null || dataSourceInfo.DataSource == null)
			{
				DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo2 = controlDataSources[dataSourceName];
				if (dataSourceInfo2 != null)
				{
					HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
					foreach (CalculatedField item in list)
					{
						hashSet.Add(item.Name);
					}
					foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in dataSourceInfo2.CalculatedFields)
					{
						if (!hashSet.Contains(calculatedField.Name))
						{
							list.Add((ICalculatedField)(object)calculatedField);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override ICalculatedField GetCalculatedField(string dataSourceName, string calculatedFieldName)
		{
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = documentDataSources[dataSourceName];
			if (dataSourceInfo != null)
			{
				foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in dataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields)
				{
					if (string.Equals(calculatedField.Name, calculatedFieldName))
					{
						return (ICalculatedField)(object)calculatedField;
					}
				}
				if (dataSourceInfo.DataSource != null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo2 = controlDataSources[dataSourceName];
			if (dataSourceInfo2 != null)
			{
				foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField2 in dataSourceInfo2.CalculatedFields)
				{
					if (string.Equals(calculatedField2.Name, calculatedFieldName))
					{
						return (ICalculatedField)(object)calculatedField2;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void DisposeCore()
		{
			if (documentDataSources != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeFromEvents(documentDataSources);
				documentDataSources = null;
			}
			if (controlDataSources != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeFromEvents(controlDataSources);
				controlDataSources = null;
			}
		}

		protected override DataSourceInfo FindNullDataSource()
		{
			foreach (DataSourceInfo documentDataSource in documentDataSources)
			{
				if (documentDataSource.DataSource == null)
				{
					return documentDataSource;
				}
			}
			foreach (DataSourceInfo controlDataSource in controlDataSources)
			{
				if (controlDataSource.DataSource == null)
				{
					return controlDataSource;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class NativeMailMergeSorting : SnapListSorting, IList<SnapListGroupParam>, ICollection<SnapListGroupParam>, IEnumerable<SnapListGroupParam>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly GroupFieldInfoCollection innerList;

		public SnapListGroupParam this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(innerList[index]);
			}
			set
			{
				innerList[index] = SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(value);
			}
		}

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		bool ICollection<SnapListGroupParam>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public NativeMailMergeSorting(GroupFieldInfoCollection innerList)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)innerList, "innerList");
			this.innerList = innerList;
		}

		private GroupFieldInfo SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(SnapListGroupParam value)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new GroupFieldInfo(value.FieldName)
			{
				GroupInterval = value.Interval,
				SortOrder = value.SortOrder
			};
		}

		private SnapListGroupParam GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(GroupFieldInfo value)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new SnapListGroupParam(value.FieldName, value.SortOrder, value.GroupInterval);
		}

		public int IndexOf(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			return innerList.IndexOf(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			innerList.Insert(index, SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			innerList.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Add(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			innerList.Add(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			innerList.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			return innerList.Contains(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public void CopyTo(SnapListGroupParam[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int count = innerList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[arrayIndex + i] = GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(innerList[i]);
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(SnapListGroupParam item)
		{
			return innerList.Remove(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
		}

		public IEnumerator<SnapListGroupParam> GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < innerList.Count; i++)
			{
				yield return GroupFieldInfoToSnapListGroupParam(innerList[i]);
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<SnapListGroupParam> collection)
		{
			List<GroupFieldInfo> list = new List<GroupFieldInfo>();
			foreach (SnapListGroupParam item in collection)
			{
				list.Add(SnapListGroupParamToGroupFieldInfo(item));
			}
			innerList.AddRange(list);
		}
	}
	public class SnapFieldUpdater : FieldUpdater
	{
		public SnapFieldUpdater(PieceTable pieceTable)
			: base(pieceTable)
		{
		}

		public override List<Field> GetInnerCodeFields(IList<Field> fields, Field parentField)
		{
			List<Field> innerCodeFields = ((FieldUpdater)this).GetInnerCodeFields(fields, parentField);
			if (parentField == null || innerCodeFields.Count == 0)
			{
				return innerCodeFields;
			}
			SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
			if (!(((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField(((FieldUpdater)this).PieceTable, parentField) is TemplatedFieldBase templatedFieldBase))
			{
				return innerCodeFields;
			}
			List<TemplateFieldInterval> templateIntervals = templatedFieldBase.GetTemplateIntervals(((FieldUpdater)this).PieceTable);
			List<RunInfo> templateRunInfos = GetTemplateRunInfos(templateIntervals);
			for (int num = innerCodeFields.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (IsFieldInsideTemplate(innerCodeFields[num], templateRunInfos))
				{
					innerCodeFields.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			return innerCodeFields;
		}

		private List<RunInfo> GetTemplateRunInfos(List<TemplateFieldInterval> templateIntervals)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<RunInfo> list = new List<RunInfo>(templateIntervals.Count);
			int count = templateIntervals.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DocumentLogInterval interval = templateIntervals[i].Interval;
				RunInfo val = new RunInfo(((FieldUpdater)this).PieceTable);
				((FieldUpdater)this).PieceTable.CalculateRunInfoStart(interval.Start, val);
				((FieldUpdater)this).PieceTable.CalculateRunInfoEnd(interval.Start + interval.Length, val);
				list.Add(val);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool IsFieldInsideTemplate(Field field, List<RunInfo> templateRunInfos)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int count = templateRunInfos.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				RunInfo val = templateRunInfos[i];
				if (field.FirstRunIndex >= val.Start.RunIndex && field.LastRunIndex <= val.End.RunIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class SnapMailMergeHelper : MailMergeHelperBase
	{
		private SnapMailMergeStartedEventArgs startedArgs;

		public SnapDocumentModel SourceModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((MailMergeHelperBase)this).SourceModel;

		private RecordSeparator RecordSeparator => ((SnapMailMergeExportOptions)((MailMergeHelperBase)this).Options).RecordSeparator;

		protected override string OperationDescription => startedArgs.OperationDescription;

		public bool IsCancellationRequested
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(((MailMergeHelperBase)this).ProgressIndication is SnapMailMergeProgressIndication snapMailMergeProgressIndication))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return snapMailMergeProgressIndication.IsCancellationRequested;
			}
		}

		public SnapMailMergeHelper(SnapDocumentModel sourceModel, SnapMailMergeExportOptions options)
			: base((DocumentModel)(object)sourceModel, (IMailMergeOptions)options)
		{
		}

		public SnapMailMergeHelper(SnapDocumentModel sourceModel, SnapMailMergeExportOptions options, IProgressIndicationService progressIndication)
			: base((DocumentModel)(object)sourceModel, (IMailMergeOptions)options, progressIndication)
		{
		}

		protected override void BeforeRecordInserted(DocumentModel targetModel, bool firstRecord)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (firstRecord)
			{
				return;
			}
			PieceTable mainPieceTable = targetModel.MainPieceTable;
			DocumentLogPosition documentEndLogPosition = mainPieceTable.DocumentEndLogPosition;
			if (RecordSeparator == RecordSeparator.Custom)
			{
				mainPieceTable.InsertParagraph(documentEndLogPosition, true);
				if (((SnapMailMergeExportOptions)((MailMergeHelperBase)this).Options).CustomSeparator is SnapNativeDocument { PieceTable: var pieceTable })
				{
					((MailMergeHelperBase)this).UpdateFields((DocumentModel)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel);
					((MailMergeHelperBase)this).CopyFromIntermediateResult((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable, mainPieceTable);
					if (((SnapMailMergeExportOptions)((MailMergeHelperBase)this).Options).StartEachRecordFromNewParagraph)
					{
						mainPieceTable.InsertParagraph(mainPieceTable.DocumentEndLogPosition);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (RecordSeparator == RecordSeparator.None)
			{
				mainPieceTable.InsertParagraph(documentEndLogPosition);
			}
			else if (RecordSeparator == RecordSeparator.PageBreak)
			{
				mainPieceTable.InsertParagraph(documentEndLogPosition);
				mainPieceTable.InsertText(documentEndLogPosition + 1, new string('\f', 1), true);
			}
			else if (((MailMergeHelperBase)this).NewSectionInserted())
			{
				mainPieceTable.InsertParagraph(documentEndLogPosition, true);
				targetModel.InsertSection(documentEndLogPosition + 1, true);
			}
			else if (RecordSeparator == RecordSeparator.Paragraph)
			{
				mainPieceTable.InsertParagraph(documentEndLogPosition, true);
				mainPieceTable.InsertParagraph(documentEndLogPosition, true);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareRecordData(DocumentModel recordModel)
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)recordModel;
			snapDocumentModel.InheritDataServicesForMailMerge((DocumentModel)(object)SourceModel);
			snapDocumentModel.DataSources.MailMergeMode = true;
			snapDocumentModel.DataSources.MailMergeDataSourceName = ((IDataDispatcherOptions)((MailMergeHelperBase)this).Options).DataSourceName;
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareRecordResultCore(DocumentModel intermediateResult, IMailMergeDataService fieldDataService)
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)intermediateResult;
			IDataDispatcherOptions dataDispatcherOptions = (IDataDispatcherOptions)((MailMergeHelperBase)this).Options;
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = snapDocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(dataDispatcherOptions.DataSourceName);
			if (dataSourceInfo == null)
			{
				if (dataDispatcherOptions.DataSourceName != null)
				{
					snapDocumentModel.BeginUpdateDataSource();
					dataSourceInfo = snapDocumentModel.DataSources.Add(dataDispatcherOptions.DataSourceName, ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)dataDispatcherOptions).DataSource);
					snapDocumentModel.EndUpdateDataSource();
				}
				else
				{
					dataSourceInfo = snapDocumentModel.RegisterDataSource(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)dataDispatcherOptions).DataSource);
					if (dataDispatcherOptions is IDataSourceContainer dataSourceContainer)
					{
						dataSourceContainer.RegisterDataSource(dataSourceInfo.DataSourceName, dataSourceInfo.DataSource);
					}
					dataDispatcherOptions.DataSourceName = dataSourceInfo.DataSourceName;
				}
			}
			int currentRecordIndex = fieldDataService.GetCurrentRecordIndex();
			snapDocumentModel.SetRootDataContext(dataSourceInfo, dataDispatcherOptions, currentRecordIndex);
			((MailMergeHelperBase)this).PrepareRecordResultCore(intermediateResult, fieldDataService);
		}

		protected override void AfterRecordInserted(DocumentModel intermediateResult, DocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((MailMergeHelperBase)this).AfterRecordInserted(intermediateResult, targetModel);
			if (((MailMergeHelperBase)this).NewSectionInserted() && ((List<Section, SectionIndex>)(object)targetModel.Sections).Count > 1)
			{
				((List<Section, SectionIndex>)(object)targetModel.Sections).Last.GeneralSettings.StartType = CalcSectionStartType();
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool MailMergeRecord(DocumentModel targetModel, MailMergeDependencies dependencies, bool firstRecord)
		{
			if (!((MailMergeHelperBase)this).MailMergeRecord(targetModel, dependencies, firstRecord))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !IsCancellationRequested;
		}

		protected override DocumentModel CreateIntermediateResultModel(DocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			DocumentModel val = ((MailMergeHelperBase)this).CreateIntermediateResultModel(targetModel);
			val.DocumentImportOptions.CopyFrom(targetModel.DocumentImportOptions);
			return val;
		}

		protected override DocumentModelPosition CalculateTargetPosition(PieceTable target)
		{
			if (RecordSeparator == RecordSeparator.PageBreak || RecordSeparator == RecordSeparator.Custom)
			{
				return DocumentModelPosition.FromDocumentEnd(target);
			}
			return ((MailMergeHelperBase)this).CalculateTargetPosition(target);
		}

		private SectionStartType CalcSectionStartType()
		{
			return (SectionStartType)(RecordSeparator switch
			{
				RecordSeparator.SectionNextPage => 0, 
				RecordSeparator.SectionEvenPage => 2, 
				RecordSeparator.SectionOddPage => 1, 
				_ => 3, 
			});
		}

		protected internal override bool NewSectionInserted()
		{
			if (RecordSeparator != RecordSeparator.SectionEvenPage && RecordSeparator != RecordSeparator.SectionNextPage)
			{
				return RecordSeparator == RecordSeparator.SectionOddPage;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool RaiseMailMergeStarted(IMailMergeDataService fieldDataService, DocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			startedArgs = new SnapMailMergeStartedEventArgs((SnapDocumentModel)(object)targetModel);
			return SourceModel.RaiseSnapMailMergeStarted(startedArgs);
		}

		protected internal override bool RaiseMailMergeRecordStarted(IMailMergeDataService fieldDataService, DocumentModel targetModel, DocumentModel recordModel)
		{
			SnapMailMergeRecordStartedEventArgs e = new SnapMailMergeRecordStartedEventArgs((SnapDocumentModel)(object)targetModel, (SnapDocumentModel)(object)recordModel);
			e.RecordIndex = fieldDataService.GetCurrentRecordIndex();
			return SourceModel.RaiseSnapMailMergeRecordStarted(e);
		}

		protected internal override bool RaiseMailMergeRecordFinished(IMailMergeDataService fieldDataService, DocumentModel targetModel, DocumentModel recordModel)
		{
			SnapMailMergeRecordFinishedEventArgs e = new SnapMailMergeRecordFinishedEventArgs((SnapDocumentModel)(object)targetModel, (SnapDocumentModel)(object)recordModel);
			e.RecordIndex = fieldDataService.GetCurrentRecordIndex();
			return SourceModel.RaiseSnapMailMergeRecordFinished(e);
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseMailMergeFinished(IMailMergeDataService fieldDataService, DocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			SnapMailMergeFinishedEventArgs args = new SnapMailMergeFinishedEventArgs((SnapDocumentModel)(object)targetModel);
			SourceModel.RaiseSnapMailMergeFinished(args);
		}
	}
	public class SNChart : Chart
	{
		private readonly IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider displayNameProvider;

		private readonly IErrorHandler errorHandler;

		public static readonly Guid DefaultSeriesTag = new Guid("7639d2fe-3db1-4a4e-acbe-c3c8e0b00ba0");

		public static readonly string AutoGeneratedSeriesTag = "41b932e7-c365-4ae1-be71-202f315b2f06";

		public SNChart(IChartContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
			displayNameProvider = (IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider)base.Container.ServiceProvider.GetService(typeof(IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider));
			errorHandler = (IErrorHandler)container.ServiceProvider.GetService(typeof(IErrorHandler));
		}

		public bool IsEmpty()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.DataContainer.SeriesDataMember))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.DataContainer.Series.Count == 0;
		}

		public string GetChartDataSourceName()
		{
			return displayNameProvider.GetDataSourceName(base.Container.DataProvider.DataSource);
		}

		public SeriesDataBindingList GetSeriesDataBindings()
		{
			SeriesDataBindingList seriesDataBindingList = new SeriesDataBindingList();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DataContainer.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = base.DataContainer.Series[i];
				if (series.DataSource != null)
				{
					string dataSourceName = displayNameProvider.GetDataSourceName(series.DataSource);
					if (dataSourceName != null)
					{
						seriesDataBindingList.Add(dataSourceName, i);
					}
				}
			}
			return seriesDataBindingList;
		}

		public void SetSeriesDataBindings(IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher, SeriesDataBindingList bindings)
		{
			int count = base.DataContainer.Series.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < bindings.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesDataBinding seriesDataBinding = bindings[i];
				if (seriesDataBinding.SeriesIndex < count)
				{
					base.DataContainer.Series[seriesDataBinding.SeriesIndex].DataSource = dataSourceDispatcher.GetDataSourceOrDefault(seriesDataBinding.DataSourceName);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public void AssignChartDataSource(IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher, string dataSourceName)
		{
			object dataSourceOrDefault = dataSourceDispatcher.GetDataSourceOrDefault(dataSourceName);
			UpdateChartBinding(dataSourceOrDefault);
			base.DataContainer.DataSource = dataSourceOrDefault;
		}

		private void UpdateChartBinding(object dataSource)
		{
			if (DataSourceChanging(dataSource) && !Loading && !base.Container.DesignMode)
			{
				UpdateChartBindingCore(dataSource);
			}
		}

		private bool DataSourceChanging(object dataSource)
		{
			if (base.DataContainer.DataSource == null)
			{
				return dataSource != null;
			}
			return !base.DataContainer.DataSource.Equals(dataSource);
		}

		private void UpdateChartBindingCore(object dataSource)
		{
			if (!ValidateDataMember(dataSource, base.DataContainer.DataMember))
			{
				base.DataContainer.DataMember = string.Empty;
			}
			if (!ValidateSeriesDataMember(dataSource, base.DataContainer.SeriesDataMember))
			{
				base.DataContainer.SeriesDataMember = string.Empty;
			}
			UpdateSeriesBinding(base.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate, dataSource);
			foreach (Series item in base.DataContainer.Series)
			{
				if (item.DataSource == null)
				{
					UpdateSeriesBinding(item, dataSource);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesBinding(SeriesBase series, object dataSource)
		{
			string dataMember = SeriesDataBindingUtils.GetDataMember(series);
			if ((!(dataSource is IChartDataSource) || !base.DataContainer.PivotGridDataSourceOptions.AutoBindingSettingsEnabled) && !ValidateArgumentDataMember(dataSource, series.ArgumentDataMember, dataMember, series.ArgumentScaleType))
			{
				series.ArgumentDataMember = string.Empty;
			}
			int count = series.ValueDataMembers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!ValidateDataMember(dataSource, series.ValueDataMembers[i], dataMember, series.ValueScaleType))
				{
					series.ValueDataMembers[i] = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (!ValidateSummaryFunction(dataSource, dataMember, series.NumericSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction))
			{
				series.NumericSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction = string.Empty;
			}
			if (!ValidateSummaryFunction(dataSource, dataMember, series.DateTimeSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction))
			{
				series.DateTimeSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction = string.Empty;
			}
			if (!ValidateSummaryFunction(dataSource, dataMember, series.QualitativeSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction))
			{
				series.QualitativeSummaryOptions.SummaryFunction = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			if (dataSource == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(ContainerAdapter.DataContext, dataSource, dataMember);
		}

		private bool ValidateSeriesDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			if (dataSource == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(ContainerAdapter.DataContext, dataSource, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(base.DataContainer.DataMember, dataMember));
		}

		private bool ValidateArgumentDataMember(Series series, string dataMember)
		{
			return ValidateArgumentDataMember(SeriesDataBindingUtils.GetDataSource(series), dataMember, SeriesDataBindingUtils.GetDataMember(series), series.ArgumentScaleType, handleErrors: true);
		}

		private bool ValidateArgumentDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember, string chartDataMember, ScaleType argumentScaleType, bool handleErrors = false)
		{
			if (Loading || dataSource == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return true;
			}
			string text = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(chartDataMember, dataMember);
			DataContext dataContext = ContainerAdapter.DataContext;
			if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, text))
			{
				if (handleErrors)
				{
					errorHandler.HandleError(ErrorType.BindChartSeriesError);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, text, argumentScaleType))
			{
				if (handleErrors)
				{
					errorHandler.HandleError(new ExtendedErrorInfo(ErrorType.IncompatibleArgumentDataMember, new object[2] { text, argumentScaleType }));
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ValidateDataMember(object dataSource, string dataMember, string chartDataMember, ScaleType? scaleType, bool handleErrors = false)
		{
			string text = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(chartDataMember, dataMember);
			DataContext dataContext = ContainerAdapter.DataContext;
			if (!BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, text))
			{
				if (handleErrors)
				{
					errorHandler.HandleError(ErrorType.BindChartSeriesError);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (scaleType.HasValue && !BindingHelper.CheckDataMember(dataContext, dataSource, text, scaleType.Value))
			{
				if (handleErrors)
				{
					errorHandler.HandleError(new ExtendedErrorInfo(ErrorType.IncompatibleValueDataMember, new object[2] { text, scaleType.Value }));
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ValidateSummaryFunction(object dataSource, string chartDataMember, string functionString)
		{
			SummaryFunctionParser summaryFunctionParser = new SummaryFunctionParser(functionString);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryFunctionParser.FunctionName))
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < summaryFunctionParser.Arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!ValidateDataMember(dataSource, summaryFunctionParser.Arguments[i], chartDataMember, null))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void AddValues(SNDataInfo[] dataInfos)
		{
			string argumentDataMember = null;
			int count = base.DataContainer.Series.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Series series = base.DataContainer.Series[i];
				if (IsAutoGeneratedSeries(series))
				{
					argumentDataMember = series.ArgumentDataMember;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!CheckSeriesCompatible(argumentDataMember, dataInfos))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				Series series2 = base.DataContainer.Series[num];
				if (IsAutoGeneratedSeries(series2))
				{
					base.DataContainer.Series.Remove(series2);
				}
			}
			foreach (SNDataInfo sNDataInfo in dataInfos)
			{
				AddNewSeries(argumentDataMember, ((DataPair)sNDataInfo).Member, ((DataInfo)sNDataInfo).DisplayName, ((DataPair)sNDataInfo).Source);
			}
		}

		private bool CheckSeriesCompatible(string argumentDataMember, SNDataInfo[] infos)
		{
			if (infos.Length == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			object source = ((DataPair)infos[0]).Source;
			foreach (SNDataInfo sNDataInfo in infos)
			{
				if (!ValidateArgumentDataMember(source, argumentDataMember, base.DataContainer.DataMember, ScaleType.Auto, handleErrors: true))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ValidateDataMember(source, ((DataPair)sNDataInfo).Member, base.DataContainer.DataMember, ScaleType.Auto, handleErrors: true))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void AddArgument(SNDataInfo dataInfo)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			int count = base.DataContainer.Series.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Series series = base.DataContainer.Series[i];
				if (IsAutoGeneratedSeries(series))
				{
					if (!ValidateArgumentDataMember(series, ((DataPair)dataInfo).Member))
					{
						return;
					}
					flag = false;
					series.ArgumentDataMember = ((DataPair)dataInfo).Member;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				AddNewSeries(((DataPair)dataInfo).Member, null, null, ((DataPair)dataInfo).Source);
			}
		}

		public bool IsAutoGeneratedSeries(Series series)
		{
			return string.Equals(AutoGeneratedSeriesTag, series.Tag as string, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		private void AddNewSeries(string argumentDataMember, string valueDataMember, string name, object dataSource)
		{
			base.DataContainer.DataSource = dataSource;
			Series series = new Series();
			((ISupportInitialize)series).BeginInit();
			series.Name = name;
			if (valueDataMember != null)
			{
				series.ValueDataMembers.AddRange(valueDataMember);
			}
			series.ArgumentDataMember = argumentDataMember;
			series.Tag = AutoGeneratedSeriesTag;
			base.DataContainer.Series.Add(series);
			((ISupportInitialize)series).EndInit();
		}

		public List<string> GetUniqueValues()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (Series item in Enumerable.Cast<Series>(base.DataContainer.Series))
			{
				foreach (string valueDataMember in item.ValueDataMembers)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueDataMember))
					{
						list.Add(GetDisplayName(item.DataSource, valueDataMember));
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				SeriesBase seriesTemplate = base.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate;
				if (seriesTemplate != null)
				{
					foreach (string valueDataMember2 in seriesTemplate.ValueDataMembers)
					{
						if (seriesTemplate != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueDataMember2))
						{
							list.Add(GetDisplayName(base.DataContainer.DataSource, valueDataMember2));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list.Distinct().ToList();
		}

		public List<string> GetUniqueArguments()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (Series item in Enumerable.Cast<Series>(base.DataContainer.Series))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ArgumentDataMember))
				{
					list.Add(GetDisplayName(item.DataSource, item.ArgumentDataMember));
				}
			}
			list = list.Distinct().ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				SeriesBase seriesTemplate = base.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate;
				if (seriesTemplate != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesTemplate.ArgumentDataMember))
				{
					list.Add(GetDisplayName(base.DataContainer.DataSource, seriesTemplate.ArgumentDataMember));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private string GetDisplayName(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			DataBrowser dataBrowser = ((DataContextBase)ChartContainer.DataProvider.DataContext).GetDataBrowser(dataSource, dataMember, true);
			IRelatedDataBrowser val = (IRelatedDataBrowser)(object)((dataBrowser is IRelatedDataBrowser) ? dataBrowser : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			return val.RelatedProperty.DisplayName;
		}
	}

	public static class SparklineBindingHelper
	{
		public static string GetDataSourceNameFromDataInfo(SNDataInfo dataInfo, SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo, string sourceName)
		{
			string contextBinding = GetContextBinding(fieldInfo);
			string text = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceName) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(contextBinding)) ? string.Empty : $"/{sourceName}");
			if (dataInfo == null || dataInfo.DataPaths.Length <= 1)
			{
				return text;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < dataInfo.DataPaths.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				string text2 = dataInfo.DataPaths[i];
				text += (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? text2 : $".{text2}");
			}
			if (string.Equals(text, contextBinding))
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(contextBinding))
			{
				text = text.Substring(contextBinding.Length + 1);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string GetContextBinding(SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			if (fieldInfo == null || fieldInfo.Field == null || fieldInfo.Field.Parent == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			SnapListFieldInfo snapListFieldInfo = new SnapListFieldInfo(fieldInfo.PieceTable, fieldInfo.Field.Parent);
			DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(snapListFieldInfo.PieceTable.DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher, new SnapFieldInfo(snapListFieldInfo.PieceTable, snapListFieldInfo.Field));
			if (fieldDesignBinding == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return fieldDesignBinding.DataMember;
		}

		public static string GetDataFieldNameFromDataInfo(SNDataInfo dataInfo)
		{
			if (dataInfo == null || dataInfo.DataPaths.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return dataInfo.DataPaths[dataInfo.DataPaths.Length - 1];
		}
	}

		public HotZoneCollection HotZones
		{
			get
			{
				if (((List<HotZone>)(object)hotZones).Count == 0)
				{
					InitializeHotZones();
				}
				return hotZones;
			}

		private void InitializeHotZones()
		{
			if (!((LayoutItem)this).ActualSizeBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				float radius = CalculateRadius(((LayoutItem)this).ActualSizeBounds);
				PointF hotZoneCenter = GetHotZoneCenter(((LayoutItem)this).ActualSizeBounds, radius);
				((List<HotZone>)(object)hotZones).Add((HotZone)(object)new DropValuesSparklineHotZone(hotZoneCenter, radius));
			}
		}

		private float CalculateRadius(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int val = bounds.Height - 40;
			int val2 = (int)((float)bounds.Width * 0.5714286f);
			return Math.Min(val, val2) / 2;
		}

		private PointF GetHotZoneCenter(Rectangle bounds, float radius)
		{
			float y = bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2;
			float x = bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2;
			return new PointF
			{
				X = x,
				Y = y
			};
		}

		public override Box CreateBox()
		{
			return (Box)(object)new SparklineBox(pieceTable);
		}

		protected override void DecorateCore(IRunVisual run, Painter painter)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			using SparklineBoxHotZonePainter sparklineBoxHotZonePainter = new SparklineBoxHotZonePainter(painter);
			foreach (IRoundHotZone item in (List<HotZone>)(object)HotZones)
			{
				IRoundHotZone val = item;
				((IHotZone)val).Accept((IHotZoneVisitor)(object)sparklineBoxHotZonePainter);
			}
		}

		private SNSparklineField GetSparklineField(SparklineRun sparklineRun)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (sparklineRun == null)

				return null;
			}
			SnapPieceTable snapPieceTable = sparklineRun.PieceTable;
			FormatterPosition startPos = ((Box)this).StartPos;
			Field val = snapPieceTable.FindNonTemplateFieldByRunIndex(((FormatterPosition)(ref startPos)).RunIndex);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((FieldCalculatorService)new SnapFieldCalculatorService()).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)sparklineRun.PieceTable, val) as SNSparklineField;
		}

		protected internal virtual void Apply(DocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)targetModel).BeginUpdate();
			foreach (TableStyle tableStyle in TableStyles)
			{
				TableStyle styleByName = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableStyle>)(object)targetModel.TableStyles).GetStyleByName(((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)tableStyle).StyleName);
				if (styleByName != null)
				{
					((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)styleByName).CopyProperties(tableStyle);
					styleByName.ConditionalStyleProperties.CopyFrom(tableStyle.ConditionalStyleProperties);
				}
				else
				{
					((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)tableStyle).Copy(targetModel);
				}
			}
			foreach (TableCellStyle tableCellStyle in TableCellStyles)
			{
				TableCellStyle styleByName2 = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)targetModel.TableCellStyles).GetStyleByName(((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)tableCellStyle).StyleName);
				if (styleByName2 != null)
				{
					((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)styleByName2).CopyProperties(tableCellStyle);
				}
				else
				{
					((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)tableCellStyle).Copy(targetModel);
				}
			}
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)targetModel).EndUpdate();
		}

		public void Apply()
		{
			if (!EnsureThemeLoaded())
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(string.Format(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.Msg_ThemeIsNotLoaded), Name));
			}
			Apply((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
		}

		private void LoadDefaultTheme(ThemeInfo info)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)info, "info");
			BeginLoadTheme();
			try
			{
				Theme theme = ((DXCollection<Theme>)(object)info.SourceModel.Themes)[0];
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
				{
					Name = theme.Name;
					defaultName = theme.Name;
				}
				CopyFrom(theme);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndLoadTheme();
			}
		}

		public void Load(Stream content)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)content, "content");
			BeginLoadTheme();
			try
			{
				LoadCore(content);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndLoadTheme();
			}
		}

		private void BeginLoadTheme()
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).History.DisableHistory();
		}

		private void EndLoadTheme()
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).History.EnableHistory();
			version = 0;
		}

		private void LoadCore(Stream content)
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = new SnapDocumentModel(createDefaultStyles: false, DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.CreateNew(), ((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).DocumentFormatsDependencies);
			try
			{
				lock (content)
				{
					if (content.CanSeek)
					{
						content.Position = 0L;
					}
					ImportThemeCore(content, snapDocumentModel);
				}
				Theme theme = ((DXCollection<Theme>)(object)snapDocumentModel.Themes)[0];
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
				{
					Name = theme.Name;
					defaultName = theme.Name;
				}
				CopyFrom(theme);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDocumentModel)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void Actualize(DocumentModel sourceModel)
		{
			if (!EnsureThemeLoaded())
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(string.Format(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.Msg_ThemeIsNotLoaded), Name));
			}
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				int num = Version;
				BeginThemeChangeTracking();
				foreach (TableStyle tableStyle in TableStyles)
				{
					TableStyle styleByName = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableStyle>)(object)sourceModel.TableStyles).GetStyleByName(((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)tableStyle).StyleName);
					if (styleByName != null)
					{
						((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)tableStyle).CopyProperties(styleByName);
						tableStyle.ConditionalStyleProperties.CopyFrom(styleByName.ConditionalStyleProperties);
					}
				}
				foreach (TableCellStyle tableCellStyle in TableCellStyles)
				{
					TableCellStyle styleByName2 = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)sourceModel.TableCellStyles).GetStyleByName(((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)tableCellStyle).StyleName);
					if (styleByName2 != null)
					{
						((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)tableCellStyle).CopyProperties(styleByName2);
					}
				}
				EndThemeChangeTracking();
				if (num != Version && !SuppressUpdateIcon)
				{
					Icon = CreateIcon();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void BeginThemeChangeTracking()
		{
			DocumentModelChangeTracker.BeginTracking((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
		}

		private void EndThemeChangeTracking()
		{
			DocumentModelChangeTracker.EndTracking((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
			if (DocumentModelChangeTracker.IsChanged)
			{
				ChangeThemeVersionHistoryItem changeThemeVersionHistoryItem = new ChangeThemeVersionHistoryItem(this);
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).History.Add((HistoryItem)(object)changeThemeVersionHistoryItem);
				((HistoryItem)(object)changeThemeVersionHistoryItem).Execute();
			}
		}

		internal OfficeImage CreateIcon()
		{
			return OfficeImage.CreateImage(ThemeHelper.CreateBitmapForTheme(this));
		}

		private void SetName(string newName)
		{
			ChangeThemeNameHistoryItem changeThemeNameHistoryItem = new ChangeThemeNameHistoryItem(this);
			changeThemeNameHistoryItem.NewName = newName;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).History.Add((HistoryItem)(object)changeThemeNameHistoryItem);
			((HistoryItem)(object)changeThemeNameHistoryItem).Execute();
		}

		internal void SetIcon(OfficeImage icon, bool suppressUpdateIcon)
		{
			UpdateThemeIconHistoryItem updateThemeIconHistoryItem = new UpdateThemeIconHistoryItem(this, icon, suppressUpdateIcon);
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).History.Add((HistoryItem)(object)updateThemeIconHistoryItem);
			((HistoryItem)(object)updateThemeIconHistoryItem).Execute();
		}

		internal void IncreaseVersion()
		{
			version++;
		}

		internal void DecreaseVersion()
		{
			version--;
		}

		internal void SetNameCore(string newName)
		{
			name = newName;
			OnPropertyChanged("Name");
		}

		internal void SetIconCore(OfficeImage image)
		{
			icon = image;
		}

		public void Save(Stream outputStream)
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = new SnapDocumentModel(createDefaultStyles: false, DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.CreateNew(), ((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).DocumentFormatsDependencies);
			try
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)snapDocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					Theme theme = Clone(snapDocumentModel);
					((DXCollectionBase<Theme>)(object)snapDocumentModel.Themes).Add(theme);
				}
				finally
				{
					((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)snapDocumentModel).EndUpdate();
				}
				ExportThemeCore(outputStream, snapDocumentModel);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDocumentModel)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void CopyFrom(Theme theme)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)theme, "theme");
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Clear();
				Icon = theme.CreateIconClone((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
				foreach (TableStyle tableStyle in theme.TableStyles)
				{
					TableStyles.Add(CopyTableStyle(tableStyle));
				}
				foreach (TableCellStyle tableCellStyle in theme.TableCellStyles)
				{
					TableCellStyles.Add(CopyTableCellStyle(tableCellStyle));
				}
				isLoaded = theme.IsLoaded;
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private OfficeImage CreateIconClone(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (Icon == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lock (Icon)
			{
				return Icon.Clone((IDocumentModel)documentModel);
			}
		}

		private TableStyle CopyTableStyle(TableStyle source)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			TableStyle val = new TableStyle((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
			((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)val).StyleName = ((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)source).StyleName;
			((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)val).CopyProperties(source);
			if (source.HasConditionalStyleProperties)
			{
				val.ConditionalStyleProperties.CopyFrom(source.ConditionalStyleProperties);
			}
			if (((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)source).Parent != null)
			{
				TableStyle val2 = TableStyles.Find((TableStyle style) => ((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)style).StyleName == ((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)source).Parent).StyleName);
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					val2 = CopyTableStyle(((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)source).Parent);
					TableStyles.Add(val2);
				}
				((StyleBase<TableStyle>)(object)val).Parent = val2;
			}
			source.ApplyPropertiesDiff(val);
			return val;
		}

		private TableCellStyle CopyTableCellStyle(TableCellStyle source)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			TableCellStyle val = new TableCellStyle((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);
			((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)val).CopyProperties(source);
			((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)val).StyleName = ((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)source).StyleName;
			if (((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)source).Parent != null)
			{
				TableCellStyle val2 = TableCellStyles.Find((TableCellStyle style) => ((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)style).StyleName == ((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)source).Parent).StyleName);
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					val2 = CopyTableCellStyle(((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)source).Parent);
					TableCellStyles.Add(val2);
				}
				((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)val).Parent = val2;
			}
			source.ApplyPropertiesDiff(val);
			return val;
		}

		internal static void ImportThemeCore(Stream stream, SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			SnapImporter snapImporter = new SnapImporter(documentModel, new SnapDocumentImporterOptions());
			((OpenXmlImporter)snapImporter).Import(stream, true);
		}

		private void ExportThemeCore(Stream stream, SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			SnapExporter snapExporter = new SnapExporter(documentModel, new SnapDocumentExporterOptions());
			((OpenXmlExporter)snapExporter).Export(stream);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			TableCellStyles.Clear();
			TableStyles.Clear();
			IsLoaded = false;
			version = 0;
		}

		public bool EnsureThemeLoaded()
		{
			if (!IsLoaded)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(NativeName))
				{
					Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				}
				ThemeInfo themeByName = ThemeRepository.GetThemeByName(NativeName);
				if (themeByName != null)
				{
					LoadDefaultTheme(themeByName);
				}
			}
			return IsLoaded;
		}

		public void RestoreDefaults()
		{
			if (!IsDefault || !IsModified)
			{
				return;
			}
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Clear();
				Name = defaultName;
				ThemeInfo themeByName = ThemeRepository.GetThemeByName(NativeName);
				if (themeByName != null)
				{
					LoadCore(themeByName.Content);
				}
				else
				{
					Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && icon != null)
			{
				icon.Dispose();
				icon = null;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public Theme Clone()
		{
			return Clone(DocumentModel);
		}

		private Theme Clone(SnapDocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			Theme theme = new Theme(targetModel, Name, isDefault: false, NativeName);
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)targetModel).History.DisableHistory();
			try
			{
				theme.CopyFrom(this);
				return theme;
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)targetModel).History.EnableHistory();
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (onPropertyChanged != null)
			{
				onPropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
	public static class DocumentModelChangeTracker
	{
		private static int historyItemsCount = -1;

		public static bool IsChanged { get; set; }

		public static void BeginTracking(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			historyItemsCount = GetHistoryItemsCount(documentModel);
		}

		public static void EndTracking(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			int num = GetHistoryItemsCount(documentModel);
			IsChanged = historyItemsCount >= 0 && historyItemsCount < num;
			historyItemsCount = -1;
		}

		private static int GetHistoryItemsCount(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.Transaction?.Count ?? ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.Count;
		}
	}
	public class ThemeCollection : NotificationCollection<Theme>
	{
		public Theme GetThemeByName(string name)
		{
			return ((DXCollectionBase<Theme>)(object)this).Find((Predicate<Theme>)((Theme theme) => theme.Name == name));
		}

		public bool Contains(string themeName)
		{
			return GetThemeByName(themeName) != null;
		}
	}
	public class ThemeInfo : IDisposable
	{
		private SnapDocumentModel sourceModel;

		public string Name { get; private set; }

		public string Caption { get; private set; }

		public string Hint { get; private set; }

		public Stream Content { get; private set; }

		public SnapDocumentModel SourceModel
		{
			get
			{
				if (sourceModel == null)
				{
					LoadTheme();
				}
				return sourceModel;
			}
		}

		public ThemeInfo(string name, string caption, string hint, Stream content)
		{
			Name = name;
			Caption = caption;
			Hint = hint;
			Content = content;
		}

		private void LoadTheme()
		{
			lock (Content)
			{
				if (sourceModel == null)
				{
					SnapDocumentModel documentModel = new SnapDocumentModel(createDefaultStyles: false, new ServerDataSourceDispatcher(), SnapDocumentFormatsDependecies.CreateDocumentFormatsDependencies());
					if (Content.CanSeek)
					{
						Content.Position = 0L;
					}
					Theme.ImportThemeCore(Content, documentModel);
					sourceModel = documentModel;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Content.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public static class ThemeRepository
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, ThemeInfo> themeInfos = CreateDefaultThemes();

		public static ICollection<ThemeInfo> ThemeInfos => themeInfos.Values;

		private static void LoadDefaultTheme(Dictionary<string, ThemeInfo> list, string themeFile, string name, string caption)
		{
			Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(SnapDocumentModel).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(themeFile);
			ThemeInfo value = new ThemeInfo(name, caption, caption, manifestResourceStream);
			list[name] = value;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, ThemeInfo> CreateDefaultThemes()
		{
			Dictionary<string, ThemeInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ThemeInfo>();
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.Casual.snt", "Casual", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_Casual));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.ContrastCyan.snt", "Contrast Cyan", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_ContrastCyan));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.ContrastOrange.snt", "Contrast Orange", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_ContrastOrange));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.ContrastRed.snt", "Contrast Red", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_ContrastRed));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.FormalBlue.snt", "Formal Blue", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_FormalBlue));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.MildBrown.snt", "Mild Brown", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_MildBrown));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.MildCyan.snt", "Mild Cyan", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_MildCyan));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.MildViolet.snt", "Mild Violet", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_MildViolet));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.MildBlue.snt", "Mild Blue", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_MildBlue));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.ContrastSalmon.snt", "Contrast Salmon", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_ContrastSalmon));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.SoftLilac.snt", "Soft Lilac", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_SoftLilac));
			LoadDefaultTheme(dictionary, "DevExpress.Snap.Themes.DodgerBlue.snt", "Dodger Blue", SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ThemeName_DodgerBlue));
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static ThemeInfo GetThemeByName(string name)
		{
			themeInfos.TryGetValue(name, out var value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	public static class ThemeHelper
	{
		public static DXBitmap CreateBitmapForTheme(Theme theme)
		{
			Color headerFooterColor = GetHeaderFooterColor(theme, "List1-Header", "List1-Footer");
			Color headerFooterColor2 = GetHeaderFooterColor(theme, "List1-GroupHeader1", "List1-GroupFooter1");
			Color headerFooterColor3 = GetHeaderFooterColor(theme, "List2-Header", "List2-Footer");
			Color headerFooterColor4 = GetHeaderFooterColor(theme, "List2-GroupHeader2", "List2-GroupFooter2");
			return CreateBitmap(headerFooterColor, headerFooterColor2, headerFooterColor3, headerFooterColor4);
		}

		private static Color GetHeaderFooterColor(Theme theme, string headerStyleName, string footerStyleName)
		{
			Color result = GetTableCellStyleBackgroundColor(theme, headerStyleName);
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = GetTableCellStyleBackgroundColor(theme, footerStyleName);
				if (result.IsEmpty)
				{
					result = Color.White;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static Color GetTableCellStyleBackgroundColor(Theme theme, string styleName)
		{
			TableCellStyle val = theme.TableCellStyles.Find((TableCellStyle s) => ((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)s).StyleName == styleName);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return ColorHelper.GetCellBackgroundColor(val.TableCellProperties);
			}
			return Color.Empty;
		}

		private static DXBitmap CreateBitmap(Color list1HFColor, Color list1GroupHF1Color, Color list2HFColor, Color listGroup2HFColor)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(65, 46);
			using DXGraphics dXGraphics = DXGraphics.FromImage(dXBitmap);
			dXGraphics.FillRectangle(new DXSolidBrush(list1HFColor), new RectangleF(0f, 0f, 65f, 10f));
			dXGraphics.FillRectangle(new DXSolidBrush(list1GroupHF1Color), new RectangleF(0f, 11f, 65f, 11f));
			dXGraphics.FillRectangle(new DXSolidBrush(list2HFColor), new RectangleF(0f, 23f, 65f, 10f));
			dXGraphics.FillRectangle(new DXSolidBrush(listGroup2HFColor), new RectangleF(0f, 34f, 65f, 11f));
			return dXBitmap;
		}
	}
	public class ChangeActiveThemeHistoryItem : RichEditHistoryItem
	{
		private Theme newActiveTheme;

		private Theme oldActiveTheme;

		public Theme NewActiveTheme
		{
			get
			{
				return newActiveTheme;
			}
			set
			{
				newActiveTheme = value;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((RichEditHistoryItem)this).DocumentModel;

		public ChangeActiveThemeHistoryItem(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base((PieceTable)(object)documentModel.ActivePieceTable)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			oldActiveTheme = DocumentModel.ActiveTheme;
			DocumentModel.ActiveTheme = NewActiveTheme;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			DocumentModel.ActiveTheme = oldActiveTheme;
		}
	}
	public class AddThemeHistoryItem : RichEditHistoryItem
	{
		private Theme addedTheme;

		public SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((RichEditHistoryItem)this).DocumentModel;

		public Theme AddedTheme
		{
			get
			{
				return addedTheme;
			}
			set
			{
				addedTheme = value;
			}
		}

		public AddThemeHistoryItem(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base((PieceTable)(object)documentModel.ActivePieceTable)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			((DXCollectionBase<Theme>)(object)DocumentModel.Themes).Add(AddedTheme);
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			((DXCollectionBase<Theme>)(object)DocumentModel.Themes).Remove(addedTheme);
		}
	}

		{

				return removedTheme;

				removedTheme = value;
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void RedoCore()

			((DXCollectionBase<Theme>)(object)DocumentModel.Themes).Remove(removedTheme);
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()

		}
	}
	public class UpdateThemeIconHistoryItem : RichEditHistoryItem
	{
		private OfficeImage oldIcon;

		private OfficeImage newIcon;

		private bool oldSuppressUpdateIcon;

		private bool newSuppressUpdateIcon;

		private Theme theme;

		public UpdateThemeIconHistoryItem(Theme theme, OfficeImage icon, bool suppressUpdateIcon)
			: base((PieceTable)(object)theme.DocumentModel.ActivePieceTable)
		{
			newIcon = icon;
			newSuppressUpdateIcon = suppressUpdateIcon;
			this.theme = theme;
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			oldIcon = theme.Icon;
			oldSuppressUpdateIcon = theme.SuppressUpdateIcon;
			theme.SetIconCore(newIcon);
			theme.SuppressUpdateIcon = newSuppressUpdateIcon;
			theme.IncreaseVersion();
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			theme.SetIconCore(oldIcon);
			theme.SuppressUpdateIcon = oldSuppressUpdateIcon;
			theme.DecreaseVersion();
		}
	}
	public class ChangeThemeVersionHistoryItem : RichEditHistoryItem
	{
		private readonly Theme theme;

		public ChangeThemeVersionHistoryItem(Theme theme)
			: base((PieceTable)(object)theme.DocumentModel.MainPieceTable)
		{
			this.theme = theme;
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			theme.IncreaseVersion();
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			theme.DecreaseVersion();
		}
	}
	public class ChangeThemeNameHistoryItem : RichEditHistoryItem
	{
		private readonly Theme theme;

		private string oldName;

		public string NewName { get; set; }

		public ChangeThemeNameHistoryItem(Theme theme)
			: base((PieceTable)(object)theme.DocumentModel.MainPieceTable)
		{
			this.theme = theme;
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			oldName = theme.Name;
			theme.SetNameCore(NewName);
			theme.IncreaseVersion();
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			theme.SetNameCore(oldName);
			theme.DecreaseVersion();
		}
	}

	public class DataContextService : DataContextServiceBase
	{
		private readonly SnapDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider dataSourceDisplayNameProvider;

		protected override IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> CalculatedFields => documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields();

		public DataContextService(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			SubscribeDataSourceDispatcherEvents();
			dataSourceDisplayNameProvider = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)this.documentModel).GetService<IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider>();
		}

		private void SubscribeDataSourceDispatcherEvents()
		{
			documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.DataSourceChanged += OnDataSourceChanged;
			documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.CollectionChanged += OnDataSourceChanged;
			documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.CalculatedFieldAdding += OnCalculatedFieldAdding;
		}

		private void OnDataSourceChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((DataContextServiceBase)this).DisposeDataContext();
		}

		private void OnCalculatedFieldAdding(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (DataContext value in base.dictionary.Values)
			{
				DataContext obj = ((value is XRDataContextBase) ? value : null);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					((XRDataContextBase)obj).ResetCalculatedFieldsApplied();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override DataContext CreateDataContextInternal(DataContextOptions options)
		{
			if (!((DataContextOptions)(ref options)).UseCalculatedFields)
			{
				return (DataContext)(object)new SnapDataContext(dataSourceDisplayNameProvider);
			}
			return (DataContext)(object)new SnapDataContext(((DataContextServiceBase)this).CalculatedFields, documentModel.Parameters, dataSourceDisplayNameProvider);
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			UnsubscribeDataSourceDispatcherEvents();
			((DataContextServiceBase)this).Dispose();
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDataSourceDispatcherEvents()
		{
			IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher = documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher;
			if (dataSourceDispatcher != null)
			{
				dataSourceDispatcher.DataSourceChanged -= OnDataSourceChanged;
				dataSourceDispatcher.CollectionChanged -= OnDataSourceChanged;
				dataSourceDispatcher.CalculatedFieldAdding -= OnCalculatedFieldAdding;
			}
		}
	}

			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FieldCollection fields = ((ParagraphFinalFormatter)this).PieceTable.Fields;
			int count = fields.Count;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				int highlightedFieldIndex = GetHighlightedFieldIndex(i);
				if (highlightedFieldIndex >= 0)
				{
					Field val = fields[highlightedFieldIndex];
					if (val.LastRunIndex < startRunIndex || val.FirstRunIndex > endRunIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					CalculateFieldHighlightArea(row, bounds, startRunIndex, endRunIndex, val);
					i = highlightedFieldIndex;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearFieldsCache(RunIndex endRunIndex)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FieldCollection fields = ((ParagraphFinalFormatter)this).PieceTable.Fields;

			}
		}

		private void CalculateFieldHighlightArea(Row row, Rectangle tightRowBounds, RunIndex startRunIndex, RunIndex endRunIndex, Field field)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RunIndex val = Algorithms.Max<RunIndex>(startRunIndex, field.FirstRunIndex);
			RunIndex val2 = Algorithms.Min<RunIndex>(endRunIndex, field.LastRunIndex);
			Color highlightColor = ((FieldOptions)DocumentModel.FieldOptions).HighlightColor;
			HighlightArea val3 = ((ParagraphFinalFormatter)this).CreateFieldHighlightAreaCore(row, val, val2, tightRowBounds, highlightColor);
			if (val3 != null)
			{
				((List<HighlightArea>)(object)row.FieldHighlightAreas).Add(val3);
			}
		}

		private int GetHighlightedFieldIndex(int index)
		{
			FieldCollection fields = ((ParagraphFinalFormatter)this).PieceTable.Fields;
			int result = -1;
			while (true)
			{
				Field val = fields[index];
				if (!ShouldHightlightField(val))
				{
					break;
				}
				result = index;
				if (val.Parent == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				index = FindParentFieldIndex(val, index);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int FindParentFieldIndex(Field child, int index)
		{
			do
			{
				index++;
			}
			while (((ParagraphFinalFormatter)this).PieceTable.Fields[index] != child.Parent);
			return index;
		}

		private CalculatedFieldBase GetCalculatedField(Field field)
		{
			if (!calculatedFieldsCache.TryGetValue(field, out var value))
			{
				value = CalculateField(field);
				calculatedFieldsCache.Add(field, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private bool ShouldHightlightField(Field field)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)((FieldOptions)DocumentModel.FieldOptions).HighlightMode != 2)
			{
				return DocumentModel.HighlightedField == field;
			}
			return ShouldHightlightField(GetCalculatedField(field));
		}

		private bool ShouldHightlightField(CalculatedFieldBase calculatedField)
		{
			return !(calculatedField is SNListField);
		}

		private CalculatedFieldBase CalculateField(Field field)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			FieldCalculatorService val = new FieldCalculatorService();
			return val.ParseField(((ParagraphFinalFormatter)this).PieceTable, field);
		}
	}
