	public delegate void ChangeFieldAction<U>(InstructionController controller, U newValue);
	public interface IFieldChanger
	{
		void ApplyNewValue<U>(ChangeFieldAction<U> changeFieldAction, U newValue);

		void ApplyNewValue(Action<InstructionController> changeFieldAction);
	}
	public class FieldChanger : IFieldChanger
	{
		private readonly IFieldInfo fieldInfo;

		private readonly IParsedInfoProvider parsedInfoProvider;

		private SnapPieceTable PieceTable => fieldInfo.PieceTable;

		private Field Field => fieldInfo.Field;

		public FieldChanger(IFieldInfo fieldInfo, IParsedInfoProvider parsedInfoProvider)
		{
			this.fieldInfo = fieldInfo;
			this.parsedInfoProvider = parsedInfoProvider;
		}

		public void ApplyNewValue<U>(ChangeFieldAction<U> changeFieldAction, U newValue)
		{
			InstructionController controller = BeginUpdateFieldCode();
			try
			{
				changeFieldAction(controller, newValue);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdateFieldCode(controller);
			}
		}

		public void ApplyNewValue(Action<InstructionController> changeFieldAction)
		{
			InstructionController val = BeginUpdateFieldCode();
			try
			{
				changeFieldAction(val);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdateFieldCode(val);
			}
		}

		private InstructionController CreateInstructionController()
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CalculatedFieldBase parsedInfo = parsedInfoProvider.GetParsedInfo();
			if (parsedInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new InstructionController(Field, parsedInfo);
		}

		private InstructionController BeginUpdateFieldCode()
		{
			return CreateInstructionController();
		}

		private void EndUpdateFieldCode(InstructionController controller)
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)PieceTable.DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				controller.ApplyDeferredActions();
				parsedInfoProvider.InvalidateParsedInfo();
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)PieceTable.DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}
	}
	internal delegate bool FilterAction(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator);
	public static class FilterStringHelper
	{
		private class FilterStringVisitor : ICriteriaVisitor
		{
			private readonly FilterAction action;

			public bool Result { get; private set; }

			public FilterStringVisitor(FilterAction action)
			{
				this.action = action;
			}

			public void Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				Result = action(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			}

			public void Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
			{
				Result = action(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)[0]);
			}

			public void Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
			{
				Result = action(theOperator.TestExpression);
			}

			public void Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				Result = action(theOperator.Operand);
			}

			public void Visit(InOperator theOperator)
			{
				Result = action(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			}

			public void Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
			}
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator GetOrFilterString(string dataFieldName, IEnumerable<string> values)
		{
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (values == null || !values.Any())
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string value in values)
			{
				list.Add(EscapeString(value));
			}
			if (list.Count <= 2)
			{
				List<CriteriaOperator> criteriaOperators = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
				list.ForEach(delegate(string e)
				{
					//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
					criteriaOperators.Add((CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(dataFieldName, e));
				});
				return (CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)1, (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)criteriaOperators);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(dataFieldName, (IEnumerable)list);
		}

		private static string EscapeString(string val)
		{
			return val.Replace("'", "''");
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ModifyFilterString(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria, IEnumerable<string> values, string dataFieldName)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return filterCriteria;
			}
			CriteriaOperator orFilterString = GetOrFilterString(dataFieldName, values);
			return ModifyFilterStringCore(filterCriteria, orFilterString, dataFieldName);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ModifyFilterString(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria, CriteriaOperator newFilterCriteria, string dataFieldName)
		{
			return ModifyFilterStringCore(filterCriteria, newFilterCriteria, dataFieldName);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ModifyFilterString(string filterString, IEnumerable<string> values, string dataFieldName)
		{
			return ModifyFilterString(CriteriaOperator.Parse(filterString, new object[0]), values, dataFieldName);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ModifyFilterString(string filterString, CriteriaOperator newfilterCriteria, string dataFieldName)
		{
			return ModifyFilterString(CriteriaOperator.Parse(filterString, new object[0]), newfilterCriteria, dataFieldName);
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator ModifyFilterStringCore(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria, CriteriaOperator newFilterCriteria, string dataFieldName)
		{
			CriteriaOperator filterStringWithoutPropertyName = GetFilterStringWithoutPropertyName(filterCriteria, dataFieldName);
			if (filterStringWithoutPropertyName != null)
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.And(filterStringWithoutPropertyName, newFilterCriteria);
			}
			return newFilterCriteria;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator GetFilterStringWithoutPropertyName(CriteriaOperator filterString, string propertyNameToIgnore)
		{
			return GetFilterStringCore(filterString, delegate(CriteriaOperator s)
			{
				//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				FilterAction filterAction = (CriteriaOperator o) => o is OperandProperty && ((OperandProperty)o).PropertyName != propertyNameToIgnore;
				if (s is GroupOperator)
				{
					foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((GroupOperator)s).Operands)
					{
						if (item is GroupOperator)
						{
							return true;
						}
						FilterStringVisitor filterStringVisitor = new FilterStringVisitor(filterAction);
						item.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)filterStringVisitor);
						if (filterStringVisitor.Result)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					return false;
				}
				return filterAction(s);
			});
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetFilterStringOnlyWithPropertyName(string filterString, string propertyName)
		{
			return GetFilterStringCore(CriteriaOperator.Parse(filterString, new object[0]), (CriteriaOperator s) => s is OperandProperty && ((OperandProperty)s).PropertyName == propertyName);
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator GetFilterStringCore(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator, FilterAction action)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (criteriaOperator != null)
			{
				GroupOperator val = (GroupOperator)(object)((criteriaOperator is GroupOperator) ? criteriaOperator : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					GroupOperatorType operatorType = val.OperatorType;
					List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
					foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val.Operands)
					{
						if (item is GroupOperator && action(item))
						{
							list.Add(item);
							continue;
						}
						FilterStringVisitor filterStringVisitor = new FilterStringVisitor(action);
						item.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)filterStringVisitor);
						if (filterStringVisitor.Result)
						{
							if ((int)operatorType == 1)
							{
								return (CriteriaOperator)(object)val;
							}
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					if ((int)operatorType != 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return CriteriaOperator.And((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list);
				}
				FilterStringVisitor filterStringVisitor2 = new FilterStringVisitor(action);
				criteriaOperator.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)filterStringVisitor2);
				if (filterStringVisitor2.Result)
				{
					return criteriaOperator;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class FilterItem
	{
		public bool? IsChecked { get; set; }

		public object Value { get; set; }

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string displayValue = GetDisplayValue();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayValue))
			{
				return base.ToString();
			}
			return displayValue;
		}

		private string GetDisplayValue()
		{
			if (Value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			char[] array = Value.ToString().ToCharArray();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != '\n' || array[i] == '\r')
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(array[i]);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

			return GetUniqueFilteredValues(filteredValuesAccessor, fieldName, -1, roundDataTime: false, null);
		}

		public static IEnumerable<FilterItem> GetUniqueFilteredValues(IUniqueFilteredValuesAccessor filteredValuesAccessor, string fieldName, int maxCount, bool roundDataTime, OperationCompleted completed)
		{
			IEnumerable<object> uniqueFilteredValues = filteredValuesAccessor.GetUniqueFilteredValues(fieldName, maxCount, includeFilteredOut: true, roundDataTime, completed);
			List<FilterItem> list = new List<FilterItem>();
			if (uniqueFilteredValues == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (object item in uniqueFilteredValues)
			{
				list.Add(new FilterItem
				{
					Value = item,
					IsChecked = false
				});
			}
			IEnumerable<object> filteredValues = filteredValuesAccessor.GetUniqueFilteredValues(fieldName, maxCount, includeFilteredOut: false, roundDataTime, completed);
			if (filteredValues != null)
			{
				list.ForEach(delegate(FilterItem item)
				{
					if (filteredValues.Contains(item.Value))
					{
						item.IsChecked = true;
					}
				});
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

		{

			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)a == null || (object)b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EqualsCore(a, b);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(GroupField a, GroupField b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is GroupField b))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EqualsCore(this, b);
		}

		private static bool EqualsCore(GroupField a, GroupField b)
		{
			if (a.SortOrder != b.SortOrder)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((object)a.designBinding).Equals((object)b.designBinding);
		}

	public static class DesignBindingHelper
	{
		public static string GetDataMember(SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo, DesignBinding designBinding)
		{
			return GetDataMember(new SnapListFieldInfo(fieldInfo.PieceTable, fieldInfo.Field.Parent), designBinding);
		}

		public static string GetDataMember(SnapListFieldInfo listFieldInfo, DesignBinding designBinding)
		{
			DesignBinding fieldDesignBinding = FieldsHelper.GetFieldDesignBinding(listFieldInfo.PieceTable.DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher, new SnapFieldInfo(listFieldInfo.PieceTable, listFieldInfo.Field));
			string text = designBinding.DataMember;
			if (fieldDesignBinding != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldDesignBinding.DataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text.StartsWith(fieldDesignBinding.DataMember))
			{
				text = designBinding.DataMember.Substring(fieldDesignBinding.DataMember.Length + 1);
			}
			SnapMailMergeVisualOptions snapMailMergeVisualOptions = listFieldInfo.PieceTable.DocumentModel.SnapMailMergeVisualOptions;
			if (((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataSource == designBinding.DataSource && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text.StartsWith(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember))
			{
				text = text.Substring(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)snapMailMergeVisualOptions).DataMember.Length + 1);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string GetDataMember(string path, out string fieldName)
		{
			int num = path.LastIndexOf(".");
			fieldName = ((num > 0) ? path.Substring(num + 1, path.Length - num - 1) : path);
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return path.Substring(0, num);
		}

		public static string GetListName(DataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			string fieldName;
			DataBrowser dataBrowser = ((DataContextBase)dataContext).GetDataBrowser(dataSource, GetDataMember(dataMember, out fieldName), true);
			if (dataBrowser == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return dataBrowser.GetListName();
		}

		private bool AreSelectedBookmarksChanged(List<SnapBookmark> newSelectedBookmarks)
		{

			{
				return false;
			}

		private SnapBookmark FindCommonParentBookmark(SnapBookmark startBookmark, SnapBookmark endBookmark)
		{
			if (startBookmark == endBookmark)
			{
				return startBookmark;
			}
			List<SnapBookmark> list = new List<SnapBookmark>();
			for (SnapBookmark snapBookmark = startBookmark; snapBookmark != null; snapBookmark = snapBookmark.Parent)
			{
				list.Add(snapBookmark);
			}
			for (SnapBookmark snapBookmark = endBookmark; snapBookmark != null; snapBookmark = snapBookmark.Parent)
			{
				if (list.Contains(snapBookmark))
				{
					return snapBookmark;
				}
			}

		}

		private void ProcessLeavedBookmarks(SnapBookmark currentBookmark, bool suppressUpdate, bool force)
		{
			bool saveSelection = true;
			bool flag = false;
			Stack<EnteredBookmarkInfo> enteredBookmarks = EnteredBookmarks;
			List<EnteredBookmarkInfo> list = EnteredBookmarksLeaves;
			foreach (EnteredBookmarkInfo item in list)
			{
				if (ShouldLeaveBookmark(item.Bookmark, currentBookmark))
				{
					if (OnBookmarkLeave(item, saveSelection, suppressUpdate, force))
					{
						saveSelection = false;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				list.Clear();
			}
			if (!flag && list.Count != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (enteredBookmarks.Count > 0 && ShouldLeaveBookmark(enteredBookmarks.Peek().Bookmark, currentBookmark))
			{
				EnteredBookmarkInfo bookmarkInfo = enteredBookmarks.Peek();
				if (OnBookmarkLeave(bookmarkInfo, saveSelection, suppressUpdate, force))
				{
					saveSelection = false;
				}
				enteredBookmarks.Pop();
			}
		}

		}

		internal void ProcessEnteredBookmarks(SnapBookmark currentBookmark)
		{
			if (currentBookmark != null)
			{
				if (EnteredBookmarksLeaves.Count == 1 && (EnteredBookmarks.Count == 0 || EnteredBookmarksLeaves[0].Bookmark.Parent == EnteredBookmarks.Peek().Bookmark))
				{
					EnteredBookmarks.Push(EnteredBookmarksLeaves[0]);
					EnteredBookmarksLeaves.Clear();
				}
				Stack<SnapBookmark> stack = new Stack<SnapBookmark>();
				Stack<EnteredBookmarkInfo> enteredBookmarks = EnteredBookmarks;
				SnapBookmark snapBookmark = ((enteredBookmarks.Count > 0) ? enteredBookmarks.Peek().Bookmark : null);
				while (currentBookmark != snapBookmark)
				{
					stack.Push(currentBookmark);
					currentBookmark = currentBookmark.Parent;
				}
				while (stack.Count > 0)
				{
					SnapBookmark bookmark = stack.Pop();
					enteredBookmarks.Push(new EnteredBookmarkInfo(bookmark));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessEnteredBookmarks(IEnumerable<SnapBookmark> selectedBookmarks)
		{
			foreach (SnapBookmark selectedBookmark in selectedBookmarks)
			{
				EnteredBookmarksLeaves.Add(new EnteredBookmarkInfo(selectedBookmark));
			}
		}

	public class EnteredBookmarkInfo : IDisposable, ICloneable<EnteredBookmarkInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<EnteredBookmarkInfo>
	{

		public bool Modified => modificationTracker.Modified;

		private EnteredBookmarkInfo()
		{
		}

		public EnteredBookmarkInfo(SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)bookmark, "bookmark");
			this.bookmark = bookmark;
			modificationTracker = ((SnapDocumentHistory)(object)((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((DocumentInterval)bookmark).DocumentModel).History).CreateModificationTracker();
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (modificationTracker != null)
				{
					modificationTracker.Dispose();
					modificationTracker = null;
				}
				bookmark = null;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{

					ref T reference = ref parsedInfo;
					CalculatedFieldBase obj = ((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable, field);
					reference = (T)(object)((obj is T) ? obj : null);
				}
				return parsedInfo;
			}
		}

			: this(pieceTable, field, default(T))
		{
		}

	public class EnumHelper
	{
		private ResourceManager resourceManager;

		private Type enumType;

		public EnumHelper(Type enumType)
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ResFinder);
			string text = "PropertyNamesRes";
			resourceManager = new ResourceManager(typeFromHandle.Namespace + "." + text, typeFromHandle.Assembly);
			this.enumType = enumType;
		}

		internal static string GetResourceName(object enumValue)
		{
			return enumValue.GetType().FullName + "." + enumValue;
		}

		public string ConvertTo(object enumValue)
		{
			return resourceManager.GetString(GetResourceName(enumValue));
		}

		public object ConvertFrom(string value)
		{
			if (enumType.BaseType != typeof(Enum))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (object enumValue in enumType.GetEnumValues())
			{
				string a = ConvertTo(enumValue);
				if (string.Equals(a, value))
				{
					return enumValue;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		public bool IsTableCellLastInTemplateBookmark(TableCell cell)
		{

			}

		}

	public class SnapCopyManager : DocumentModelCopyManager
	{
		private SnapDocumentModel TargetModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((DocumentModelCopyManager)this).TargetModel;

		public SnapCopyManager(PieceTable sourcePieceTable, PieceTable targetPieceTable, ParagraphNumerationCopyOptions paragraphNumerationCopyOptions, FormattingCopyOptions formattingCopyOptions)
			: base(sourcePieceTable, targetPieceTable, paragraphNumerationCopyOptions, formattingCopyOptions)
		{
		}//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		public override void CopyAdditionalInfo(bool copyBetweenInternalModels)
		{
			if (copyBetweenInternalModels || !(((DocumentModelCopyManager)this).SourceModel is SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DataSourceInfo dataSource in snapDocumentModel.DataSources)
			{
				DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = TargetModel.DataSources[dataSource.DataSourceName];
				if (dataSourceInfo == null)
				{
					dataSourceInfo = TargetModel.DataSources.Add(dataSource.DataSourceName, dataSource.DataSource);
					foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in dataSource.CalculatedFields)
					{
						dataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields.Add(calculatedField.Clone());
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (dataSourceInfo.DataSource != dataSource.DataSource)
					{
						continue;
					}
					HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(dataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields.Select((CalculatedField field) => field.Name));
					foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField2 in dataSource.CalculatedFields)
					{
						if (!hashSet.Contains(calculatedField2.Name))
						{
							dataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields.Add(calculatedField2.Clone());
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertParagraph(Paragraph sourceParagraph)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((List<TextRunBase, RunIndex>)(object)((DocumentModelCopyManager)this).SourcePieceTable.Runs)[sourceParagraph.LastRunIndex] is NonEditableParagraphRun)
			{
				((DocumentModelCopyManager)this).TargetPieceTable.InsertNonEditableParagraph(((DocumentModelCopyManager)this).TargetPosition.LogPosition);
			}
			else
			{
				((DocumentModelCopyManager)this).TargetPieceTable.InsertParagraph(((DocumentModelCopyManager)this).TargetPosition.LogPosition);
			}
		}

		protected internal string[] GetListNames()
		{
			List<string> listNames = new List<string>();
			((PieceTable)MainPieceTable).Fields.ForEach((Action<Field>)delegate(Field field)
			{
				SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
				if (((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)MainPieceTable, field) is SNListField sNListField && !listNames.Contains(sNListField.Name))
				{
					listNames.Add(sNListField.Name);
				}
			});
			return listNames.ToArray();
		}

		protected internal string GetListName(List<string> listNames, string dataSourceName)
		{
			string baseName = dataSourceName;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceName) && DataSources.DefaultDataSourceInfo.DataSource != null)
			{
				baseName = DataSources.DefaultDataSourceInfo.DataSource.GetType().Name;
			}
			return NameHelper.GetName(listNames, baseName);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateFields()
		{
			foreach (PieceTable pieceTable in ((DocumentModel)this).GetPieceTables(false))
			{
				pieceTable.FieldUpdater.UpdateFields((UpdateFieldOperationType)4);
			}
			ForceSelectionLeaveFieldResultEnd();
		}

		private void ForceSelectionLeaveFieldResultEnd()
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DocumentModelPosition start = ((DocumentModel)this).Selection.Interval.Start;
			RunIndex runIndex = start.RunIndex;
			if (((List<TextRunBase, RunIndex>)(object)((DocumentModel)this).Selection.PieceTable.Runs)[runIndex] is FieldResultEndRun)
			{
				IVisibleTextFilter visibleTextFilter = ((DocumentModel)this).Selection.PieceTable.VisibleTextFilter;
				DocumentLogPosition nextVisibleLogPosition = visibleTextFilter.GetNextVisibleLogPosition(start, false);
				((DocumentModel)this).Selection.Start = nextVisibleLogPosition;
				((DocumentModel)this).Selection.End = nextVisibleLogPosition;
			}
		}

		public void LoadTheme(Stream content)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)content, "content");
			Theme theme = new Theme(this);
			theme.Load(content);
			if (!theme.IsLoaded)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("content", content);
			}
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				AddTheme(theme);
				ApplyTheme(theme);
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal void AddTheme(Theme theme)
		{
			if (Themes.Contains(theme.Name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.Msg_CollectionAlreadyContainsTheme), theme.Name));
			}
			AddThemeCore(theme);
		}

		private void AddThemeCore(Theme theme)
		{
			AddThemeHistoryItem addThemeHistoryItem = new AddThemeHistoryItem(this);
			addThemeHistoryItem.AddedTheme = theme;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History.Add((HistoryItem)(object)addThemeHistoryItem);
			((HistoryItem)(object)addThemeHistoryItem).Execute();
		}

		public void ApplyTheme(string themeName)
		{
			Theme themeByName = Themes.GetThemeByName(themeName);
			if (themeByName == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("themeName", themeName);
			}
			ApplyTheme(themeByName);
		}

		private void GenerateDefaultThemes()
		{
			((NotificationCollection<Theme>)Themes).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				foreach (ThemeInfo themeInfo in ThemeRepository.ThemeInfos)
				{
					Theme theme = new Theme(this, themeInfo.Caption, isDefault: true, themeInfo.Name);
					((DXCollectionBase<Theme>)(object)Themes).Add(theme);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((NotificationCollection<Theme>)Themes).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void SaveCurrentTheme(Stream stream)
		{
			SaveCurrentTheme(stream, null);
		}

		public void SaveCurrentTheme(Stream stream, string newName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)stream, "stream");
			Theme theme = ((ActiveTheme != null) ? ActiveTheme : Themes.GetThemeByName(SnapControlCompatibility.DefaultReportThemeName));
			if (theme == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			using Theme theme2 = theme.Clone();
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History.DisableHistory();
			try
			{
				theme2.Actualize((DocumentModel)(object)this);
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History.EnableHistory();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(newName))
			{
				theme2.Name = newName;
				theme2.NativeName = newName;
			}
			theme2.Save(stream);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetDefaultTheme()
		{
			Theme themeByName = Themes.GetThemeByName(SnapControlCompatibility.DefaultReportThemeName);
			if (themeByName == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isHistoryDisabled = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History.IsHistoryDisabled;
			if (!isHistoryDisabled)
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History.DisableHistory();
			}
			try
			{
				using (new HistoryTransaction(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History))
				{
					themeByName.Apply();
					ChangeActiveTheme(null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!isHistoryDisabled)
				{
					((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History.EnableHistory();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreDefaults(Theme theme)
		{
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				theme.RestoreDefaults();
				if (theme == ActiveTheme)
				{
					ChangeActiveTheme(null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyTheme(Theme theme)
		{
			using (new HistoryTransaction(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History))
			{
				theme.Apply();
				ChangeActiveTheme(theme);
			}
		}

		private void ChangeActiveTheme(Theme theme)
		{
			ChangeActiveThemeHistoryItem changeActiveThemeHistoryItem = new ChangeActiveThemeHistoryItem(this);
			changeActiveThemeHistoryItem.NewActiveTheme = theme;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History.Add((HistoryItem)(object)changeActiveThemeHistoryItem);
			((HistoryItem)(object)changeActiveThemeHistoryItem).Execute();
		}

		public void RemoveTheme(Theme theme)
		{
			if (theme == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (new HistoryTransaction(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)this).History))
			{
				if (theme == ActiveTheme)
				{
					ChangeActiveTheme(null);
				}
				RemoveThemeCore(theme);
			}
		}

			((HistoryItem)(object)removeThemeHistoryItem).Execute();
		}

		}

		internal bool IsDefaultStyle(string styleName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsDefaultListStyle(styleName))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (styleName.StartsWith("Header"))
			{
				return IsAllDigits(styleName.Substring("Header".Length));
			}
			if (styleName.StartsWith("Footer"))
			{
				return IsAllDigits(styleName.Substring("Footer".Length));
			}
			if (styleName.StartsWith("GroupHeader"))
			{
				return IsAllDigits(styleName.Substring("GroupHeader".Length));
			}
			if (styleName.StartsWith("GroupFooter"))
			{
				return IsAllDigits(styleName.Substring("GroupFooter".Length));
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int GetDefaultListStyleNameLevel(string styleName)
		{
			if (!IsDefaultListStyle(styleName))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return Convert.ToInt32(styleName.Substring("List".Length));
		}

		private bool IsDefaultListStyle(string styleName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (styleName.StartsWith("List"))
			{
				return IsAllDigits(styleName.Substring("List".Length));
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsAllDigits(string source)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < source.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!char.IsDigit(source[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal void SetMailMergeRootDataContext()
		{
			if (SnapMailMergeVisualOptions != null && SnapMailMergeVisualOptions.DataSourceName != null)
			{

		}

		{
			SetRootDataContextCore(CreateRootDataContext(info, options, currentRecordIndex));
		}

		internal IFieldContext CreateRootDataContext(DataSourceInfo info, IDataDispatcherOptions options, int currentRecordIndex)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ListFieldContext listFieldContext = CreateListContext(info.DataSourceName, options);
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)this).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			IFieldContextService fieldContextService = service.FieldContextService;
			DataControllerCalculationContext dataControllerCalculationContext = fieldContextService.BeginCalculation(DataSourceDispatcher) as DataControllerCalculationContext;
			try
			{
				if (dataControllerCalculationContext == null)
				{
					listFieldContext.Root.Dispose();
					return null;
				}
				SnapListController listController = dataControllerCalculationContext.GetListController(listFieldContext);
				if (listController == null)
				{
					listFieldContext.Root.Dispose();
					return null;
				}
				int visibleIndex = listController.GetVisibleIndex(currentRecordIndex);
				return new SingleListItemFieldContext(listFieldContext, visibleIndex, currentRecordIndex, currentRecordIndex + 1);
			}
			finally
			{
				fieldContextService.EndCalculation(dataControllerCalculationContext);
			}
		}

		private ListFieldContext CreateListContext(string dataSourceName, IDataDispatcherOptions options)
		{
			ISingleObjectFieldContext parent = new SnapMailMergeRootFieldContext(DataSourceDispatcher, dataSourceName, ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)options).DataMember);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IDataSourceContainerOptions)options).DataMember))
			{
				parent = new SimplePropertyFieldContext(parent, ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)options).DataMember);
			}
			List<GroupProperties> groups = MailMergeParamsConverter.ConvertToGroupPropertiesList(options.Sorting);
			FilterProperties filters = MailMergeParamsConverter.ConvertToFilterProperties(options.FilterString);
			return new ListFieldContext(parent, new ListParameters(groups, filters));
		}

		private void InheritDataServicesCore(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			((DocumentModel)this).InheritDataServices(documentModel);
			((DocumentModel)this).InheritService<IFieldDataService>((IServiceContainer)documentModel);
			((DocumentModel)this).InheritService<IFieldCalculatorService>((IServiceContainer)documentModel);

		private void InheritDataSources(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)documentModel;
			UnsubscribeDataSourcesEvents();
			InheritDataSourcesForMailMerge(documentModel);
			SubscribeDataSourcesEvents();
			if (dataSourceDispatcher != snapDocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher)
			{
				SetDataSourceDispatcher(snapDocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher);
			}
		}

		private void SetDataSourceDispatcher(IDataSourceDispatcher newDataSourceDispatcher)
		{
			ReleaseDataSourceDispatcher();
			dataSourceDispatcher = newDataSourceDispatcher;
			if (dataSourceDispatcher != null)
			{
				dataSourceDispatcher.Capture();
				snapMailMergeVisualOptions.SubscribeDataSourceEvents();
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseDataSourceDispatcher()
		{
			if (dataSourceDispatcher != null)
			{
				snapMailMergeVisualOptions.UnsubscribeDataSourceEvents();
				dataSourceDispatcher.Release();
			}
		}

		private void InheritDataSourcesForMailMerge(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)documentModel;
			fDataSources.Clear();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo dataSource in snapDocumentModel.DataSources)
			{
				fDataSources.Add(dataSource.Clone());
			}
		}

			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			foreach (SnapPieceTable pieceTable in ((DocumentModel)this).GetPieceTables(false))

				InsertFieldController insertFieldController = new InsertFieldController(pieceTable, (SnapPieceTable)(object)destination, pos);

		protected internal void AddParameterWithReplace(DevExpress.Snap.Core.API.Parameter item)
		{
			int count = Parameters.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (Parameters[i].Name == item.Name)
				{
					Parameters.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
			Parameters.Add(item);
		}

		public ICollection<CalculatedField> GetCalculatedFieldsByDataSourceName(string dataSourceName, bool createDataSourceIfNotExists)
		{
			DataSourceInfo info = DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(dataSourceName);
			if (info == null && !createDataSourceIfNotExists)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICollection<CalculatedField> calculatedFields = info.CalculatedFields;
			if (calculatedFields != null || !createDataSourceIfNotExists)
			{
				return calculatedFields;
			}
			info = new DataSourceInfo(dataSourceName, null);
			DataSources.Add(info);
			return info.CalculatedFields;
		}

		protected override void DisposeCore()
		{

		}

		public DataSourceInfo GetNotNullDocumentModelDataSourceInfo(string name)
		{
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = DataSources[name];

				dataSourceInfo = DataSources.Add(name, null);

		}

		public DataSourceInfo RegisterDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			BeginUpdateDataSource();
			try
			{
				string text = $"{DefaultDataSourceName} {dataSourceNameIndex}";
				while (DataSourceDispatcher.GetDataSource(text) != null)
				{
					dataSourceNameIndex++;
					text = $"{DefaultDataSourceName} {dataSourceNameIndex}";
				}
				DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = new DataSourceInfo(text, dataSource);
				DataSources.Add(dataSourceInfo);
				return dataSourceInfo;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdateDataSource();
			}
		}

		internal bool HasNonEmptyDataSource()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < DataSources.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!DataSources[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal string GetNewDataSourceName(string oldName)
		{
			int num = 1;
			string text;
			do
			{
				text = oldName + "_" + num;
				num++;
			}
			while (ShouldChangeDataSourceName(text));
			return text;
		}

		internal bool ShouldChangeDataSourceName(string dataSourceName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < DataSources.Count; i++)
			{
				if (DataSources[i].DataSourceName == dataSourceName)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void FillSqlDataSource(SqlDataSource dataSource)
		{
			FillSqlDataSource(dataSource, Parameters);
		}

		internal void FillSqlDataSource(SqlDataSource dataSource, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			dataSource.ValidateCustomSqlQuery += ValidateCustomSqlQuery;
			dataSource.CustomizeFilterExpression += CustomizeFilterExpression;
			try
			{
				dataSource.Fill(parameters);
			}
			finally
			{
				dataSource.ValidateCustomSqlQuery -= ValidateCustomSqlQuery;
				dataSource.CustomizeFilterExpression -= CustomizeFilterExpression;
			}
		}

		private void ValidateCustomSqlQuery(object sender, ValidateCustomSqlQueryEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidateSqlEventArgs e2 = new ValidateSqlEventArgs(e.CustomSqlQuery);
			e2.Valid = e.Valid;
			e2.Message = e.ExceptionMessage;
			RaiseValidateCustomSql(e2);
			e.ExceptionMessage = e2.Message;
			e.Valid = e2.Valid;
		}

		private void CustomizeFilterExpression(object sender, CustomizeFilterExpressionEventArgs e)
		{
			SqlDataSource sqlDataSource = (SqlDataSource)sender;
			CustomFilterExpressionEventArgs e2 = new CustomFilterExpressionEventArgs(sqlDataSource.Site?.Name, sqlDataSource.Name, e.QueryName);
			e2.FilterExpression = e.FilterExpression;
			RaiseCustomFilterExpression(e2);
			e.FilterExpression = e2.FilterExpression;
		}

		internal void FillExcelDataSource(ExcelDataSource dataSource)
		{
			FillExcelDataSource(dataSource, Parameters);
		}

		internal void FillExcelDataSource(ExcelDataSource dataSource, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			dataSource.BeforeFill += OnBeforeFillExcelDataSource;
			try
			{
				dataSource.Fill(parameters);
			}
			finally
			{
				dataSource.BeforeFill -= OnBeforeFillExcelDataSource;
			}
		}

		private void OnBeforeFillExcelDataSource(object sender, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.BeforeFillEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseBeforeFillExcelDataSoure(e);
		}

		}

	public static class MailMergeParamsConverter
	{
		public static List<GroupProperties> ConvertToGroupPropertiesList(SnapListSorting sorting)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<GroupProperties> list = new List<GroupProperties>();
			for (int i = 0; i < sorting.Count; i++)
			{
				GroupProperties groupProperties = new GroupProperties();
				SnapListGroupParam snapListGroupParam = sorting[i];
				GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo = groupProperties.AddField(snapListGroupParam.FieldName);
				groupFieldInfo.SortOrder = snapListGroupParam.SortOrder;
				groupFieldInfo.GroupInterval = snapListGroupParam.Interval;
				list.Add(groupProperties);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static FilterProperties ConvertToFilterProperties(string filterString)
		{
			FilterProperties filterProperties = new FilterProperties();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterString))
			{
				filterProperties.AddFilter(filterString);
			}
			return filterProperties;
		}
	}

		protected internal override bool RaiseDocumentClosing()
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = DocumentModel.HasNonEmptyDataSource();
			DocumentDataSources interimDataSources = new DocumentDataSources(DocumentModel);
			if (onDocumentClosing != null)
			{
				DocumentClosingEventArgs e = new DocumentClosingEventArgs(interimDataSources);
				onDocumentClosing(this, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (e.Handled)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag && Owner is ISnapControl snapControl)
			{
				PortableDialogResult val = snapControl.ShowDataSourceSaveForm();
				if ((int)val == 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)val == 7)
				{
					docDataSources = null;
					return true;
				}
			}
			SaveDataSources(interimDataSources);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseEmptyDocumentCreated()
		{
			((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)this).RaiseEmptyDocumentCreated();
			DocumentImportedEventArgs e = new DocumentImportedEventArgs(docDataSources);
			if (onEmptyDocumentCreated != null)
			{
				onEmptyDocumentCreated(this, e);
			}
			LoadDataSource(e.InterimDataSources);
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseDocumentLoaded()
		{
			((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)this).RaiseDocumentLoaded();
			DocumentImportedEventArgs e = new DocumentImportedEventArgs(docDataSources);
			if (onDocumentLoaded != null)
			{
				onDocumentLoaded(this, e);
			}
			LoadDataSource(e.InterimDataSources);
		}

		private void SaveDataSources(DocumentDataSources interimDataSources)
		{
			docDataSources = new DocumentDataSources();
			for (int i = 0; i < interimDataSources.DataSources.Count; i++)
			{
				if (interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSource != null)
				{
					docDataSources.DataSources.AddWithReplace(interimDataSources.DataSources[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadDataSource(DocumentDataSources interimDataSources)
		{
			if (interimDataSources == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < interimDataSources.DataSources.Count; i++)
			{
				if (interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSource != null)
				{
					if (!DocumentModel.ShouldChangeDataSourceName(interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSourceName))
					{
						DocumentModel.DataSources.AddWithReplace(interimDataSources.DataSources[i]);
						continue;
					}
					string newDataSourceName = DocumentModel.GetNewDataSourceName(interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSourceName);

	public class SnapMouseCursorCalculator : MouseCursorCalculator
	{
		private readonly InnerSnapControl innerControl;

		public SnapMouseCursorCalculator(InnerSnapControl innerControl, RichEditView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			this.innerControl = innerControl;
		}

		public override IPortableCursor Calculate(RichEditHitTestResultCore hitTestResult, Point physicalPoint)
		{
			ILayoutUIElementViewInfo activeUIElementViewInfo = GetActiveUIElementViewInfo(innerControl, hitTestResult);
			if (activeUIElementViewInfo == null)
			{
				return ((MouseCursorCalculator)this).Calculate(hitTestResult, physicalPoint);
			}
			return activeUIElementViewInfo.GetCursor();
		}

		protected internal override IPortableCursor CalculateHotZoneCursorCore(HotZone hotZone)
		{
			if (FieldsHelper.IsNotResizableField(hotZone))
			{
				return RichEditCursors.Default;
			}
			return ((MouseCursorCalculator)this).CalculateHotZoneCursorCore(hotZone);
		}

		private ILayoutUIElementViewInfo GetActiveUIElementViewInfo(InnerSnapControl innerControl, RichEditHitTestResultCore hitTestResult)
		{
			foreach (ILayoutUIElementViewInfo activeUIElementViewInfo in innerControl.ActiveUIElementViewInfos)
			{
				if (activeUIElementViewInfo.HitTest(hitTestResult))
				{
					return activeUIElementViewInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		protected internal override bool RaiseDocumentClosing()
		{
			if (onDocumentClosing != null)
			{
				DocumentDataSources interimDataSources = new DocumentDataSources(DocumentModel);
				DocumentClosingEventArgs e = new DocumentClosingEventArgs(interimDataSources);
				onDocumentClosing(this, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (e.Handled)
				{
					SaveDataSources(e.InterimDataSources);
				}
				else
				{
					docDataSources = null;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseEmptyDocumentCreated()
		{
			((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)this).RaiseEmptyDocumentCreated();
			DocumentImportedEventArgs e = new DocumentImportedEventArgs(docDataSources);
			if (onEmptyDocumentCreated != null)
			{
				onEmptyDocumentCreated(this, e);
			}
			LoadDataSource(e.InterimDataSources);
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseDocumentLoaded()
		{
			((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)this).RaiseDocumentLoaded();
			DocumentImportedEventArgs e = new DocumentImportedEventArgs(docDataSources);
			if (onDocumentLoaded != null)
			{
				onDocumentLoaded(this, e);
			}
			LoadDataSource(e.InterimDataSources);
		}

		private void SaveDataSources(DocumentDataSources interimDataSources)
		{
			docDataSources = new DocumentDataSources();
			for (int i = 0; i < interimDataSources.DataSources.Count; i++)
			{
				if (interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSource != null)
				{
					docDataSources.DataSources.AddWithReplace(interimDataSources.DataSources[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadDataSource(DocumentDataSources interimDataSources)
		{
			if (interimDataSources == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < interimDataSources.DataSources.Count; i++)
			{
				if (interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSource != null)
				{
					if (!DocumentModel.ShouldChangeDataSourceName(interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSourceName))
					{
						DocumentModel.DataSources.AddWithReplace(interimDataSources.DataSources[i]);
						continue;
					}
					string newDataSourceName = DocumentModel.GetNewDataSourceName(interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSourceName);
					DocumentModel.DataSources.Add(new DataSourceInfo(newDataSourceName, interimDataSources.DataSources[i].DataSource));
				}
			}
		}

		public void SnapMailMerge(SnapMailMergeExportOptions options, string fileName, DocumentFormat format)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			using FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.Read);
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).CreateNew();
			try
			{
				CalculateDocumentVariableEventRouter val = new CalculateDocumentVariableEventRouter((DocumentModel)(object)DocumentModel);

				SnapMailMerge(options, snapDocumentModel);
				InnerRichEditDocumentServer.SaveDocumentCore((DocumentModel)(object)snapDocumentModel, (Stream)fileStream, format, fileName);
				((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).CalculateDocumentVariable -= new CalculateDocumentVariableEventHandler(val.OnCalculateDocumentVariable);
			}
			finally

			}
		}

		public void SnapMailMerge(SnapMailMergeExportOptions options, Stream stream, DocumentFormat format)
		{

		protected internal bool SnapMailMerge(SnapMailMergeExportOptions options, SnapDocumentModel targetModel)

		}

		protected internal bool SnapMailMerge(SnapMailMergeExportOptions options, SnapDocumentModel targetModel, IProgressIndicationService progressIndication)
		{
			return SnapMailMerge(options, targetModel, progressIndication, createNewDocument: true);
		}

		protected internal bool SnapMailMerge(SnapMailMergeExportOptions options, SnapDocumentModel targetModel, IProgressIndicationService progressIndication, bool createNewDocument)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)targetModel, "targetModel");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)options, "options");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)progressIndication, "progressIndication");
			bool flag = false;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)targetModel).BeginUpdate();
			if (createNewDocument)
			{
				((InternalAPI)targetModel.InternalAPI).CreateNewDocument();
			}
			try
			{
				((DocumentSaveOptions)targetModel.DocumentSaveOptions).CurrentFileName = ((DocumentSaveOptions)DocumentModel.DocumentSaveOptions).CurrentFileName;
				((DocumentModel)targetModel).PrintingOptions.CopyFrom(((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).PrintingOptions, false);
				SnapMailMergeHelper snapMailMergeHelper = new SnapMailMergeHelper(DocumentModel, options, progressIndication);
				((MailMergeHelperBase)snapMailMergeHelper).ExecuteMailMerge((DocumentModel)(object)targetModel);
				flag = !snapMailMergeHelper.IsCancellationRequested;
				((DocumentSaveOptions)targetModel.DocumentSaveOptions).CurrentFileName = string.Empty;
				return flag;
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)targetModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

	public class MathUtils
	{
		public static long LCM(int a, int b)
		{
			if (a == 0 || b == 0)
			{
				return 0L;
			}
			long num = a * b;
			return num / GCD(a, b);
		}

		public static int GCD(int a, int b)
		{
			if (a > b)
			{
				return GCDCore(a, b);
			}
			return GCDCore(b, a);
		}

		private static int GCDCore(int a, int b)
		{
			if (b == 0)
			{
				return a;
			}
			return GCDCore(b, a % b);
		}
	}

	public static class StyleHelper
	{
		public static void ApplyTableCellStyle(SnapDocumentModel styleSourceModel, SnapDocumentModel result, string baseStyleName, int level)
		{
			string cellStyleName = GetCellStyleName(baseStyleName, level, (DocumentModel)(object)styleSourceModel);
			TableCellStyle styleByName = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)((DocumentModel)styleSourceModel).TableCellStyles).GetStyleByName(cellStyleName);
			if (styleByName == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = ((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)styleByName).Copy((DocumentModel)(object)result);
			TableCellStyle newStyle = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)((DocumentModel)result).TableCellStyles)[num];
			foreach (Table table in ((PieceTable)result.MainPieceTable).Tables)
			{
				((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table.Rows).ForEach((Action<TableRow>)delegate(TableRow row)
				{
					((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).ForEach((Action<TableCell>)delegate(TableCell cell)
					{
						ApplyTableCellStyleCore(((StyleBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)newStyle).StyleName, cell);
					});
				});
			}
		}

		public static void ApplyTableCellStyleCore(string styleName, TableCell cell)
		{
			cell.StyleIndex = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)cell.DocumentModel.TableCellStyles).GetStyleIndexByName(styleName);
		}

		public static void ApplyTableCellStyleDirect(string styleName, TableCell cell)
		{
			cell.SetTableCellStyleIndexCore(((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)cell.DocumentModel.TableCellStyles).GetStyleIndexByName(styleName));
		}

		public static string GetStyleName(string baseStyleName, int level, DocumentModel styleSourceModel)
		{
			while (level >= 0)
			{
				string text = baseStyleName + level;
				TableStyle styleByName = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableStyle>)(object)styleSourceModel.TableStyles).GetStyleByName(text);
				if (styleByName != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
				level--;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static string GetCellStyleName(string baseStyleName, int level, DocumentModel styleSourceModel)
		{
			while (level >= 0)
			{
				string text = "List" + level + "-" + baseStyleName;
				TableCellStyle styleByName = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)styleSourceModel.TableCellStyles).GetStyleByName(text);
				if (styleByName != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
				level--;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static string GetGroupStyleName(string baseStyleName, int listLevel, int level, DocumentModel styleSourceModel)
		{
			int num = listLevel;
			while (level > 0)
			{
				while (listLevel > 0)
				{
					string text = "List" + listLevel + "-" + baseStyleName + level;
					TableCellStyle styleByName = ((StyleCollectionBase<TableCellStyle>)(object)styleSourceModel.TableCellStyles).GetStyleByName(text);
					if (styleByName != null)
					{
						return text;
					}
					listLevel--;
				}
				listLevel = num;
				level--;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	public static class TableHelper
	{
		public static bool IsEmpty(this TableRow row)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TableCell first = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).First;
			TableCell last = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Last;
			ParagraphIndex startParagraphIndex = first.StartParagraphIndex;
			ParagraphIndex endParagraphIndex = last.EndParagraphIndex;
			PieceTable pieceTable = row.PieceTable;
			ParagraphIndex val = startParagraphIndex;
			while (val <= endParagraphIndex)
			{
				if (((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)pieceTable.Paragraphs)[val].Length > 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				val = ParagraphIndex.op_Increment(val);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void RemoveEmptyRows(this Table table)
		{
			List<TableRow> emptyRows = new List<TableRow>();
			((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table.Rows).ForEach((Action<TableRow>)delegate(TableRow row)
			{
				if (row.IsEmpty())
				{
					emptyRows.Add(row);
				}
			});
			int count = emptyRows.Count;
			if (count == ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table.Rows).Count)
			{
				table.PieceTable.DeleteTableWithContent(table, false);
				return;
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < count; num++)
			{
				table.PieceTable.DeleteTableRowWithContent(emptyRows[num], false);
			}
			table.NormalizeCellColumnSpans();
		}

		public static bool ContainsFields(Table table)
		{
			return FindBookmarkForFirstRow(table) != null;
		}

		public static SnapBookmark FindBookmarkForFirstRow(Table table)
		{
			return TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table.Rows).First);
		}

		public static SnapBookmark FindSnapBookmarkForFistRow(Table table)
		{
			return TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table.Rows).First);
		}

		public static bool CompareRowsByGrid(TableRow row1, TableRow row2)
		{
			if (row1.GridBefore != row2.GridBefore)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row1.Cells).Count;
			if (((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row2.Cells).Count != count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row1.Cells)[i].ColumnSpan != ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row2.Cells)[i].ColumnSpan)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return row1.GridAfter == row2.GridAfter;
		}
	}
	public static class TableRowHelper
	{
		public static SnapBookmark FindTemplateBookmark(TableRow row)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)row.PieceTable;
			SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController(pieceTable);
			return snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByTableCell(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).First);
		}

		public static List<int> GetColumnSpans(TableRow row)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			list.Add(row.GridBefore);
			int count = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells)[i].ColumnSpan);
			}
			list.Add(row.GridAfter);
			return list;
		}

		public static bool CheckColumnSpans(TableRow row, List<int> template)
		{
			int count = template.Count;
			if (((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Count != count - 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row.GridBefore != template[0] || row.GridAfter != template[count - 1])
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count - 2; i++)
			{
				if (((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells)[i].ColumnSpan != template[i + 1])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public static class TemplatedFieldTypeQualifier
	{
		public static bool IsCheckBoxField(DataBrowser dataBrowser)
		{
			Type type = dataBrowser.DataSourceType;
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			if (underlyingType != null)
			{
				type = underlyingType;
			}
			if (type == typeof(bool))
			{
				return true;
			}
			object value = dataBrowser.GetValue();
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type2 = value.GetType();
			underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type2);
			if (underlyingType != null)
			{
				type2 = underlyingType;
			}
			return type2.Equals(typeof(bool));
		}

		public static bool IsHyperlinkField(DataBrowser dataBrowser)
		{
			Type dataSourceType = dataBrowser.DataSourceType;
			if (dataSourceType != typeof(string))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(dataBrowser.GetValue() is string uriString) || !Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(uriString, UriKind.Absolute))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Uri.TryCreate(uriString, UriKind.Absolute, out var result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsUriSchemeValid(result);
		}

		private static bool IsUriSchemeValid(Uri uri)
		{
			if (!(uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp) && !(uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeNntp) && !(uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps) && !(uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeFile) && !(uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeFtp) && !(uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeMailto) && !(uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeGopher))
			{
				return uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeNews;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsImageField(DataBrowser dataBrowser)
		{
			Type type = dataBrowser.DataSourceType;
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(dataBrowser.DataSourceType);
			if (underlyingType != null)
			{
				type = underlyingType;
			}
			if (!typeof(Image).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return typeof(byte[]).Equals(type);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public static class ListUtils
	{
		public static bool AreEquals<T>(List<T> list1, List<T> list2)
		{
			if (list1 == list2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (list1 == null || list2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = list1.Count;
			if (count != list2.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(list1[i], list2[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static int CalcHashCode<T>(List<T> list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (list[0] == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return list[0].GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public static class SnapSizeConverter
	{
		public static Size ModelUnitsToPixels(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, Size size, float dpi)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).UnitConverter;
			int width = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixels(size.Width, dpi);
			int height = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixels(size.Height, dpi);
			return new Size(width, height);
		}
	}

	internal class SnapBookmarkCopyOperation : BookmarkCopyOperationBase<SnapBookmark>
	{
		private Dictionary<SnapBookmark, SnapBookmark> mapSourceToTargetBookmarks;

		private List<SnapBookmark> copiedBookmarks;

		public SnapBookmarkCopyOperation()
		{
			mapSourceToTargetBookmarks = new Dictionary<SnapBookmark, SnapBookmark>();
			copiedBookmarks = new List<SnapBookmark>();
		}

		public override List<SnapBookmark> GetEntireBookmarks(PieceTable sourcePieceTable, DocumentLogPosition start, int length)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<SnapBookmark> entireSnapBookmarks = ((SnapPieceTable)(object)sourcePieceTable).GetEntireSnapBookmarks(start, length);
			for (int num = entireSnapBookmarks.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!ShouldCopyBookmark(sourcePieceTable, entireSnapBookmarks[num], start, length))
				{
					entireSnapBookmarks.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			return entireSnapBookmarks;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldCopyBookmark(PieceTable sourcePieceTable, SnapBookmark snapBookmark, DocumentLogPosition start, int length)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapTemplateInterval templateInterval = snapBookmark.TemplateInterval;
			if ((object)templateInterval.PieceTable != sourcePieceTable)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (((DocumentInterval)templateInterval).NormalizedStart < start)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((DocumentInterval)templateInterval).NormalizedEnd >= start + length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void InsertBookmark(PieceTable targetPieceTable, DocumentLogPosition start, int length, SnapBookmark bookmark, int positionOffset)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapTemplateInterval templateInterval = bookmark.TemplateInterval;
			DocumentLogInterval newTemplateInterval = GetNewTemplateInterval((PieceTable)(object)bookmark.PieceTable, targetPieceTable, templateInterval, positionOffset);
			SnapPieceTable snapPieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)targetPieceTable;
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = snapPieceTable.CreateSnapBookmarkCore(start, length, bookmark.FieldContext, newTemplateInterval, snapPieceTable, templateInterval.TemplateInfo);
			mapSourceToTargetBookmarks.Add(bookmark, snapBookmark);
			copiedBookmarks.Add(snapBookmark);
		}

		private DocumentLogInterval GetNewTemplateInterval(PieceTable sourcePieceTable, PieceTable targetPieceTable, SnapTemplateInterval templateInterval, int positionOffset)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (sourcePieceTable != targetPieceTable && (object)targetPieceTable == templateInterval.PieceTable)
			{
				return new DocumentLogInterval(((DocumentInterval)templateInterval).Start, ((DocumentInterval)templateInterval).Length);
			}
			return new DocumentLogInterval(((DocumentInterval)templateInterval).Start + positionOffset, ((DocumentInterval)templateInterval).Length);
		}

		public void FixBookmarkReferences()
		{
			foreach (SnapBookmark copiedBookmark in copiedBookmarks)
			{
				SnapTemplateInfo templateInfo = copiedBookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo;
				if (templateInfo.FirstGroupBookmark != null)
				{
					templateInfo.FirstGroupBookmark = GetCopiedBookmarkSafe(templateInfo.FirstGroupBookmark);
				}
				if (templateInfo.LastGroupBookmark != null)
				{
					templateInfo.LastGroupBookmark = GetCopiedBookmarkSafe(templateInfo.LastGroupBookmark);
				}
				if (templateInfo.FirstListBookmark != null)
				{
					templateInfo.FirstListBookmark = GetCopiedBookmarkSafe(templateInfo.FirstListBookmark);
				}
				if (templateInfo.LastListBookmark != null)
				{
					templateInfo.LastListBookmark = GetCopiedBookmarkSafe(templateInfo.LastListBookmark);
				}
			}
		}

		private SnapBookmark GetCopiedBookmarkSafe(SnapBookmark sourceBookmark)
		{
			if (IndicesAreCleared(sourceBookmark))
			{
				return sourceBookmark;
			}
			if (mapSourceToTargetBookmarks.TryGetValue(sourceBookmark, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IndicesAreCleared(SnapBookmark sourceBookmark)
		{
			if (IndicesAreCleared(((DocumentInterval)sourceBookmark).Interval.Start))
			{
				return IndicesAreCleared(((DocumentInterval)sourceBookmark).Interval.End);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IndicesAreCleared(DocumentModelPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (pos.RunIndex == RunIndex.Zero)
			{
				return pos.ParagraphIndex == ParagraphIndex.Zero;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
