	public abstract class RowTemplateUpdaterBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> updateTemplateActions;

		private readonly HashSet<SnapTemplateInterval> updatedIntervals = new HashSet<SnapTemplateInterval>();

		private readonly HashSet<TableRow> updatedRows = new HashSet<TableRow>();

		private readonly List<int> columnSpansTemplate;

		private readonly TableCell cell;

		private List<TableRow> rows;

		protected Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> UpdateTemplateActions => updateTemplateActions;

		protected List<int> ColumnSpansTemplate => columnSpansTemplate;

		protected List<TableRow> Rows
		{
			get
			{
				if (rows == null)
				{
					InitTableRows(cell);
				}
				return rows;
			}
			set
			{
				rows = value;
			}
		}

		protected RowTemplateUpdaterBase(TableCell cell)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)cell, "cell");
			this.cell = cell;
			columnSpansTemplate = TableRowHelper.GetColumnSpans(cell.Row);
			updateTemplateActions = CreateUpdateTemplateActions();
		}

		protected internal virtual void InitTableRows(TableCell cell)
		{
			Rows = new List<TableRow>();
			((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)cell.Table.Rows).ForEach((Action<TableRow>)delegate(TableRow r)
			{
				Rows.Add(r);
			});
		}

		public void UpdateTemplates()
		{
			UpdateTemplates(forceUpdateRows: true);
		}

		public virtual void UpdateTemplates(bool forceUpdateRows)
		{
			PrepareUpdateInfo();
			int count = Rows.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UpdateTemplate(Rows[i]);
			}
			if (forceUpdateRows)
			{
				UpdateRows();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void PrepareUpdateInfo()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateTemplate(TableRow row)
		{
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(row);
			if (snapBookmark != null && !updatedIntervals.Contains(snapBookmark.TemplateInterval))
			{
				UpdateTemplateCore(row, snapBookmark);
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateTemplateCore(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			List<TableRow> list = new List<TableRow>();
			for (SnapBookmark snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(row); snapBookmark == bookmark; snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(row))
			{
				list.Add(row);
				row = row.Next;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				UpdateTableRowForTemplate(list[i], bookmark);
			}
			updatedIntervals.Add(bookmark.TemplateInterval);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateTableRowForTemplate(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			if (ShouldUpdateContent(row, bookmark))
			{
				UpdateRowContent(bookmark, GetCell(row), row);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateRowContent(SnapBookmark bookmark, TableCell cell, TableRow row)
		{
			UpdateTemplateInterval(bookmark.TemplateInterval, cell);
			updatedRows.Add(row);
		}

		protected void UpdateTemplateInterval(SnapTemplateInterval interval, TableCell cell)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (UpdateTemplateActions.TryGetValue(interval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType, out var value))
			{
				value(cell, GetDocumentLogPosition(cell));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateRows()
		{
			foreach (TableRow updatedRow in updatedRows)
			{
				((SnapPieceTable)(object)updatedRow.PieceTable).UpdateTemplateByTableRow(updatedRow, clearUnusedSwitches: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual DocumentLogPosition GetDocumentLogPosition(TableCell cell)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new SnapObjectModelController((SnapPieceTable)(object)cell.PieceTable).FindCellStartLogPosition(cell);
		}

		protected abstract Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> CreateUpdateTemplateActions();

		protected abstract bool ShouldUpdateContent(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark);

		protected abstract TableCell GetCell(TableRow row);

		internal static void CopyModel(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos, DocumentModel source)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PieceTableInsertContentConvertedToDocumentModelCommand val = new PieceTableInsertContentConvertedToDocumentModelCommand(cell.PieceTable, source, pos, (InsertOptions)1, false)
			{
				SuppressFieldsUpdate = true,
				CopyBetweenInternalModels = true,
				PasteFromIE = false,
				RemoveLeadingPageBreak = true
			};
			((PieceTableCommand)val).Execute();
		}

		protected string GetSNFieldText(DataBrowser dataBrowser)
		{
			if (TemplatedFieldTypeQualifier.IsImageField(dataBrowser))
			{
				return SNImageField.FieldType;
			}
			if (TemplatedFieldTypeQualifier.IsCheckBoxField(dataBrowser))
			{
				return SNCheckBoxField.FieldType;
			}
			if (TemplatedFieldTypeQualifier.IsHyperlinkField(dataBrowser))
			{
				return SNHyperlinkField.FieldType;
			}
			return SNTextField.FieldType;
		}
	}
	public abstract class RowTemplateDataUpdater : RowTemplateUpdaterBase
	{
		private SNDataInfo dataInfo;

		private bool listHeaderUpdated;

		private bool insertedToRight;

		private List<SnapBookmark> processedDataRowBookmarks = new List<SnapBookmark>();

		protected SNDataInfo DataInfo => dataInfo;

		protected bool InsertedToRight => insertedToRight;

		protected RowTemplateDataUpdater(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo dataInfo, bool insertedToRight)
			: base(cell)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataInfo, "dataInfo");
			this.dataInfo = dataInfo;
			this.insertedToRight = insertedToRight;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateDataRowTemplate(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PieceTable pieceTable = cell.PieceTable;
			SnapDocumentModel hostingModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel;
			UpdateDataRowTemplate(pieceTable, hostingModel, pos);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateDataRowTemplate(PieceTable pieceTable, SnapDocumentModel hostingModel, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object source = ((DataPair)DataInfo).Source;
			string member = ((DataPair)DataInfo).Member;
			if (source is ParametersDataSource)
			{
				string columnName = DataMemberInfo.Create(DataInfo.DataPaths).ColumnName;
				InsertParameterAsSnTextField(pieceTable, pos, columnName);
				return;
			}
			string columnName2 = DataMemberInfo.Create(DataInfo.EscapedDataPaths).ColumnName;
			IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)hostingModel).GetService<IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider>();
			DataContext val = (DataContext)(object)new SnapDataContext(hostingModel.DataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields(source), hostingModel.Parameters, service);
			try
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = ((DataContextBase)val).GetDataBrowser(source, member, true);
				if (dataBrowser != null)
				{
					InsertSNField(pieceTable, pos, dataBrowser, columnName2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void InsertParameterAsSnTextField(PieceTable pieceTable, DocumentLogPosition pos, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = $"{SNTextField.FieldType} {InstructionController.GetEscapedArgument(fieldName)} \\{SNMergeFieldSupportsParameters.ParameterSwitch}";
			pieceTable.InsertText(pos, text);
			pieceTable.CreateField(pos, text.Length);
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateTableRowForTemplate(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			TableCell val = GetCell(row);
			if (!processedDataRowBookmarks.Contains(bookmark) && ShouldUpdateContent(row, bookmark))
			{
				UpdateRowContent(bookmark, val, row);
				processedDataRowBookmarks.Add(bookmark);
			}
			else if (val.PieceTable.Tables.Contains(val.Table))
			{
				MergeInsertedCell(val);
			}
		}

		protected void MergeInsertedCell(TableCell cell)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			TableCell val = ((InsertedToRight && !cell.IsFirstCellInRow) ? cell.Previous : cell);
			int num = val.ColumnSpan + val.Next.ColumnSpan;
			PieceTableMergeTableCellsHorizontallyCommand val2 = new PieceTableMergeTableCellsHorizontallyCommand(val.PieceTable, val, num);
			((PieceTableCommand)val2).Execute();
		}

		protected override Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> CreateUpdateTemplateActions()
		{
			Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> dictionary = new Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>>();
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow, UpdateDataRowTemplate);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListHeader, UpdateListHeaderTemplate);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupHeader, UpdateGroupHeaderTemplate);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter, UpdateGroupFooterTemplate);
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateListHeaderTemplate(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			listHeaderUpdated = UpdateListHeaderTemplateCore(cell, pos);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool UpdateListHeaderTemplateCore(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			cell.PieceTable.InsertText(pos, FieldPathService.DecodePath(((DataInfo)DataInfo).DisplayName));
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateGroupHeaderTemplate(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			InsertDataInfoHeader(cell, pos);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateGroupFooterTemplate(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			InsertDataInfoHeader(cell, pos);
		}

		private void InsertDataInfoHeader(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!listHeaderUpdated && !((DataPair)dataInfo).IsEmpty)
			{
				cell.PieceTable.InsertText(pos, FieldPathService.DecodePath(((DataInfo)dataInfo).DisplayName));
			}
		}

		protected abstract void InsertSNField(PieceTable pieceTable, DocumentLogPosition logPosition, DataBrowser dataBrowser, string fieldName);
	}
	public class InsertColumnTemplateUpdater : RowTemplateDataUpdater
	{
		private int columnSpanAfterInsertedCell;

		private DocumentModel headerTemplate;

		private DocumentModel bodyTemplate;

		public InsertColumnTemplateUpdater(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo dataInfo, bool insertedToRight)
			: base(cell, dataInfo, insertedToRight)
		{
			columnSpanAfterInsertedCell = CalculateColumnSpanAfterInsertedCell(cell);
			PrepareTemplates(cell, dataInfo);
		}

		protected internal virtual void PrepareTemplates(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo dataInfo)
		{
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)cell.DocumentModel;
			TableRow val = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)cell.Table.Rows).First;
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(val);
			while (!ShouldUpdateContent(val, snapBookmark))
			{
				val = val.Next;
				snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(val);
			}
			if (snapBookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListHeader)
			{
				headerTemplate = ((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).CreateNew();
				headerTemplate.MainPieceTable.InsertText(headerTemplate.MainPieceTable.DocumentStartLogPosition, FieldPathService.DecodePath(((DataInfo)dataInfo).DisplayName));
			}
			else
			{
				headerTemplate = null;
			}
			bodyTemplate = ((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).CreateNew();
			UpdateDataRowTemplate(bodyTemplate.MainPieceTable, (SnapDocumentModel)(object)cell.DocumentModel, DocumentLogPosition.Zero);
			snapDocumentModel.RaisePrepareSnListColumns(new PrepareSnListColumnsEventArgs(headerTemplate, bodyTemplate));
		}

		protected internal override bool UpdateListHeaderTemplateCore(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (headerTemplate == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RowTemplateUpdaterBase.CopyModel(cell, pos, headerTemplate);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateDataRowTemplate(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RowTemplateUpdaterBase.CopyModel(cell, pos, bodyTemplate);
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalculateColumnSpanAfterInsertedCell(TableCell cell)
		{
			TableRow row = cell.Row;
			int indexInRow = cell.IndexInRow;
			int num = row.GridAfter;
			for (int num2 = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Count - 1; num2 > indexInRow; num2--)
			{
				num += ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells)[num2].ColumnSpan;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateContent(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			return TableRowHelper.CheckColumnSpans(row, base.ColumnSpansTemplate);
		}

		protected override TableCell GetCell(TableRow row)
		{
			int num = row.GridAfter;
			TableCellCollection cells = row.Cells;
			int num2 = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cells).Count - 1;
			for (int num3 = num2; num3 > 0; num3--)
			{
				TableCell val = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cells)[num3];
				if (num >= columnSpanAfterInsertedCell)
				{
					return val;
				}
				num += val.ColumnSpan;
			}
			return row.FirstCell;
		}

		protected override void InsertSNField(PieceTable pieceTable, DocumentLogPosition logPosition, DataBrowser dataBrowser, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string sNFieldText = GetSNFieldText(dataBrowser);
			string text = $"{sNFieldText} {InstructionController.GetEscapedArgument(fieldName)}";
			pieceTable.InsertText(logPosition, text);
			pieceTable.CreateField(logPosition, text.Length);
		}
	}
	public class InsertColumnCommandTemplateUpdater : InsertColumnTemplateUpdater
	{
		public InsertColumnCommandTemplateUpdater(TableCell cell, bool insertedToRight)
			: base(cell, new SNDataInfo(null, string.Empty), insertedToRight)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareTemplates(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo dataInfo)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateDataRowTemplate(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool UpdateListHeaderTemplateCore(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateTableRowForTemplate(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			TableCell val = GetCell(row);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (!ShouldMergeCell(val, bookmark))
				{
					UpdateRowContent(bookmark, val, row);
				}
				else
				{
					MergeInsertedCell(val);
				}
			}
		}

		private TableCell CorrectCell(TableCell cell)
		{
			TableRow row = cell.Row;
			if (base.InsertedToRight)
			{
				if (cell == row.FirstCell && ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Count > 1)
				{
					return ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells)[1];
				}
				return cell.Previous;
			}
			return cell.NextCellInRow;
		}

		private bool ShouldMergeCell(TableCell resultCell, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TableCell val = CorrectCell(resultCell);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SnapPieceTable snapPieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)val.PieceTable;
			Paragraph val2 = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)snapPieceTable).Paragraphs)[val.StartParagraphIndex];
			Paragraph val3 = ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)snapPieceTable).Paragraphs)[val.EndParagraphIndex];
			Field val4 = ((PieceTable)snapPieceTable).FindFieldByRunIndex(val2.FirstRunIndex);
			SnapFieldInfo snapFieldInfo = new SnapFieldInfo((SnapPieceTable)(object)val4.PieceTable, val4);
			if (!(snapFieldInfo.ParsedInfo is SNListField))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentModelPosition val5 = DocumentModelPosition.FromRunStart((PieceTable)(object)snapPieceTable, snapFieldInfo.Field.Result.Start);
			DocumentModelPosition val6 = DocumentModelPosition.FromRunEnd((PieceTable)(object)snapPieceTable, snapFieldInfo.Field.Result.End);
			if (!(val2.LogPosition <= val5.LogPosition) || !(val6.LogPosition - 1 <= val3.LogPosition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class SummaryTemplateUpdater : RowTemplateDataUpdater
	{
		private string running;

		private SummaryItemType summaryItemType;

		private string stringFormat;

		public SummaryTemplateUpdater(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo info, SummaryItemType summaryItemType, string running, string stringFormat)
			: base(cell, info, insertedToRight: false)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.summaryItemType = summaryItemType;
			this.running = running;
			this.stringFormat = stringFormat;
		}

		protected internal override void InitTableRows(TableCell cell)
		{
			base.Rows = new List<TableRow>();
			TableRow val = cell.Table.LastRow;
			if (running == "report")
			{
				base.Rows.Add(val);
				return;
			}
			while (val != null)
			{
				SnapBookmark snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(val);
				if (snapBookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter)
				{
					base.Rows.Add(val);
					return;
				}
				val = val.Previous;
			}
			base.Rows.Add(cell.Table.LastRow);
		}

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateContent(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			SnapTemplateIntervalType templateType = bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType;
			if (templateType != SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListFooter)
			{
				return templateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> CreateUpdateTemplateActions()
		{
			Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> dictionary = new Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>>();
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListFooter, UpdateDataRowTemplate);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter, UpdateDataRowTemplate);
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override void InsertSNField(PieceTable pieceTable, DocumentLogPosition logPosition, DataBrowser dataBrowser, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = SNTextField.GetSummaryFieldCode(fieldName, running, summaryItemType) + " ";
			if ((int)summaryItemType != 3)
			{
				text += $"\\{CalculatedFieldBase.FrameworkStringFormatSwitch} {stringFormat} ";
			}
			pieceTable.InsertText(logPosition, text);
			pieceTable.CreateField(logPosition, text.Length - 1);
			pieceTable.InsertText(logPosition, SNTextField.GetDisplaySummaryString(((DataInfo)base.DataInfo).DisplayName, summaryItemType));
		}

		protected override TableCell GetCell(TableRow row)
		{
			return row.FirstCell;
		}

		protected override DocumentLogPosition GetDocumentLogPosition(TableCell cell)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return cell.PieceTable.GetRunInfoByTableCell(cell).End.LogPosition;
		}
	}
	public class DeleteColumnTemplateUpdater : RowTemplateUpdaterBase
	{
		private IRichEditControl control;

		private int indexInRow;

		public DeleteColumnTemplateUpdater(TableCell cell, IRichEditControl control)
			: base(cell)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)control, "control");
			this.control = control;
			indexInRow = cell.IndexInRow;
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = TableRowHelper.FindTemplateBookmark(cell.Row);
			if (snapBookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow)
			{
				InitTableRows(cell);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void InitTableRows(TableCell cell)
		{
			base.Rows = new List<TableRow>();
			if (TableRowHelper.CheckColumnSpans(cell.Table.FirstRow, base.ColumnSpansTemplate))
			{
				base.Rows.Add(cell.Table.FirstRow);
			}
			if (TableRowHelper.CheckColumnSpans(cell.Table.LastRow, base.ColumnSpansTemplate))
			{
				base.Rows.Add(cell.Table.LastRow);
			}
		}

		protected override Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> CreateUpdateTemplateActions()
		{
			Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> dictionary = new Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>>();
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListHeader, UpdateListHeaderFooter);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListFooter, UpdateListHeaderFooter);
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override TableCell GetCell(TableRow row)
		{
			return ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells)[indexInRow];
		}

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateContent(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			SnapTemplateIntervalType templateType = bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType;
			if (templateType != SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListHeader)
			{
				return templateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.ListFooter;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void UpdateListHeaderFooter(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			DeleteCell(cell);
		}

		private void DeleteCell(TableCell cell)
		{
			TableCell modifiedTableCell = GetModifiedTableCell(cell);
			PieceTable pieceTable = cell.PieceTable;
			pieceTable.DeleteTableCellWithContent(cell, control.InnerDocumentServer.Owner);
			if (modifiedTableCell != null)
			{
				TableCommandsHelper.InsertSeparators(modifiedTableCell.PieceTable, new List<TableCell> { modifiedTableCell });
			}
		}

		private TableCell GetModifiedTableCell(TableCell cell)
		{
			DocumentModel documentModel = cell.DocumentModel;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SnapObjectModelController snapObjectModelController = new SnapObjectModelController((SnapPieceTable)(object)cell.PieceTable);
				if (!(snapObjectModelController.GetFirstCellRun(cell) is SeparatorTextRun))
				{
					return null;
				}
				SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController((SnapPieceTable)(object)cell.PieceTable);
				return snapBookmarkController.IsTableCellLastInTemplateBookmark(cell) ? null : cell.Next;
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}
	}
	public class InsertDetailListTemplateUpdater : RowTemplateUpdaterBase
	{
		private DocumentModel templateModel;

		private TableRow row;

		private List<SnapBookmark> processedDataRowBookmarks = new List<SnapBookmark>();

		protected TableRow Row => row;

		public InsertDetailListTemplateUpdater(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo[] dataInfo)
			: base(cell)

			row = cell.Row;

		}

		protected override Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> CreateUpdateTemplateActions()
		{
			Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> dictionary = new Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>>();
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow, InsertSnListDetailCore);
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected internal virtual void PrepareTemplate(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo[] dataInfo)
		{
			templateModel = CreateDataRowTemplate(cell, dataInfo);
			((SnapDocumentModel)(object)cell.DocumentModel).RaisePrepareSnListDetail(new PrepareSnListDetailEventArgs(templateModel));
		}

		protected override TableCell GetCell(TableRow row)
		{
			return row.FirstCell;
		}

		public override void UpdateTemplates(bool forceUpdateRows)
		{
			UpdateTemplate(Row);
			if (forceUpdateRows)
			{
				UpdateRows();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateTableRowForTemplate(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			if (!processedDataRowBookmarks.Contains(bookmark) && ShouldUpdateContent(row, bookmark))
			{
				UpdateRowContent(bookmark, GetCell(row), row);
				processedDataRowBookmarks.Add(bookmark);
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateContent(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			return bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow;
		}

		protected internal virtual DocumentModel CreateDataRowTemplate(TableCell cell, SNDataInfo[] dataInfo)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TableCellHelper.PrepareMasterCell(cell);
			SnapPieceTable snapPieceTable = (SnapPieceTable)(object)cell.PieceTable;
			SnapDocumentModel documentModel = snapPieceTable.DocumentModel;
			DocumentLogPosition logPosition = ((PieceTable)snapPieceTable).GetRunInfoByTableCell(cell).Start.LogPosition;
			TemplateBuilder templateBuilder = documentModel.CreateTemplateBuilder();
			DocumentModel val = templateBuilder.CreateTemplateFromDraggedDataInfo(snapPieceTable, logPosition, dataInfo);
			val.InheritDataServices((DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
			TableCommandsHelper.InsertHeader((SnapPieceTable)(object)val.MainPieceTable, documentModel, logPosition, dataInfo);
			return val;
		}

		protected void InsertSnListDetailCore(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RowTemplateUpdaterBase.CopyModel(cell, pos, templateModel);
		}

	public class ResizeGroupHeaderFooterTemplateUpdater : RowTemplateUpdaterBase
	{
		private IRichEditControl control;

		private readonly TableRow patternRow;

		private WidthUnitInfo preferredWidthInfo;

		private int startCellIndex;

		private int endCellIndex;

		private int cellCount;

		private List<PreferredWidth> cellsWidths;

		protected TableRow PatternRow => patternRow;

		public ResizeGroupHeaderFooterTemplateUpdater(SelectedCellsIntervalInRow interval, IRichEditControl control)
			: base(interval.StartCell)
		{
			this.control = control;
			patternRow = interval.StartCell.Row;
			startCellIndex = interval.StartCellIndex;
			endCellIndex = interval.EndCellIndex;
			cellCount = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)interval.Row.Cells).Count;
			cellsWidths = new List<PreferredWidth>();
			for (int i = 0; i < cellCount; i++)
			{
				cellsWidths.Add(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)interval.Row.Cells)[i].PreferredWidth);
			}
		}

		protected override Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> CreateUpdateTemplateActions()
		{
			Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>> dictionary = new Dictionary<SnapTemplateIntervalType, Action<TableCell, DocumentLogPosition>>();
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupHeader, UpdatePreferredWidth);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter, UpdatePreferredWidth);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupSeparator, UpdatePreferredWidth);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.Separator, UpdatePreferredWidth);
			dictionary.Add(SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow, UpdateDataRow);
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override TableCell GetCell(TableRow row)
		{
			return row.FirstCell;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateContent(TableRow row, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			if (preferredWidthInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SnapTemplateIntervalType templateType = bookmark.TemplateInterval.TemplateInfo.TemplateType;
			if (templateType == SnapTemplateIntervalType.DataRow && ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Count == cellCount)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < cellCount; i++)
				{
					if (((WidthUnit)((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells)[i].PreferredWidth).Value != ((WidthUnit)cellsWidths[i]).Value)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (IsCorrespondsType(templateType))
			{
				return ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).Count == 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsCorrespondsType(SnapTemplateIntervalType type)
		{
			if (type != SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupHeader && type != SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupFooter && type != SnapTemplateIntervalType.GroupSeparator)
			{
				return type == SnapTemplateIntervalType.Separator;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareUpdateInfo()
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if ((int)((WidthUnit)PatternRow.FirstCell.PreferredWidth).Type != 3)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)PatternRow.Cells).Count; i++)
			{
				if ((int)((WidthUnit)((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)PatternRow.Cells)[i].PreferredWidth).Type == 3)
				{
					num += ((WidthUnit)((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)PatternRow.Cells)[i].PreferredWidth).Value;
				}
			}
			preferredWidthInfo = new WidthUnitInfo((WidthUnitType)3, num);
		}

		protected void UpdatePreferredWidth(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			((UndoableIndexBasedObject<WidthUnitInfo, DocumentModelChangeActions>)(object)cell.Properties.PreferredWidth).CopyFrom(preferredWidthInfo);
		}

		protected void UpdateDataRow(TableCell cell, DocumentLogPosition pos)
		{
			for (int num = endCellIndex; num >= startCellIndex; num--)
			{
				DeleteCell(((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cell.Row.Cells)[num]);
			}
		}

		private void DeleteCell(TableCell cell)
		{
			TableCell modifiedTableCell = GetModifiedTableCell(cell);
			PieceTable pieceTable = cell.PieceTable;
			pieceTable.DeleteTableCellWithContent(cell, control.InnerDocumentServer.Owner);
			if (modifiedTableCell != null)
			{
				TableCommandsHelper.InsertSeparators(modifiedTableCell.PieceTable, new List<TableCell> { modifiedTableCell });
			}
		}

		private TableCell GetModifiedTableCell(TableCell cell)
		{
			DocumentModel documentModel = cell.DocumentModel;
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SnapObjectModelController snapObjectModelController = new SnapObjectModelController((SnapPieceTable)(object)cell.PieceTable);
				if (!(snapObjectModelController.GetFirstCellRun(cell) is SeparatorTextRun))
				{
					return null;
				}
				SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController((SnapPieceTable)(object)cell.PieceTable);
				return snapBookmarkController.IsTableCellLastInTemplateBookmark(cell) ? null : cell.Next;
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class InsertAction
	{
		private readonly InsertAction parent;

		public InsertAction Parent => parent;

		protected InsertAction(InsertAction parent)
		{
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is InsertAction insertAction))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (insertAction.Parent == Parent)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Parent.Equals(insertAction.Parent);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return parent.GetHashCode() + 1;
		}

		public abstract void WriteStartText(TemplateWriter templateWriter);

		public abstract void WriteEndText(TemplateWriter templateWriter);

		public virtual void BeforeWriteInnerAction(InsertAction innerAction, TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
		}

		public virtual void AfterWriteInnerAction(InsertAction innerAction, TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
		}
	}
	public class InsertActionTreeNode
	{
		private readonly InsertAction action;

		private readonly List<InsertActionTreeNode> childNodes;

		private readonly InsertActionTreeNode parentNode;

		public InsertAction Action => action;

		public List<InsertActionTreeNode> ChildNodes => childNodes;

		public InsertActionTreeNode ParentNode => parentNode;

		public InsertActionTreeNode(InsertAction action, InsertActionTreeNode parentNode)
		{
			this.action = action;
			childNodes = new List<InsertActionTreeNode>();
			this.parentNode = parentNode;
		}
	}
	public class InsertActionTreeBuilder
	{
		private Dictionary<InsertAction, InsertActionTreeNode> mapActionToNode;

		public InsertActionTree Build(InsertAction rootAction, List<InsertAction> leafActions)
		{
			mapActionToNode = new Dictionary<InsertAction, InsertActionTreeNode>();
			foreach (InsertAction leafAction in leafActions)
			{
				GetNode(leafAction);
			}
			return new InsertActionTree(GetNode(rootAction));
		}

		private InsertActionTreeNode GetNode(InsertAction action)
		{
			if (!mapActionToNode.TryGetValue(action, out var value))
			{
				InsertActionTreeNode insertActionTreeNode = ((action.Parent != null) ? GetNode(action.Parent) : null);
				value = new InsertActionTreeNode(action, insertActionTreeNode);
				mapActionToNode.Add(action, value);
				insertActionTreeNode?.ChildNodes.Add(value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class InsertActionTree
	{
		private readonly InsertActionTreeNode rootNode;

		public InsertActionTreeNode RootNode => rootNode;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (rootNode != null)
				{
					return rootNode.ChildNodes.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public InsertActionTree(InsertActionTreeNode rootNode)
		{
			this.rootNode = rootNode;
		}
	}
	public class RootInsertAction : InsertAction
	{
		private readonly List<InsertAction> leafActions;

		private InsertActionTree insertActionTree;

		private List<InsertAction> LeafActions => leafActions;

		public RootInsertAction()
			: base(null)
		{
			leafActions = new List<InsertAction>();
		}

		public InsertActionTree GetInsertActionTree()
		{
			if (insertActionTree == null)
			{
				InsertActionTreeBuilder insertActionTreeBuilder = new InsertActionTreeBuilder();
				insertActionTree = insertActionTreeBuilder.Build(this, LeafActions);
			}
			return insertActionTree;
		}

		public void AddLeafAction(InsertAction action)
		{
			leafActions.Add(action);
			insertActionTree = null;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return this == obj;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void WriteStartText(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
		}

		public override void WriteEndText(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
		}
	}

		}

		private string ApplyCurrentSparklineSettings(string startText)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceName))
			{
				startText = startText + " \\" + SNSparklineField.SnSparklineDataSourceNameSwitch + " " + GetQuotes(dataSourceName) + dataSourceName + GetQuotes(dataSourceName);
			}
			if (Instructions == null)
			{
				return startText;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> instruction in Instructions)
			{
				startText = startText + " \\" + instruction.Key + " " + instruction.Value;
			}
			return startText;
		}

		private string GetQuotes(string dataSourceName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (!dataSourceName.Contains(" "))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return "\"";
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return FieldName.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is InsertSNSparklineFieldAction insertSNSparklineFieldAction))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = string.Compare(FieldName, insertSNSparklineFieldAction.FieldName, ignoreCase: true) == 0;
			bool flag2 = string.Compare(DataSourceName, insertSNSparklineFieldAction.DataSourceName, ignoreCase: true) == 0;
			return flag && flag2;
		}
	}

	public abstract class InsertObjectActionBase : InsertAction
	{
		private readonly string dataSourceName;

		private readonly string dataMember;

		public string DataMember => dataMember;

		public string DataSourceName => dataSourceName;

		protected abstract string FieldName { get; }

		public static InsertObjectActionBase Create(Type dataSourceType, string dataSourceName, string dataMember, InsertAction parent, string listName)
		{
			if (ListTypeHelper.IsListType(dataSourceType))
			{
				if (dataMember != null)
				{
					return new InsertSNListAction(dataSourceName, dataMember, parent, listName);
				}
				return null;
			}
			return new InsertDisplayObjectAction(dataSourceName, dataMember, parent);
		}

		protected InsertObjectActionBase(string dataSourceName, string dataMember, InsertAction parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
			this.dataSourceName = dataSourceName;
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is InsertObjectActionBase insertObjectActionBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.Compare(DataSourceName, insertObjectActionBase.DataSourceName, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				return string.Compare(DataMember, insertObjectActionBase.DataMember, ignoreCase: true) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataMember))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataSourceName))
			{
				return DataMember.GetHashCode() ^ DataSourceName.GetHashCode();
			}
			return DataMember.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void WriteStartText(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			templateWriter.BeginField();
			string dataReferenceString = GetDataReferenceString();
			templateWriter.WriteText($"{FieldName} {EscapeDataReferenceString(dataReferenceString)} \\t ");
			templateWriter.BeginTemplate();
		}

		public override void WriteEndText(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			templateWriter.EndTemplate();
			BeforeEndField(templateWriter);
			templateWriter.EndField();
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeEndField(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
		}

		public string GetDataReferenceString()
		{
			string text = GetDataReferenceStringCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			int num = text.IndexOf('[');
			if (num > 0)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, num);
			}
			else if (num == 0)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected virtual string GetDataReferenceStringCore()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataSourceName))
			{
				return DataMember;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataMember))
			{
				return $"/{DataSourceName}.{DataMember}";
			}
			return $"/{DataSourceName}";
		}

		protected virtual string EscapeDataReferenceString(string dataReferenceString)
		{
			return InstructionController.GetEscapedArgument(dataReferenceString);
		}

		public override void BeforeWriteInnerAction(InsertAction innerAction, TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			templateWriter.WriteParagraphStart();
		}
	}

	public class InsertSNListAction : InsertObjectActionBase
	{
		private string listName;

		protected override string FieldName => SNListField.FieldType;

		public InsertSNListAction(string dataSourceName, string dataMember, InsertAction parent, string listName)
			: base(dataSourceName, dataMember, parent)
		{
			this.listName = listName;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return obj is InsertSNListAction;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void WriteStartText(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			base.WriteStartText(templateWriter);
			templateWriter.WriteParagraphStart();
			templateWriter.BeginTable();
			templateWriter.BeginTableRow();
		}

		protected override string EscapeDataReferenceString(string dataReferenceString)
		{
			return InstructionController.GetEscapedDataSourceName(dataReferenceString);
		}

		protected override void BeforeEndField(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			templateWriter.WriteText($"{SNListField.NameSwitchWithPrefix} {InstructionController.GetEscapedArgument(listName)}");
		}

		public override void WriteEndText(TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			templateWriter.EndTableRow(applyEqualPercentWidthToCells: true);
			templateWriter.EndTable("List", GetListLevel(), applyPercentWidth: true);
			base.WriteEndText(templateWriter);
		}

		private int GetListLevel()
		{
			int num = 1;
			for (InsertAction insertAction = base.Parent; insertAction != null; insertAction = insertAction.Parent)
			{
				if (insertAction is InsertSNListAction)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override void BeforeWriteInnerAction(InsertAction innerAction, TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			bool changeStyleProperties = false;
			if (innerAction is InsertSNListAction)
			{
				templateWriter.EndTableRow(applyEqualPercentWidthToCells: true);
				templateWriter.BeginTableRow();
				changeStyleProperties = true;
			}
			templateWriter.BeginTableCell(changeStyleProperties);
		}

		public override void AfterWriteInnerAction(InsertAction innerAction, TemplateWriter templateWriter)
		{
			base.AfterWriteInnerAction(innerAction, templateWriter);
			templateWriter.WriteParagraphStart();
			templateWriter.EndTableCell();
			if (innerAction is InsertSNListAction)
			{
				templateWriter.EndTableRow(applyEqualPercentWidthToCells: true);
				templateWriter.BeginTableRow();
			}
		}
	}

	public class SparklineTemplateBuilder : TemplateBuilder
	{
		private enum ContextType
		{
			None,
			Without,
			Within
		}

		private enum ContextLevel
		{
			None,
			Correct,
			SameLevel,
			Deeper
		}

		private enum DataSourceType
		{
			None,
			Default,
			Named
		}

		private Dictionary<string, string> instructions;

		private ContextLevel contextLevel;

		private ContextType contextType;

		private DataSourceType dataSourceType;

		private bool isLastContextLevel = true;

		private InsertAction sparklineParentAction;

		private string columnName = string.Empty;

		private DataMemberInfo baseDataMemberInfo;

		private bool calculateRelationAction;

		private SNDataInfo currentDataInfo;

		private string customDataSourceName = string.Empty;

		private InsertAction RootActionForSparklineWithoutContext
		{
			get
			{
				if (contextType != ContextType.Without || sparklineParentAction == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				InsertAction result = ((sparklineParentAction.Parent == null) ? null : sparklineParentAction);
				InsertAction parent = sparklineParentAction.Parent;
				while (parent != null && parent.Parent != null)
				{
					result = parent;
					parent = parent.Parent;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public SparklineTemplateBuilder(Dictionary<string, string> instructions)
		{
			this.instructions = instructions;
			contextLevel = ContextLevel.None;
			contextType = ContextType.None;
			dataSourceType = DataSourceType.None;
		}

		protected override InsertAction GetInsertAction(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, List<string> listNames, string listName, DataContext dataContext, DataBrowser dataBrowser, object dataSource, DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo, InsertAction parentAction, bool leafAction, List<string> insertPositionDataSources)
		{
			IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher = documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher;
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.None)
			{
				dataSourceType = ((dataSourceDispatcher.DefaultDataSource == dataSource) ? DataSourceType.Default : DataSourceType.Named);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Named && string.IsNullOrEmpty(customDataSourceName))
			{
				customDataSourceName = dataSourceDispatcher.FindDataSourceName(dataSource);
			}
			if (contextType == ContextType.None)
			{
				contextType = ((insertPositionDataSources.Count == 0) ? ContextType.Without : ContextType.Within);
			}
			if (contextLevel == ContextLevel.None)
			{
				string[] array = dataMemberInfo.DataMember.Split('.');
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					if (contextType == ContextType.Without)
					{
						int num = ((dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Default) ? 1 : 2);
						contextLevel = ((array.Length == num) ? ContextLevel.Correct : ContextLevel.Deeper);
					}
					else if (contextType == ContextType.Within)
					{
						if (array.Length >= 2)
						{
							int num2 = ((dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Default) ? 2 : 3);
							contextLevel = ((array.Length == num2) ? ContextLevel.Correct : ContextLevel.Deeper);
						}
						else
						{
							contextLevel = ContextLevel.SameLevel;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			isLastContextLevel = contextType != ContextType.None && contextLevel == ContextLevel.Deeper && string.Equals(dataMemberInfo.ColumnName, dataMemberInfo.DataMember);
			return base.GetInsertAction(documentModel, listNames, listName, dataContext, dataBrowser, dataSource, dataMemberInfo, parentAction, leafAction, insertPositionDataSources);
		}

		protected override string GetColumnName(DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo)
		{
			if (calculateRelationAction || contextLevel == ContextLevel.None)
			{
				return base.GetColumnName(dataMemberInfo);
			}
			return dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo.ColumnName;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldCreateInsertAction(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, object dataSource, string parentDataMember)
		{
			if (contextLevel == ContextLevel.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.ShouldCreateInsertAction(documentModel, dataSource, parentDataMember) && contextLevel == ContextLevel.Deeper)
			{
				return !isLastContextLevel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override InsertAction CreateInsertAction(DataBrowser dataBrowser, DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo, InsertAction parentAction)
		{
			if (calculateRelationAction || contextLevel == ContextLevel.None)
			{
				bool flag = IsRelatedDataInfoInRightContext(dataMemberInfo.DataMember.Split('.'), baseDataMemberInfo.DataMember.Split('.'));
				InsertAction parentAction2 = ((sparklineParentAction != null && flag) ? sparklineParentAction : parentAction);
				if (!flag && contextType == ContextType.Without && sparklineParentAction != null)
				{
					InsertAction rootActionForSparklineWithoutContext = RootActionForSparklineWithoutContext;
					parentAction2 = ((rootActionForSparklineWithoutContext == null) ? parentAction : rootActionForSparklineWithoutContext);
				}
				return base.CreateInsertAction(dataBrowser, dataMemberInfo, parentAction2);
			}
			string[] array = dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo.DataMember.Split('.');
			string text = ((array.Length != 0) ? array[array.Length - 1] : string.Empty);
			if (parentAction is RootInsertAction && dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Named && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(customDataSourceName) && array.Length <= 1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					text = $".{text}";
				}
				text = $"/{customDataSourceName}{text}";
			}
			sparklineParentAction = parentAction;
			baseDataMemberInfo = dataMemberInfo;
			columnName = dataMemberInfo.ColumnName;
			return new InsertSNSparklineFieldAction(dataMemberInfo.ColumnName, text, parentAction, instructions);
		}

		protected override bool IsRootListInsertAction(DataBrowser dataBrowser)
		{
			bool flag = base.IsRootListInsertAction(dataBrowser);
			if (dataSourceType != DataSourceType.Named || contextType == ContextType.Within)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return dataBrowser.Parent.Parent.Parent == null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override string GetDataMember(DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo)
		{
			string dataMember = base.GetDataMember(dataMemberInfo);
			if (dataSourceType != DataSourceType.Named || contextType == ContextType.Within)
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			if (dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo == null)
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			return dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo.DataMember;
		}

		protected override void CalculateRelation(SNDataInfo dataInfo, SNDataInfo[] dataInfoArray, List<SNDataInfo> relatedDataInfos, SnapDocumentModel documentModel, List<string> listNames, RootInsertAction rootInsertAction, List<string> insertPositionDataSources)
		{
			if ((contextType == ContextType.None || contextLevel != ContextLevel.Correct) && contextLevel != ContextLevel.None)
			{
				calculateRelationAction = true;
				currentDataInfo = dataInfo;
				base.CalculateRelation(dataInfo, dataInfoArray, relatedDataInfos, documentModel, listNames, rootInsertAction, insertPositionDataSources);
				currentDataInfo = null;
				calculateRelationAction = false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanAddRelatedDataInfo(SNDataInfo relatedDataInfo, SNDataInfo[] dataInfos)
		{
			if (contextType == ContextType.Within && currentDataInfo != null && currentDataInfo.DataPaths.Length > 1)
			{
				return IsRelatedDataInfoInRightContext(relatedDataInfo.DataPaths, currentDataInfo.DataPaths);
			}
			return base.CanAddRelatedDataInfo(relatedDataInfo, dataInfos);
		}

		private bool IsRelatedDataInfoInRightContext(string[] relatedDataPaths, string[] currentDataPaths)
		{
			if (currentDataPaths.Length == 0 || relatedDataPaths.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (relatedDataPaths.Length != currentDataPaths.Length - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (relatedDataPaths.Length == 1 && currentDataPaths.Length == 2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < relatedDataPaths.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				if (!string.Equals(relatedDataPaths[i], currentDataPaths[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class TemplateBuilder
	{
		public bool InduceRelation { get; set; }

		public DocumentModel CreateTemplateFromDraggedDataInfo(SnapPieceTable sourcePieceTable, DocumentLogPosition position, SNDataInfo[] dataInfoArray)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (dataInfoArray == null || dataInfoArray.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapBookmarkController snapBookmarkController = new SnapBookmarkController(sourcePieceTable);
			SnapBookmark snapBookmark = snapBookmarkController.FindInnermostTemplateBookmarkByPosition(position);
			SnapDocumentModel documentModel = sourcePieceTable.DocumentModel;
			SnapDocumentModel snapDocumentModel = (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((DocumentModel)documentModel).CreateNew();
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).BeginSetContent();
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).IntermediateModel = true;
			((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).InheritDataServices((DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
			if (documentModel.SnapMailMergeVisualOptions.DataSourceName != null)
			{
				((ISupportsCopyFrom<SnapMailMergeVisualOptions>)snapDocumentModel.SnapMailMergeVisualOptions).CopyFrom(documentModel.SnapMailMergeVisualOptions);
			}
			try
			{
				DocumentModelCopyCommand.ReplaceDefaultProperties((DocumentModel)(object)snapDocumentModel, (DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
				DocumentModelCopyCommand.CopyStyles((DocumentModel)(object)snapDocumentModel, (DocumentModel)(object)documentModel);
				((FieldOptions)snapDocumentModel.FieldOptions).CopyFrom((FieldOptions)(object)documentModel.FieldOptions);
				List<string> insertPositionDataSources = GetInsertPositionDataSources(sourcePieceTable, snapBookmark);
				InsertActionTree tree = CalculateInsertActionTree(documentModel, dataInfoArray, insertPositionDataSources);
				TemplateWriter templateWriter = new TemplateWriter(snapDocumentModel.MainPieceTable, CreateInputPosition((PieceTable)(object)snapDocumentModel.MainPieceTable, (PieceTable)(object)sourcePieceTable, position));
				WriteTree(templateWriter, tree, insertPositionDataSources);
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModel)snapDocumentModel).EndSetContent((DocumentModelChangeType)12, false, (FieldUpdateOnLoadOptions)null);
			}
			if (snapBookmark != null && snapBookmark.FieldContext != null)

		}

		protected internal virtual InputPosition CreateInputPosition(PieceTable targetPieceTable, PieceTable sourcePieceTable, DocumentLogPosition logPosition)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DocumentModelPosition val = PositionConverter.ToDocumentModelPosition(sourcePieceTable, logPosition);
			TextRunBase val2 = ((List<TextRunBase, RunIndex>)(object)sourcePieceTable.Runs)[val.RunIndex];
			InputPosition val3 = new InputPosition(targetPieceTable);
			val3.CharacterStyleIndex = ((StyleBase<CharacterStyle>)(object)val2.CharacterStyle).Copy(targetPieceTable.DocumentModel);
			val3.CharacterFormatting.CopyFrom(((UndoableIndexBasedObject<CharacterFormattingBase, DocumentModelChangeActions>)(object)val2.CharacterProperties).Info);
			return val3;
		}

		protected internal void WriteTree(TemplateWriter templateWriter, InsertActionTree tree, List<string> insertPositionDataSource)
		{
			InsertActionTreeNode rootNode = tree.RootNode;
			foreach (InsertActionTreeNode childNode in rootNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (!(childNode.Action is InsertObjectActionBase insertObjectActionBase))
				{
					templateWriter.WriteTree(childNode);
					continue;
				}
				string dataReferenceString = insertObjectActionBase.GetDataReferenceString();
				int num = insertPositionDataSource.IndexOf(dataReferenceString);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					templateWriter.WriteTree(childNode);
				}
				else
				{
					WriteChildNodesCore(templateWriter, childNode, insertPositionDataSource, num - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteChildNodesCore(TemplateWriter templateWriter, InsertActionTreeNode parentNode, List<string> insertPositionDataSource, int index)
		{
			foreach (InsertActionTreeNode childNode in parentNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (!(childNode.Action is InsertRelationAction))
				{
					if (!(childNode.Action is InsertObjectActionBase insertObjectActionBase))
					{
						templateWriter.WriteTree(childNode);
					}
					else if (index < 0)
					{
						templateWriter.WriteTree(childNode);
					}
					else if (insertPositionDataSource[index] == insertObjectActionBase.GetDataReferenceString())
					{
						WriteChildNodesCore(templateWriter, childNode, insertPositionDataSource, index - 1);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public List<string> GetInsertPositionDataSources(SnapPieceTable sourcePieceTable, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (bookmark == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			Field val = sourcePieceTable.FindNonTemplateFieldByRunIndex(((DocumentInterval)bookmark).Interval.NormalizedStart.RunIndex);
			SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
			while (val != null)
			{
				CalculatedFieldBase val2 = ((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField((PieceTable)(object)sourcePieceTable, val);
				if (val2 != null && val2 is TemplatedFieldBase { DataSourceName: var text })
				{
					int num = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? (-1) : text.IndexOf('['));
					if (num > 0)
					{
						text = text.Substring(0, num);
					}
					else if (num == 0)
					{
						text = string.Empty;
					}
					list.Add(text);
				}
				val = val.Parent;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual InsertAction GetInsertAction(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, List<string> listNames, string listName, DataContext dataContext, DataBrowser dataBrowser, object dataSource, DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo, InsertAction parentAction, bool leafAction, List<string> insertPositionDataSources)
		{
			string listName2 = documentModel.GetListName(listNames, listName);
			if (dataBrowser.Parent == null || (IsRootListInsertAction(dataBrowser) && dataBrowser.DataSource is ITypedList && dataSource is IListSource))
			{
				listNames.Add(listName2);
				string dataSourceName = documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.FindDataSourceName(dataSource);
				return InsertObjectActionBase.Create(dataBrowser.DataSourceType, dataSourceName, GetDataMember(dataMemberInfo), parentAction, listName2);
			}
			string text = FieldPathService.DecodePath(dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo.DataMember);
			DataBrowser dataBrowser2 = ((DataContextBase)dataContext).GetDataBrowser(dataSource, text, true);
			if (ShouldCreateInsertAction(documentModel, dataSource, text))

		internal InsertActionTree CalculateInsertActionTree(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, SNDataInfo[] dataInfoArray, List<string> insertPositionDataSources)
		{
			RootInsertAction rootInsertAction = new RootInsertAction();
			List<string> listNames = new List<string>(documentModel.GetListNames());
			List<SNDataInfo> relatedDataInfos = new List<SNDataInfo>();
			foreach (SNDataInfo sNDataInfo in dataInfoArray)
			{
				InsertAction insertAction = CalculateInsertAction(documentModel, listNames, sNDataInfo, rootInsertAction, insertPositionDataSources);
				if (insertAction != null)
				{
					if (InduceRelation && sNDataInfo.RelatedData != null)
					{
						CalculateRelation(sNDataInfo, dataInfoArray, relatedDataInfos, documentModel, listNames, rootInsertAction, insertPositionDataSources);
					}
					rootInsertAction.AddLeafAction(insertAction);
				}
			}
			return rootInsertAction.GetInsertActionTree();
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateRelation(SNDataInfo dataInfo, SNDataInfo[] dataInfoArray, List<SNDataInfo> relatedDataInfos, SnapDocumentModel documentModel, List<string> listNames, RootInsertAction rootInsertAction, List<string> insertPositionDataSources)
		{
			SNDataInfo[] relatedData = dataInfo.RelatedData;
			foreach (SNDataInfo sNDataInfo in relatedData)
			{
				if (relatedDataInfos.Contains(sNDataInfo) || !CanAddRelatedDataInfo(sNDataInfo, dataInfoArray))
				{
					continue;
				}
				DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = DataMemberInfo.Create(sNDataInfo.EscapedDataPaths);
				if (ShouldCreateInsertAction(documentModel, ((DataPair)sNDataInfo).Source, dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo.DataMember))
				{
					InsertAction insertAction = CalculateInsertAction(documentModel, listNames, sNDataInfo, rootInsertAction, insertPositionDataSources);
					if (insertAction != null)
					{
						rootInsertAction.AddLeafAction(new InsertRelationAction(insertAction));
					}
					relatedDataInfos.Add(sNDataInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		private InsertAction CalculateInsertAction(SnapDocumentModel documentModel, List<string> listNames, SNDataInfo dataInfo, InsertAction root, List<string> insertPositionDataSources)
		{
			object source = ((DataPair)dataInfo).Source;
			string member = ((DataPair)dataInfo).Member;
			IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).GetService<IDataSourceDisplayNameProvider>();
			IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher = documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher;
			DataSourceInfo info = dataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(((DataPair)dataInfo).Source);
			if (source is ParametersDataSource)
			{
				DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = DataMemberInfo.Create(dataInfo.DataPaths);
				return new InsertParameterAsSNTextFieldAction(dataMemberInfo.ColumnName, root);
			}
			if (info == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataContext val = (DataContext)(object)new SnapDataContext((IEnumerable<ICalculatedField>)info.CalculatedFields, documentModel.Parameters, service);
			try
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = ((DataContextBase)val).GetDataBrowser(source, member, true);
				if (dataBrowser == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((dataSourceDispatcher.DefaultDataSource != source) ? dataSourceDispatcher.FindDataSourceName(source) : DesignBindingHelper.GetListName(val, source, member));
				return GetInsertAction(documentModel, listNames, empty, val, dataBrowser, source, DataMemberInfo.Create(dataInfo.EscapedDataPaths), root, leafAction: true, insertPositionDataSources);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanAddRelatedDataInfo(SNDataInfo relatedDataInfo, SNDataInfo[] dataInfos)
		{
			return Array.TrueForAll(dataInfos, (SNDataInfo dataInfo) => !dataInfo.IsNeighbour(relatedDataInfo));
		}

		protected virtual void WriteTemplateForActionsRecursive(InsertActionTreeNode node)
		{
			node.Action.WriteStartText(this);
			foreach (InsertActionTreeNode childNode in node.ChildNodes)
			{
				node.Action.BeforeWriteInnerAction(childNode.Action, this);
				WriteTemplateForActionsRecursive(childNode);
				node.Action.AfterWriteInnerAction(childNode.Action, this);
			}
			node.Action.WriteEndText(this);
		}

		public Table EndTable(string styleName, int level, WidthUnitInfo preferredWidthInfo)
		{
			Table result = currentTable;
			EnsureCellSpansValid(currentTable);
			ApplyTableStyle(currentTable, styleName, level);
			if (preferredWidthInfo != null)
			{
				PreferredWidth preferredWidth = currentTable.TableProperties.PreferredWidth;
				((UndoableIndexBasedObject<WidthUnitInfo, DocumentModelChangeActions>)(object)preferredWidth).BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					((UndoableIndexBasedObject<WidthUnitInfo, DocumentModelChangeActions>)(object)preferredWidth).CopyFrom(preferredWidthInfo);
				}
				finally
				{
					((UndoableIndexBasedObject<WidthUnitInfo, DocumentModelChangeActions>)(object)preferredWidth).EndUpdate();
				}
			}
			currentTableCell = currentTable.ParentCell;
			if (currentTableCell != null)
			{
				currentTableRow = currentTableCell.Row;
				currentTable = currentTableCell.Table;
			}
			else
			{

			}
			return result;
		}

		public void EnsureCellSpansValid(Table table)
		{
			int lcmColumnSpan = 1;
			((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table.Rows).ForEach((Action<TableRow>)delegate(TableRow row)
			{
				int totalCellsInRowConsiderGrid = table.GetTotalCellsInRowConsiderGrid(row);
				lcmColumnSpan = (int)MathUtils.LCM(lcmColumnSpan, totalCellsInRowConsiderGrid);
			});
			((TableItemCollectionCore<TableRow, Table>)(object)table.Rows).ForEach((Action<TableRow>)delegate(TableRow row)
			{
				int multiplier = lcmColumnSpan / table.GetTotalCellsInRowConsiderGrid(row);
				if (multiplier != 1)
				{
					if (row.GridBefore > 0)
					{
						row.Properties.GridBefore = row.GridBefore * multiplier;
					}
					if (row.GridAfter > 0)
					{
						row.Properties.GridAfter = row.GridAfter * multiplier;
					}
					((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)row.Cells).ForEach((Action<TableCell>)delegate(TableCell cell)
					{
						cell.Properties.ColumnSpan = cell.ColumnSpan * multiplier;
					});
				}
			});
		}

		public virtual void EndTableRow(bool applyEqualPercentWidthToCells)
		{
			if (((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)currentTableRow.Cells).Count > 0)
			{
				currentTable.Rows.AddInternal(currentTableRow);

				{
					ApplyEqualPercentWidthToCells(currentTableRow.Cells);
				}
			}
			currentTableRow = null;
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyEqualPercentWidthToCells(TableCellCollection cells)
		{
			int count = ((TableItemCollectionCore<TableCell, TableRow>)(object)cells).Count;
			int num = 5000;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{

	internal static class DragCaretTypeCalculator
	{
		public static DragCaretType CalculateDragCaretType(InsertActionTree actionTree, List<string> insertPositionDataSources)
		{
			InsertActionTreeNode rootNode = actionTree.RootNode;
			DragCaretType dragCaretType = DragCaretType.Default;
			foreach (InsertActionTreeNode childNode in rootNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (!(childNode.Action is InsertObjectActionBase insertObjectActionBase))
				{
					dragCaretType = GetDragCaretType(dragCaretType, DragCaretType.InsertField);
					continue;
				}
				string dataReferenceString = insertObjectActionBase.GetDataReferenceString();
				int num = insertPositionDataSources.IndexOf(dataReferenceString);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					dragCaretType = GetDragCaretType(dragCaretType, CalculateDragCaretTypeRecursive(childNode));
					continue;
				}
				DragCaretType newValue = CalculateDragCaretTypeCore(childNode, insertPositionDataSources, num - 1);
				dragCaretType = GetDragCaretType(dragCaretType, newValue);
			}
			return dragCaretType;
		}

		private static DragCaretType CalculateDragCaretTypeRecursive(InsertActionTreeNode rootNode)
		{
			DragCaretType dragCaretType = ((!(rootNode.Action is InsertSNListAction)) ? DragCaretType.InsertField : DragCaretType.InsertList);
			foreach (InsertActionTreeNode childNode in rootNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				DragCaretType dragCaretType2 = CalculateDragCaretTypeRecursive(childNode);
				dragCaretType = ((dragCaretType != DragCaretType.InsertList || dragCaretType2 != DragCaretType.InsertList) ? GetDragCaretType(dragCaretType, dragCaretType2) : DragCaretType.InsertMasterDetail);
			}
			return dragCaretType;
		}

		private static DragCaretType CalculateDragCaretTypeCore(InsertActionTreeNode parentNode, List<string> insertPositionDataSource, int index)
		{
			DragCaretType dragCaretType = DragCaretType.Default;
			foreach (InsertActionTreeNode childNode in parentNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (!(childNode.Action is InsertObjectActionBase insertObjectActionBase))
				{
					DragCaretType newValue = CalculateDragCaretTypeRecursive(childNode);
					dragCaretType = GetDragCaretType(dragCaretType, newValue);
				}
				else if (index < 0)
				{
					DragCaretType newValue2 = CalculateDragCaretTypeRecursive(childNode);
					dragCaretType = GetDragCaretType(dragCaretType, newValue2);
				}
				else if (insertPositionDataSource[index] == insertObjectActionBase.GetDataReferenceString())
				{
					dragCaretType = CalculateDragCaretTypeCore(childNode, insertPositionDataSource, index - 1);
				}
			}
			return dragCaretType;
		}

		private static DragCaretType GetDragCaretType(DragCaretType oldValue, DragCaretType newValue)
		{
			if (newValue <= oldValue)
			{
				return oldValue;
			}
			return newValue;
		}
	}

	public class ItemWithUserData<TItem, TUserData>
	{
		private readonly TItem item;

		private readonly TUserData userData;

		public TItem Item => item;

		public TUserData UserData => userData;

		public ItemWithUserData(TItem item, TUserData userData)
		{
			this.item = item;
			this.userData = userData;
		}
	}
	public class HierarchicalController<TItem, TUserData> where TItem : class, ISupportHierarchy<TItem> where TUserData : class
	{
		private Stack<ItemWithUserData<TItem, TUserData>> enteredItems;

		private EventHandler beforeChangeCurrentItem;

		private EventHandler afterChangeCurrentItem;

		public virtual TItem CurrentItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (enteredItems.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return enteredItems.Peek().Item;
			}
		}

		public virtual TUserData CurrentUserData
		{
			get
			{
				if (enteredItems.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return enteredItems.Peek().UserData;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler BeforeChangeCurrentItem
		{
			add
			{
				beforeChangeCurrentItem = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(beforeChangeCurrentItem, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				beforeChangeCurrentItem = Delegate.Remove(beforeChangeCurrentItem, value) as EventHandler;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler AfterChangeCurrentItem
		{
			add
			{
				afterChangeCurrentItem = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(afterChangeCurrentItem, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				afterChangeCurrentItem = Delegate.Remove(afterChangeCurrentItem, value) as EventHandler;
			}
		}

		public HierarchicalController()
		{
			enteredItems = new Stack<ItemWithUserData<TItem, TUserData>>();
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseBeforeChangeCurrentItem()
		{
			if (beforeChangeCurrentItem != null)
			{
				beforeChangeCurrentItem(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseAfterChangeCurrentItem()
		{
			if (afterChangeCurrentItem != null)
			{
				afterChangeCurrentItem(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public virtual void ChangeCurrentItem(TItem item, TUserData userData)
		{
			if (item == CurrentItem)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				RaiseBeforeChangeCurrentItem();
				ProcessLeavedItems(item);
				if (item != CurrentItem)
				{
					ProcessEnteredItems(item, userData);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				RaiseAfterChangeCurrentItem();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessLeavedItems(TItem item)
		{
			while (ShouldLeaveCurrentItem(item))
			{
				enteredItems.Pop();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessEnteredItems(TItem item, TUserData userData)
		{
			if (item != null && ((ISupportHierarchy<TItem>)item).Parent != CurrentItem)
			{
				ProcessEnteredItems(((ISupportHierarchy<TItem>)item).Parent, userData);
			}
			enteredItems.Push(new ItemWithUserData<TItem, TUserData>(item, userData));
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldLeaveCurrentItem(TItem item)
		{
			if (CurrentItem != null)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					return !((ISupportHierarchy<TItem>)item).Inside(CurrentItem);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class SnapMouseHandler : RichEditMouseHandler
	{
		private HierarchicalController<Field, PieceTable> fieldHierarchicalController;

		public HierarchicalController<Field, PieceTable> FieldHierarchicalController => fieldHierarchicalController;

		public SnapMouseHandler(IRichEditControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
			fieldHierarchicalController = CreateFieldHierarchicalController();
			SubscribeFieldHierarchicalControllerEvents();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (fieldHierarchicalController != null)
				{
					UnsubscribeFieldHierarchicalControllerEvents();
				}
				fieldHierarchicalController = null;
			}
			((MouseHandler)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected virtual HierarchicalController<Field, PieceTable> CreateFieldHierarchicalController()
		{
			return new HierarchicalController<Field, PieceTable>();
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeFieldHierarchicalControllerEvents()
		{
			FieldHierarchicalController.BeforeChangeCurrentItem += BeforeChangeCurrentItem;
			FieldHierarchicalController.AfterChangeCurrentItem += AfterChangeCurrentItem;
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeFieldHierarchicalControllerEvents()
		{
			FieldHierarchicalController.BeforeChangeCurrentItem -= BeforeChangeCurrentItem;
			FieldHierarchicalController.AfterChangeCurrentItem -= AfterChangeCurrentItem;
		}

		protected internal override DefaultMouseHandlerState CreateDefaultState()
		{
			return (DefaultMouseHandlerState)(object)new SnapDefaultMouseHandlerState(this);
		}

		protected internal override RichEditRectangularObjectResizeMouseHandlerState CreateRectangularObjectResizeState(RectangularObjectHotZone hotZone, RichEditHitTestResultCore result)
		{
			return (RichEditRectangularObjectResizeMouseHandlerState)(object)new SnapRectangularObjectResizeMouseHandlerState(this, hotZone, result);
		}

		protected virtual void AfterChangeCurrentItem(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Field currentItem = FieldHierarchicalController.CurrentItem;
			if (currentItem != null)
			{
				OnCurrentFieldChanged(FieldHierarchicalController.CurrentUserData, currentItem);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeChangeCurrentItem(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Field currentItem = FieldHierarchicalController.CurrentItem;
			if (currentItem != null)
			{
				OnCurrentFieldChanging(FieldHierarchicalController.CurrentUserData, currentItem);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnCurrentFieldChanged(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field)
		{
			((InnerSnapControl)(object)((RichEditMouseHandler)this).Control.InnerControl).OnCurrentFieldChanged(pieceTable, field);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCurrentFieldChanging(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field)
		{
			((InnerSnapControl)(object)((RichEditMouseHandler)this).Control.InnerControl).OnCurrentFieldChanging(pieceTable, field);
		}

		protected override void HandleMouseUp(PortableMouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((MouseHandler)this).HandleMouseUp(e);
			RichEditHitTestResultCore val = ((RichEditMouseHandler)this).CalculateHitTest(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
			if (val != null)
			{
				SnapPieceTable userData = (SnapPieceTable)(object)((DocumentLayoutPosition)val).PieceTable;
				Field val2 = FieldsHelper.FindFieldByHitTestResult(val);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					FieldHierarchicalController.ChangeCurrentItem(val2, (PieceTable)(object)userData);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override DragContentMouseHandlerStateCalculator CreateDragContentMouseHandlerStateCalculator()
		{
			return (DragContentMouseHandlerStateCalculator)(object)new SnapDragContentMouseHandlerStateCalculator(((RichEditMouseHandler)this).Control.InnerControl.Owner);
		}

		protected internal override DragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator CreateDragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator()
		{
			return (DragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator)(object)new SnapDragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator(((RichEditMouseHandler)this).Control.InnerControl.Owner);
		}

		public override void SwitchStateCore(MouseHandlerState newState, Point mousePosition)
		{
			((MouseHandler)this).SwitchStateCore(newState, mousePosition);
			UpdateTableViewInfoController(newState, mousePosition);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTableViewInfoController(MouseHandlerState newState, Point mousePosition)
		{
			ITableViewInfoControllerService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)((RichEditMouseHandler)this).Control.InnerControl).DocumentModel).GetService<ITableViewInfoControllerService>();
			RichEditView activeView = ((RichEditMouseHandler)this).Control.InnerControl.ActiveView;
			if (service != null && activeView != null)
			{
				activeView.TableController = service.Get(newState, activeView, mousePosition);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SnapDragContentMouseHandlerStateCalculator : DragContentMouseHandlerStateCalculator

		public override bool CanDropContentTo(RichEditHitTestResultCore hitTestResult, PieceTable pieceTable)

			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			currentBookmarkChanged = false;

				return false;
			}

			if (StartDragBookmark != null && !IsHitTestPositionOnBookmark(hitTestResult, StartDragBookmark.Bookmark))

				return false;
			}
			currentBookmarkChanged = documentModel.SelectionInfo.CheckCurrentSnapBookmark(suppressUpdate: true, internalUpdate: false, runLogPosition, runLogPosition, snapPieceTable);
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnInternalDragStart()

		}

		private bool IsHitTestPositionOnBookmark(RichEditHitTestResultCore hitTestResult, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RunIndex runIndex = ((DocumentInterval)bookmark).Interval.NormalizedStart.RunIndex;
			RunIndex runIndex2 = ((DocumentInterval)bookmark).Interval.NormalizedEnd.RunIndex;
			FormatterPosition startPos = ((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Box.StartPos;
			RunIndex runIndex3 = ((FormatterPosition)(ref startPos)).RunIndex;
			if (runIndex3 >= runIndex)
			{
				return runIndex3 <= runIndex2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private EnteredBookmarkInfo GetModifiedBookmark(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Stack<EnteredBookmarkInfo> enteredBookmarks = documentModel.EnteredBookmarks;
			foreach (EnteredBookmarkInfo item in enteredBookmarks)
			{
				if (item.Modified)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

			DocumentLogPosition val3 = (val.IsCodeView ? ((PieceTable)snapPieceTable).GetRunLogPosition(val.Result.Start) : ((PieceTable)snapPieceTable).GetRunLogPosition(val.LastRunIndex));
			RunIndex val4 = ((val3 - pos.LogPosition > pos.LogPosition - val2) ? val.FirstRunIndex : (val.LastRunIndex + 1));
