	public class SnapDragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator : DragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator
	{
		private readonly IInnerRichEditControlOwner owner;

		private readonly EnteredBookmarkInfo startDragBookmark;

		private SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => (SnapDocumentModel)(object)((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)((IRichEditControl)owner).InnerControl).DocumentModel;

		private EnteredBookmarkInfo StartDragBookmark => startDragBookmark;

		public SnapDragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator(IInnerRichEditControlOwner owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			Stack<EnteredBookmarkInfo> enteredBookmarks = DocumentModel.EnteredBookmarks;
			if (enteredBookmarks.Count == 0)
			{
				startDragBookmark = null;
			}
			else
			{
				startDragBookmark = enteredBookmarks.Peek();
			}
		}

		public override bool CanDropTo(RichEditHitTestResultCore point)
		{
			if (!((DragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator)this).CanDropTo(point))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (StartDragBookmark == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return IsHitTestPositionOnBookmark(point, StartDragBookmark.Bookmark);
		}

		private bool IsHitTestPositionOnBookmark(RichEditHitTestResultCore hitTestResult, SnapBookmark bookmark)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Page == null || ((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Column == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentLayout documentLayout = ((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).DocumentLayout;
			int pageIndex = ((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Page.PageIndex;
			DocumentModelPosition normalizedStart = ((DocumentInterval)bookmark).Interval.NormalizedStart;
			DocumentModelPosition normalizedEnd = ((DocumentInterval)bookmark).Interval.NormalizedEnd;
			DocumentLayoutPosition val = documentLayout.CreateLayoutPosition(((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).PieceTable, normalizedStart.LogPosition, pageIndex);
			DocumentLayoutPosition val2 = documentLayout.CreateLayoutPosition(((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).PieceTable, normalizedEnd.LogPosition - 1, pageIndex);
			if (!val.Update(documentLayout.Pages, (DocumentLayoutDetailsLevel)6) || !val2.Update(documentLayout.Pages, (DocumentLayoutDetailsLevel)6))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pageIndex < val.Page.PageIndex || pageIndex > val2.Page.PageIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FormatterPosition val3 = ((Box)((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Column).StartPos;
			if (((FormatterPosition)(ref val3)).RunIndex > normalizedStart.RunIndex)
			{
				val3 = ((Box)((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Column).EndPos;
				if (((FormatterPosition)(ref val3)).RunIndex < normalizedEnd.RunIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			int num = hitTestResult.LogicalPoint.Y + ((DragFloatingObjectMouseHandlerStateCalculator)this).LogicalPointOffset.Y;
			if (((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Column == val.Column)
			{
				if (((DocumentLayoutPosition)hitTestResult).Column == val2.Column)
				{
					if (num > ((LayoutItem)val.Box).Bounds.Top)
					{
						return num < ((LayoutItem)val2.Box).Bounds.Bottom;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return num > ((LayoutItem)val.Box).Bounds.Top;
			}
			return num < ((LayoutItem)val2.Box).Bounds.Bottom;
		}
	}

		private void CopyCustomSeparator(SnapDocument sourceDocument)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (sourceDocument is SnapNativeDocument snapNativeDocument && customSeparator != null)
			{
				SnapPieceTable pieceTable = snapNativeDocument.PieceTable;
				SnapPieceTable pieceTable2 = customSeparator.PieceTable;
				DocumentModelCopyManager val = new DocumentModelCopyManager((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable, (PieceTable)(object)pieceTable2, (ParagraphNumerationCopyOptions)0);
				val.TargetPosition.CopyFrom(DocumentModelPosition.FromParagraphStart((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable2, ((IndexedTree<Paragraph, ParagraphIndex>)(object)((PieceTable)pieceTable2).Paragraphs).First.Index));
				CopySectionOperation val2 = ((DocumentModel)pieceTable.DocumentModel).CreateCopySectionOperation(val);
				val2.FixLastParagraph = true;
				((SelectionBasedOperation)val2).Execute(((PieceTable)pieceTable).DocumentStartLogPosition, ((PieceTable)pieceTable).DocumentEndLogPosition - ((PieceTable)pieceTable).DocumentStartLogPosition + 1, false);
				((List<Section, SectionIndex>)(object)((DocumentModel)pieceTable2.DocumentModel).Sections).Last.CopyFromCore(((List<Section, SectionIndex>)(object)((DocumentModel)pieceTable.DocumentModel).Sections).Last);
			}
		}

		void IDataSourceContainer.RegisterDataSource(string dataSourceName, object dataSource)
		{
			if (documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.GetDataSource(dataSourceName) == null)
			{
				documentModel.BeginUpdateDataSource();
				documentModel.DataSources.Add(dataSourceName, dataSource);
				documentModel.EndUpdateDataSource();
			}
		}

		private void DataSourceDispatcherCollectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{

			}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDataMember()

		}

		internal void SubscribeDataSourceEvents()
		{
			documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.CollectionChanged += DataSourceDispatcherCollectionChanged;
		}

		{
			documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.CollectionChanged -= DataSourceDispatcherCollectionChanged;
		}

		protected internal void SetRootDataContext(bool force)
		{
			DataSourceInfo info = ((!string.Equals(dataSourceName, DataSourceDispatcher.DefaultDataSourceName)) ? DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(dataSourceName) : DataSourceDispatcher.DefaultDataSourceInfo);
			SetRootDataContext(info, force);
		}

		protected internal void SetRootDataContext(DataSourceInfo info, bool force)
		{
			if (!((BaseOptions)this).IsLockUpdate && (force || !InfosAreEqual(info, contextInfo)))
			{
				contextInfo = info;
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
				DocumentModel.SetRootDataContext(info);
				((DocumentModel)DocumentModel).UpdateFields((UpdateFieldOperationType)4);
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
				RefreshRecordCount();
			}
		}

		private static bool InfosAreEqual(DataSourceInfo a, DataSourceInfo b)
		{
			if (a == b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (b == null || a == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a.DataSource != b.DataSource)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(a.DataSourceName, b.DataSourceName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = a.CalculatedFields.Count;
			if (b.CalculatedFields.Count != count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (a.CalculatedFields[i] != b.CalculatedFields[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void EndUpdate()
		{
			((BaseOptions)this).EndUpdate();
			if (DocumentModel != null)
			{
				SetRootDataContext(force: true);
			}
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(SnapMailMergeVisualOptions value)
		{
			((BaseOptions)this).BeginUpdate();
			CopyFromCore(value);
			((BaseOptions)this).EndUpdate();
		}

		protected virtual void CopyFromCore(SnapMailMergeVisualOptions value)
		{
			dataMember = ((IDataSourceContainerOptions)value).DataMember;
			dataSourceName = value.DataSourceName;
			sorting.AddRange(value.Sorting);
			filterString = value.FilterString;
			currentRecordIndex = value.CurrentRecordIndex;
			progressIndicationFormVisible = value.ProgressIndicationFormVisible;
		}

		protected internal override void ResetCore()
		{
			ResetMailMerge();
		}

		public void ResetMailMerge()
		{
			dataMember = string.Empty;
			dataSourceName = null;
			currentRecordIndex = 0;
			filterString = string.Empty;
			progressIndicationFormVisible = true;
			if (sorting != null)
			{
				sorting.Clear();
			}
			if (DocumentModel != null)
			{
				DocumentModel.RaiseSnapMailMergeDataSourceChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void OnSortingChanged(GroupFieldInfoCollection oldValue)
		{
			((RichEditNotificationOptions)this).OnChanged<GroupFieldInfoCollection>("SortingBindings", oldValue, SortingBindings);
		}

		public int RefreshRecordCount()
		{
			recordCount = 0;
			if (DataSource == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (DataSource is DataSet && string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataMember.Trim()))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return RefreshRecordsCountCore();
		}

		private int RefreshRecordsCountCore()
		{
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			IFieldContextService fieldContextService = service.FieldContextService;
			IFieldPathService fieldPathService = service.FieldPathService;
			ICalculationContext calculationContext = fieldContextService.BeginCalculation(DataSourceDispatcher);
			string fieldPath = FieldPathService.EncodePath(DataMember);
			FieldPathDataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = fieldPathService.FromString(fieldPath).DataMemberInfo;
			dataMemberInfo.AddFilter(FilterString);
			IFieldContext fieldContext = new RootFieldContext(DataSourceDispatcher, DataSourceName);
			using (IDataEnumerator dataEnumerator = calculationContext.GetChildDataEnumerator(fieldContext, dataMemberInfo))
			{
				if (dataEnumerator != null)
				{
					while (dataEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						recordCount++;
					}
				}
			}
			fieldContextService.EndCalculation(calculationContext);
			return recordCount;
		}
	}
	public class NativeSnapMailMergeOptionsTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(value, attributes);
			if (((IDataSourceContainerOptions)(IDataDispatcherOptions)value).DataSource != null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				if (item.Name != "SortingBindings" && item.Name != "Filters")
				{
					propertyDescriptorCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return propertyDescriptorCollection;
		}
	}
	[Editor("DevExpress.Snap.Extensions.Native.SortingCollectionEditor,DevExpress.Snap.v23.2.Extensions", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class GroupFieldInfoCollection : IList<GroupFieldInfo>, ICollection<GroupFieldInfo>, IEnumerable<GroupFieldInfo>, IEnumerable, ICloneable<GroupFieldInfoCollection>, IList, ICollection
	{
		private readonly List<GroupFieldInfo> innerList;

		private readonly NativeSnapMailMergeVisualOptions owner;

		public GroupFieldInfo this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(innerList[index] == value))
				{
					GroupFieldInfoCollection oldValue = Clone();
					innerList[index] = value;
					Update();
					owner.OnSortingChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		bool ICollection<GroupFieldInfo>.IsReadOnly => false;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = (GroupFieldInfo)value;
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => this;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => false;

		public GroupFieldInfoCollection(NativeSnapMailMergeVisualOptions owner)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)owner, "owner");
			this.owner = owner;
			innerList = new List<GroupFieldInfo>();
		}

		protected void Update()
		{
			owner.SetRootDataContext(force: true);
		}

		public int IndexOf(GroupFieldInfo item)
		{
			return innerList.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, GroupFieldInfo item)
		{
			GroupFieldInfoCollection oldValue = Clone();
			innerList.Insert(index, item);
			Update();
			owner.OnSortingChanged(oldValue);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			GroupFieldInfoCollection oldValue = Clone();
			innerList.RemoveAt(index);
			Update();
			owner.OnSortingChanged(oldValue);
		}

		public void Add(GroupFieldInfo item)
		{
			GroupFieldInfoCollection oldValue = Clone();
			innerList.Add(item);
			Update();
			owner.OnSortingChanged(oldValue);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (Count != 0)
			{
				GroupFieldInfoCollection oldValue = Clone();
				innerList.Clear();
				Update();
				owner.OnSortingChanged(oldValue);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(GroupFieldInfo item)
		{
			return innerList.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(GroupFieldInfo[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			innerList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(GroupFieldInfo item)
		{
			GroupFieldInfoCollection oldValue = Clone();
			bool flag = innerList.Remove(item);
			if (flag)
			{
				Update();
				owner.OnSortingChanged(oldValue);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public IEnumerator<GroupFieldInfo> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			Add((GroupFieldInfo)value);
			return innerList.Count - 1;
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains((GroupFieldInfo)value);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf((GroupFieldInfo)value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, (GroupFieldInfo)value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove((GroupFieldInfo)value);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			CopyTo((GroupFieldInfo[])array, index);
		}

		public GroupFieldInfoCollection Clone()
		{
			GroupFieldInfoCollection groupFieldInfoCollection = new GroupFieldInfoCollection(owner);
			groupFieldInfoCollection.innerList.AddRange(this);
			return groupFieldInfoCollection;
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<GroupFieldInfo> collection)
		{
			GroupFieldInfoCollection groupFieldInfoCollection = Clone();
			innerList.AddRange(collection);
			if (Count != groupFieldInfoCollection.Count)
			{
				Update();
				owner.OnSortingChanged(groupFieldInfoCollection);
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.Data

	public class DataMemberInfo
	{
		private static readonly DataMemberInfo EmptyDataMemberInfo = CreateEmpty();

		public string DataMember { get; private set; }

		public DataMemberInfo ParentDataMemberInfo { get; private set; }

		public string ColumnName { get; private set; }

		private static DataMemberInfo CreateEmpty()
		{
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = new DataMemberInfo(string.Empty, null, string.Empty);
			dataMemberInfo.ParentDataMemberInfo = dataMemberInfo;
			return dataMemberInfo;
		}

		public static DataMemberInfo Create(string[] escDataPaths)
		{
			if (escDataPaths == null || escDataPaths.Length == 0)
			{
				return EmptyDataMemberInfo;
			}
			if (escDataPaths.Length == 1)
			{
				return new DataMemberInfo(escDataPaths[0], EmptyDataMemberInfo, escDataPaths[0]);
			}
			string[] array = new string[escDataPaths.Length - 1];
			Array.Copy(escDataPaths, 0, array, 0, escDataPaths.Length - 1);
			return new DataMemberInfo(string.Join(".", escDataPaths), Create(array), escDataPaths[escDataPaths.Length - 1]);
		}

		private DataMemberInfo(string dataMember, DataMemberInfo parentDataMemberInfo, string columnName)
		{
			DataMember = dataMember;
			ParentDataMemberInfo = parentDataMemberInfo;
			ColumnName = columnName;
		}
	}
	public class SNDataInfo : DataInfo
	{
		public string[] DataPaths { get; private set; }

		public string[] EscapedDataPaths { get; private set; }

		internal SNDataInfo[] RelatedData { get; set; }

		internal int Level => DataPaths.Length;

		public SNDataInfo(object dataSource, string dataMember, string displayName)
			: this(dataSource, new string[1] { dataMember }, displayName)

		}

			: this(dataSource, new string[1] { dataMember }, dataMember)

		}

			: this(dataSource, string.Join(".", dataPaths), dataPaths, escDataPaths, displayName)

		}

		public SNDataInfo(object dataSource, string member, string[] dataPaths, string displayName)
			: this(dataSource, member, dataPaths, dataPaths, displayName)

		}

		public SNDataInfo(object dataSource, string member, string[] dataPaths, string[] escDataPaths, string displayName)
			: base(dataSource, member, displayName)
		{
			DataPaths = dataPaths;
			EscapedDataPaths = escDataPaths;
		}

		internal bool IsNeighbour(SNDataInfo dataInfo)
		{
			if (((DataPair)this).Source != ((DataPair)dataInfo).Source)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Level != dataInfo.Level)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Level - 1; i++)
			{
				if (DataPaths[i] != dataInfo.DataPaths[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is SNDataInfo sNDataInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((DataPair)this).Source == ((DataPair)sNDataInfo).Source)
			{
				return ((DataPair)this).Member == ((DataPair)sNDataInfo).Member;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (((DataPair)this).Source.GetHashCode() << 15) | ((DataPair)this).Member.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		public void Initialize(DataBrowser dataBrowser, GroupFieldInfo[] groupFields, CriteriaOperator filterExpression)
		{
			ListBrowser val = (ListBrowser)(object)((dataBrowser is ListBrowser) ? dataBrowser : null);
			if (val != null && ShouldInitialize(groupFields, filterExpression))
			{
				((SnapListController)(object)val.ListController).Initialize(fCalculatedFields, parameterCollection, groupFields, filterExpression, dataBrowser);
				this.groupFields = groupFields;
				this.filterExpression = filterExpression;
				initialized = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldInitialize(GroupFieldInfo[] newGroupFields, CriteriaOperator newFilterExpression)
		{
			if (!initialized)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(newFilterExpression, filterExpression))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((groupFields == null && newGroupFields != null) || (groupFields != null && newGroupFields == null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (groupFields != null)
			{
				if (newGroupFields.Length != groupFields.Length)
				{
					return true;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < groupFields.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!groupFields[i].Equals(newGroupFields[i]))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override CalculatedPropertyDescriptorBase CreateCalculatedPropertyDescriptor(ICalculatedField calculatedField)
		{
			return (CalculatedPropertyDescriptorBase)(object)new CalculatedPropertyDescriptor(calculatedField, parameterCollection, (DataContext)(object)this);
		}

		{

			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			return ((DataContext)this).GetDataSourceDisplayName(dataSource, dataMember);
		}

		public DataColumnSortInfo[] GetDataColumnSortInfo(GroupFieldInfo[] groupFields)
		{
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<DataColumnSortInfo> list = new List<DataColumnSortInfo>();
			if (groupFields == null)
			{
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in groupFields)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupFieldInfo.FieldName))
				{
					DataColumnInfo val = ((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).Columns[groupFieldInfo.FieldName];
					if (val != null)
					{
						DataColumnSortInfo item = new DataColumnSortInfo(val, groupFieldInfo.SortOrder, ToColumnGroupInterval(groupFieldInfo.GroupInterval));
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static ColumnGroupInterval ToColumnGroupInterval(GroupInterval groupInterval)
		{
			return (ColumnGroupInterval)(groupInterval switch
			{
				GroupInterval.Day => 2, 
				GroupInterval.Month => 3, 
				GroupInterval.Year => 4, 
				GroupInterval.Smart => 5, 
				_ => 0, 
			});
		}

		public void InitializeProperties(IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields, DataBrowser dataBrowser)
		{
			properties.Clear();
			if (calculatedFields == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in calculatedFields)
			{
				if (((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).Columns[calculatedField.Name] == null)
				{
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = dataBrowser.FindItemProperty(calculatedField.Name, true);
					if (propertyDescriptor is CalculatedPropertyDescriptorBase)
					{
						properties.Add(propertyDescriptor);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeCalculatedFields(IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			properties.Clear();
			if (calculatedFields == null || calculatedFields.Count() == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SnapDataContext snapDataContext = new SnapDataContext(calculatedFields, parameters, null);
			try
			{
				foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in calculatedFields)
				{
					DataBrowser dataBrowser = ((DataContextBase)snapDataContext).GetDataBrowser(calculatedField.DataSource, calculatedField.DataMember, true);
					if (dataBrowser != null && ((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).Columns[calculatedField.Name] == null)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = dataBrowser.FindItemProperty(calculatedField.Name, true);
						if (propertyDescriptor is CalculatedPropertyDescriptorBase)
						{
							properties.Add(propertyDescriptor);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDataContext)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual SnapListController CreateDetailController(string fullPath, ListParameters listParameters, int controllerRow, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields, string[] nestedFields)
		{
			int relationIndex = GetRelationIndex(fullPath);
			if (relationIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList detailList = ((DataController)sourceDataController).GetDetailList(controllerRow, relationIndex);
			if (detailList == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SnapListController snapListController = new SnapListController();
			snapListController.Update(detailList, listParameters, calculatedFields, parameters, nestedFields);
			return snapListController;
		}

		private int GetRelationIndex(string fullPath)
		{
			DataColumnInfo val = ((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).DetailColumns[fullPath];
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.Index;
			}
			DataColumnInfo val2 = ((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).Columns[fullPath];
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				val2 = RegisterComplexColumn(fullPath);
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
			}
			((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).DetailColumns.Add(val2);
			return val2.Index;
		}

		private DataColumnInfo RegisterComplexColumn(string fullPath)
		{
			if (fullPath.IndexOf('.') < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).Columns.Add((PropertyDescriptor)(object)new SnapComplexPropertyDescriptor((DataControllerBase)(object)sourceDataController, fullPath));
		}

		internal bool Update(object source, ListParameters listParameters, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields, ParameterCollection parameters, string[] nestedFields)
		{
			this.parameters = parameters;
			if (listParameters != null)
			{
				groupFields = listParameters.GetGroupFieldInfos();
				filterExpression = CriteriaOperator.Parse(GetFullFilterString(listParameters.Filters), new object[0]);
				if (parameters != null)
				{
					ParametersValueSetter.Process(filterExpression, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)parameters);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				groupFields = null;
			}
			this.nestedFields = GetAllNestedFields(nestedFields);
			((ListControllerBase)this).SetList(GetDataSourceSource(source));
			if (sourceDataController == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			InitializeCalculatedFields(calculatedFields);
			ApplyProperties();
			GroupData();
			((DataController)sourceDataController).FilterCriteria = filterExpression;
			((DataController)sourceDataController).ExpandAll();
			return true;
		}

		private string[] GetAllNestedFields(string[] nestedFields)
		{
			if (groupFields != null)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				if (nestedFields != null && nestedFields.Length != 0)
				{
					list.AddRange(nestedFields);
				}
				GroupFieldInfo[] array = groupFields;
				foreach (GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo in array)
				{
					if (!list.Contains(groupFieldInfo.FieldName, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						list.Add(groupFieldInfo.FieldName);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return nestedFields;
		}

		private string GetFullFilterString(FilterProperties filterProperties)
		{
			if (filterProperties == null || filterProperties.IsEmpty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (filterProperties.Filters.Count == 1)
			{
				return filterProperties.Filters[0];
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (string filter in filterProperties.Filters)
			{
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("&&");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("(");
				stringBuilder.Append(filter);
				stringBuilder.Append(")");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public object GetGroupSummaryValue(int controllerRow, string columnName, SummaryRunning summaryRunning, SummaryItemType summaryFunc, bool ignoreNullValues, int groupLevel)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataColumnInfo val = ((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).Columns[columnName];
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SummaryItemCollection val2 = ((summaryRunning == SummaryRunning.Report) ? TotalSummary : GroupSummary);
			SummaryItem val3 = (SummaryItem)(object)new SnapSummaryItem(val, summaryFunc);
			int summaryItemIndex = GetSummaryItemIndex(val2, val3);
			if (summaryItemIndex < 0)
			{
				val2.Add(val3);
			}
			else
			{
				val3 = ((ColumnInfoNotificationCollection<SummaryItem>)(object)val2)[summaryItemIndex];
			}
			if (summaryRunning == SummaryRunning.Group)
			{
				return GetGroupSummaryValue(controllerRow, val3, groupLevel);
			}
			return val3.SummaryValue;
		}

		private int GetSummaryItemIndex(SummaryItemCollection collection, SummaryItem item)
		{
			int count = ((CollectionBase)(object)collection).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (((object)item).Equals((object)((ColumnInfoNotificationCollection<SummaryItem>)(object)collection)[i]))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

			finally
			{
				((object)this).Finalize();
			}
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && sourceDataController != null)
			{
				((DataControllerBase)sourceDataController).Dispose();
				sourceDataController = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class SnapFieldDataSource
	{
		private readonly object source;

		public SnapFieldDataSource(object source)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull(source, "source");
			this.source = source;
		}

		public object GetFieldValue(string fieldName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(fieldName, "fieldName");
			return GetPropertyDescriptor(fieldName)?.GetValue(source);
		}

		private PropertyDescriptor GetPropertyDescriptor(string columnName)
		{
			return FindProperty(source, columnName);
		}

		private static PropertyDescriptor FindProperty(object component, string name)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component);
			return properties.Find(name, ignoreCase: false);
		}
	}

	public class FieldPathDataMemberInfo
	{
		private static readonly FieldPathDataMemberInfo empty = new FieldPathDataMemberInfo();

		private readonly List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem> items;

		public static FieldPathDataMemberInfo Empty => empty;

		public bool IsEmpty => items.Count == 0;

		public FieldDataMemberInfoItem LastItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEmpty)
				{
					return items[items.Count - 1];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem> Items => items;

		public FieldPathDataMemberInfo()
		{
			items = new List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem>();
		}

		public void AddFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			Items.Add(new FieldDataMemberInfoItem(fieldName));
		}

		public void AddGroup(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			EnsureItemsNotEmpty();
			FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = Items[Items.Count - 1];
			fieldDataMemberInfoItem.AddGroup(groupProperties);
		}

		public void AddFilter(string filter)
		{
			EnsureItemsNotEmpty();
			FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = Items[Items.Count - 1];
			fieldDataMemberInfoItem.AddFilter(filter);
		}

		public void AddFilter(string filter, bool unescapeString)
		{
			if (unescapeString)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(filter.Length);
				for (int i = 0; i < filter.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = filter[i];
					if (c == '\\')
					{
						i++;
						if (i >= filter.Length)
						{
							break;
						}
						c = filter[i];
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
				filter = stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			AddFilter(filter);
		}

		internal void EnsureItemsNotEmpty()
		{
			if (Items.Count == 0)
			{
				Items.Add(new FieldDataMemberInfoItem(string.Empty));
			}
		}

		internal void AddEmptyFilterIfNeeded()
		{
			EnsureItemsNotEmpty();
			if (!Items[Items.Count - 1].HasFilters && !Items[Items.Count - 1].HasGroups)
			{
				AddFilter(string.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	public class FieldDataMemberInfoItem
	{
		private readonly string fieldName;

		private int currentGroupIndex;

		public string FieldName => fieldName;

		protected internal int CurrentGroupIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return currentGroupIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				currentGroupIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public List<GroupProperties> Groups { get; protected set; }

		public FilterProperties FilterProperties { get; protected set; }

		public bool HasFilters
		{
			get
			{
				if (FilterProperties != null)
				{
					return !FilterProperties.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool HasGroups
		{
			get
			{
				if (Groups != null)
				{
					return Groups.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public FieldDataMemberInfoItem(string fieldName)
		{
			this.fieldName = fieldName;
		}

		public FieldDataMemberInfoItem(string fieldName, List<GroupProperties> groups, FilterProperties filterProperties)
		{
			this.fieldName = fieldName;
			Groups = groups;
			FilterProperties = filterProperties;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return FieldName;
		}

		public virtual void AddGroup(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			if (Groups == null)
			{
				Groups = new List<GroupProperties>();
			}
			Groups.Add(groupProperties);
		}

		public virtual void InsertGroup(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			if (Groups == null)
			{
				Groups = new List<GroupProperties>();
			}
			Groups.Insert(currentGroupIndex, groupProperties);
			currentGroupIndex++;
		}

		public virtual void RemoveGroup(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			if (Groups.Remove(groupProperties))
			{
				currentGroupIndex--;
			}
		}

		public virtual void AddFilter(string filter)
		{
			if (FilterProperties == null)
			{
				FilterProperties = new FilterProperties();
			}
			FilterProperties.AddFilter(filter);
		}

		public virtual void MoveToGrouped(int index)
		{
			if (index > currentGroupIndex)
			{
				GroupProperties item = Groups[index];
				Groups.RemoveAt(index);
				Groups.Insert(currentGroupIndex, item);
				currentGroupIndex++;
			}
		}
	}

	public class FieldPathInfo
	{
		public virtual FieldPathDataMemberInfo DataMemberInfo { get; set; }

		public virtual FieldDataSourceInfo DataSourceInfo { get; set; }

		public string GetFullPath()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem> items = DataMemberInfo.Items;
			if (items == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = items[i];
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FieldName))
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text += ".";
					}
					text += fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FieldName;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

	public class GroupProperties
	{
		private List<GroupFieldInfo> groupFieldInfos;

		public string TemplateHeaderSwitch { get; set; }

		public string TemplateFooterSwitch { get; set; }

		public string TemplateSeparatorSwitch { get; set; }

		public bool HasTemplateHeader => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TemplateHeaderSwitch);

		public bool HasTemplateFooter => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TemplateFooterSwitch);

		public bool HasTemplateSeparator => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TemplateSeparatorSwitch);

		public bool HasGroupTemplates
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasTemplateHeader)
				{
					return HasTemplateFooter;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public List<GroupFieldInfo> GroupFieldInfos => groupFieldInfos;

		public GroupProperties()
		{
			groupFieldInfos = new List<GroupFieldInfo>();
		}

		public GroupFieldInfo AddField(string fieldName)
		{
			GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo = new GroupFieldInfo(fieldName);
			groupFieldInfos.Add(groupFieldInfo);
			return groupFieldInfo;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			int count = groupFieldInfos.Count;
			string[] array = new string[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = groupFieldInfos[i].ToString();
			}
			return string.Format("{0},{1},{2},{3}", TemplateHeaderSwitch, TemplateFooterSwitch, TemplateSeparatorSwitch, string.Join(",", array));
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is GroupProperties groupProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ListUtils.AreEquals(groupFieldInfos, groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ListUtils.CalcHashCode(groupFieldInfos);
		}
	}

	public abstract class DataAccessServiceBase
	{
		private readonly SnapDocumentModel documentModel;

		protected SnapDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		protected IDataSourceDispatcher DataSourceDispatcher => documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher;

		protected DataAccessServiceBase(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
		}

		protected DataBrowser GetDataBrowserForParentDataMember(SnapDataContext dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			return ((DataContextBase)dataContext).GetDataBrowser(dataSource, dataMember, true);
		}

	public class DataAccessService : DataAccessServiceBase, IDataAccessService
	{
		private class NoLimitDataAccessService : DataAccessService
		{
			public NoLimitDataAccessService(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
				: base(documentModel)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<string, bool> sortableCache = new Dictionary<string, bool>();

		public DataAccessService(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
		}

		public virtual IDataAccessService GetDataAccessServiceForPrinting()
		{
			return new NoLimitDataAccessService(base.DocumentModel);
		}

		public virtual Type GetFieldType(SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			return (Type)InvokeListControllerMethod((SnapListController controller, string columnName) => controller.GetColumnType(columnName), fieldInfo);
		}

		public virtual IEnumerable<FilterItem> GetFilterItems(SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			return (IEnumerable<FilterItem>)InvokeListControllerMethod(FilteredValuesHelper.GetUniqueFilteredValues, fieldInfo);
		}

		public IEnumerable<object> GetFilterValues(SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			return (IEnumerable<object>)InvokeListControllerMethod((SnapListController controller, string columnName) => controller.GetUniqueFilteredValues(columnName), fieldInfo);
		}

		private object InvokeListControllerMethod(Func<SnapListController, string, object> action, SnapFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			CalculatedFieldBase parsedInfo = fieldInfo.ParsedInfo;
			MergefieldField val = (MergefieldField)(object)((parsedInfo is MergefieldField) ? parsedInfo : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.DocumentModel.SnapMailMergeVisualOptions.DataSourceName == null)
			{
				if (fieldInfo.Field.Parent == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				SNListField sNListField = FieldsHelper.GetParsedInfoCore((PieceTable)(object)fieldInfo.PieceTable, fieldInfo.Field.Parent) as SNListField;
				if (sNListField == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldValueDescriptor = service.GetFieldValueDescriptor(fieldInfo.PieceTable, fieldInfo.Field, val.DataFieldName, new FieldNameStringScanner(val.DataFieldName));
			ICalculationContext calculationContext = service.FieldContextService.BeginCalculation(base.DataSourceDispatcher);
			try
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.DataFieldName) && val.DataFieldName.Contains("."))
				{
					calculationContext.FieldNames = new string[1] { val.DataFieldName };
				}
				SnapListController snapListController = calculationContext.RestoreListController(fieldValueDescriptor.ParentDataContext);
				if (snapListController == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return action(snapListController, val.DataFieldName);
			}
			finally
			{
				service.FieldContextService.EndCalculation(calculationContext);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowGroupAndSort(object dataSource, string dataMember, string fieldName)
		{
			return IsSortable(dataSource, dataMember, fieldName, allowEmptyDataSource: true);
		}

		public virtual bool AllowFilter(object dataSource, string dataMember, string fieldName)
		{
			return IsSortable(dataSource, dataMember, fieldName, allowEmptyDataSource: false);
		}

		public virtual bool AllowSum(object dataSource, string dataMember, string fieldName, SummaryItemType summaryItemType)
		{
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (dataSource == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SnapDataContext snapDataContext = new SnapDataContext(base.DataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields(dataSource), base.DocumentModel.Parameters, null);
			try
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowserForParentDataMember = GetDataBrowserForParentDataMember(snapDataContext, dataSource, dataMember);
				ListBrowser val = (ListBrowser)(object)((dataBrowserForParentDataMember is ListBrowser) ? dataBrowserForParentDataMember : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember)) ? $"{dataMember}.{fieldName}" : fieldName);
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = ((DataContextBase)snapDataContext).GetDataBrowser(dataSource, text, true);
				if (dataBrowser == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)summaryItemType == 3)
				{
					return true;
				}
				Type type = dataBrowser.DataSourceType;
				Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
				if (underlyingType != null)
				{
					type = underlyingType;
				}
				if ((int)summaryItemType == 1 || (int)summaryItemType == 2)
				{
					return typeof(IComparable).IsAssignableFrom(type);
				}
				if ((int)summaryItemType == 4 || (int)summaryItemType == 0)
				{
					if (type.Equals(typeof(DateTime)) || type.Equals(typeof(bool)))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return type.IsValueType;
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDataContext)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public virtual string GetFieldDisplayName(object dataSource, string dataMember, string fieldName)
		{
			SnapDataContext snapDataContext = new SnapDataContext(base.DataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields(dataSource), base.DocumentModel.Parameters, null);
			try
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
				{
					return ((DataContext)snapDataContext).GetDataMemberDisplayName(dataSource, fieldName);
				}
				string dataMemberDisplayName = ((DataContext)snapDataContext).GetDataMemberDisplayName(dataSource, dataMember);
				string dataMemberDisplayName2 = ((DataContext)snapDataContext).GetDataMemberDisplayName(dataSource, $"{dataMember}.{fieldName}");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberDisplayName2) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberDisplayName) && dataMemberDisplayName2.StartsWith(dataMemberDisplayName))
				{
					return dataMemberDisplayName2.Substring(dataMemberDisplayName.Length + 1);
				}
				return $"{dataMember}.{fieldName}";
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDataContext)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private bool IsSortable(object dataSource, string dataMember, string fieldName, bool allowEmptyDataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = base.DataSourceDispatcher.FindDataSourceName(dataSource);
			string key = string.Format("{0}:{1}.{2}.{3}", allowEmptyDataSource ? "1" : "0", text, dataMember, fieldName);
			if (sortableCache.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			string[] nestedFields = ((!fieldName.Contains(".")) ? null : new string[1] { fieldName });
			SnapDataContext snapDataContext = new SnapDataContext(base.DataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields(dataSource), base.DocumentModel.Parameters, null, nestedFields);
			try
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowserForParentDataMember = GetDataBrowserForParentDataMember(snapDataContext, dataSource, dataMember);
				ListBrowser val = (ListBrowser)(object)((dataBrowserForParentDataMember is ListBrowser) ? dataBrowserForParentDataMember : null);
				if (val != null && (allowEmptyDataSource || ((DataBrowser)val).Count != 0))
				{
					snapDataContext.Initialize((DataBrowser)(object)val, null, null);
					value = ((SnapListController)(object)val.ListController).AllowSort(fieldName);
					sortableCache.Add(key, value);
					return value;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)snapDataContext)?.Dispose();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ClearCache()
		{
			sortableCache.Clear();
		}
	}

	public class HierarchicalEnumerator<T> : IEnumerator<T>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		private IEnumerator<T> parentEnumerator;

		private IEnumerator<T> baseEnumerator;

		private bool firstMove;

		public T Current => baseEnumerator.Current;

		public IEnumerator<T> ParentEnumerator => parentEnumerator;

		public IEnumerator<T> BaseEnumerator => baseEnumerator;

		object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

		public HierarchicalEnumerator(IEnumerator<T> parentEnumerator, IEnumerator<T> baseEnumerator)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)parentEnumerator, "parentEnumerator");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)baseEnumerator, "baseEnumerator");
			this.parentEnumerator = parentEnumerator;
			this.baseEnumerator = baseEnumerator;
			Reset();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~HierarchicalEnumerator()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (baseEnumerator != null)
				{
					baseEnumerator.Dispose();
				}
				if (parentEnumerator != null)
				{
					parentEnumerator.Dispose();
				}
			}
			baseEnumerator = null;
			parentEnumerator = null;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (firstMove)
			{
				firstMove = false;
				if (!parentEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (baseEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				return true;
			}
			while (parentEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				baseEnumerator.Reset();
				if (baseEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			parentEnumerator.Reset();
			baseEnumerator.Reset();
			firstMove = true;
		}
	}
	public interface IEnumeratorWithState : IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		void WriteState(List<int> target);
	}
	public class InnerHierarchicalDataEnumerator : HierarchicalEnumerator<object>, IEnumeratorWithState, IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator

			: base((IEnumerator<object>)parentEnumerator, (IEnumerator<object>)baseEnumerator)
		{
		}

		public void WriteState(List<int> target)
		{
			((IEnumeratorWithState)base.ParentEnumerator).WriteState(target);
			((IEnumeratorWithState)base.BaseEnumerator).WriteState(target);
		}
	}

		public FieldDataValueDescriptor GetFieldValueDescriptor(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, Field field, string fieldName, StringScanner scanner)

		public FieldDataValueDescriptor GetFieldValueDescriptor(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, DocumentLogPosition pos, string fieldName, StringScanner scanner)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RunIndex runIndex = PositionConverter.ToDocumentModelPosition((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable, pos).RunIndex;
			return GetFieldValueDescriptorCore(pieceTable, runIndex, fieldName, scanner);
		}

		private FieldDataValueDescriptor GetFieldValueDescriptorCore(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, RunIndex runIndex, string fieldName, StringScanner scanner)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IFieldContext fieldContext = null;
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = FieldPathService.FromString(fieldName, scanner);
			if (fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo.FieldDataSourceType == FieldDataSourceType.Root)
			{
				RootFieldDataSourceInfo rootFieldDataSourceInfo = (RootFieldDataSourceInfo)fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo;
				fieldContext = new RootFieldContext(pieceTable.DocumentModel.DataSourceDispatcher, rootFieldDataSourceInfo.Name);
			}
			else
			{
				fieldContext = GetFieldContext(pieceTable, runIndex);
				if (fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo is RelativeFieldDataSourceInfo { RelativeLevel: >0 } relativeFieldDataSourceInfo)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < relativeFieldDataSourceInfo.RelativeLevel; i++)
					{
						if (fieldContext is ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext)
						{
							fieldContext = singleObjectFieldContext.Parent;
							continue;
						}
						if (!(fieldContext is IDataControllerListFieldContext dataControllerListFieldContext))
						{
							break;
						}
						fieldContext = dataControllerListFieldContext.Parent;
					}
				}
			}
			return new FieldDataValueDescriptor(fieldContext, fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
		}

		public IFieldContext GetFieldContext(Field field)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return GetFieldContext((SnapPieceTable)(object)field.PieceTable, field.FirstRunIndex);
		}

		protected virtual IFieldContext GetFieldContext(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, RunIndex index)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FieldContextOwnerFinder fieldContextOwnerFinder = new FieldContextOwnerFinder();
			IFieldContextOwner fieldContextOwner = fieldContextOwnerFinder.FindInnermostOwnerByPosition((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable, index);
			if (fieldContextOwner == null)
			{
				return fieldContextOwnerFinder.FindRootDataContext((PieceTable)(object)pieceTable);
			}
			return fieldContextOwner.FieldContext;
		}

		public bool CanCalculateValue(DocumentLogPosition pos, SnapPieceTable pieceTable, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldValueDescriptor = GetFieldValueDescriptor(pieceTable, pos, fieldName, new FieldNameStringScanner(fieldName));
			ICalculationContext calculationContext = FieldContextService.BeginCalculation(documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher);
			try
			{
				object rawValue = calculationContext.GetRawValue(fieldValueDescriptor.ParentDataContext, fieldValueDescriptor.RelativePath);
				return rawValue != FieldNull.Value;
			}
			finally
			{
				FieldContextService.EndCalculation(calculationContext);
			}
		}
	}

	public class DataControllerFieldContextService : IFieldContextService
	{
		private readonly ParameterCollection parameters;

		private DataControllerCalculationContext calculationContext;

		public ParameterCollection Parameters => parameters;

		public DataControllerFieldContextService(ParameterCollection parameters)
		{
			this.parameters = parameters;
		}

		public ICalculationContext BeginCalculation(IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher)
		{
			if (calculationContext == null)
			{
				calculationContext = new DataControllerCalculationContext(this, dataSourceDispatcher);
			}
			calculationContext.IncRefCount();
			return calculationContext;
		}

		public void EndCalculation(ICalculationContext calculationContext)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)calculationContext, "calculationContext");
			if (calculationContext != this.calculationContext)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			this.calculationContext.DecRefCount();
			if (!this.calculationContext.HasRef)
			{
				this.calculationContext.Dispose();
				this.calculationContext = null;
			}
		}
	}

		public IDataEnumerator GetChildDataEnumerator(IFieldContext fieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext = fieldContext as ISingleObjectFieldContext;
			if (singleObjectFieldContext == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			IDataEnumerator dataEnumerator = null;
			if (singleObjectFieldContext.ListContext != null)
			{
				return GetDetailListEnumerator(singleObjectFieldContext, path);
			}
			return GetMasterListEnumerator(singleObjectFieldContext, path);
		}

		public object GetRawValue(IFieldContext fieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			if (fieldContext is ProxyFieldContext)
			{
				return FieldNull.Value;

			return GetRawValueCore(rawValueFieldContextCore);
		}

		private object GetRawValueCore(ISingleObjectFieldContext fieldContext)
		{
			if (fieldContext.ListContext != null)
			{
				return GetColumnValue(fieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo.Empty);
			}
			return GetObjectValue(fieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo.Empty);
		}

		public object GetSummaryValue(IFieldContext fieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path, SummaryRunning summaryRunning, SummaryItemType summaryFunc, bool ignoreNullValues, int groupLevel)
		{
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext = fieldContext as ISingleObjectFieldContext;
			if (singleObjectFieldContext == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			SnapListController listController = GetListController(singleObjectFieldContext.ListContext);
			if (listController == null)
			{
				return FieldNull.Value;
			}
			string text = GetFullPathToParentList(singleObjectFieldContext);
			if (path.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < path.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					text = PathHelper.Join(text, path.Items[i].FieldName);
				}
			}
			return listController.GetGroupSummaryValue(singleObjectFieldContext.RowHandle, text, summaryRunning, summaryFunc, ignoreNullValues, groupLevel);
		}

		public SnapListController RestoreListController(IFieldContext fieldContext)

		private IDataControllerListFieldContext GetListFieldContext(IFieldContext fieldContext)

			ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext = null;

			{

				{

				}

			}
			return fieldContext as IDataControllerListFieldContext;
		}

		public IFieldContext GetRawValueFieldContext(IFieldContext fieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			return GetRawValueFieldContextCore(fieldContext, path);
		}

		private ISingleObjectFieldContext GetRawValueFieldContextCore(IFieldContext fieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext = fieldContext as ISingleObjectFieldContext;
			if (singleObjectFieldContext == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			int count = path.Items.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return singleObjectFieldContext;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = path.Items[i];
				singleObjectFieldContext = new SimplePropertyFieldContext(singleObjectFieldContext, fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FieldName);
				if (fieldDataMemberInfoItem.HasGroups || fieldDataMemberInfoItem.HasFilters)
				{
					ListFieldContext parent = new ListFieldContext(singleObjectFieldContext, new ListParameters(fieldDataMemberInfoItem.Groups, fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FilterProperties));
					singleObjectFieldContext = new SingleListItemFieldContext(parent, 0, 0, 1);
				}
			}
			return singleObjectFieldContext;
		}

		private string GetWrapPath(FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			int count = path.Items.Count;
			if (count <= 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = path.Items[count - 1];
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FieldName) && !fieldDataMemberInfoItem.HasFilters && !fieldDataMemberInfoItem.HasGroups)
			{
				return fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FieldName;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IDataEnumerator GetMasterListEnumerator(ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			int count = path.Items.Count;
			object objectValue = GetObjectValue(singleObjectFieldContext, path);
			if (objectValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISingleObjectFieldContext parent = singleObjectFieldContext;
			if (count > 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(path.Items[0].FieldName))
			{
				parent = new SimplePropertyFieldContext(singleObjectFieldContext, path.Items[0].FieldName);
			}
			ListFieldContext listContext = new ListFieldContext(parent, (count > 0) ? new ListParameters(path.Items[0].Groups, path.Items[0].FilterProperties) : null);
			string fullPathToRoot = GetFullPathToRoot(singleObjectFieldContext);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				fullPathToRoot = PathHelper.Join(fullPathToRoot, FieldPathService.EncodePath(path.Items[0].FieldName));
			}
			SnapListController masterListController = GetMasterListController(listContext);
			if (masterListController == null)
			{
				if (!path.IsEmpty && path.LastItem.HasFilters)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new SingleValueDataEnumerator(singleObjectFieldContext, objectValue);
			}
			if (count > 1)
			{
				if (!path.LastItem.HasFilters && masterListController.Columns[path.LastItem.FieldName] != null)
				{
					SingleListDataEnumerator dataEnumerator = new SingleListDataEnumerator(listContext, masterListController);
					return new DataEnumeratorWrapper(dataEnumerator, path.LastItem.FieldName);
				}
				path.Items.RemoveAt(0);
				return new MultilistDataEnumerator(this, listContext, masterListController, path);
			}
			return new SingleListDataEnumerator(listContext, masterListController);
		}

		private IDataEnumerator GetDetailListEnumerator(ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			string text = GetFullPathToParentList(singleObjectFieldContext);
			string fullPathToRoot = GetFullPathToRoot(singleObjectFieldContext);
			int count = path.Items.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				List<string> fieldNames = new List<string>();
				path.Items.ForEach(delegate(FieldDataMemberInfoItem f)
				{
					fieldNames.Add(f.FieldName);
				});
				text = PathHelper.Join(text, string.Join(".", fieldNames));
			}
			ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext2 = singleObjectFieldContext;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				singleObjectFieldContext2 = new SimplePropertyFieldContext(singleObjectFieldContext, text);
			}
			FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = null;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				fieldDataMemberInfoItem = path.Items[path.Items.Count - 1];
			}
			ListFieldContext listContext = new ListFieldContext(singleObjectFieldContext2, (count > 0) ? new ListParameters(fieldDataMemberInfoItem.Groups, fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FilterProperties) : null);
			string pathToRoot = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fullPathToRoot)) ? string.Join(".", fullPathToRoot, text) : text);
			SnapListController detailListController = GetDetailListController(singleObjectFieldContext2.ListContext, text, pathToRoot, (count > 0) ? new ListParameters(fieldDataMemberInfoItem.Groups, fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FilterProperties) : null, singleObjectFieldContext.RowHandle);
			if (detailListController == null)
			{
				SnapListController listController = GetListController(singleObjectFieldContext2.ListContext);
				if (listController == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return new SingleValueDataEnumerator(singleObjectFieldContext2, ((ListControllerBase)listController).GetItem(singleObjectFieldContext2.RowHandle));
				}
				return new SingleValueDataEnumerator(singleObjectFieldContext2, ((ListControllerBase)listController).GetColumnValue(singleObjectFieldContext2.RowHandle, text));
			}
			return new SingleListDataEnumerator(listContext, detailListController);
		}

		protected virtual SnapListController GetMasterListController(IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext)
		{
			lock (masterControllersCache)
			{
				if (masterControllersCache.TryGetValue(listContext, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				string fullPathToRoot = GetFullPathToRoot(listContext);
				object objectValue = GetObjectValue(listContext.Parent.Root, fullPathToRoot);
				if (objectValue == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				value = new SnapListController();
				if (!value.Update(objectValue, listContext.ListParameters, GetFilteredCalculatedFields(listContext.Parent.Root.Source, fullPathToRoot), dataContextService.Parameters, GetNestedFields()))
				{
					return null;
				}
				masterControllersCache.Add(listContext, value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		private string[] GetNestedFields()
		{
			if (FieldNames == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string[] array = FieldNames;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text.Contains("."))
				{
					list.Add(text);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> GetFilteredCalculatedFields(object dataSource, string path)
		{
			ICollection<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields = dataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields(dataSource);
			List<ICalculatedField> list = new List<ICalculatedField>();
			foreach (ICalculatedField item in calculatedFields)
			{
				if ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) || string.Compare(item.DataMember, path, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public virtual SnapListController GetListController(IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext)
		{
			IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext2 = listContext.Parent.ListContext;
			if (listContext2 == null)
			{
				return GetMasterListController(listContext);
			}
			if (lastCreatedListController != null && listContext == prevListContext)
			{
				return lastCreatedListController;
			}
			string fullPathToParentList = GetFullPathToParentList(listContext);
			string fullPathToRoot = GetFullPathToRoot(listContext);
			lastCreatedListController = GetDetailListController(listContext2, fullPathToParentList, fullPathToRoot, listContext.ListParameters, listContext.Parent.RowHandle);
			prevListContext = listContext;
			return lastCreatedListController;
		}

		private SnapListController GetDetailListController(IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext, string pathToDetail, string pathToRoot, ListParameters listParameters, int controllerRow)
		{
			ListFieldContext listFieldContext = listContext as ListFieldContext;
			if (listFieldContext == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			return GetListController(listContext)?.CreateDetailController(pathToDetail, listParameters, controllerRow, GetFilteredCalculatedFields(listContext.Parent.Root.Source, pathToRoot), GetNestedFields());
		}

		private string GetFullPathToRoot(IDataControllerFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext)
		{
			GetFullPathToRootVisitor visitor = new GetFullPathToRootVisitor(sb);
			singleObjectFieldContext.Accept(visitor);
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetFullPathToParentList(ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext)
		{
			GetFullPathToParentListVisitor visitor = new GetFullPathToParentListVisitor(sb, singleObjectFieldContext.ListContext);
			singleObjectFieldContext.Accept(visitor);
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetFullPathToParentList(IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext)
		{
			GetFullPathToParentListVisitor visitor = new GetFullPathToParentListVisitor(sb, listContext.Parent.ListContext);
			listContext.Accept(visitor);
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		private object GetObjectValue(ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			int count = path.Items.Count;
			string text = GetFullPathToRoot(singleObjectFieldContext);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				text = PathHelper.Join(text, FieldPathService.EncodePath(path.Items[0].FieldName));
			}
			object source = singleObjectFieldContext.Root.Source;
			if (source == null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return FieldNull.Value;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return source;
			}
			string[] parts = FieldPathService.SplitPath(text);
			return GetObjectValueCore(source, parts);
		}

		private object GetObjectValue(RootFieldContext root, string path)
		{
			object obj = root.Source;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || obj == null)
			{
				if (obj is DataSet)
				{
					obj = MasterDetailHelper.GetDataSource(obj, string.Empty);
				}
				return obj;
			}
			string[] parts = FieldPathService.SplitPath(path);
			return GetObjectValueCore(obj, parts);
		}

		private object GetObjectValueCore(object source, string[] parts)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < parts.Length; i++)
			{
				if (source == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text = parts[i];
				if (source is DataSet)
				{
					source = MasterDetailHelper.GetDataSource(source, text);
					continue;
				}
				IDataComponent val = (IDataComponent)((source is IDataComponent) ? source : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					SnapDataContext snapDataContext = new SnapDataContext();
					DataBrowser dataBrowserSafe = snapDataContext.GetDataBrowserSafe(val, text);
					if (dataBrowserSafe != null)
					{
						source = dataBrowserSafe.GetValue();
						continue;
					}
				}
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(source)[text];
				if (propertyDescriptor == null)
				{
					if (source is IList { Count: >0 } list)
					{
						object obj = list[0];
						if (obj == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(list[0])[text];
						if (propertyDescriptor == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						source = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(list[0]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					source = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(source);
				}
			}
			return source;
		}

		private object GetColumnValue(ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			string text = GetFullPathToParentList(singleObjectFieldContext);
			int count = path.Items.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				text = PathHelper.Join(text, path.Items[0].FieldName);
			}
			SnapListController listController = GetListController(singleObjectFieldContext.ListContext);
			if (listController == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return ((ListControllerBase)listController).GetColumnValue(singleObjectFieldContext.RowHandle, text);
			}
			return ((ListControllerBase)listController).GetItem(singleObjectFieldContext.RowHandle);
		}

		public void PrepareDataContext(DataContext dataContext, IFieldContext fieldContext)
		{
			if (fieldContext is ISingleObjectFieldContext singleObjectFieldContext)
			{
				DataDispatcherFieldContextVisitor dataDispatcherFieldContextVisitor = new DataDispatcherFieldContextVisitor();
				singleObjectFieldContext.Accept(dataDispatcherFieldContextVisitor);
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = ((DataContextBase)dataContext).GetDataBrowser(dataDispatcherFieldContextVisitor.DataSource, dataDispatcherFieldContextVisitor.DataMember, true);
				if (dataBrowser != null && !(fieldContext is RootFieldContext))
				{
					dataBrowser.Position = singleObjectFieldContext.VisibleIndex;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~DataControllerCalculationContext()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SnapListController value in masterControllersCache.Values)
			{
				value.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataEnumeratorWrapper : IDataEnumerator, IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		private readonly IDataEnumerator dataEnumerator;

		private readonly string path;

		public object Current => dataEnumerator.GetColumnValue(path);

		public bool GroupStart => dataEnumerator.GroupStart;

		public DataEnumeratorWrapper(IDataEnumerator dataEnumerator, string path)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataEnumerator, "dataEnumerator");
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(path, "path");
			this.dataEnumerator = dataEnumerator;
			this.path = path;
		}

		public ISingleObjectFieldContext CreateFieldContext()
		{
			ISingleObjectFieldContext parent = dataEnumerator.CreateFieldContext();
			return new SimplePropertyFieldContext(parent, path);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			dataEnumerator.Dispose();
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			return dataEnumerator.MoveNext();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			dataEnumerator.Reset();
		}

		public object GetColumnValue(string columnName)
		{
			return dataEnumerator.GetColumnValue(PathHelper.Join(path, columnName));
		}

		public List<GroupProperties> GetChangedGroupsWithTemplates()
		{
			return dataEnumerator.GetChangedGroupsWithTemplates();
		}

		public IDataControllerListFieldContext GetListFieldContext()
		{
			return dataEnumerator.GetListFieldContext();
		}
	}
	public class SingleListDataEnumerator : IDataEnumerator, IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		private readonly IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext;

		private readonly SnapListController listController;

		private GroupRowInfo lastGroupRowInfo;

		private List<GroupProperties> changedGroups;

		private int visibleIndex;

		private int rowHandle;

		private int currentGroupStartPosition;

		private bool groupChanged;

		public IDataControllerListFieldContext ListContext => listContext;

		public SnapListController ListController => listController;

		public object Current => ((ListControllerBase)listController).GetItem(rowHandle);

		public bool GroupStart => groupChanged;

		public SingleListDataEnumerator(IDataControllerListFieldContext listContext, SnapListController listController)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)listContext, "listContext");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)listController, "listController");
			this.listContext = listContext;
			this.listController = listController;
			Reset();
		}

		public ISingleObjectFieldContext CreateFieldContext()
		{
			return new SingleListItemFieldContext(listContext, visibleIndex, rowHandle, rowHandle - currentGroupStartPosition + 1);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			groupChanged = false;
			changedGroups = null;
			while (visibleIndex < ((ListControllerBase)listController).Count)
			{
				visibleIndex++;
				int controllerRowHandle = listController.GetControllerRowHandle(visibleIndex);
				if (controllerRowHandle == int.MinValue)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (controllerRowHandle >= 0)
				{
					if (groupChanged)
					{
						OnGroupChanged(listController.GetParentGroupRow(controllerRowHandle));
						if (changedGroups.Count > 0)
						{
							currentGroupStartPosition = controllerRowHandle;
						}
					}
					rowHandle = controllerRowHandle;
					return true;
				}
				groupChanged = true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			visibleIndex = -1;
			groupChanged = false;
		}

		public object GetColumnValue(string columnName)
		{
			return ((ListControllerBase)listController).GetColumnValue(rowHandle, columnName);
		}

		public List<GroupProperties> GetChangedGroupsWithTemplates()
		{
			return changedGroups;
		}

		private void OnGroupChanged(GroupRowInfo groupRowInfo)
		{
			changedGroups = new List<GroupProperties>();
			if (!listContext.HasGroups)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<GroupProperties> groups = listContext.ListParameters.Groups;
			int changedGroupCount = GetChangedGroupCount(lastGroupRowInfo, groupRowInfo);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = groups.Count - 1;
			while (num < changedGroupCount && num2 >= 0)
			{
				GroupProperties groupProperties = groups[num2];
				if (groupProperties.HasGroupTemplates)
				{
					changedGroups.Add(groupProperties);
				}
				num += groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos.Count;
				num2--;
			}
			changedGroups.Reverse();
			lastGroupRowInfo = groupRowInfo;
		}

		private int GetChangedGroupCount(GroupRowInfo lastGroupRowInfo, GroupRowInfo currentGroupRowInfo)
		{
			if (lastGroupRowInfo == null)
			{
				return currentGroupRowInfo.Level + 1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			while (lastGroupRowInfo != currentGroupRowInfo)
			{
				num++;
				currentGroupRowInfo = currentGroupRowInfo.ParentGroup;
				lastGroupRowInfo = lastGroupRowInfo.ParentGroup;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public IDataControllerListFieldContext GetListFieldContext()
		{
			return ListContext;
		}
	}
	public class MultilistDataEnumerator : IDataEnumerator, IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		private IDataEnumerator[] innerEnumerators;

		private DataControllerCalculationContext calculationContext;

		private ListFieldContext listContext;

		private SnapListController masterListController;

		private FieldPathDataMemberInfo path;

		public object Current => innerEnumerators[innerEnumerators.Length - 1].Current;

		public bool GroupStart => innerEnumerators[innerEnumerators.Length - 1].GroupStart;

		public MultilistDataEnumerator(DataControllerCalculationContext calculationContext, ListFieldContext listContext, SnapListController masterListController, FieldPathDataMemberInfo path)
		{
			this.listContext = listContext;
			this.path = path;
			this.masterListController = masterListController;
			this.calculationContext = calculationContext;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (innerEnumerators == null)
			{
				innerEnumerators = new IDataEnumerator[path.Items.Count + 1];
				if (!RecreateInnerEnumerators(0))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			int num = innerEnumerators.Length - 1;
			if (innerEnumerators[num].MoveNext())
			{
				return true;
			}
			num--;
			while (num >= 0)
			{
				if (innerEnumerators[num].MoveNext())
				{
					if (RecreateInnerEnumerators(num + 1))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num--;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ISingleObjectFieldContext CreateFieldContext()
		{
			return innerEnumerators[innerEnumerators.Length - 1].CreateFieldContext();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			innerEnumerators = null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}

		private bool RecreateInnerEnumerators(int invalidEnumeratorIndex)
		{
			int num = innerEnumerators.Length;
			for (int i = invalidEnumeratorIndex; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (innerEnumerators[i] != null)
				{
					innerEnumerators[i].Dispose();
					innerEnumerators[i] = null;
				}
				innerEnumerators[i] = CreateInnerEnumerator((i > 0) ? innerEnumerators[i - 1] : null, i);
				if (!innerEnumerators[i].MoveNext())
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private IDataEnumerator CreateInnerEnumerator(IDataEnumerator parentEnumerator, int index)
		{
			if (parentEnumerator != null)
			{
				FieldDataMemberInfoItem fieldDataMemberInfoItem = path.Items[index - 1];
				ISingleObjectFieldContext parent = parentEnumerator.CreateFieldContext();
				ListParameters listParameters = null;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FieldName))
				{
					parent = new SimplePropertyFieldContext(parent, fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FieldName);
				}
				listParameters = new ListParameters(fieldDataMemberInfoItem.Groups, fieldDataMemberInfoItem.FilterProperties);
				ListFieldContext listFieldContext = new ListFieldContext(parent, listParameters);
				SnapListController listController = calculationContext.GetListController(listFieldContext);
				return new SingleListDataEnumerator(listFieldContext, listController);
			}
			return new SingleListDataEnumerator(listContext, masterListController);
		}

		public object GetColumnValue(string columnName)
		{
			return innerEnumerators[innerEnumerators.Length - 1].GetColumnValue(columnName);
		}

		public List<GroupProperties> GetChangedGroupsWithTemplates()
		{
			return innerEnumerators[innerEnumerators.Length - 1].GetChangedGroupsWithTemplates();
		}

		public IDataControllerListFieldContext GetListFieldContext()
		{
			return innerEnumerators[innerEnumerators.Length - 1].GetListFieldContext();
		}
	}
	public class GetFullPathToParentListVisitor : IFieldContextVisitor
	{
		private readonly IDataControllerListFieldContext parentListContext;

		private readonly StringBuilder sb;

		public GetFullPathToParentListVisitor(StringBuilder sb, IDataControllerListFieldContext parentListContext)
		{
			this.parentListContext = parentListContext;
			this.sb = sb;
			sb.Length = 0;
		}

		public void Visit(EmptyFieldContext context)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void Visit(ProxyFieldContext context)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void Visit(RootFieldContext context)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(SnapMailMergeRootFieldContext context)
		{
			Visit((RootFieldContext)context);
		}

		public void Visit(SingleListItemFieldContext context)
		{
			context.Parent.Accept(this);
		}

		public void Visit(ListFieldContext context)
		{
			if (context != parentListContext)
			{
				context.Parent.Accept(this);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(SimplePropertyFieldContext context)
		{
			context.Parent.Accept(this);
			PathHelper.Join(sb, context.Path);
		}
	}
