		public GetFullPathToRootVisitor(StringBuilder sb)
		{
			this.sb = sb;
			sb.Length = 0;
		}

		public void Visit(EmptyFieldContext context)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void Visit(ProxyFieldContext context)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void Visit(RootFieldContext context)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(SnapMailMergeRootFieldContext context)
		{
			Visit((RootFieldContext)context);
		}

		public void Visit(SingleListItemFieldContext context)
		{
			context.Parent.Accept(this);
		}

		public void Visit(ListFieldContext context)
		{
			context.Parent.Accept(this);
		}

		public void Visit(SimplePropertyFieldContext context)
		{
			context.Parent.Accept(this);
			PathHelper.Join(sb, FieldPathService.EncodePath(context.Path));
		}
	}
	public class RootFieldContext : ISingleObjectFieldContext, IDataControllerFieldContext, IFieldContext, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher;

		private readonly string dataSourceName;

		private readonly object source;

		public IDataControllerFieldContext Parent => null;

		public IDataControllerListFieldContext ListContext => null;

		public int VisibleIndex
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public int RowHandle
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public int CurrentRecordIndex => 1;

		public int CurrentRecordIndexInGroup => 1;

		public RootFieldContext Root => this;

		public virtual object Source
		{
			get
			{
				if (source != null)
				{
					return source;
				}
				if (dataSourceName == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return dataSourceDispatcher.GetDataSource(dataSourceName);
			}
		}

		internal RootFieldContext(IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher, string dataSourceName, object source)
		{
			dataSourceDispatcher.Capture();
			this.dataSourceDispatcher = dataSourceDispatcher;
			this.dataSourceName = dataSourceName;
			this.source = source;
		}

		public RootFieldContext(IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher, string dataSourceName)
			: this(dataSourceDispatcher, dataSourceName, null)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Accept(IFieldContextVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public T Accept<T>(IFieldContextVisitor<T> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is RootFieldContext rootFieldContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.Equals(dataSourceName, rootFieldContext.dataSourceName);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (dataSourceName == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return dataSourceName.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				dataSourceDispatcher.Release();
			}
		}

		~RootFieldContext()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}
	}
	public class SnapMailMergeRootFieldContext : RootFieldContext
	{
		private readonly string dataMember;

		public override object Source
		{
			get
			{
				object obj = base.Source;
				return ControlDataSourceDispatcher.GetBindingSourceDataSource(obj) ?? obj;
			}
		}

		public string DataMember => dataMember;

		public SnapMailMergeRootFieldContext(IDataSourceDispatcher dataSourceDispatcher, string dataSourceName, string dataMember)
			: base(dataSourceDispatcher, dataSourceName)
		{
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
		}

		public override void Accept(IFieldContextVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}

	public class ListParameters
	{
		private static readonly ListParameters empty = new ListParameters(null, null);

		private readonly List<GroupProperties> groups;

		private readonly FilterProperties filters;

		private GroupFieldInfo[] groupFieldInfos;

		public static ListParameters Empty => empty;

		public List<GroupProperties> Groups => groups;

		public FilterProperties Filters => filters;

		public ListParameters(List<GroupProperties> groups, FilterProperties filters)
		{
			this.groups = groups;
			this.filters = filters;
		}

		public GroupFieldInfo[] GetGroupFieldInfos()
		{
			if (groupFieldInfos == null)
			{
				groupFieldInfos = GetGroupFieldInfosCore();
			}
			if (groupFieldInfos.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return groupFieldInfos;
		}

		private GroupFieldInfo[] GetGroupFieldInfosCore()
		{
			List<GroupFieldInfo> list = new List<GroupFieldInfo>();
			if (groups == null)
			{
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			foreach (GroupProperties group in groups)
			{
				if (group.GroupFieldInfos.Count > 0)
				{
					list.AddRange(group.GroupFieldInfos);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is ListParameters listParameters))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsFiltersEquals(filters, listParameters.Filters))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ListUtils.AreEquals(groups, listParameters.Groups);
		}

		private bool IsFiltersEquals(FilterProperties firstFilters, FilterProperties secondFilters)
		{
			bool flag = firstFilters == null || firstFilters.Filters == null || firstFilters.Filters.Count == 0;
			bool flag2 = secondFilters == null || secondFilters.Filters == null || secondFilters.Filters.Count == 0;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return object.Equals(firstFilters, secondFilters);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ListUtils.CalcHashCode(groups) ^ ((filters != null) ? filters.GetHashCode() : 0);
		}
	}

	public class PathHelper
	{
		public static string Join(string path1, string path2)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path1))
			{
				return path2;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path2))
			{
				return path1;
			}
			return path1 + "." + path2;
		}

		public static void Join(StringBuilder path, string path2)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path2))
			{
				if (path.Length > 0)
				{
					path.Append('.');
				}
				path.Append(path2);
			}
		}

		public static string GetPath(FieldPathDataMemberInfo fieldPathDataMemberInfo)
		{
			if (fieldPathDataMemberInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (FieldDataMemberInfoItem item in fieldPathDataMemberInfo.Items)
			{
				if (item.HasFilters || item.HasGroups)
				{
					Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				}
				text = Join(text, item.FieldName);
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	public class FieldPathService : IFieldPathService
	{
		internal static readonly string AscendingSortString = "asc";

		internal static readonly string DescendingSortString = "desc";

		protected static readonly string RelativePrefix = "../";

		protected static readonly string AbsolutePrefix = "/";

		public static GroupInterval ParseGroupInterval(string value)
		{
			try
			{
				return (GroupInterval)Enum.Parse(typeof(GroupInterval), value, ignoreCase: true);
			}
			catch
			{
				return GroupInterval.Default;
			}
		}

		public static ColumnSortOrder ParseSortOrder(string value)
		{
			value = value.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (!(value == AscendingSortString))
			{
				if (!(value == DescendingSortString))
				{
					return (ColumnSortOrder)0;
				}
				return (ColumnSortOrder)2;
			}
			return (ColumnSortOrder)1;
		}

		public virtual string GetStringPath(FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo)
		{
			string dataSourceStringPath = GetDataSourceStringPath(fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo);
			string dataMemberStringPath = GetDataMemberStringPath(fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
			if (ShouldSeparateDataSourceAndDataDataMemberPath(fieldPathInfo))
			{
				return $"{dataSourceStringPath}.{dataMemberStringPath}";
			}
			return $"{dataSourceStringPath}{dataMemberStringPath}";
		}

		protected virtual string GetDataSourceStringPath(FieldDataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo)
		{
			if (dataSourceInfo != null && dataSourceInfo.FieldDataSourceType == FieldDataSourceType.Root)
			{
				RootFieldDataSourceInfo rootFieldDataSourceInfo = (RootFieldDataSourceInfo)dataSourceInfo;
				return $"{AbsolutePrefix}{EncodePath(rootFieldDataSourceInfo.Name)}";
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (dataSourceInfo != null)
			{
				RelativeFieldDataSourceInfo relativeFieldDataSourceInfo = (RelativeFieldDataSourceInfo)dataSourceInfo;
				for (int num = relativeFieldDataSourceInfo.RelativeLevel - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					text += RelativePrefix;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetDataMemberStringPath(FieldPathDataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo)
		{
			List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem> items = dataMemberInfo.Items;
			List<string> list = new List<string>(items.Count);
			foreach (FieldDataMemberInfoItem item in dataMemberInfo.Items)
			{
				list.Add(GetDataMemberItemString(item));
			}
			return string.Join(".", list.ToArray());
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldSeparateDataSourceAndDataDataMemberPath(FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo)
		{
			if (fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.IsEmpty || fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo.FieldDataSourceType == FieldDataSourceType.Relative)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.Items[0].FieldName);
		}

		protected virtual string GetDataMemberItemString(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (item.HasGroups)
			{
				foreach (GroupProperties group in item.Groups)
				{
					text += GetGroupPropertiesString(group);
				}
			}
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			if (item.HasFilters)
			{
				foreach (string filter in item.FilterProperties.Filters)
				{
					string text3 = EscapeFilterString(GetFilterString(filter));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						text2 += $"[{text3}]";
					}
				}
			}
			string text4 = EncodePath(item.FieldName);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text4 += $"[{text}]";
			}
			return text4 + text2;
		}

		protected virtual string EscapeFilterString(string filter)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return EncodePath(filter).Replace("[", "\\[").Replace("]", "\\]");
		}

		public static string EncodePath(string path)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				return path.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace(".", "\\.");
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static string DecodePath(string path)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(path.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < path.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = path[i];
				if (c == '\\' && i != path.Length - 1)
				{
					c = path[++i];
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static string[] SplitPath(string path)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(path.Length);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < path.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = path[i];
				if (c == '\\' && i < path.Length - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(path[++i]);
				}
				else if (c == '.')
				{
					list.Add(stringBuilder.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Length = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
			}
			list.Add(stringBuilder.ToString());
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public FieldPathInfo FromString(string fieldPath)
		{
			return FromString(fieldPath, new DataSourceNameStringScanner(fieldPath));
		}

		public FieldPathInfo FromString(string fieldPath, StringScanner scanner)
		{
			fieldPath = fieldPath.Trim();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldPath))
			{
				FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = new FieldPathInfo();
				fieldPathInfo.DataSourceInfo = new RelativeFieldDataSourceInfo(0);
				fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo = new FieldPathDataMemberInfo();
				return fieldPathInfo;
			}
			PathParser pathParser = new PathParser(scanner);
			pathParser.Parse();
			FieldPathInfo result = pathParser.GetResult();
			if (result.DataMemberInfo == null)
			{
				result.DataMemberInfo = new FieldPathDataMemberInfo();
			}
			if (result.DataSourceInfo == null)
			{
				result.DataSourceInfo = new RelativeFieldDataSourceInfo(0);
			}
			CalculateGroupIndexes(result);
			return result;
		}

		private void CalculateGroupIndexes(FieldPathInfo parseResult)
		{
			List<FieldDataMemberInfoItem> items = parseResult.DataMemberInfo.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				CalculateCurrentGroupIndex(items[i]);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateCurrentGroupIndex(FieldDataMemberInfoItem item)
		{
			if (!item.HasGroups)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = item.Groups.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (item.Groups[i].HasGroupTemplates)
				{
					item.CurrentGroupIndex++;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual string GetGroupPropertiesString(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			List<GroupFieldInfo> groupFieldInfos = groupProperties.GroupFieldInfos;
			int count = groupFieldInfos.Count;
			string[] array = new string[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = GetGroupFieldInfoString(groupFieldInfos[i]);
			}
			return string.Format("({0},{1},{2},{3})", groupProperties.TemplateHeaderSwitch, groupProperties.TemplateFooterSwitch, groupProperties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch, string.Join(",", array));
		}

		protected virtual string GetGroupFieldInfoString(GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			List<object> list = new List<object>(new string[1] { groupFieldInfo.FieldName });
			if ((int)groupFieldInfo.SortOrder != 0)
			{
				list.Add(((int)groupFieldInfo.SortOrder == 1) ? AscendingSortString : DescendingSortString);
			}
			if (groupFieldInfo.GroupInterval != GroupInterval.Default)
			{
				list.Add(groupFieldInfo.GroupInterval);
			}
			string text = "{0}";
			for (int i = 1; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				text = text + ",{" + i + "}";
			}
			text = ((list.Count > 1) ? $"({text})" : text);
			return string.Format(text, list.ToArray());
		}

		protected virtual string GetFilterString(string filter)
		{
			if (filter != null && (filter.StartsWith("(") || filter.StartsWith("/")))
			{
				return $"/{filter}";
			}
			return filter;
		}
	}
	[GeneratedCode("Suppress FxCop check", "")]
	public class PathParser
	{
		internal const int _EOF = 0;

		internal const int _Text = 1;

		internal const int _OpenParenthesis = 2;

		internal const int _CloseParenthesis = 3;

		internal const int _OpenBracket = 4;

		internal const int _CloseBracket = 5;

		internal const int _Slash = 6;

		internal const int _Dot = 7;

		internal const int _Comma = 8;

		internal const int maxT = 9;

		private const bool T = true;

		private const bool x = false;

		private const int minErrDist = 2;

		public StringScanner scanner;

		public Errors errors;

		public PathToken t;

		public PathToken la;

		private int errDist = 2;

		private FieldPathInfo result;

		private bool[,] set = new bool[5, 11]
		{
			{
				true, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false,
				false
			},
			{
				false, true, false, true, false, false, true, true, true, false,
				false
			},
			{
				false, true, false, true, false, false, false, true, true, false,
				false
			},
			{
				false, true, true, true, true, false, true, true, true, false,
				false
			},
			{
				false, true, true, true, false, false, true, true, true, false,
				false
			}
		};

		public FieldPathInfo GetResult()
		{
			return result;
		}

		public PathParser(StringScanner scanner)
		{
			this.scanner = scanner;
			errors = new Errors();
		}

		private void SynErr(int n)
		{
			if (errDist >= 2)
			{
				errors.SynErr(0, 0, n);
			}
			errDist = 0;
		}

		public void SemErr(string msg)
		{
			if (errDist >= 2)
			{
				errors.SemErr(0, 0, msg);
			}
			errDist = 0;
		}

		private void Get()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				t = la;
				la = scanner.Scan();
				if (la.Kind <= 9)
				{
					break;
				}
				la = t;
			}
			errDist++;
		}

		private void Expect(int n)
		{
			if (la.Kind == n)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(n);
			}
		}

		private bool StartOf(int s)
		{
			return set[s, la.Kind];
		}

		private void ExpectWeak(int n, int follow)
		{
			if (la.Kind == n)
			{
				Get();
				return;
			}
			SynErr(n);
			while (!StartOf(follow))
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		private bool WeakSeparator(int n, int syFol, int repFol)
		{
			int kind = la.Kind;
			if (kind == n)
			{
				Get();
				return true;
			}
			if (StartOf(repFol))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SynErr(n);
			while (!set[syFol, kind] && !set[repFol, kind] && !set[0, kind])
			{
				Get();
				kind = la.Kind;
			}
			return StartOf(syFol);
		}

		private void FieldPath()
		{
			FieldPathInfoCore(out result);
		}

		private void FieldPathInfoCore(out FieldPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			pathInfo = new FieldPathInfo();
			if (la.Kind == 6)
			{
				AbsolutePathInfo(pathInfo);
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 1 || la.Kind == 4 || la.Kind == 7)
			{
				RelativePathInfo(pathInfo, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(10);
			}
		}

		private void AbsolutePathInfo(FieldPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			pathInfo.DataMemberInfo = new FieldPathDataMemberInfo();
			Expect(6);
			if (la.Kind == 1)
			{
				DataSourceName(pathInfo);
				while (la.Kind == 4)
				{
					Get();
					if (la.Kind == 2)
					{
						GroupProperties(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
					}
					if (StartOf(1))
					{
						Filter(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
					}
					pathInfo.DataMemberInfo.AddEmptyFilterIfNeeded();
					Expect(5);
				}
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 4)
			{
				pathInfo.DataSourceInfo = new RootFieldDataSourceInfo(string.Empty);
				Get();
				if (la.Kind == 2)
				{
					GroupProperties(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
				}
				if (StartOf(1))
				{
					Filter(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
				}
				pathInfo.DataMemberInfo.AddEmptyFilterIfNeeded();
				Expect(5);
				while (la.Kind == 4)
				{
					Get();
					if (la.Kind == 2)
					{
						GroupProperties(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
					}
					if (StartOf(1))
					{
						Filter(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
					}
					pathInfo.DataMemberInfo.AddEmptyFilterIfNeeded();
					Expect(5);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(11);
			}
			if (la.Kind == 7)
			{
				Get();
				RelativePathCore(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
			}
		}

		private void RelativePathInfo(FieldPathInfo pathInfo, int relativeLevel)
		{
			if (la.Kind == 7)
			{
				RelativePrefix();
				RelativePathInfo(pathInfo, relativeLevel + 1);
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 1 || la.Kind == 4)
			{
				pathInfo.DataSourceInfo = new RelativeFieldDataSourceInfo(relativeLevel);
				pathInfo.DataMemberInfo = new FieldPathDataMemberInfo();
				RelativePathCore(pathInfo.DataMemberInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(12);
			}
		}

		private void DataSourceName(FieldPathInfo info)
		{
			Expect(1);
			info.DataSourceInfo = new RootFieldDataSourceInfo(t.Value);
		}

		private void GroupProperties(FieldPathDataMemberInfo info)
		{
			GroupProperties groupProperties = new GroupProperties();
			Expect(2);
			if (la.Kind == 1)
			{
				TemplateHeaderSwitch(groupProperties);
			}
			Expect(8);
			if (la.Kind == 1)
			{
				TemplateFooterSwitch(groupProperties);
			}
			Expect(8);
			if (la.Kind == 1)
			{
				TemplateSeparatorSwitch(groupProperties);
			}
			Expect(8);
			GroupFields(groupProperties);
			while (la.Kind == 8)
			{
				Get();
				GroupFields(groupProperties);
			}
			Expect(3);
			info.AddGroup(groupProperties);
			if (la.Kind == 2)
			{
				GroupProperties(info);
			}
		}

		private void Filter(FieldPathDataMemberInfo info)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (la.Kind == 6)
			{
				Get();
				BalancedBracketText(ref text);
				info.AddFilter(text, unescapeString: true);
			}
			else if (StartOf(2))
			{
				SimpleFilterTextStart(ref text);
				if (StartOf(3))
				{
					BalancedBracketText(ref text);
				}
				info.AddFilter(text, unescapeString: true);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(13);
			}
		}

		private void RelativePathCore(FieldPathDataMemberInfo info)
		{
			if (la.Kind == 1)
			{
				Get();
				info.AddFieldName(FieldPathService.DecodePath(t.Value));
				while (la.Kind == 4)
				{
					Get();
					if (la.Kind == 2)
					{
						GroupProperties(info);
					}
					if (StartOf(1))
					{
						Filter(info);
					}
					info.AddEmptyFilterIfNeeded();
					Expect(5);
				}
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 4)
			{
				Get();
				if (la.Kind == 2)
				{
					GroupProperties(info);
				}
				if (StartOf(1))
				{
					Filter(info);
				}
				info.AddEmptyFilterIfNeeded();
				Expect(5);
				while (la.Kind == 4)
				{
					Get();
					if (la.Kind == 2)
					{
						GroupProperties(info);
					}
					if (StartOf(1))
					{
						Filter(info);
					}
					info.AddEmptyFilterIfNeeded();
					Expect(5);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(14);
			}
			if (la.Kind == 7)
			{
				Get();
				RelativePathCore(info);
			}
		}

		private void RelativePrefix()
		{
			Expect(7);
			Expect(7);
			Expect(6);
		}

		private void TemplateHeaderSwitch(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			Expect(1);
			groupProperties.TemplateHeaderSwitch = t.Value;
		}

		private void TemplateFooterSwitch(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			Expect(1);
			groupProperties.TemplateFooterSwitch = t.Value;
		}

		private void TemplateSeparatorSwitch(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			Expect(1);
			groupProperties.TemplateSeparatorSwitch = t.Value;
		}

		private void GroupFields(GroupProperties groupProperties)
		{
			string fieldName;
			if (la.Kind == 1)
			{
				GroupFieldName(out fieldName);
				GroupFieldInfo groupFieldInfo = groupProperties.AddField(fieldName);
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 2)
			{
				Get();
				GroupFieldInfo fieldInfo = null;
				if (la.Kind == 1)
				{
					GroupFieldName(out fieldName);
					fieldInfo = groupProperties.AddField(fieldName);
				}
				else if (la.Kind == 3 || la.Kind == 8)
				{
					fieldInfo = groupProperties.AddField(string.Empty);
				}
				else
				{
					SynErr(15);
				}
				if (la.Kind == 8)
				{
					Get();
					FieldGroupParameters(fieldInfo);
				}
				Expect(3);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(16);
			}
		}

		private void GroupFieldName(out string fieldName)
		{
			Expect(1);
			fieldName = FieldPathService.DecodePath(t.Value);
			while (la.Kind == 7)
			{
				Get();
				Expect(1);
				fieldName = fieldName + "." + t.Value;
			}
		}

		private void FieldGroupParameters(GroupFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			SortingParameters(fieldInfo);
			if (la.Kind == 8)
			{
				Get();
				GroupIntervalParameters(fieldInfo);
			}
		}

		private void SortingParameters(GroupFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			SortDirection(fieldInfo);
		}

		private void GroupIntervalParameters(GroupFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			Expect(1);
			fieldInfo.GroupInterval = FieldPathService.ParseGroupInterval(t.Value);
		}

		private void SortDirection(GroupFieldInfo fieldInfo)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Expect(1);
			fieldInfo.SortOrder = FieldPathService.ParseSortOrder(t.Value);
		}

		private void BalancedBracketText(ref string text)
		{
			if (StartOf(4))
			{
				FilterText(ref text);
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 4)
			{
				Get();
				text += t.Value;
				if (StartOf(3))
				{
					BalancedBracketText(ref text);
				}
				Expect(5);
				text += t.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(17);
			}
			while (StartOf(3))
			{
				if (StartOf(4))
				{
					FilterText(ref text);
					continue;
				}
				Get();
				text += t.Value;
				if (StartOf(3))
				{
					BalancedBracketText(ref text);
				}
				Expect(5);
				text += t.Value;
			}
		}

		private void SimpleFilterTextStart(ref string text)
		{
			if (la.Kind == 1)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 3)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 7)
			{
				RelativePrefix();
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 8)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(18);
			}
			text += t.Value;
		}

		private void FilterText(ref string text)
		{
			if (StartOf(2))
			{
				SimpleFilterTextStart(ref text);
			}
			else if (la.Kind == 2 || la.Kind == 6)
			{
				if (la.Kind == 2)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
				}
				text += t.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(19);
			}
		}

		public void Parse()
		{
			la = new PathToken();
			la.Value = "";
			Get();
			FieldPath();
			Expect(0);
		}
	}

	public class Errors
	{
		public int count;

		public TextWriter errorStream = new StringWriter();

		public string errMsgFormat = "-- line {0} col {1}: {2}";

		public void SynErr(int line, int col, int n)
		{
			string arg = n switch
			{
				0 => "EOF expected", 
				1 => "Text expected", 
				2 => "OpenParenthesis expected", 
				3 => "CloseParenthesis expected", 
				4 => "OpenBracket expected", 
				5 => "CloseBracket expected", 
				6 => "Slash expected", 
				7 => "Dot expected", 
				8 => "Comma expected", 
				9 => "??? expected", 
				10 => "invalid FieldPathInfoCore", 
				11 => "invalid AbsolutePathInfo", 
				12 => "invalid RelativePathInfo", 
				13 => "invalid Filter", 
				14 => "invalid RelativePathCore", 
				15 => "invalid GroupFields", 
				16 => "invalid GroupFields", 
				17 => "invalid BalancedBracketText", 
				18 => "invalid SimpleFilterTextStart", 
				19 => "invalid FilterText", 
				_ => "error " + n, 
			};
			errorStream.WriteLine(errMsgFormat, line, col, arg);
			count++;
		}

		public void SemErr(int line, int col, string s)
		{
			errorStream.WriteLine(errMsgFormat, line, col, s);
			count++;
		}

		public void SemErr(string s)
		{
			errorStream.WriteLine(s);
			count++;
		}

		public void Warning(int line, int col, string s)
		{
			errorStream.WriteLine(errMsgFormat, line, col, s);
		}

		public void Warning(string s)
		{
			errorStream.WriteLine(s);
		}
	}

	public class PathToken
	{
		public int Kind { get; set; }

		public string Value { get; set; }

		public PathToken Next { get; set; }

		public int Position { get; set; }
	}
	public abstract class StringScanner
	{
		private PathToken t;

		private char ch;

		private int pos;

		private PathToken tokens;

		private PathToken pt;

		private int tlen;

		private string str;

		protected abstract char[] SpecialSymbols { get; }

		protected abstract int[] SpecialSymbolTypes { get; }

		protected StringScanner(string str)
		{
			this.str = str;
			Init();
		}

		private void Init()
		{
			pos = -1;
			NextCh();
			pt = (tokens = new PathToken());
		}

		private void NextCh()
		{
			pos++;
			tlen++;
			if (pos < str.Length)
			{
				ch = str[pos];
			}
		}

		public PathToken Scan()
		{
			if (tokens.Next == null)
			{
				return NextToken();
			}
			pt = (tokens = tokens.Next);
			return tokens;
		}

		public PathToken Peek()
		{
			if (pt.Next == null)
			{
				do
				{
					PathToken pathToken = (pt.Next = NextToken());
					pt = pathToken;
				}
				while (pt.Kind > 9);
			}
			else
			{
				do
				{
					pt = pt.Next;
				}
				while (pt.Kind > 9);
			}
			return pt;
		}

		public void ResetPeek()
		{
			pt = tokens;
		}

		private PathToken NextToken()
		{
			t = new PathToken();
			t.Position = pos;
			tlen = 0;
			if (pos < str.Length)
			{
				int num = Array.IndexOf(SpecialSymbols, ch);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					t.Kind = SpecialSymbolTypes[num];
					NextCh();
				}
				else
				{
					while (pos < str.Length && Array.IndexOf(SpecialSymbols, ch) < 0)
					{
						if (ch == '\\' && pos < str.Length - 1)
						{
							NextCh();
						}
						NextCh();
					}
					t.Kind = 1;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				t.Kind = 0;
			}
			t.Value = str.Substring(t.Position, tlen);
			return t;
		}
	}

	public class FilterStringAccessService : IFilterStringAccessService
	{
		private SnapDocumentModel documentModel;

		public FilterStringAccessService(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
		}

		public string GetFilterString()
		{
			return GetFilterString(GetParsedInfo());
		}

		private SNListField GetParsedInfo()
		{
			SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
			Field selectedField = GetSelectedField();
			if (selectedField == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField(((DocumentModel)documentModel).Selection.PieceTable, selectedField) as SNListField;
		}

		private Field GetSelectedField()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			FieldController val = new FieldController();
			return val.FindFieldBySelection(((DocumentModel)documentModel).Selection).Parent;
		}

		public string GetFilterString(SNListField list)
		{
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			if (service == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			FieldPathInfo fieldPathInfo = service.FieldPathService.FromString(list.DataSourceName);
			FieldDataMemberInfoItem lastItem = fieldPathInfo.DataMemberInfo.LastItem;
			if (lastItem == null || !lastItem.HasFilters)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return lastItem.FilterProperties.Filters[lastItem.FilterProperties.Filters.Count - 1];
		}
	}
	public class SnapFieldDataService : IFieldDataService
	{
		private class ConvertToDoubleEnumerator : IEnumerator<double>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private IFieldContext parentDataContext;

			private IDataEnumerator dataEnumerator;

			public double Current => Convert.ToDouble(dataEnumerator.Current);

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public ConvertToDoubleEnumerator(SnapPieceTable pieceTable, IFieldDataAccessService fieldDataAccessService, IFieldContext parentDataContext, IDataEnumerator dataEnumerator)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pieceTable, "pieceTable");
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fieldDataAccessService, "fieldDataAccessService");
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)parentDataContext, "parentDataContext");
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataEnumerator, "dataEnumerator");
				this.dataEnumerator = dataEnumerator;
				this.parentDataContext = parentDataContext;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Dispose(disposing: true);
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			~ConvertToDoubleEnumerator()
			{
				Dispose(disposing: false);
			}

			protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					_ = parentDataContext;
				}
				parentDataContext = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return dataEnumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				dataEnumerator.Reset();
			}
		}

		public bool BoundMode => true;

		public object GetFieldValue(MailMergeProperties mailMergeProperties, string fieldName, bool mapFieldName, MailMergeDataMode options, PieceTable pieceTable, Field field)
		{
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			if (service == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldValueDescriptor = service.GetFieldValueDescriptor((SnapPieceTable)(object)pieceTable, field, fieldName, new FieldNameStringScanner(fieldName));
			object fieldValueCore = GetFieldValueCore(fieldValueDescriptor, service, fieldName, pieceTable);
			if (fieldValueCore != null && fieldValueCore != DBNull.Value && fieldValueCore != FieldNull.Value)
			{
				return fieldValueCore;
			}
			fieldValueDescriptor = service.GetFieldValueDescriptor((SnapPieceTable)(object)pieceTable, field, fieldName, new DataSourceNameStringScanner(fieldName));
			return GetFieldValueCore(fieldValueDescriptor, service, fieldName, pieceTable);
		}

		private object GetFieldValueCore(FieldDataValueDescriptor descriptor, IFieldDataAccessService fieldDataAccessService, string fieldName, PieceTable pieceTable)
		{
			ICalculationContext calculationContext = fieldDataAccessService.FieldContextService.BeginCalculation(((SnapDocumentModel)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel).DataSourceDispatcher);
			try
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName) && fieldName.Contains("."))
				{
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					if (calculationContext.FieldNames != null && calculationContext.FieldNames.Length != 0)
					{
						list.AddRange(calculationContext.FieldNames);
					}
					if (!list.Contains(fieldName))
					{
						list.Add(fieldName);
						calculationContext.FieldNames = list.ToArray();
					}
				}
				return calculationContext.GetRawValue(descriptor.ParentDataContext, descriptor.RelativePath);
			}
			finally
			{
				fieldDataAccessService.FieldContextService.EndCalculation(calculationContext);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<double> GetReferenceValuesEnumerator(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field, string reference)
		{
			if (reference.StartsWith("[") && reference.EndsWith("]"))
			{
				return GetReferenceValuesEnumeratorCore(pieceTable, field, reference.Substring(1, reference.Length - 2));
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerator<double> GetReferenceValuesEnumeratorCore(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SnapPieceTable pieceTable2 = (SnapPieceTable)(object)pieceTable;
			IFieldDataAccessService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel).GetService<IFieldDataAccessService>();
			if (service == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FieldDataValueDescriptor fieldValueDescriptor = service.GetFieldValueDescriptor(pieceTable2, field, fieldName, new DataSourceNameStringScanner(fieldName));
			IFieldContext parentDataContext = fieldValueDescriptor.ParentDataContext;
			ICalculationContext calculationContext = service.FieldContextService.BeginCalculation(((SnapDocumentModel)(object)pieceTable.DocumentModel).DataSourceDispatcher);
			try
			{
				IDataEnumerator childDataEnumerator = calculationContext.GetChildDataEnumerator(parentDataContext, fieldValueDescriptor.RelativePath);
				if (childDataEnumerator == null)
				{
					return (IEnumerator<double>)new SingleReferenceValueEnumerator(0.0);
				}
				return new ConvertToDoubleEnumerator(pieceTable2, service, parentDataContext, childDataEnumerator);
			}
			catch
			{
				service.FieldContextService.EndCalculation(calculationContext);
			}
			return (IEnumerator<double>)new SingleReferenceValueEnumerator(0.0);
		}
	}

	public class DataSourceNameCreationService : IDataSourceNameCreationService
	{
		private const string prefix = "Data Source ";

		private readonly SnapDocumentModel documentModel;

		public DataSourceNameCreationService(SnapDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
		}

		public string CreateName()
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo info in documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfos())
			{
				if (!documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.IsDefaultDataSource(info.DataSource))
				{
					hashSet.Add(info.DataSourceName);
				}
			}
			int num = 1;
			string text;
			do
			{
				text = string.Format("{0}{1}", "Data Source ", num);
				num++;
			}
			while (hashSet.Contains(text));
			return text;
		}

		public bool ValidateName(string name)
		{
			foreach (DataSourceInfo info in documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfos())
			{
				if (!documentModel.DataSourceDispatcher.IsDefaultDataSource(info.DataSource) && string.Equals(info.DataSourceName, name))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		{
			Series series = new Series();
			((ISupportInitialize)series).BeginInit();
			AddPoint(series, 0, 3);
			AddPoint(series, 1, 4);
			AddPoint(series, 2, 2);
			AddPoint(series, 3, 5);
			AddPoint(series, 4, 1);
			series.Tag = SNChart.DefaultSeriesTag;
			chart.Series.Add(series);
			((ISupportInitialize)series).EndInit();
		}

		private void AddPoint(Series series, int x, int y)
		{
			series.Points.Add(new SeriesPoint(x, y));
		}
	}

	{

		public void Add<TMouseHandlerState, TTableViewInfoController>() where TMouseHandlerState : MouseHandlerState where TTableViewInfoController : TableViewInfoController
		{
			((ObjectFactoryBase<MouseHandlerState, TableViewInfoController>)tableViewInfoControllers).Add<TMouseHandlerState, TTableViewInfoController>();
		}

		public void AddIfNotPresent<TMouseHandlerState, TTableViewInfoController>() where TMouseHandlerState : MouseHandlerState where TTableViewInfoController : TableViewInfoController
		{
			if (!((ObjectFactoryBase<MouseHandlerState, TableViewInfoController>)tableViewInfoControllers).Contains<TMouseHandlerState>())
			{
				((ObjectFactoryBase<MouseHandlerState, TableViewInfoController>)tableViewInfoControllers).Add<TMouseHandlerState, TTableViewInfoController>();

	public interface IThemeService
	{
		event EventHandler ThemesChanged;

		void BeginUpdate();

		void EndUpdate();

		void AddTheme(ThemeInfo theme);

		void RemoveTheme(ThemeInfo theme);

		IEnumerable<ThemeInfo> GetThemes();

		ThemeInfo GetDefaultTheme();
	}
	public class ThemeService : IThemeService
	{
		private const string defaultThemeCaption = "Casual";

		private List<ThemeInfo> themes = new List<ThemeInfo>();

		private EventHandler themesChanged;

		private int updateCount;

		public event EventHandler ThemesChanged
		{
			add
			{
				themesChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(themesChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				themesChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(themesChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public virtual void AddTheme(ThemeInfo theme)
		{
			themes.Add(theme);
			OnThemeChanged();
		}

		public virtual void RemoveTheme(ThemeInfo theme)
		{
			themes.Remove(theme);
			OnThemeChanged();
		}

		public virtual IEnumerable<ThemeInfo> GetThemes()
		{
			return themes;
		}

		public virtual ThemeInfo GetDefaultTheme()
		{
			foreach (ThemeInfo theme in themes)
			{
				if (theme.Caption == "Casual")
				{
					return theme;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void OnThemeChanged()
		{
			if (updateCount == 0 && themesChanged != null)
			{
				themesChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			updateCount++;
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			updateCount--;
			OnThemeChanged();
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public interface IDropFieldsService
	{
		bool CanDropContentOnField(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field);
	}
	public class SnapDropFieldsService : IDropFieldsService
	{
		public bool CanDropContentOnField(PieceTable pieceTable, Field field)
		{
			if (field == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			SnapFieldCalculatorService snapFieldCalculatorService = new SnapFieldCalculatorService();
			CalculatedFieldBase val = ((FieldCalculatorService)snapFieldCalculatorService).ParseField(pieceTable, field);
			return val is TemplatedFieldBase;
		}
	}

		{
			return DropFieldRoundHotZoneHoverCalculator.IsInRange(point, this);

	public class DropFieldRoundHotZoneHoverCalculator
	{
		public static bool IsInRange(Point mousePosition, DropFieldRoundHotZone hotZone)
		{
			float x = ((RoundHotZone)hotZone).Center.X;
			float y = ((RoundHotZone)hotZone).Center.Y;
			float num = mousePosition.X;
			float num2 = mousePosition.Y;
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(x - num, 2.0) + Math.Pow(y - num2, 2.0)) < (double)((RoundHotZone)hotZone).Radius;
		}
	}

		private void SetProperty<T>(Action<T> setter, T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			IDataSourceChangeManager dataSourceChangeManager = DataSourceDispatcher?.GetInfo(DataSourceName)?.ChangeManager;
			if (!ExcludeFromHistory && dataSourceChangeManager != null)
			{
				dataSourceChangeManager.SetProperty(setter, oldValue, newValue);
			}
			else
			{
				setter(newValue);
			}
		}

		private void ValidateName(string name)
		{
			if (!validate || IsValidName(name))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DataSourceDispatcher != null)
			{
				DataSourceDispatcher.ErrorHandler.HandleError(new ExtendedErrorInfo(ErrorType.InvalidCalculatedFieldName, name));
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		private bool IsValidName(string name)
		{
			if (!HasWrongCharacters(name))
			{
				return !ContainsName(name);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool HasWrongCharacters(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || (!char.IsLetter(name[0]) && name[0] != '_'))
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (char c in name)
			{
				if (!char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) && c != '_')
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ContainsName(string name)
		{
			if (DataSourceDispatcher == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ICalculatedField calculatedField in DataSourceDispatcher.GetCalculatedFields())
			{
				if (string.Compare(name, calculatedField.Name) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ValidateDataSourceName(string dataSourceName)
		{
			if (!validate || DataSourceDispatcher == null || string.Compare(dataSourceName, DataSourceDispatcher.DefaultDataSourceName) == 0 || DataSourceDispatcher.GetDataSource(dataSourceName) != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataSourceDispatcher.ErrorHandler.HandleError(new ExtendedErrorInfo(ErrorType.InvalidDataSourceName, dataSourceName));
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		private bool ValidateExpression(string value)
		{
			if (!validate)
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				CriteriaOperator.Parse(value, (object[])null);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (DataSourceDispatcher != null)
				{
					CriteriaParserException ex2 = (CriteriaParserException)(object)((ex is CriteriaParserException) ? ex : null);
					if (ex2 != null)
					{
						DataSourceDispatcher.ErrorHandler.HandleError(new ExtendedErrorInfo(ErrorType.FilterCriteriaInvalidExpression, new int[2]
						{
							ex2.Line + 1,
							ex2.Column
						}));
					}
					else
					{
						DataSourceDispatcher.ErrorHandler.HandleError(ErrorType.FilterCriteriaInvalidExpressionEx);
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				OnDisposed();
			}
		}

		~CalculatedField()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public CalculatedField Clone()
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CalculatedField calculatedField = new CalculatedField(dataMember);
			calculatedField.name = name;
			calculatedField.fieldType = fieldType;
			calculatedField.expression = expression;
			calculatedField.dataSourceName = dataSourceName;
			calculatedField.DataSourceDispatcher = DataSourceDispatcher;
			return calculatedField;
		}

		string IDisplayNamePropertyContainer.GetDisplayPropertyValue(string source)
		{
			return CriteriaFieldNameConverter.ToDisplayNames(this, source);
		}

		string IDisplayNamePropertyContainer.GetRealPropertyValue(string source)
		{
			return CriteriaFieldNameConverter.ToRealNames(this, source);
		}

	public static class CriteriaFieldNameConverter
	{
		public static string ToDisplayNames(CalculatedField calculatedField, string source)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source))
			{
				return source;
			}
			DataSourceInfo info = calculatedField.DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(calculatedField.DataSourceName);
			if (info == null)
			{
				return source;
			}
			using DataContextProvider dataContextProvider = new DataContextProvider(info.CalculatedFields);
			return ToDisplayNames(dataContextProvider.DataContext, info.DataSource, calculatedField.DataMember ?? string.Empty, source);
		}

		public static string ToRealNames(CalculatedField calculatedField, string source)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source))
			{
				return source;
			}
			DataSourceInfo info = calculatedField.DataSourceDispatcher.GetInfo(calculatedField.DataSourceName);
			if (info == null)
			{
				return source;
			}
			using DataContextProvider dataContextProvider = new DataContextProvider(info.CalculatedFields);
			return ToRealNames(dataContextProvider.DataContext, info.DataSource, calculatedField.DataMember ?? string.Empty, source);
		}

		public static string ToDisplayNames(XRDataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, string source)
		{
			return Convert(source, (FilterStringVisitorBase)(object)new DisplayNameFilterStringVisitor(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember));
		}

		public static string ToRealNames(XRDataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, string source)
		{
			return Convert(source, (FilterStringVisitorBase)(object)new RealNameFilterStringVisitor(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember));
		}

		private static string Convert(string source, FilterStringVisitorBase visitor)
		{
			return CriteriaFieldNameConverterCore.Convert(source, visitor);
		}

		private static string EscapeFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			return fieldName.Replace("]", "\\]");
		}

		private static string CorrectBackRefs(string src, string replacement)
		{
			int depth = GetDepth(src);
			int depth2 = GetDepth(replacement);
			if (depth >= depth2)
			{
				return replacement;
			}
			return replacement.Substring(depth2 - depth);
		}

		private static int GetDepth(string s)
		{
			int i;
			for (i = 0; s.IndexOf("^.", i) == i; i += 2)
			{
			}
			return i;
		}
	}

	public class DisplayNameFilterStringVisitor : FilterStringVisitorBase
	{
		private XRDataContextBase dataContext;

		private object dataSource;

		private string dataMember;

		public DisplayNameFilterStringVisitor(XRDataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{

			this.dataSource = dataSource;

		}
	}

	{
		private XRDataContextBase dataContext;

		private object dataSource;

		private string dataMember;

		public RealNameFilterStringVisitor(XRDataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			this.dataContext = dataContext;
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
		}

		}
	}
	public static class EmbeddedFieldsHelper
	{
		public static string GetShortFieldDisplayName(XRDataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, string fieldName)
		{
			string text = BindingHelper.JoinStrings(".", dataMember, fieldName);
			string dataMemberDisplayName = ((DataContext)dataContext).GetDataMemberDisplayName(dataSource, dataMember, text);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberDisplayName))
			{
				return dataMemberDisplayName;
			}
			return fieldName;
		}

		public static string GetShortFieldRealName(XRDataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, string displayName)
		{
			string dataMemberFromDisplayName = dataContext.GetDataMemberFromDisplayName(dataSource, dataMember, displayName);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberFromDisplayName))
			{
				return displayName;
			}
			return GetColumnName(dataMember, dataMemberFromDisplayName);
		}

		public static string GetColumnName(string reportDataMember, string dataMember)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(reportDataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ParametersReplacer.GetParameterName(dataMember)))
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			string text = reportDataMember + ".";
			if (dataMember.StartsWith(text))
			{
				return dataMember.Remove(0, text.Length);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(CollectionTypeConverter))]
	public class CalculatedFieldCollection : BindingList<CalculatedField>
	{
		internal IDataSourceChangeManager ChangeManager { get; set; }

		protected internal event EventHandler<CalculatedFieldEventArgs> CalculatedFieldAdding;

		private void RaiseCalculatedFieldAdding(CalculatedField field)
		{
			this.CalculatedFieldAdding?.Invoke(this, new CalculatedFieldEventArgs(field));
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			if (ChangeManager != null)
			{
				ChangeManager.InsertCalculatedField(this, index, item);
			}
			else
			{
				InsertItemCore(index, item);
			}
		}

		internal void InsertItemCore(int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			item.Disposed += OnItemDisposed;
			RaiseCalculatedFieldAdding(item);
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			if (ChangeManager != null)
			{
				ChangeManager.RemoveCalculatedField(this, index);
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveItemCore(index);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveItemCore(int index)
		{
			CalculatedField calculatedField = base[index];
			calculatedField.Disposed -= OnItemDisposed;
			calculatedField.DataSourceDispatcher = null;
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			if (ChangeManager != null)
			{
				ChangeManager.SetCalculatedField(this, index, item);
			}
			else
			{
				SetItemCore(index, item);
			}
		}

		internal void SetItemCore(int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			if (ChangeManager != null)
			{
				ChangeManager.ClearCalculatedFields(this);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearItemsCore();
			}
		}

		internal void ClearItemsCore()
		{
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		public void AddRangeByValue(IList calculatedFields)
		{
			foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in calculatedFields)
			{
				Add(calculatedField.Clone());
			}
		}

		private void OnItemDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Remove((CalculatedField)sender);
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			ChangeManager?.BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			ChangeManager?.EndUpdate();
		}
	}
	public class DataSourceInfo : IDataSourceOwner, ICloneable<DataSourceInfo>
	{
		private readonly bool isDataSourceInternal;

		private CalculatedFieldCollection fCalculatedFields;

		private object dataSource;

		private string dataSourceName;

		private EventHandler onDataSourceNameChanged;

		internal IDataSourceChangeManager ChangeManager { get; set; }

		[Description("")]
		public string DataSourceName
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSourceName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(DataSourceName == value))
				{
					if (ChangeManager != null)
					{
						ChangeManager.ChangeDataSourceName(this, value);
					}
					else
					{
						SetDataSourceName(value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[AttributeProvider(typeof(IListSource))]
		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSource != value)
				{
					if (ChangeManager != null)
					{
						ChangeManager.ChangeDataSource(this, value);
					}
					else
					{
						SetDataSource(value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.Snap.Extensions.Native.CalculatedFieldCollectionEditor, DevExpress.Snap.v23.2.Extensions", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		public CalculatedFieldCollection CalculatedFields => fCalculatedFields;

		internal bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceName))
				{
					return dataSource == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDataSourceInternal => isDataSourceInternal;

		internal event DataSourceChangedEventHandler DataSourceChanged;

		internal event EventHandler DataSourceNameChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onDataSourceNameChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onDataSourceNameChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onDataSourceNameChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onDataSourceNameChanged, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal event EventHandler<CalculatedFieldEventArgs> CalculatedFieldAdding;

		public DataSourceInfo(string dataSourceName, object dataSource)
			: this(dataSourceName, dataSource, isDataSourceInternal: false)
		{
		}

		public DataSourceInfo()
			: this(isDataSourceInternal: false)
		{
		}

		internal DataSourceInfo(string dataSourceName, object dataSource, bool isDataSourceInternal)
			: this(isDataSourceInternal)
		{
			DataSourceName = dataSourceName;
			DataSource = dataSource;
		}

		internal DataSourceInfo(bool isDataSourceInternal)
		{
			this.isDataSourceInternal = isDataSourceInternal;
			InitCalculatedFields();
		}

		internal void SetDataSourceName(string value)
		{
			dataSourceName = value;
			RaiseDataSourceNameChanged();
		}

		internal void SetDataSource(object value)
		{
			dataSource = value;
			RaiseDataSourceChanged(DataSourceChangeType.DataSource);
		}

		private void RaiseDataSourceNameChanged()
		{
			onDataSourceNameChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void InitCalculatedFields()
		{
			fCalculatedFields = new CalculatedFieldCollection();
			fCalculatedFields.ListChanged += OnCalculatedFieldsListChanged;
			fCalculatedFields.CalculatedFieldAdding += OnCalculatedFieldAdding;
		}

		private void OnCalculatedFieldsListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseDataSourceChanged(DataSourceChangeType.CalculatedFields);
		}

		private void RaiseDataSourceChanged(DataSourceChangeType dataSourceChangeType)
		{
			if (this.DataSourceChanged != null)
			{
				this.DataSourceChanged(this, new DataSourceChangedEventArgs(this, dataSourceChangeType));
			}
		}

		private void OnCalculatedFieldAdding(object sender, CalculatedFieldEventArgs e)
		{
			this.CalculatedFieldAdding?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddCalculatedFieldWithReplace(CalculatedField calculatedField)
		{
			int count = fCalculatedFields.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (fCalculatedFields[i].Name == calculatedField.Name && fCalculatedFields[i].DataMember == calculatedField.DataMember)
				{
					fCalculatedFields.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
			fCalculatedFields.Add(calculatedField);
		}

		public DataSourceInfo Clone()
		{
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = new DataSourceInfo(dataSourceName, dataSource, isDataSourceInternal);
			foreach (CalculatedField calculatedField in CalculatedFields)
			{
				dataSourceInfo.CalculatedFields.Add(calculatedField.Clone());
			}
			return dataSourceInfo;
		}
	}
	public class DataSourceInfoCollection : Collection<DataSourceInfo>, IDataSourceChangeManager, IDataSourceInfoContainer, IDisposable
	{
		internal const string DefaultDataSourceInfoName = "";

		private readonly IComponent component;

		private EventHandler collectionChanged;

		private DataSourceChangedEventHandler dataSourceChanged;

		private EventHandler<DataSourceRemovedEventArgs> dataSourceRemoved;

		private DataSourceNameChangedEventHandler onDataSourceNameChanged;

		[Description("")]
		public DataSourceInfo DefaultDataSourceInfo
		{
			get
			{
				DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = this[""];
				if (dataSourceInfo == null)
				{
					SetDefaultDataSource(null);
					dataSourceInfo = this[""];
				}
				return dataSourceInfo;
			}
		}

		public DataSourceInfo this[string dataSourceName]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<DataSourceInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						DataSourceInfo current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.DataSourceName == dataSourceName)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal string MailMergeDataSourceName { get; set; }

		protected internal bool MailMergeMode { get; set; }

		[Description("")]
		public event EventHandler CollectionChanged
		{
			add
			{
				collectionChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(collectionChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				collectionChanged = Delegate.Remove(collectionChanged, value) as EventHandler;
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public event DataSourceChangedEventHandler DataSourceChanged
		{
			add
			{
				dataSourceChanged = (DataSourceChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(dataSourceChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				dataSourceChanged = Delegate.Remove(dataSourceChanged, value) as DataSourceChangedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public event EventHandler<DataSourceRemovedEventArgs> DataSourceRemoved
		{
			add
			{
				dataSourceRemoved = (EventHandler<DataSourceRemovedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(dataSourceRemoved, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				dataSourceRemoved = (EventHandler<DataSourceRemovedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(dataSourceRemoved, value);
			}
		}

		internal event DataSourceNameChangedEventHandler DataSourceNameChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onDataSourceNameChanged = (DataSourceNameChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onDataSourceNameChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onDataSourceNameChanged = (DataSourceNameChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onDataSourceNameChanged, value);
			}
		}

		internal event EventHandler<DataSourceAddedEventArgs> DataSourceAdded;

		protected internal event EventHandler<CalculatedFieldEventArgs> CalculatedFieldAdding;

		internal DataSourceInfoCollection(bool createDefaultDataSource, IComponent component)
		{
			this.component = component;
			if (createDefaultDataSource)
			{
				CreateDefaultDataSource();
			}
		}

		public DataSourceInfoCollection()
			: this(createDefaultDataSource: true, null)
		{
		}

		protected internal void RaiseCollectionChanged()
		{
			if (collectionChanged != null)
			{
				collectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseNamedDataSourceChanged(DataSourceInfo changedDataSourceInfo, DataSourceChangeType changeType)
		{
			if (dataSourceChanged != null)
			{
				dataSourceChanged(this, new DataSourceChangedEventArgs(changedDataSourceInfo, changeType));
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseDataSourceRemoved(DataSourceInfo item)
		{
			if (dataSourceRemoved != null)
			{
				dataSourceRemoved(this, new DataSourceRemovedEventArgs(item, item.IsDataSourceInternal));
			}
		}

		private void RaiseDataSourceNameChanged(DataSourceInfo changedDataSourceInfo)
		{
			onDataSourceNameChanged?.Invoke(this, new DataSourceNameChangedEventArgs(changedDataSourceInfo));
		}

		private void RaiseDataSourceAdded(DataSourceInfo info)
		{
			this.DataSourceAdded?.Invoke(this, new DataSourceAddedEventArgs(info));
		}

		[GeneratedCode("Suppress FxCop check", "")]
		public bool IsDefaultDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			DataSourceInfo info = GetInfo(dataSource);
			if (info == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.Equals(info.DataSourceName, "");
		}

		internal void CreateDefaultDataSource()
		{
			InsertItemCore(0, new DataSourceInfo("", null));
		}

		internal DataSourceInfo SetDefaultDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			int dataSourceInfoIndex = GetDataSourceInfoIndex("");
			if (dataSourceInfoIndex < 0)
			{
				return Add("", dataSource);
			}
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = base[dataSourceInfoIndex];
			dataSourceInfo.DataSource = dataSource;
			return dataSourceInfo;
		}

		public DataSourceInfo GetInfo(object dataSource)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<DataSourceInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataSourceInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.DataSource == dataSource)
					{
						return current;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public CalculatedFieldCollection GetCalculatedFieldsByDataSourceName(string dataSourceName)
		{
			return this[dataSourceName]?.CalculatedFields;
		}

		public CalculatedFieldCollection GetCalculatedFieldsByDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			return GetInfo(dataSource)?.CalculatedFields;
		}

		public string GetDataSourceNameByDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			return GetInfo(dataSource)?.DataSourceName;
		}

		public object GetDataSourceByName(string name)
		{
			return this[name]?.DataSource;
		}

		public void Remove(string name)
		{
			if (MailMergeMode && string.Compare(name, MailMergeDataSourceName) == 0)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidRemoveDataSource);
			}
			int dataSourceInfoIndex = GetDataSourceInfoIndex(name);
			if (dataSourceInfoIndex >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(dataSourceInfoIndex);
			}
		}

		public DataSourceInfo Add(string name, object dataSource)
		{
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = new DataSourceInfo(name, dataSource);
			Add(dataSourceInfo);
			return dataSourceInfo;
		}

		public IList<ICalculatedField> GetCalculatedFields()
		{
			List<ICalculatedField> list = new List<ICalculatedField>();
			using IEnumerator<DataSourceInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DataSourceInfo current = enumerator.Current;
				list.AddRange((IEnumerable<ICalculatedField>)current.CalculatedFields);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IList<object> GetDataSources()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			using IEnumerator<DataSourceInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DataSourceInfo current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.DataSource != null)
				{
					list.Add(current.DataSource);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal void AddWithReplace(DataSourceInfo item)
		{
			int dataSourceInfoIndex = GetDataSourceInfoIndex(item.DataSourceName);
			if (dataSourceInfoIndex < 0)
			{
				InsertItemCore(base.Count, item);
			}
			else
			{
				SetItemCore(dataSourceInfoIndex, item);
			}
		}

		protected internal int GetDataSourceInfoIndex(string name)
		{
			for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (base[num].DataSourceName == name)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, DataSourceInfo item)
		{
			InsertItemCore(index, item);
		}

		internal void InsertItemCore(int index, DataSourceInfo item)
		{
			bool flag = IsDesignMode();
			int dataSourceInfoIndex = GetDataSourceInfoIndex(item.DataSourceName);
			if (dataSourceInfoIndex >= 0)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					SnapExceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(SnapStringId.Msg_DataSourceNameExists);
				}
				else
				{
					base[dataSourceInfoIndex] = item;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
			}
			SubscribeDataSourceInfoEvents(item);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
			RaiseDataSourceAdded(item);
			item.CalculatedFieldAdding += OnCalculatedFieldAdding;
		}

		private bool IsDesignMode()
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (component.Site != null)
			{
				return component.Site.DesignMode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnCalculatedFieldAdding(object sender, CalculatedFieldEventArgs e)
		{
			this.CalculatedFieldAdding?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			List<DataSourceInfo> list = new List<DataSourceInfo>();
			using (IEnumerator<DataSourceInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataSourceInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					UnsubscribeDataSourceInfoEvents(current);
					list.Add(current);
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
			foreach (DataSourceInfo item in list)
			{
				RaiseDataSourceRemoved(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			RemoveItemCore(index);
		}

		internal void RemoveItemCore(int index)
		{
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = base[index];
			UnsubscribeDataSourceInfoEvents(dataSourceInfo);
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
			RaiseDataSourceRemoved(dataSourceInfo);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, DataSourceInfo item)
		{
			SetItemCore(index, item);
		}

		internal void SetItemCore(int index, DataSourceInfo item)
		{
			int dataSourceInfoIndex = GetDataSourceInfoIndex(item.DataSourceName);
			if (dataSourceInfoIndex >= 0 && dataSourceInfoIndex != index)
			{
				SnapExceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(SnapStringId.Msg_DataSourceNameExists);
			}
			DataSourceInfo dataSourceInfo = base[index];
			UnsubscribeDataSourceInfoEvents(dataSourceInfo);
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			SubscribeDataSourceInfoEvents(item);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
			RaiseDataSourceRemoved(dataSourceInfo);
			RaiseDataSourceAdded(item);
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeDataSourceInfoEvents(DataSourceInfo info)
		{
			info.ChangeManager = this;
			info.CalculatedFields.ChangeManager = this;
			info.DataSourceChanged += OnDataSourceChanged;
			info.DataSourceNameChanged += OnDataSourceNameChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeDataSourceInfoEvents(DataSourceInfo info)
		{
			info.ChangeManager = null;
			info.CalculatedFields.ChangeManager = null;
			info.DataSourceChanged -= OnDataSourceChanged;
			info.DataSourceNameChanged -= OnDataSourceNameChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void OnDataSourceChanged(object sender, DataSourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DataSourceInfo changedDataSourceInfo = (DataSourceInfo)sender;
			RaiseNamedDataSourceChanged(changedDataSourceInfo, e.DataSourceChangeType);
		}

		private void OnDataSourceNameChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseDataSourceNameChanged((DataSourceInfo)sender);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~DataSourceInfoCollection()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				collectionChanged = null;
				dataSourceChanged = null;
				Clear();
				dataSourceRemoved = null;
			}
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.ChangeDataSource(DataSourceInfo info, object dataSource)
		{
			ChangeDataSourceCore(info, dataSource);
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeDataSourceCore(DataSourceInfo info, object dataSource)
		{
			info.SetDataSource(dataSource);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.ChangeDataSourceName(DataSourceInfo info, string name)
		{
			ChangeDataSourceNameCore(info, name);
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeDataSourceNameCore(DataSourceInfo info, string name)
		{
			info.SetDataSourceName(name);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.InsertCalculatedField(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields, int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			InsertCalculatedFieldCore(calculatedFields, index, item);
		}

		protected virtual void InsertCalculatedFieldCore(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields, int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			calculatedFields.InsertItemCore(index, item);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.RemoveCalculatedField(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields, int index)
		{
			RemoveCalculatedFieldCore(calculatedFields, index);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveCalculatedFieldCore(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields, int index)
		{
			calculatedFields.RemoveItemCore(index);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.SetProperty<T>(Action<T> setter, T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			SetPropertyCore(setter, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected virtual void SetPropertyCore<T>(Action<T> setter, T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			setter(newValue);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.SetCalculatedField(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields, int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			SetCalculatedFieldCore(calculatedFields, index, item);
		}

		protected virtual void SetCalculatedFieldCore(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields, int index, CalculatedField item)
		{
			calculatedFields.SetItemCore(index, item);
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.ClearCalculatedFields(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields)
		{
			ClearCalculatedFieldsCore(calculatedFields);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearCalculatedFieldsCore(CalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields)
		{
			calculatedFields.ClearItemsCore();
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.BeginUpdate()
		{
			BeginUpdateCore();
		}

		protected virtual void BeginUpdateCore()
		{
		}

		void IDataSourceChangeManager.EndUpdate()
		{
			EndUpdateCore();
		}

		protected virtual void EndUpdateCore()
		{
		}
	}

		}
	}

		}
	}

	public interface SnapDocument : Document, SubDocument, SnapSubDocument, ISnapFieldOwner, IDataSourceOwner

	public abstract class SnListBasedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private SnapSubDocument subDocument;

		private Field targetField;

		private SnapList targetList;

		protected SnListBasedEventArgs(SnapSubDocument subDocument, Field targetField)
		{
			this.subDocument = subDocument;
			this.targetField = targetField;
		}

		protected SnapList GetTargetList()
		{
			if (targetList == null)
			{
				targetList = subDocument.ParseField(targetField) as SnapList;
			}
			return targetList;
		}
	}

	public class DataFieldInfo
	{
		[Description("")]
		public object DataSource { get; set; }

		[Description("")]
		public string[] DataPaths { get; set; }

		[Description("")]
		public string DisplayName { get; set; }

		public DataFieldInfo(object dataSource, string[] dataPaths, string displayName)
		{
			DataSource = dataSource;
			DataPaths = dataPaths;
			DisplayName = displayName;
		}

		public DataFieldInfo(object dataSource, string[] dataPaths)
			: this(dataSource, dataPaths, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public DataFieldInfo(object dataSource, string dataMember)
			: this(dataSource, dataMember, dataMember)
		{
		}

		public DataFieldInfo(object dataSource, string dataMember, string displayName)
			: this(dataSource, new string[1] { dataMember }, displayName)
		{
		}

		internal DataFieldInfo(SNDataInfo dataInfo)
		{
			DataSource = ((DataPair)dataInfo).Source;
			DataPaths = (string[])dataInfo.DataPaths.Clone();
			DisplayName = ((DataInfo)dataInfo).DisplayName;
		}

		internal SNDataInfo ToSNDataInfo()
		{
			return new SNDataInfo(DataSource, DataPaths, DisplayName);
		}
	}

	public class PrepareSnListColumnsEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.PrepareSnListColumnsEventArgs innerE;

		private InnerRichEditDocumentServer server;

		private SnapDocument header;

		private SnapDocument body;

		public SnapDocument Header
		{
			get
			{
				if (header == null)
				{
					if (innerE.Header == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					header = new SnapNativeDocument((SnapPieceTable)(object)innerE.Header.MainPieceTable, server);
				}
				return header;
			}
		}

		public SnapDocument Body
		{
			get
			{
				if (body == null)
				{
					if (innerE.Body == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					body = new SnapNativeDocument((SnapPieceTable)(object)innerE.Body.MainPieceTable, server);
				}
				return body;
			}
		}

		internal PrepareSnListColumnsEventArgs(DevExpress.Snap.Core.Native.PrepareSnListColumnsEventArgs e, InnerRichEditDocumentServer server)
		{
			innerE = e;
			this.server = server;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter("DevExpress.XtraReports.Design.ParameterValueEditorChangingConverter,DevExpress.Utils.v23.2.UI")]
	public class Parameter : IParameter, IFilterParameter, INotifyPropertyChanged, IComponent, IDisposable
	{
		private static readonly Type defaultType = typeof(string);

		private readonly ISite site;

		private Type type;

		private object value;

		private string name = string.Empty;

		private PropertyChangedEventHandler onPropertyChanged;

		[Description("")]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		[Category("Design")]
		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.Compare(name, value) != 0)
				{
					ValidateName(value);
					SetProperty(delegate(string v)
					{
						name = v;
						OnPropertyChanged("Name");
					}, name, value);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[TypeConverter("DevExpress.XtraReports.Design.ParameterTypeConverter,DevExpress.Utils.v23.2.UI")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public Type Type
		{
			get
			{
				return type ?? defaultType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (type == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				SetProperty(delegate(Type v)
				{
					type = v;
					if (ParameterHelper.ShouldConvertValue(Value, Type))
					{
						Value = ParameterHelper.ConvertFrom(Value, Type, DefaultValue);
					}
					OnPropertyChanged("Type");
				}, type, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value ?? DefaultValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(Value, value))
				{
					SetProperty(delegate(object v)
					{
						this.value = v;
						OnPropertyChanged("Value");
					}, this.value, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private object DefaultValue => ParameterHelper.GetDefaultValue(Type);

		internal IParameterChangeManager ChangeManager { get; set; }

		internal bool ExcludeFromHistory { get; set; }

		ISite IComponent.Site
		{
			get
			{
				return site;
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onPropertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onPropertyChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onPropertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onPropertyChanged, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public event EventHandler Disposed;

		public Parameter()
		{
			site = new ParameterSite(this);
		}

		public Parameter Clone()
		{
			Parameter parameter = new Parameter();
			parameter.name = Name;
			parameter.type = Type;
			parameter.value = Value;
			return parameter;
		}

		private void ValidateName(string name)
		{
			if (SnapControlCompatibility.DisableParameterNameValidation)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ParametersErrorNoName));
			}
			string message = SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ParametersErrorInvalidCharacters) + name;
			foreach (char c in name)
			{
				if (!CriteriaLexer.CanContinueColumn(c))
				{
					Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(message);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (onPropertyChanged != null)
			{
				onPropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void SetProperty<T>(Action<T> setter, T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			if (!ExcludeFromHistory && ChangeManager != null)
			{
				ChangeManager.BeginUpdate();
				ChangeManager.SetProperty(setter, oldValue, newValue);
				ChangeManager.EndUpdate();
			}
			else
			{
				setter(newValue);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~Parameter()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				OnDisposed();
			}
		}

		private void OnDisposed()
		{
			this.Disposed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}
	}

	}
	[Editor("DevExpress.Snap.Extensions.Native.ParameterCollectionEditor, DevExpress.Snap.v23.2.Extensions", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class ParameterCollection : BindingList<Parameter>, IList<IParameter>, ICollection<IParameter>, IEnumerable<IParameter>, IEnumerable, IList<IFilterParameter>, ICollection<IFilterParameter>, IEnumerable<IFilterParameter>
	{
		public Parameter this[string parameterName] => GetByName(parameterName);

		IParameter IList<IParameter>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (IParameter)(object)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = (Parameter)(object)value;
			}
		}

		int ICollection<IParameter>.Count => base.Count;

		bool ICollection<IParameter>.IsReadOnly => ((IList)this).IsReadOnly;

		IFilterParameter IList<IFilterParameter>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (IFilterParameter)(object)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = (Parameter)(object)value;
			}
		}

		int ICollection<IFilterParameter>.Count => base.Count;

		bool ICollection<IFilterParameter>.IsReadOnly => ((IList)this).IsReadOnly;

		internal Parameter GetByName(string parameterName)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<Parameter> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Parameter current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.Name == parameterName)
					{
						return current;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void AddRange(Parameter[] parameters)
		{
			AddRangeCore(parameters, clone: false);
		}

		public void AddRangeByValue(IList parameters)
		{
			AddRangeCore(parameters, clone: true);
		}

		protected internal void AddRangeCore(IList parameters, bool clone)
		{
			foreach (Parameter parameter in parameters)
			{
				Parameter item = (clone ? parameter.Clone() : parameter);
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<IParameter> IEnumerable<IParameter>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (Parameter item in base.Items)
			{
				yield return (IParameter)(object)item;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<IFilterParameter> IEnumerable<IFilterParameter>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (Parameter item in base.Items)
			{
				yield return (IFilterParameter)(object)item;
			}
		}

		int IList<IParameter>.IndexOf(IParameter item)
		{
			return IndexOf((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void IList<IParameter>.Insert(int index, IParameter item)
		{
			Insert(index, (Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void IList<IParameter>.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		void ICollection<IParameter>.Add(IParameter item)
		{
			Add((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void ICollection<IParameter>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<IParameter>.Contains(IParameter item)
		{
			return Contains((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void ICollection<IParameter>.CopyTo(IParameter[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			CopyToCore((IFilterParameter[])(object)array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<IParameter>.Remove(IParameter item)
		{
			return Remove((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		int IList<IFilterParameter>.IndexOf(IFilterParameter item)
		{
			return IndexOf((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void IList<IFilterParameter>.Insert(int index, IFilterParameter item)
		{
			Insert(index, (Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void ICollection<IFilterParameter>.Add(IFilterParameter item)
		{
			Add((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void ICollection<IFilterParameter>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<IFilterParameter>.Contains(IFilterParameter item)
		{
			return Contains((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		void ICollection<IFilterParameter>.CopyTo(IFilterParameter[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			CopyToCore(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		private void CopyToCore(IFilterParameter[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			Parameter[] array2 = new Parameter[array.Length];
			CopyTo(array2, arrayIndex);
			array2.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<IFilterParameter>.Remove(IFilterParameter item)
		{
			return Remove((Parameter)(object)item);
		}

		internal IParameterService GetParameterService()
		{
			return new ParameterService(this);
		}
	}
	public class ParameterService : IParameterService
	{
		private readonly ParameterCollection parameters;

		public string AddParameterString => SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ParameterService_AddParameter);

		public string CreateParameterString => SnapLocalizer.GetString(SnapStringId.ParameterService_CreateParameter);

		public bool CanCreateParameters => true;

		public IEnumerable<IParameter> Parameters => parameters;

		public ParameterService(ParameterCollection parameters)
		{
			this.parameters = parameters;
		}

		public void AddParameter(IParameter parameter)
		{
			parameters.Add((Parameter)(object)parameter);
		}

		public IParameter CreateParameter(Type type)
		{
			return (IParameter)(object)new Parameter
			{
				Type = type,
				Name = NameHelper.GetParameterName(parameters)
			};
		}
	}
